Cutting-edge chips such as Blackwell are off-limits, based on the theory that labs without access to the best hardware can’t build the best AI. Officials have accused Chinese companies of getting the chips anyway, though they have not offered much evidence yet. If DePue’s analysis holds up, it would confirm that the wall around the U.S.’s best hardware has a side door, and some of China’s top labs have found the way in.
paras.zh: 美国对中国的芯片出口理应受到严格监管。 Blackwell 等尖端芯片是禁区，因为没有最好硬件的实验室无法构建最好的人工智能。官员们指责中国公司无论如何都获得了这些芯片，尽管他们尚未提供太多证据。如果德普的分析成立，将证实美国最好的硬件周围有侧门，而中国的一些顶级实验室已经找到了进入的方法。

paras.en: The detective work is possible because of a quirk in the way a model gets its weights, the billions of numbers that collectively decide how to respond to any given prompt. Before a model sees any data at all, its weights start out as seemingly random numbers. Training slowly nudges these values toward their final form, which miraculously encodes the information and writing patterns in the data. Not all weights are nudged the same, though. “There are some specific weights in a language model that actually don’t change that much at all throughout training,” says Rohith Kuditipudi, a recent Ph.D. graduate in computer science from Stanford University.
paras.zh: 侦探工作之所以成为可能，是因为模型获取权重的方式有一个怪癖，数十亿个数字共同决定如何响应任何给定的提示。在模型看到任何数据之前，它的权重最初是看似随机的数字。训练慢慢地将这些值推向最终形式，从而奇迹般地对数据中的信息和书写模式进行编码。不过，并非所有的重量都受到相同的推动。 “语言模型中有一些特定的权重，实际上在整个训练过程中根本不会发生太大变化，”最近获得博士学位的 Rohith Kuditipudi 说。毕业于斯坦福大学计算机科学专业。

paras.en: “The model doesn’t have to go that far in this crazy dimensional space to get to the final model that speaks English,” DePue says. “Because it’s not moving that far, that initialization is still stuck in the weights.”
paras.zh: “模型不必在这个疯狂的维度空间中走那么远就能得到会说英语的最终模型，”德普说。 “因为它没有移动那么远，所以初始化仍然停留在权重中。”

paras.en: Those starting numbers aren’t truly random. Training software begins with a single number, called a seed, and feeds it to an algorithm that spins out a long string of random-looking values, one for each of the billions of weights. For efficiency, the work of generating them is split across the chip’s many processors. It just so happens that the way this work is split depends on the specific chip used.
paras.zh: 这些起始数字并不是真正随机的。训练软件从一个称为种子的数字开始，并将其输入算法，生成一长串看似随机的值，每个值代表数十亿个权重。为了提高效率，生成它们的工作被分散到芯片的许多处理器上。恰好，这项工作的划分方式取决于所使用的具体芯片。

paras.en: A graphics processing unit, or GPU, the kind of chip used to train and run AI models, is made up of many processors that can all work at once. But “the hardware itself can’t run a million things,” says Tor Aamodt, a computer engineering professor at the University of British Columbia, who consults for Nvidia. Here the million things are random numbers, each headed for its own slot in the model-to-be. The question for the GPU, he says, becomes “How do you take the million and run it on something that has much less?”
paras.zh: 图形处理单元（GPU）是一种用于训练和运行人工智能模型的芯片，由许多可以同时工作的处理器组成。但“硬件本身无法运行一百万个东西”，不列颠哥伦比亚大学计算机工程教授、英伟达顾问托尔·阿莫特 (Tor Aamodt) 说。这里的一百万个事物都是随机数，每个事物都在未来的模型中走向自己的位置。他说，GPU 面临的问题是“如何将这 100 百万美元运行在资源少得多的东西上？”

paras.en: Different generations of hardware have slightly different definitions of “much less,” though. The specific Hopper chips in question have 132 of these processors, which Nvidia calls streaming multiprocessors; the Blackwell chips have 148 or 152, depending on the version. Feed each the same seed, and the same random numbers land in different places depending on the chip type. By sifting through some six trillion combinations of seed and chip layout, DePue found the ones that reproduced the barely moved weights in each model he could read, revealing which kind of chip most likely laid down its starting point. The same hardware probably did the training, too, though the fingerprint alone can’t prove that. Nor can it say how the four Chinese labs gained access to Blackwell chips or where the chips sat—in a server room in China or a rented rack abroad—and DePue is careful not to claim proof of lawbreaking. But by his rough estimate, building these models took thousands of the chips.
paras.zh: 不过，不同代的硬件对“少得多”的定义略有不同。所讨论的特定 Hopper 芯片有 132 个这样的处理器，Nvidia 将其称为流式多处理器； Blackwell 芯片有 148 或 152，具体取决于版本。为每个种子提供相同的种子，并且根据芯片类型，相同的随机数会落在不同的位置。通过筛选大约六万亿种种子和芯片布局的组合，DePue 找到了在他能读取的每个模型中重现几乎没有移动的权重的组合，从而揭示了哪种芯片最有可能奠定了其起点。相同的硬件可能也进行了训练，尽管仅凭指纹无法证明这一点。它也不能说明这四个中国实验室是如何获得 Blackwell 芯片的，也不能说明这些芯片位于中国的服务器机房或国外租用的机架中，而且 DePue 小心翼翼地不声称存在违法行为。但根据他的粗略估计，构建这些模型需要数千块芯片。

paras.en: DePue’s research has not been peer-reviewed—he self-published it—but Kuditipudi is sold. “I find the evidence pretty convincing,” he says. Aamodt finds the approach feasible at a glance but wants more evidence. “I would have liked to see the technical details on how that works,” he says. DePue says he sat on his findings for a while, until he was almost certain of them.
paras.zh: DePue 的研究尚未经过同行评审（他自行出版），但 Kuditipudi 已被出售。 “我发现证据非常有说服力，”他说。阿莫特乍一看认为这种方法可行，但需要更多证据。 “我希望了解其工作原理的技术细节，”他说。德普说，他对自己的发现犹豫了一段时间，直到他几乎确定了这些结果。

paras.en: Since DePue released his report, these initial tracks have already been covered. PyTorch, a popular open-source tool kit for building and training AI models, is already in the process of removing this type of fingerprinting, according to an engineer at Meta who has been working on the program. “Unfortunately, it is pretty easy to erase these fingerprints,” DePue says, and he believes the open weights have more to tell. “The seed tracking example is just so immediate,” he says. “There’s a lot of forensic analysis we can do.”
paras.zh: 自从 DePue 发布报告以来，这些最初的轨迹已经被涵盖了。据一直致力于该项目的 Meta 工程师表示，PyTorch 是一种流行的用于构建和训练人工智能模型的开源工具包，它已经在消除这种类型的指纹识别。 “不幸的是，擦除这些指纹非常容易，”德普说，他相信开放权重有更多的信息。 “种子追踪的例子是如此直接，”他说。 “我们可以做很多取证分析。”

articles.title: FAA ground stop suggests how risky air traffic control upgrades can be

paras.en: The trouble may have started with a single router. Last Friday afternoon a problem in the Federal Aviation Administration’s telecommunications network prompted the agency to halt departures at every airport in the country. The extremely rare nationwide ground stop on November 13 lasted more than four hours, and the fallout took days to clear: more than 18,000 flights canceled and more than 28,000 delayed. With Thanksgiving a week away, the agency’s engineers are still scrambling to figure out what went wrong.
paras.zh: 问题可能是从单个路由器开始的。上周五下午，美国联邦航空管理局的电信网络出现问题，促使该机构停止了该国每个机场的航班起飞。 11 月 13 日发生的极为罕见的全国性地面停留持续了四个多小时，其后果需要几天时间才能消除：超过 18,000 架次航班被取消，超过 28,000 架次航班延误。距离感恩节还有一周，该机构的工程师仍在努力找出问题所在。

paras.en: At a November 14 press conference, Secretary of Transportation Sean Duffy blamed the ground stop on the FAA’s “incredibly old telecommunication system.” By his account, the problem surfaced during routine work by Florida-based contractor L3Harris, which is replacing the system’s copper wire with fiber-optic cable. Whether the culprit was a faulty router or the crew that installed it, he said, is still unknown. Either way, the trouble spread through parts of the air traffic control system, disrupting radar feeds and communication with some airplanes. “When we see that—your safety is paramount—we shut down the airspace, and we do it safely,” Duffy said.
paras.zh: 在 11 月 14 日的新闻发布会上，交通部长肖恩·达菲 (Sean Duffy) 将地面停车归咎于美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) “极其陈旧的电信系统”。据他介绍，这个问题是在佛罗里达州承包商 L3Harris 的日常工作中出现的，该公司正在用光缆取代系统的铜线。他说，罪魁祸首是否是有故障的路由器或安装它的人员仍然未知。无论哪种方式，问题都会蔓延到空中交通管制系统的部分区域，扰乱雷达信号和与一些飞机的通信。达菲说：“当我们看到您的安全至关重要时，我们就会关闭领空，并且我们会安全地进行操作。”

paras.en: Many observers view such statements with skepticism, though they agree that the FAA is contending with ongoing problems with aging infrastructure. “Like most engineers, I feel like we’re not getting the whole story here,” says Missy Cummings, a transportation engineer at George Mason University and a former Navy fighter pilot. She’s also surprised that anyone would attempt a challenging upgrade on a busy Friday afternoon. “This just doesn’t pass the smell test,” she says.
paras.zh: 许多观察家对此类声明持怀疑态度，尽管他们同意美国联邦航空局正在应对基础设施老化带来的持续问题。 “像大多数工程师一样，我觉得我们没有了解整个故事，”乔治梅森大学的运输工程师、前海军战斗机飞行员米西·卡明斯说。她还惊讶于有人会在繁忙的周五下午尝试进行具有挑战性的升级。 “这根本没有通过气味测试，”她说。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: The limited information released so far suggests a lack of transparency, says Ratul Mahajan, an associate professor of computer engineering at the University of Washington. “As a comparison point, Microsoft had an outage, too, and they had a detailed incident report published within three days,” he says, referring to the worldwide Microsoft 365 failure that began the day before the ground stop. He’s less bothered by the Friday-afternoon timing. “One way to make systems resilient is for changes to not be special and to be putting processes in place so that you can do updates all the time,” he says. A system that’s updated regularly, in other words, becomes better at being updated.
paras.zh: 华盛顿大学计算机工程副教授拉图尔·马哈詹 (Ratul Mahajan) 表示，迄今为止发布的信息有限，表明缺乏透明度。 “作为比较点，微软也发生了一次停机，他们在三天内发布了一份详细的事件报告，”他说，指的是在地面停止前一天开始的全球范围内的 Microsoft 365 故障。他对周五下午的时间安排不太在意。 “使系统具有弹性的一种方法是不要进行特殊的更改，并将流程落实到位，以便您可以随时进行更新，”他说。换句话说，定期更新的系统会更善于更新。

paras.en: The copper-to-fiber swap at the center of Duffy’s account is itself part of the FAA’s fix for its aging network. The agency says it has replaced 69 percent of the old copper wire with the fiber cables, which carry data at much higher speeds. Plenty of older gear sticks around. At some sites, the air traffic control system still uses floppy disks, which “contain vital weather and other critical information,” according to the FAA’s website. Of course, most people haven’t used floppies since the 2000s, and they can hold little data compared with USB sticks and cloud storage that can be quickly downloaded. Though the floppy disks aren’t running operating systems and aren’t critical infrastructure, they’re an example of aging technologies air traffic controllers are working with, says Ruth Stilwell, an experienced former air traffic controller and policy expert.
paras.zh: 达菲账户中心的铜缆到光纤交换本身就是美国联邦航空局对其老化网络进行修复的一部分。该机构表示，它已经用光纤电缆取代了 69% 的旧铜线，光纤传输数据的速度要快得多。大量旧装备仍然存在。根据美国联邦航空局网站的说法，在一些地点，空中交通管制系统仍然使用软盘，其中“包含重要的天气和其他关键信息”。当然，大多数人自 2000 年代以来就不再使用软盘，与可快速下载的 U 盘和云存储相比，软盘所能容纳的数据很少。经验丰富的前空中交通管制员和政策专家露丝·史迪威 (Ruth Stilwell) 表示，虽然软盘不运行操作系统，也不是关键基础设施，但它们是空中交通管制员正在使用的老化技术的一个例子。

paras.en: Ripping out the old equipment carries its own risks. “It’s true that some things may be working, and you may not want to change them, because every time you change something, you introduce the risk of breaking it,” says Michele Polese, an electrical and computer engineering researcher at Northeastern University. But once technology gets so old that vendors no longer sell or maintain it, he argues, fixing problems as they arise becomes harder.
paras.zh: 拆除旧设备本身就有风险。东北大学电气和计算机工程研究员 Michele Polese 表示：“确实，有些东西可能有效，但你可能不想改变它们，因为每次你改变某些东西，就会带来破坏它的风险。”但他认为，一旦技术变得过时，供应商不再销售或维护它，解决出现的问题就变得更加困难。

paras.en: “Like most engineers, I feel like we’re not getting the whole story here.” — Missy Cummings, transportation engineer, George Mason University
paras.zh: “和大多数工程师一样，我觉得我们并没有了解整个故事。” — Missy Cummings，乔治梅森大学交通工程师

paras.en: The FAA is attempting that kind of swap across the whole country while keeping planes in the air, and federal auditors have their doubts about how it’s going. In September the Government Accountability Office warned that the FAA is juggling thousands of modernization projects without an integrated schedule to coordinate them, leaving costs uncertain and flights vulnerable to disruption. “The net effect could be that air traffic controllers are forced to continue to rely on severely outdated systems that are prone to failure leading to more system outages, ground stops, flight delays, or worse—safety incidents,” the report said. The recent ground stop came two months later.
paras.zh: 美国联邦航空局正在尝试在全国范围内进行这种交换，同时保持飞机在空中飞行，联邦审计员对事情的进展表示怀疑。 9 月，政府问责办公室警告称，美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 正在处理数千个现代化项目，却没有一个统一的时间表来协调这些项目，导致成本不确定，航班也容易受到干扰。报告称：“最终的影响可能是，空中交通管制员被迫继续依赖严重过时的系统，这些系统很容易出现故障，导致更多的系统中断、地面停止、航班延误，或更糟糕的安全事故。”最近的地面停留发生在两个月后。

paras.en: The administration thinks the answer is more money. Within hours of the ground stop, Duffy raised his funding request to Congress for air traffic control and airport upgrades from $30 billion to $50 billion. To Stilwell, the ballooning budgets and new programs look like “requirements creep” that leaves the underlying infrastructure problems unaddressed. She also warns that Duffy’s push to consolidate air route traffic control centers—the regional hubs that guide planes between airports—risks another “Chicago sabotage”: in 2014 a contract employee disabled one of those centers, outside Chicago, halting traffic at both of the city’s major airports. Meanwhile the FAA has yet to spend most of the $12.5 billion Congress already gave it in last year’s so-called One Big Beautiful Bill Act.
paras.zh: 政府认为答案是更多的钱。地面停止后数小时内，达菲向国会提出空中交通管制和机场升级的资金请求，从 300 亿美元提高到 500 亿美元。在史迪威看来，不断膨胀的预算和新项目看起来就像“需求蔓延”，导致根本的基础设施问题得不到解决。她还警告说，达菲推动整合航线交通控制中心（引导飞机在机场之间飞行的区域枢纽）的努力可能会带来另一场“芝加哥破坏”：2014 年，一名合同工关闭了芝加哥郊外的其中一个中心，导致该市两个主要机场的交通中断。与此同时，国会在去年所谓的“美丽大法案”中拨款 125 亿美元，美国联邦航空局尚未支出其中的大部分。

paras.en: “Infrastructure maintenance is not sexy and does not get headlines, but it is the thing that causes these problems. Rather than a new wish list, focus on this first,” Stilwell says. The agency also needs to invest in training and keeping the workforce, she says—yet in 2025 the so-called Department of Government Efficiency, or U.S. DOGE Service, fired some 400 FAA workers, and around 1,300 more took buyouts or early retirement.
paras.zh: “基础设施维护并不性感，也不会成为头条新闻，但它却是导致这些问题的原因。与其制定新的愿望清单，不如先关注这一点，”史迪威说。她表示，该机构还需要投资于培训和留住员工队伍，但到 2025 年，所谓的政府效率部（U.S. DOGE Service）解雇了约 400 名 FAA 员工，另有约 1,300 名员工接受了买断或提前退休。

paras.en: If you’re traveling for Thanksgiving, the FAA has offered some reassuring news on its website: its system is now stable, and the agency has paused installations of the type of router in question. Stilwell stresses how much remains unknown, starting with why the FAA stopped traffic entirely. By the agency’s own account, on November 13 its telecommunications system remained operational while experiencing “instability,” something like a fluttering Internet connection. “Planes were flying; there were no reported incidents of aircraft being in danger; controllers were still talking to planes. So why wouldn’t you go to reduced traffic instead of no traffic?” she says. So far, Stilwell says, the FAA hasn’t explained that. “This is so odd for this to blow up as big as it did and to last as long as it did.”
paras.zh: 如果您准备去感恩节旅行，美国联邦航空局在其网站上提供了一些令人放心的消息：其系统现已稳定，并且该机构已暂停安装相关类型的路由器。史迪威强调，还有多少未知数，首先是美国联邦航空局为何完全停止交通。根据该机构自己的说法，11 月 13 日，其电信系统仍在运行，但经历了“不稳定”，类似于互联网连接不稳定。 “飞机正在飞行；没有关于飞机处于危险中的事件报告；管制员仍在与飞机交谈。那么为什么不减少交通量而不是没有交通量呢？”她说。史迪威说，到目前为止，美国联邦航空局还没有对此做出解释。 “这件事能爆发得这么大，而且持续得这么久，真是太奇怪了。”

articles.title: The U.S. Army is about to blow up a cache of dangerous lead azide in Iowa—here’s what to know

paras.en: The U.S. Army’s plan to blow up 68 drums’ worth of a toxic compound could cause significant health problems for the local community, experts warn.
paras.zh: 专家警告称，美国陆军计划炸毁 68 桶有毒化合物，可能会给当地社区带来严重的健康问题。

paras.en: On Friday the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant will detonate 68 drums of lead azide, which is used in the manufacture of detonators, blasting caps and other components of explosives. As the chemical ages and degrades, it can form unstable crystals that can spontaneously explode at room temperature. The planned detonation is to prevent that from happening and must be done on-site because of the potential dangers of trying to transport it.
paras.zh: 周五，爱荷华州陆军弹药厂将引爆 68 桶叠氮化铅，这些叠氮化铅用于制造雷管、雷管和炸药的其他部件。随着化学物质的老化和降解，它会形成不稳定的晶体，在室温下会自发爆炸。计划中的爆炸是为了防止这种情况发生，并且必须在现场进行，因为试图运输它存在潜在的危险。

paras.en: The explosion will likely lead to large amounts of particulate matter in the air. While sodium azide, one of the two necessary components used to synthesize lead azide, poses no danger, according to the National Institutes of Health, lead is a highly dangerous substance.
paras.zh: 爆炸可能会导致空气中产生大量颗粒物。据美国国立卫生研究院称，虽然叠氮化钠是合成叠氮化铅的两种必要成分之一，不会造成任何危险，但铅是一种高度危险的物质。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: The greatest risk is to children, but it’s not limited to them, warns Ellen Wells, a public health professor at Purdue University.
paras.zh: 普渡大学公共卫生教授埃伦·威尔斯警告说，最大的风险是儿童，但不仅限于儿童。

paras.en: “The literature shows that they can have lifetime impacts from exposure at a young age,” she says. “Even at very low levels, it has shown that lead can influence neurological health, and that means [lower] IQ in children or cognitive development in children.”
paras.zh: “文献表明，年轻时接触这些物质可能会对一生产生影响，”她说。 “即使水平非常低，研究表明铅也会影响神经系统健康，这意味着儿童的智商或认知发展会降低。”

paras.en: “But it can also influence cardiovascular health,” she says, including in adults. “There’s been a lot of studies in adults that even low levels of lead in adults can contribute, population-wise, to increased cardiovascular mortality.”
paras.zh: “但它也会影响心血管健康，”她说，包括成年人。 “对成年人进行的大量研究表明，即使成年人体内的铅含量较低，也会导致人口心血管死亡率增加。”

paras.en: Lead is considered a probable carcinogen by the Environmental Protection Agency, although the International Agency for Research on Cancer has found insufficient evidence as to whether lead exposure causes cancer.
paras.zh: 尽管国际癌症研究机构没有发现足够的证据证明铅暴露是否会导致癌症，但环境保护署仍将铅视为可能的致癌物。

paras.en: Local authorities have warned residents of the impending explosion. In a Facebook post on November 16, the city of Middletown, Iowa, acknowledged that the detonation will lead to lead-containing particles in the air. It warned residents in affected areas to stay inside with windows and doors closed on the day of the explosion and to have heating and cooling systems set to recirculate to avoid having outdoor air enter their homes. The post also asked residents to clean indoor and outdoor surfaces after the exposure period has ended.
paras.zh: 地方当局已警告居民即将发生爆炸。爱荷华州米德尔敦市在 11 月 16 日的 Facebook 帖子中承认，爆炸将导致空气中产生含铅颗粒。它警告受影响地区的居民在爆炸当天留在室内并关闭门窗，并设置供暖和制冷系统再循环，以避免室外空气进入家中。该帖子还要求居民在暴露期结束后清洁室内外表面。

paras.en: “If individuals take some actions to prevent lead from getting into their house, that can probably prevent longer-term exposure,” Wells says.
paras.zh: “如果个人采取一些行动来防止铅进入他们的房子，这可能可以防止长期接触，”威尔斯说。

paras.en: But even if residents follow all safety procedures, Wells says the danger could remain because of lead settling into the soil, where it can stay for decades.
paras.zh: 但威尔斯表示，即使居民遵守所有安全程序，危险也可能仍然存在，因为铅会沉淀到土壤中，并可以在土壤中停留数十年。

paras.en: “If people are walking around in the soil or using the soil, then they have a chance to get exposed to it again,” she says. “I would recommend trying to get your soil tested. Or, especially if you have children, try to get their blood lead tested, maybe even a few times after. Blood lead is reflective of exposures over the past 30 days or so, and blood lead tests are generally free, especially for younger children.”
paras.zh: “如果人们在土壤中行走或使用土壤，那么他们就有机会再次接触土壤，”她说。 “我建议尝试测试土壤。或者，特别是如果你有孩子，尝试测试他们的血铅，甚至可能是几次。血铅反映了过去 30 天左右的暴露情况，血铅测试通常是免费的，特别是对于年幼的孩子。”

paras.en: The Environmental Protection Agency issued an emergency permit for the detonation to the Army. In it, the EPA has tasked the Army with performing daily environmental monitoring measures to detect any residue in the area and with conducting a cleanup operation of any high-touch surfaces where lead is detected, such as parks and public facilities.
paras.zh: 环境保护局向陆军颁发了爆炸紧急许可证。其中，美国环保署责成陆军执行日常环境监测措施，以检测该地区的任何残留物，并对检测到铅的任何高接触表面（例如公园和公共设施）进行清理操作。

paras.en: A spokesperson for the Army did not respond to a request for comment.
paras.zh: 陆军发言人没有回应置评请求。

paras.en: That cleanup doesn’t necessarily have to be complicated, Wells says.
paras.zh: 威尔斯说，清理工作不一定很复杂。

paras.en: “With really, really highly contaminated sites, the procedure has been to remove the soil and replace it,” she says. “However, there has been some research showing that even if you put one inch of topsoil on top of soil that has been contaminated with lead, that can sort of trap the lead in the soil, so you reduce the immediate exposures.”
paras.zh: “对于污染非常非常严重的地点，程序就是去除土壤并更换它，”她说。 “然而，有一些研究表明，即使你在被铅污染的土壤上放置一英寸的表土，也会将铅困在土壤中，从而减少直接接触。”

articles.title: What to know about kratom and its powerful derivatives
articles.author: Bethany Brookshire

paras.en: For the past few years, addiction specialist Roopa Sethi has been seeing a new set of patients. They show up at the University of Kansas Health System hospital in Kansas City with what looks like severe opiate withdrawal: nausea, vomiting and muscle aches. They’re extremely anxious and sometimes hallucinating. But they haven’t taken an opioid, like fentanyl or heroin. Instead, they’ve used something labeled as kratom, though it may not contain kratom at all.
paras.zh: 在过去的几年里，成瘾专家鲁帕·塞西（Roopa Sethi）接诊了一批新的患者。他们出现在堪萨斯城堪萨斯大学健康系统医院，症状看起来像是严重的阿片戒断症状：恶心、呕吐和肌肉疼痛。他们极度焦虑，有时甚至产生幻觉。但他们没有服用芬太尼或海洛因等阿片类药物。相反，他们使用了标记为卡痛叶的东西，尽管它可能根本不含卡痛叶。

paras.en: Kratom is a plant used for chronic pain relief and to help people stay off opioids. But souped-up new versions with hyperpotent derivatives of the active compound are sold online and in gas stations. The derivatives act strongly on the body’s opioid receptors and are often far more powerful than the opioid drugs they are sometimes intended to replace. Kratom products — sold as pills, liquid shots, edibles and more — are often mislabeled, and state and federal regulations lag far behind.
paras.zh: 卡痛叶是一种用于缓解慢性疼痛并帮助人们远离阿片类药物的植物。但含有活性化合物超强衍生物的增强版新版本在网上和加油站出售。这些衍生物对人体的阿片受体产生强烈作用，并且通常比它们有时打算取代的阿片类药物更强大。卡痛产品（以药丸、液体注射剂、食品等形式出售）经常贴错标签，而且州和联邦法规远远落后。

paras.en: A 2026 survey estimated that about 5 million Americans have used kratom or similar products, and the increased use has sent kratom-related exposures up 1,200 percent from only 258 exposures in 2015, according to the National Poison Data System.
paras.zh: 根据国家毒物数据系统的数据，2026 年的一项调查估计，约有 500 万美国人使用过卡痛叶或类似产品，随着使用量的增加，与卡痛叶相关的接触量比 2015 年的 258 次增加了 1,200%。

paras.en: Now, newer versions of the substance can produce withdrawal symptoms like nausea and vomiting, which are often so severe they bring people to the hospital. Here’s what to know.
paras.zh: 现在，该物质的新版本可以产生恶心和呕吐等戒断症状，​​这些症状往往非常严重，导致人们去医院。以下是需要了解的内容。

paras.en: Kratom comes from the dried leaves of Mitragyna speciosa, a tree native to Southeast Asia. Dutch scientist Pieter Willem Korthals first described it in 1839. But “without a doubt, it was used likely for centuries prior to that” in countries including Thailand, Indonesia and Myanmar, says Oliver Grundmann, a pharmacologist at the University of Florida in Gainesville. “Wherever there is a stream, these trees are growing there.” People chewed the leaves for a stimulant effect and brewed them into a tea to treat pain,” Grundmann says.
paras.zh: 卡痛来自原产于东南亚的帽柱木 (Mitragyna spiosa) 的干燥叶子。荷兰科学家 Pieter Willem Korthals 于 1839 年首次描述了它。但佛罗里达大学盖恩斯维尔分校的药理学家奥利弗·格伦德曼 (Oliver Grundmann) 表示，“毫无疑问，它可能在此之前的几个世纪前就已在泰国、印度尼西亚和缅甸等国家使用”。 “哪里有溪流，哪里就有这些树。”人们咀嚼叶子以获得兴奋作用，并将它们泡成茶来治疗疼痛，”格伦德曼说。

paras.en: In the United States, kratom is billed pain treatment that is more “natural” than opiates like morphine, Sethi says. “When you take this product at low doses, it is used for waking up … but at higher doses it becomes opiate-like.” Others take it to treat withdrawal or cravings from opioid use.
paras.zh: 塞西说，在美国，卡痛叶被宣传为比吗啡等阿片类药物更“天然”的止痛药。 “当你服用低剂量的这种产品时，它是用来醒来的……但剂量较高时，它会变得像鸦片一样。”其他人则用它来治疗因使用阿片类药物而产生的戒断或渴望。

paras.en: The leaf form contains more than 40 different naturally occurring chemicals called alkaloids that could have psychoactive effects. The most important is mitragynine, which makes up two-thirds of the plant’s alkaloid content.
paras.zh: 叶子含有 40 多种不同的天然化学物质，称为生物碱，可能具有精神作用。最重要的是帽柱木碱，占植物生物碱含量的三分之二。

paras.en: Mitragynine acts on the body’s mu opioid receptors. These receptors — found in the brain, spinal cord and gut — usually respond to natural peptide signals in the body such as endorphins, signaling cells to produce pain relief and release chemicals like dopamine. The receptors get their name from the most famous drug that binds to them: opium. Mitragynine is not derived from or related to opium or morphine but it binds partially to the receptor.
paras.zh: 帽柱木碱作用于人体的 mu 阿片受体。这些受体存在于大脑、脊髓和肠道中，通常会对体内的天然肽信号（如内啡肽）做出反应，信号细胞产生止痛作用并释放多巴胺等化学物质。这些受体的名字来源于与其结合的最著名的药物：鸦片。帽柱木碱并非源自鸦片或吗啡，也与鸦片或吗啡无关，但它与受体部分结合。

paras.en: “It’s kind of like a dimmer switch versus turning on the lights,” says Mallory Pullman, a clinical toxicologist at the Mississippi Poison Control Center at the University of Mississippi Medical Center in Jackson. “You don’t fully light your room.”
paras.zh: “这有点像调光开关与开灯，”杰克逊密西西比大学医学中心密西西比毒物控制中心的临床毒理学家马洛里·普尔曼说。 “你的房间没有完全照亮。”

paras.en: Mitragynine also hits receptors that bind norepinephrine, serotonin and dopamine receptors, says Grundmann. The activity at adrenergic receptors creates a stimulant-like effect. “Now I think when we look at mitragynine, it’s primarily kind of this duality of the adrenergic and the opioid receptor activity,” he says, producing stimulating and depressive results in turn.
paras.zh: 格伦德曼说，帽柱木碱还会攻击与去甲肾上腺素、血清素和多巴胺受体结合的受体。肾上腺素能受体的活性产生类似兴奋剂的作用。 “现在我认为，当我们观察帽柱木碱时，它主要是肾上腺素能和阿片受体活性的二元性，”他说，依次产生刺激和抑制结果。

paras.en: What nature made, chemists and users are happy to tweak.
paras.zh: 化学家和用户很乐意对大自然的创造进行调整。

paras.en: As the kratom leaf is dried, Grundmann says, tiny amounts of mitragynine metabolize into another alkaloid, 7-hydroxymitragynine, or 7-OH. After someone takes kratom, the body also converts some mitragynine to 7-OH. The small chemical tweak changes the compound from one that binds partially to the mu opioid receptors to one that binds fully — like morphine or opium, Grundmann says. 7-OH binds 10 times more strongly to mu opioid receptors than mitragynine does. The resulting product is far more potent in its effects and addictive potential.
paras.zh: 格伦德曼说，当卡痛叶子干燥时，少量的帽柱木碱会代谢成另一种生物碱，7-羟基帽柱木碱或7-OH。服用卡痛叶后，身体还会将一些帽柱木碱转化为 7-OH。格伦德曼说，微小的化学调整将这种化合物从一种与μ阿片受体部分结合的化合物改变为一种完全结合的化合物，就像吗啡或鸦片一样。 7-OH 与 mu 阿片受体的结合强度是帽柱木碱的 10 倍。由此产生的产品的效果和成瘾潜力要强大得多。

paras.en: When people use the leaves alone, the amount of 7-OH is extremely limited. But by the mid-2010s, scientists found products with more than 500 percent more 7-OH than in the plant alone, and now, consumers can buy products labeled as pure 7-OH.
paras.zh: 当人们单独使用叶子时，7-OH的含量极其有限。但到了 2010 年代中期，科学家发现产品中的 7-OH 含量比植物本身多出 500% 以上，现在，消费者可以购买标记为纯 7-OH 的产品。

paras.en: While 7-OH can be described as “natural” because it can, in theory, occur in nature, toxicologists like Pullman are also seeing synthetic derivatives that are even stronger, including one molecule named MGM-15. MGM-15 is sold as a “research chemical” and is four times more powerful than 7-OH.
paras.zh: 虽然 7-OH 可以被描述为“天然”，因为理论上它可以存在于自然界中，但普尔曼等毒理学家也发现了更强的合成衍生物，包括一种名为 MGM-15 的分子。 MGM-15 作为“研究化学品”出售，其功效是 7-OH 的四倍。

paras.en: What is in kratom products may not always be what’s on the label, leaving users in the dark about what they are taking. In a 2026 analysis of 44 different kratom products, including tablets, dissolvable films and edibles, Pullman and her colleagues found that 85 percent of the products had contents that did not match the label. Some advertised kratom but contained very high levels of 7-OH. Others had alkaloids that weren’t listed at all.
paras.zh: 卡痛叶产品中的成分可能并不总是标签上的成分，这让用户对自己服用的成分一无所知。 2026 年，普尔曼和她的同事对 44 种不同的卡痛叶产品（包括片剂、可溶解薄膜和食品）进行了分析，发现 85% 的产品含量与标签不符。有些宣传卡痛叶但含有非常高含量的 7-OH。其他人则含有根本未列出的生物碱。

paras.en: It’s “very concerning at a consumer level if you can’t trust what’s actually on the label,” Pullman says.
paras.zh: 普尔曼说，“如果你不能相信标签上的实际内容，这对消费者来说是非常令人担忧的”。

paras.en: Sethi started hearing the word kratom about 10 years ago in her work with people seeking treatment for opioid use. “I would have patients intermittently tell me about kratom use,” she says. People were using kratom to stay off opioids, or to treat pain, and didn’t report being addicted to the plant.
paras.zh: 大约 10 年前，Sethi 在与寻求阿片类药物使用治疗的人们一起工作时开始听到卡痛叶这个词。 “我会让患者间歇性地告诉我卡痛叶的使用情况，”她说。人们使用卡痛叶来远离阿片类药物或治疗疼痛，但没有报告对这种植物上瘾。

paras.en: Now, it’s a different story, Sethi says.
paras.zh: 塞西说，现在情况不同了。

paras.en: Patients who started using kratom or 7-OH to get off opioids “now are having really bad withdrawal and cravings and ending up in the hospital,” she says. Some are seeking addiction treatment, not for opioids, but for kratom and 7-OH. In 2025, U.S. poison centers documented 3,434 kratom-related exposure reports, reported both by people who called the center and medical professionals. “I see less fentanyl and more kratom at this point, or more 7-OH,” Sethi says.
paras.zh: 她说，开始使用卡痛叶或 7-OH 来戒除阿片类药物的患者“现在戒断和渴望非常严重，最终住院了”。有些人正在寻求成瘾治疗，不是针对阿片类药物，而是针对卡痛叶和 7-OH。 2025 年，美国毒物中心记录了 3,434 份与卡痛叶相关的暴露报告，这些报告均由致电该中心的人员和医疗专业人员报告。 “此时我看到更少的芬太尼和更多的卡痛叶，或者更多的 7-OH，”Sethi 说。

paras.en: In July of 2026, the U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration temporarily classified some kratom derivatives as Schedule I drugs, meaning they have high abuse potential and no medical use. Those derivatives include 7-OH and another related kratom derivative, mitragynine pseudoindoxyl or MGPI, as well as MGM-15 and its powerful sibling MGM-16. The DEA re-upped the temporary scheduling of MGM-15 and 16 and MGPI in October. 7-OH was temporarily placed in Schedule I at any dose higher than that found in the kratom plant. The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has also issued statements warning consumers not to use the products. None of these measures affect the legality of the kratom leaf itself.
paras.zh: 2026 年 7 月，美国缉毒局暂时将一些卡痛叶衍生物归类为附表 I 药物，这意味着它们具有很高的滥用潜力且没有医疗用途。这些衍生物包括 7-OH 和另一种相关的卡痛衍生物、帽柱木碱假吲哚酚或 MGPI，以及 MGM-15 及其强大的同级 MGM-16。 DEA 于 10 月份重新调整了 MGM-15 和 16 以及 MGPI 的临时调度。 7-OH 暂时列入附表 I，其剂量高于卡痛厂中发现的剂量。美国食品和药物管理局也发表声明警告消费者不要使用这些产品。这些措施都不会影响卡痛叶本身的合法性。

paras.en: Regulations vary at the state level: Twenty-six states don’t regulate kratom at all, while six states and the District of Columbia list kratom’s ingredients as a Schedule I controlled substance, like the current federal scheduling. A further 18 states regulate sale and manufacture in some way.
paras.zh: 州一级的法规各不相同：26 个州根本不监管卡痛叶，而 6 个州和哥伦比亚特区将卡痛叶的成分列为附表 I 受控物质，就像目前的联邦附表一样。另外 18 个州以某种方式规范销售和制造。

paras.en: “I think there’s a lot more concern now, especially that there might be potential opioids out on the market,” Pullman says. Regulations are trying to thread the needle between banning the plant and banning high-potency derivatives, knowing that when one derivative gets smacked down, another will quickly appear in its place. That cycle is a familiar one, mirroring the evolution and development of synthetic opioids.
paras.zh: “我认为现在有更多的担忧，特别是市场上可能存在潜在的阿片类药物，”普尔曼说。法规正试图在禁止植物和禁止高效衍生品之间找到平衡点，因为他们知道，当一种衍生品被淘汰时，另一种衍生品很快就会出现在它的位置上。这一循环是常见的，反映了合成阿片类药物的演变和发展。

paras.en: “There’s risk with everything,” she says. “I think it’s important to distinguish the difference between a synthetic product versus the natural, and that way we can clearly attribute where the risk lies.”
paras.zh: “凡事都有风险，”她说。 “我认为区分合成产品与天然产品之间的差异很重要，这样我们就可以清楚地归因风险所在。”

articles.title: The U.S. just lost its measles elimination status. What now?
articles.author: Erin Garcia de Jesús

paras.en: After two years with nearly 100 measles outbreaks, thousands sickened and nearly a dozen deaths, the United States has officially lost its measles elimination status.
paras.zh: 两年来，美国爆发了近 100 起麻疹疫情，数千人患病，近十几人死亡，美国正式失去了麻疹消除地位。

paras.en: The highly contagious disease is now endemic in the United States, the Pan American Health Organization declared November 17. Analyses of cases dated from when the first outbreak began in 2025 in West Texas through part of 2026 revealed the virus has been spreading uninterrupted for more than a year. That benchmark signals measles is no longer under control.
paras.zh: 泛美卫生组织 11 月 17 日宣布，这种高度传染性的疾病目前在美国流行。对从 2025 年西德克萨斯州第一次疫情爆发到 2026 年部分时间的病例分析显示，该病毒已经不间断地传播了一年多。该基准表明麻疹不再受到控制。

paras.en: The United States is not alone. Mexico and Bolivia also lost their measles elimination status, PAHO announced; Canada had lost it in 2025. “Measles is resurging globally amid persistent gaps in vaccination coverage,” PAHO director Jarbas Barbosa said in a Nov. 17 news conference. “And this global trend is also affecting the Americas.” Countries will need to not only stop ongoing outbreaks, but also prove that no one caught measles within their borders for a full year to regain measles-free status.
paras.zh: 美国并不孤单。泛美卫生组织宣布，墨西哥和玻利维亚也失去了消除麻疹的地位；加拿大在 2025 年失去了这一点。“由于疫苗接种覆盖率持续存在差距，麻疹在全球范围内卷土重来，”泛美卫生组织主任贾巴斯·巴博萨 (Jarbas Barbosa) 在 11 月 17 日的新闻发布会上表示。 “这种全球趋势也正在影响美洲。”各国不仅需要阻止持续的疫情爆发，还需要证明一整年内没有人在其境内感染麻疹，才能恢复无麻疹状态。

paras.en: That won’t happen overnight. But there is a way, experts say. Vaccinating people across the country, particularly in areas with low vaccination rates, will stifle the virus’s spread. But so far, the U.S. federal public health response has taken a back seat to efforts from state and local health departments to curb ongoing outbreaks.
paras.zh: 这不会在一夜之间发生。但专家表示，有办法。在全国范围内为人们接种疫苗，特别是在疫苗接种率低的地区，将遏制病毒的传播。但到目前为止，美国联邦公共卫生应对措施已经退居次要地位，而州和地方卫生部门为遏制持续爆发的疫情做出了努力。

paras.en: Measles’s return “is an enormous black eye on the reputation of the United States,” said epidemiologist Jennifer Nuzzo of the Brown University School of Public Health in Providence, R.I., in a Nov. 9 webinar hosted by the university. The Americas led the global campaign to control the virus, and in 2016 the region became the first to eliminate measles transmission from all its countries.
paras.zh: 罗德岛州普罗维登斯布朗大学公共卫生学院的流行病学家 Jennifer Nuzzo 在 11 月 9 日由该大学主办的网络研讨会上表示，麻疹的卷土重来“对美国的声誉造成了巨大的打击”。美洲地区引领了全球控制病毒的运动，并于 2016 年成为第一个消除麻疹传播的国家。

paras.en: “To lose [elimination status] means we’re going backwards… meaning decades of progress lost,” Nuzzo said. “It’s an indicator of our lack of protection. It is an indicator of our lack of preparedness for disease threats in general.”
paras.zh: “失去[淘汰状态]意味着我们正在倒退……意味着几十年的进步都消失了，”努佐说。 “这表明我们缺乏保护。这表明我们总体上缺乏对疾病威胁的准备。”

paras.en: PAHO’s verdict comes amid a surge of measles not seen in the United States since 1991. Health officials have recorded more than 7,000 cases since the beginning of the West Texas outbreak. That tally includes nearly 2,300 measles cases in 2025 and 5,412 in 2026 as of November 12, according to the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. Over 90 percent of cases have been in people who are unvaccinated or whose status is unknown. States report that 13 people have died, although the CDC so far recognizes only nine of those deaths.
paras.zh: 泛美卫生组织做出这一裁决之际，美国麻疹疫情自 1991 年以来从未出现过激增。自西德克萨斯州疫情爆发以来，卫生官员已记录了 7,000 多例病例。根据美国疾病控制与预防中心的数据，截至 11 月 12 日，这一数字包括 2025 年近 2,300 例麻疹病例和 2026 年 5,412 例麻疹病例。超过 90% 的病例发生在未接种疫苗或状况不明的人身上。各州报告称，已有 13 人死亡，但 CDC 迄今为止仅确认其中 9 人死亡。

paras.en: While mild measles symptoms include high fever, cough and a rash, roughly 1 in 5 people will be hospitalized with complications such as pneumonia or brain swelling. Children younger than 5 years and adults over 20 are more likely to get sick, as are pregnant women and their infants. At least 13 babies were born infected, called congenital measles, since the beginning of 2025, researchers report November 16 in NEJM Evidence. Those babies are at risk for developing dangerous brain swelling that is almost always fatal later on in life.
paras.zh: 虽然轻微的麻疹症状包括高烧、咳嗽和皮疹，但大约五分之一的人会因肺炎或脑肿胀等并发症而住院。 5 岁以下的儿童和 20 岁以上的成年人以及孕妇及其婴儿更容易生病。研究人员 11 月 16 日在 NEJM Evidence 上报告称，自 2025 年初以来，至少有 13 名婴儿出生时就受到感染，称为先天性麻疹。这些婴儿面临着发生危险的脑肿胀的风险，这种肿胀在以后的生活中几乎总是致命的。

paras.en: The measles, mumps and rubella, or MMR, vaccine helped eliminate measles from the United States in 2000. After that, cases still sometimes popped up. Those cases were mostly in unvaccinated people traveling from parts of the world where the virus still widely circulates. At least 95 percent of people in a community need to be vaccinated to prevent outbreaks.
paras.zh: 2000 年，麻疹、腮腺炎和风疹 (MMR) 疫苗帮助美国消除了麻疹。此后，病例仍时有出现。这些病例大多是来自病毒仍广泛传播的世界各地的未接种疫苗的人。社区中至少 95% 的人需要接种疫苗以预防疫情爆发。

paras.en: But widespread misinformation, including a disproven claim that the vaccine causes autism, means fewer children are receiving the MMR shot and more people are questioning its safety. According to the CDC, roughly 92 percent of kindergarteners across the United States had gotten the vaccine in 2025, down from 95 percent in 2019. And in 2025, 83 percent of U.S. adults viewed the MMR vaccine as safe, down from 86 percent in 2024, according to a survey from the University of Pennsylvania’s Annenberg Public Policy Center. Yet decades of evidence show the vaccine is safe and highly effective.
paras.zh: 但广泛存在的错误信息，包括未经证实的疫苗导致自闭症的说法，意味着接受 MMR 疫苗接种的儿童越来越少，而越来越多的人质疑其安全性。根据 CDC 的数据，到 2025 年，全美约 92% 的幼儿园儿童接种了疫苗，低于 2019 年的 95%。宾夕法尼亚大学安纳伯格公共政策中心的一项调查显示，2025 年，83% 的美国成年人认为 MMR 疫苗是安全的，低于 2024 年的 86%。然而数十年的证据表明该疫苗是安全且高效的。

paras.en: That measles made a comeback is not a surprise, says Nathan Lo, an infectious diseases physician and epidemiologist at Stanford University School of Medicine. Until recently, outbreaks were largely isolated to communities with low vaccination rates and quickly contained. But now, outbreaks seem to be more likely to spill over into neighboring communities, Lo says. “There’s a lot of potential connectedness between the outbreaks.”
paras.zh: 斯坦福大学医学院传染病医生兼流行病学家内森·洛 (Nathan Lo) 表示，麻疹卷土重来并不令人意外。直到最近，疫情主要局限于疫苗接种率较低的社区，并很快得到遏制。但现在，疫情似乎更有可能蔓延到邻近社区，罗说。 “疫情之间存在很多潜在的联系。”

paras.en: What’s more, some infected people aren’t getting tested, making them invisible to officials who are now struggling to trace chains of transmission. An outbreak that hit Arizona and Utah, for instance, was far larger than official numbers suggest, researchers reported July 15 in a preprint at medRxiv.org. The roughly 1,000 confirmed cases may represent just 20 to 30 percent of the outbreak’s true size.
paras.zh: 更重要的是，一些感染者没有接受检测，这使得目前正在努力追踪传播链的官员看不到他们。例如，研究人员 7 月 15 日在 medRxiv.org 上的预印本中报告称，亚利桑那州和犹他州爆发的疫情规模远远大于官方数据显示的规模。大约 1,000 例确诊病例可能仅占疫情真实规模的 20% 至 30%。

paras.en: A functional surveillance system is crucial to keeping outbreaks under control, Jonathan Temte, a family medicine physician at the University of Wisconsin School of Medicine and Public Health in Madison, said in the Brown University webinar. Without good surveillance across the entire country, “we can miss pockets out there if people aren’t reporting, if people are hiding cases.”
paras.zh: 威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校医学与公共卫生学院的家庭医学医生乔纳森·特姆特在布朗大学网络研讨会上表示，功能齐全的监测系统对于控制疫情至关重要。如果全国范围内没有良好的监控，“如果人们不报告、如果人们隐瞒病例，我们可能会错过一些地方。”

paras.en: But surveillance alone won’t stop the virus from “popcorning across the country,” Nuzzo said. “Measles has returned, and it’s going to take vaccination to stop it.”
paras.zh: 但努佐说，仅靠监视并不能阻止病毒“在全国范围内传播”。 “麻疹卷土重来，需要接种疫苗来阻止它。”

paras.en: Over the last two years, measles outbreaks have popped up across the United States, sickening thousands of people since mid-January 2025. Most of those cases, shown by county where they were reported, are in people who are unvaccinated. Colors on the map indicate the relative number of cases reported. Green represents the lowest and red the highest number of cases. Notable outbreaks have appeared in Utah, Arizona, Texas, South Carolina, Wisconsin and Pennsylvania.
paras.zh: 过去两年，美国各地爆发了麻疹疫情，自 2025 年 1 月中旬以来，已有数千人患病。按报告所在县显示，大多数病例都是未接种疫苗的人。地图上的颜色表示报告病例的相对数量。绿色代表病例数量最少，红色代表病例数量最多。犹他州、亚利桑那州、德克萨斯州、南卡罗来纳州、威斯康星州和宾夕法尼亚州出现了明显的疫情爆发。

paras.en: Efforts to boost vaccine uptake could be targeted toward areas with low vaccination rates. Most places across the United States still have vaccination rates high enough to fend off measles, but not all. “Figuring out which ones are [high risk] can be a little tricky,” Lo says. “But if you do, then intervening in those places can be quite helpful to mitigate spread.”
paras.zh: 提高疫苗接种率的努力可以针对疫苗接种率低的地区。美国大多数地方的疫苗接种率仍然足够高，足以抵御麻疹，但并非全部。 “找出哪些是[高风险]可能有点棘手，”罗说。 “但如果你这样做，那么对这些地方进行干预对于减轻传播非常有帮助。”

paras.en: Homing in on school districts or individual schools could also help. State health departments typically report vaccination rates among school-age children by county. But that broad metric can hide high risk schools with low vaccination rates, epidemiologists Siyu Chen and Ana Bento reported in August in Nature Medicine. Computer simulations relying on data that included 50,000 schools across the United States showed that school-level estimates best revealed where the virus could gain a foothold. That was true even if county-level vaccination rates were close to 95 percent.
paras.zh: 关注学区或个别学校也可能有所帮助。州卫生部门通常按县报告学龄儿童的疫苗接种率。但流行病学家 Siyu Chen 和 Ana Bento 在 8 月的《自然医学》杂志上报道称，这一广泛的指标可能会掩盖疫苗接种率低的高风险学校。基于美国 50,000 所学校数据的计算机模拟显示，学校层面的估计最能揭示病毒可能在哪里立足。即使县级疫苗接种率接近 95%，情况也是如此。

paras.en: Another element that influenced where measles took off was whether communities with cases were near other areas with low vaccination rates, the team found. The outbreak in Texas, for instance, may have ended faster because communities with low vaccination rates were farther away from one another compared with outbreaks in South Carolina and Pennsylvania, says Bento, of Cornell University. Neighboring areas where many are unvaccinated may face longer-burning outbreaks. “Which is what we are now seeing,” Bento says.
paras.zh: 研究小组发现，影响麻疹爆发地点的另一个因素是出现病例的社区是否靠近其他疫苗接种率较低的地区。康奈尔大学的本托说，例如，德克萨斯州的疫情可能结束得更快，因为与南卡罗来纳州和宾夕法尼亚州的疫情相比，疫苗接种率较低的社区彼此之间距离更远。许多人未接种疫苗的邻近地区可能会面临持续时间更长的疫情爆发。 “这就是我们现在所看到的，”本托说。

paras.en: Measles elimination status can be regained. The declaration that the virus is endemic is “not a punishment,” Bento says. It’s a sign that something needs to change. That might include vaccine catch-up campaigns, community outreach or getting rid of nonmedical vaccine exemptions.
paras.zh: 可以恢复麻疹消除状态。本托说，宣布该病毒为地方性病毒“不是一种惩罚”。这是一个迹象，表明有些事情需要改变。这可能包括疫苗追赶运动、社区外展或取消非医疗疫苗豁免。

paras.en: Local public health officials are “doing every last thing that you can imagine with limited resources,” health psychologist Noel T. Brewer said in a Nov. 12 webinar hosted by the Association of Health Care Journalists. But a cohesive plan at the federal level could bolster defenses before the virus arrives in new states, noted Brewer, of the University of North Carolina Gillings School of Global Public Health in Chapel Hill.
paras.zh: 健康心理学家诺埃尔·T·布鲁尔 (Noel T. Brewer) 在医疗保健记者协会 (Association of Health Care Journalists) 主办的 11 月 12 日网络研讨会上表示，当地公共卫生官员正在“利用有限的资源竭尽全力”。但北卡罗来纳大学教堂山吉林斯全球公共卫生学院的布鲁尔指出，联邦层面的一项有凝聚力的计划可以在病毒到达新州之前加强防御。

paras.en: Such efforts could be targeted toward areas with low vaccination rates. Most places across the United States still have vaccination rates high enough to fend off measles. “A subset [with low vaccination rates] are high risk,” Lo says. “Figuring out which ones are which can be a little tricky. But if you do, then intervening in those places can be quite helpful to mitigate spread.”
paras.zh: 这些努力可以针对疫苗接种率低的地区。美国大多数地方的疫苗接种率仍然很高，足以抵御麻疹。 “（疫苗接种率低的）子集是高风险的，”Lo 说。 “弄清楚哪些是哪些可能有点棘手。但如果你这样做了，那么对这些地方进行干预对于减轻传播非常有帮助。”

paras.en: There’s also wiggle room in the childhood vaccine schedule to provide kids extra protection. Normally children don’t get their first MMR dose until their first birthday. But doctors can give infants an extra MMR dose at 6 months if there is an active outbreak in their area. Pediatricians can also offer the second dose a month after the first one, rather than waiting until around the time children start kindergarten. Adults, particularly those who received only one dose, can also get a booster. It’s unclear whether health officials will officially recommend such actions.
paras.zh: 儿童疫苗接种计划中也有回旋余地，可以为孩子提供额外的保护。通常，儿童直到一岁生日才会接种第一剂 MMR 疫苗。但如果婴儿所在地区存在活跃的 MMR 疫情，医生可以在 6 个月大时给婴儿额外注射 MMR 剂量。儿科医生还可以在第一次注射后一个月注射第二剂，而不是等到孩子开始上幼儿园的时候。成年人，特别是那些只接受一剂疫苗的人，也可以获得加强疫苗。目前尚不清楚卫生官员是否会正式建议采取此类行动。

paras.en: “The problem is that there’s no trusted source for this vaccine decision anymore,” Lo says. Previous vaccine recommendations were up to the CDC’s Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices, which was disbanded in March after lawsuits blocked appointments made by Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. “Now, there’s a lot of different medical societies and initiatives to try and fill that void,” Lo says. But it’s unclear which would be best positioned to lead.
paras.zh: “问题是这个疫苗决定不再有可信的来源，”罗说。此前的疫苗建议由疾病预防控制中心的免疫实践咨询委员会提出，该委员会因诉讼阻止了卫生与公共服务部部长小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪的任命而于三月份解散。“现在，有很多不同的医学协会和倡议试图填补这一空白，”罗说。但目前尚不清楚谁最适合领导。

paras.en: CDC director Erica Schwartz has said the health agency will not be changing its response to ongoing outbreaks. “We’re going to be doing the same exact thing that we’ve been doing today, which is working with the states,” she told Reuters. The CDC did not respond to Science News requests for an interview, but shared in a Nov. 17 statement that the agency will “encourage MMR vaccination, expand access to vaccines, and help communities close gaps in protection.”
paras.zh: 疾病预防控制中心主任埃里卡·施瓦茨表示，该卫生机构不会改变对持续爆发的疫情的应对措施。她告诉路透社：“我们将做与今天一样的事情，即与各州合作。” CDC 没有回应《科学新闻》的采访请求，但在 11 月 17 日的一份声明中表示，该机构将“鼓励 MMR 疫苗接种，扩大疫苗接种范围，并帮助社区缩小保护差距。”

paras.en: Eliminating measles again will take dedicated resources and more funding funneled to public health departments across the country, Lo says. “You see increasing measles outbreaks and a lot of time and resources to contain these outbreaks at a time where you’re slashing budgets,” Lo says, “that’s a really bad mismatch.”
paras.zh: 罗说，再次消除麻疹需要专门的资源和更多的资金流入全国各地的公共卫生部门。罗说：“在削减预算的同时，麻疹疫情不断增加，需要大量时间和资源来控制疫情，这是一种非常严重的不匹配。”

paras.en: Public health responses to measles are expensive. Officials in New Mexico spent an estimated $5.4 million — over $53,000 per case — responding to a 2025 outbreak that was linked to West Texas. The CDC has provided an additional $100 million to states to help fight measles.
paras.zh: 针对麻疹的公共卫生应对措施成本高昂。新墨西哥州官员估计花费了 540 万美元（每个病例超过 53,000 美元）来应对 2025 年与西德克萨斯州有关的疫情。疾病预防控制中心已向各州额外提供 1 亿美元，以帮助抗击麻疹。

paras.en: Other countries have beaten back measles after an unwelcome return. Extensive vaccination campaigns helped Venezuela and Brazil regain measles elimination status after briefly losing it in 2017 and 2019. The Public Health Agency of Canada also announced that its nearly two-year-long outbreak officially ended in October, though it’s unclear when the country might earn its status back.
paras.zh: 在麻疹不受欢迎地卷土重来后，其他国家已经成功击退了麻疹。广泛的疫苗接种活动帮助委内瑞拉和巴西在 2017 年和 2019 年短暂失去麻疹消除地位后重新获得麻疹消除地位。加拿大公共卫生局还宣布，长达近两年的疫情于 10 月正式结束，但尚不清楚该国何时才能恢复麻疹消除地位。

paras.en: “It is not hopeless,” Nuzzo said. “It can be done, and I hope it will be done [in the United States].”
paras.zh: “这并非毫无希望，”努佐说。 “这是可以做到的，而且我希望（在美国）能够做到。”

articles.title: Solo meerkats can find their way back home
articles.author: Meghan Rosen

paras.en: It was a hot, dry day in the Kalahari Desert, and Mathilde Martin was running after a meerkat.
paras.zh: 那是喀拉哈里沙漠炎热干燥的一天，玛蒂尔德·马丁正在追赶一只猫鼬。

paras.en: The animal wore a GPS tracker around its neck and bolted between shelters, like an action hero running for cover, says Martin, a biologist at the University of Zurich. She and her colleagues had captured the meerkat earlier that morning, driven it 1.5 kilometers from its pack and then released it into the desert. They were trying to find out how well individual meerkats could find their way back home.
paras.zh: 苏黎世大学生物学家马丁说，这只动物脖子上戴着 GPS 追踪器，在避难所之间奔跑，就像动作英雄奔跑寻找掩护一样。那天早上，她和她的同事捕获了这只猫鼬，将它赶离了狼群 1.5 公里，然后将它放回了沙漠。他们试图找出个体狐獴如何找到回家的路。

paras.en: The answer was quite well, the researchers reported November 19 in the Journal of Experimental Biology. The results suggest that meerkats can navigate expertly on their own, perhaps relying on mental maps charted early in life. “They all seem to be very, very good,” Martin says. It’s a surprise finding for a species known for its group cooperation.
paras.zh: 研究人员 11 月 19 日在《实验生物学杂志》上报道说，答案非常好。结果表明，狐獴可以熟练地自行导航，这可能依赖于生命早期绘制的心理地图。 “他们看起来都非常非常好，”马丁说。对于一个以群体合作闻名的物种来说，这是一个令人惊讶的发现。

paras.en: Meerkats (Suricata suricatta), which live in southern Africa, form tight-knit family groups of up to 50 members. These social animals cooperate in many aspects of life, including by babysitting each other’s pups and watching for predators while traveling along foraging paths. Martin and her colleagues thought meerkats might also rely on one another for navigating. Some pack members, perhaps those who’ve had more opportunity to explore solo, might have spatial knowledge of their territory and lead the rest, she says. But that’s not what the team discovered.
paras.zh: 狐獴 (Suricata suricatta) 生活在非洲南部，它们形成紧密的家庭群体，最多可容纳 50 名成员。这些群居动物在生活的许多方面进行合作，包括照顾彼此的幼崽，以及在沿着觅食路径行走时监视捕食者。马丁和她的同事们认为猫鼬也可能依靠彼此来导航。她说，一些狼群成员，也许是那些有更多机会独自探索的人，可能对自己的领地有空间知识，并领导其他成员。但这并不是团队的发现。

paras.en: In separate catch and release experiments with 20 individual meerkats, 18 made a beeline back home, back to their group or back to the site where they were captured. (The other two may have been too stressed to get moving, Martin says.)
paras.zh: 在对 20 只狐獴进行单独的捕捉和释放实验中，18 只猫鼬径直回家、回到它们的群体或回到它们被捕获的地点。 （马丁说，另外两个人可能压力太大而无法动弹。）

paras.en: Neither age nor individual experience, which researchers had been tracking, seemed to factor into the meerkats’ homing skills. Nearly all of them knew where to go, Martin says. She thinks these crackerjack navigators relied on visual cues to orient themselves. They’d pop up on their hind legs and scan the landscape before scampering off in a direct line to their target.
paras.zh: 研究人员一直在追踪的年龄和个人经历似乎都没有影响猫鼬的归巢技能。马丁说，几乎所有人都知道该去哪里。她认为这些出色的航海家依靠视觉提示来定位自己。它们会用后腿突然出现，扫描周围的风景，然后直接跑向目标。

paras.en: It’s likely that scent played a role, too, though distant scent marks may have faded by the time the meerkats were released. The researchers dropped the animals off in territory they hadn’t visited for at least 30 days. “Otherwise,” she says, “it would have been a bit too easy for them to find their way back,” she says.
paras.zh: 气味很可能也发挥了作用，尽管当猫鼬被释放时，远处的气味标记可能已经消失。研究人员将这些动物送到它们至少 30 天没有去过的地方。 “否则，”她说，“他们就太容易找到回去的路了，”她说。

articles.title: Antarctica’s ice cliffs are collapsing faster than expected, but there’s a twist

paras.en: Antarcticaâs ice cliffs are collapsing faster than expected, but thereâs a twist
paras.zh: 南极洲冰崖崩塌的速度比预期的要快，但情况却出现了转折

paras.en: - A surprising new study suggests Antarctica's towering ice cliffs may be less vulnerable to catastrophic collapse than scientists once feared. After tracking more than 15,000 ice cliffs, researchers discovered that even the tallest cliffs, which can collapse at alarming speeds, often stabilize rather than triggering an unstoppable chain reaction. Underwater ridges, surrounding water, and broken ice appear to provide natural defenses against further collapse.
paras.zh: - 一项令人惊讶的新研究表明，南极洲高耸的冰崖可能不像科学家曾经担心的那样容易遭受灾难性崩塌。在追踪了 15,000 多座冰崖后，研究人员发现，即使是最高的悬崖，也能以惊人的速度崩塌，通常会稳定下来，而不是引发不可阻挡的连锁反应。水下山脊、周围的水和破碎的冰似乎提供了防止进一步塌陷的天然防御。

paras.en: As temperatures rise, the floating ice shelves that help hold Antarctica's massive ice sheet in place are melting and breaking apart at record rates. As these protective barriers disappear, they expose towering walls of solid ice. Whether these cliffs remain standing or collapse could play a major role in Antarctica's future ice loss and its contribution to rising sea levels worldwide.
paras.zh: 随着气温上升，支撑南极洲巨大冰盖的漂浮冰架正在以创纪录的速度融化和破裂。当这些保护屏障消失时，高耸的固体冰墙就会暴露出来。这些悬崖是保持矗立还是倒塌，都可能对南极洲未来的冰损失及其对全球海平面上升的影响发挥重要作用。

paras.en: For years, scientists have believed that ice cliffs become unstable once they exceed 100 meters in height, roughly as tall as the Statue of Liberty. According to this theory, a cliff that grows too tall will collapse under its own weight, exposing an even taller wall of ice farther inland. That new cliff would then collapse, potentially setting off a chain reaction that causes the ice sheet to retreat rapidly.
paras.zh: 多年来，科学家们一直认为，一旦冰崖高度超过 100 米（大约与自由女神像一样高），就会变得不稳定。根据这一理论，长得太高的悬崖会在自身重量的作用下崩塌，露出内陆更高的冰墙。然后，新的悬崖就会崩塌，可能引发连锁反应，导致冰盖迅速后退。

paras.en: But new research from MIT and the Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution (WHOI) challenges this long-standing assumption. The findings suggest that the fate of an Antarctic ice cliff depends on much more than its height, and that even dramatic collapses do not necessarily lead to an unstoppable retreat.
paras.zh: 但麻省理工学院和伍兹霍尔海洋研究所 (WHOI) 的新研究挑战了这一长期存在的假设。研究结果表明，南极冰崖的命运不仅仅取决于其高度，而且即使是剧烈的崩塌也不一定会导致不可阻挡的消退。

paras.en: Published in the journal Science, the study examined satellite observations of more than 15,000 Antarctic ice cliffs collected over four years. Researchers discovered a surprising pattern: When the cliffs collapsed, they sometimes retreated much faster than existing models predicted. Yet rather than continuing to disintegrate, the affected glaciers soon stabilized.
paras.zh: 该研究发表在《科学》杂志上，研究了四年来收集的 15,000 多个南极冰崖的卫星观测结果。研究人员发现了一个令人惊讶的模式：当悬崖崩塌时，它们的后退速度有时比现有模型预测的要快得多。然而，受影响的冰川并没有继续崩解，而是很快稳定下来。

paras.en: "We found that when the cliffs were retreating, they were doing so faster than what has been modeled, which would mean more ice loss and higher contributions of sea level rise," says study author Caroline Needell, a graduate student in the MIT-WHOI Joint Program. "But because we found that the retreat was short-lived, and all the glaciers eventually stabilized, that would suggest that things won't be so bad. We don't see this runaway effect."
paras.zh: “我们发现，当悬崖后退时，其退缩速度比模拟的要快，这意味着更多的冰损失和对海平面上升的更大贡献，”该研究的作者、麻省理工学院-WHOI联合项目的研究生卡罗琳·尼德尔（Caroline Needell）说。 “但因为我们发现退缩是短暂的，所有冰川最终都稳定下来，这表明事情不会那么糟糕。我们没有看到这种失控的效应。”

paras.en: The study's co-authors are Catherine Walker, an assistant scientist at WHOI, and Jeremy Bassis, an associate professor at the University of Michigan.
paras.zh: 该研究的共同作者是 WHOI 的助理科学家凯瑟琳·沃克 (Catherine Walker) 和密歇根大学的副教授杰里米·巴西斯 (Jeremy Bassis)。

paras.en: Why Scientists Expected Antarctica's Ice Cliffs to Collapse
paras.zh: 为什么科学家预计南极洲的冰崖会崩塌

paras.en: The possibility of runaway ice cliff collapse is described by a theory called marine ice cliff instability (MICI). It proposes that when an exposed ice wall reaches a critical height, its own weight makes it structurally unstable. If the cliff falls and reveals an even taller wall behind it, the process could repeat, progressively eating away at the Antarctic ice sheet.
paras.zh: 失控冰崖崩塌的可能性由一种称为海洋冰崖不稳定性（MICI）的理论描述。它提出，当暴露的冰墙达到临界高度时，其自身重量使其结构不稳定。如果悬崖塌陷并露出后面更高的墙壁，这个过程可能会重复，逐渐侵蚀南极冰盖。

paras.en: Earlier research investigated this possibility primarily through computer models. Scientists used the physical properties of ice to estimate how enormous frozen cliffs should behave, then compared those calculations with a limited number of observations from Antarctica. These studies suggested that cliffs taller than approximately 100 meters were particularly vulnerable to collapse.
paras.zh: 早期的研究主要通过计算机模型调查这种可能性。科学家利用冰的物理特性来估计巨大的冰冻悬崖的行为，然后将这些计算结果与南极洲的有限观测结果进行比较。这些研究表明，高度超过 100 米的悬崖特别容易崩塌。

paras.en: "Predictive ice-sheet models that have been used so far to represent ice cliff instability just take into account cliff height," Needell notes. "That's the only variable that matters. And once the cliff height reaches the critical threshold, usually 100 meters, it should initiate this runaway effect of ice sheet retreat."
paras.zh: 尼德尔指出：“迄今为止用于表示冰崖不稳定的预测冰盖模型只考虑了悬崖高度。” “这是唯一重要的变量。一旦悬崖高度达到临界阈值，通常是 100 米，它就会引发冰盖退缩的失控效应。”

paras.en: Needell and her colleagues wanted to test those predictions against a much larger collection of real-world measurements. They sought to determine how tall Antarctica's ice cliffs actually become and whether their collapse consistently triggers the destructive chain reactions predicted by existing models.
paras.zh: 尼德尔和她的同事希望根据更多的现实世界测量数据来测试这些预测。他们试图确定南极洲冰崖的实际高度，以及冰崖的崩塌是否会持续引发现有模型预测的破坏性连锁反应。

paras.en: Satellites Reveal Surprising Ice Cliff Stability
paras.zh: 卫星揭示了令人惊讶的冰崖稳定性

paras.en: To investigate, the researchers turned to NASA's Ice, Cloud, and Land Elevation Satellite-2 (ICESat-2). This spacecraft repeatedly travels over Earth's polar regions, using a laser-based instrument called an altimeter to measure elevations with great precision. Its observations track the heights of glaciers, ice sheets, and sea ice, as well as ocean levels in and around Antarctica.
paras.zh: 为了进行调查，研究人员求助于 NASA 的冰、云和陆地高程卫星 2 (ICESat-2)。这艘航天器反复飞越地球的两极地区，使用一种称为高度计的激光仪器来高精度测量海拔。它的观测追踪冰川、冰盖和海冰的高度，以及南极洲及其周围的海平面。

paras.en: The team analyzed measurements gathered between 2019 and 2023, examining more than 15,000 ice cliffs at three-month intervals. Most were far shorter than the height considered dangerous by earlier models. The average cliff stood approximately 30 meters tall, although a small number exceeded the proposed 100-meter instability threshold.
paras.zh: 该团队分析了 2019 年至 2023 年间收集的测量数据，每隔三个月检查超过 15,000 个冰崖。大多数都远低于早期模型认为危险的高度。悬崖平均高度约为 30 米，但也有少数悬崖超出了建议的 100 米不稳定阈值。

paras.en: The researchers also searched for characteristics that might explain why some cliffs remained stable while others retreated.
paras.zh: 研究人员还寻找可能解释为什么一些悬崖保持稳定而另一些悬崖后退的特征。

paras.en: One important clue came from the broken ice accumulating in front of the cliffs. Known as mélange, this material consists of a slushy mixture of sea ice and fragments of icebergs. Cliffs that remained relatively stationary tended to have thicker accumulations of mélange, suggesting that the debris could help support the towering ice walls.
paras.zh: 一条重要线索来自悬崖前堆积的碎冰。这种物质被称为混合物，由海冰和冰山碎片的泥浆混合物组成。保持相对静止的悬崖往往有更厚的混合岩堆积，这表明这些碎片可以帮助支撑高耸的冰墙。

paras.en: "We measured mélange height and found taller cliffs have thicker mélange, which could be a built-in stabilizing effect," Needell explains.
paras.zh: “我们测量了混杂岩的高度，发现越高的悬崖具有越厚的混杂岩，这可能是一种内置的稳定效应，”尼德尔解释道。

paras.en: Surrounding seawater provided another possible source of stability. The observations indicated that deeper water can exert greater supporting pressure against an ice cliff, helping counteract the forces that might otherwise cause it to collapse.
paras.zh: 周围的海水提供了另一个可能的稳定来源。观察结果表明，更深的水可以对冰崖施加更大的支撑压力，有助于抵消可能导致冰崖崩塌的力量。

paras.en: Together, these findings suggest that the stability of Antarctica's ice cliffs cannot be predicted by height alone. Conditions in the water surrounding the ice may also determine whether a cliff remains standing.
paras.zh: 总之，这些发现表明，南极洲冰崖的稳定性不能仅通过高度来预测。冰周围的水域状况也可能决定悬崖是否仍然矗立。

paras.en: Antarctica's Tallest Ice Cliffs Collapse, Then Stabilize
paras.zh: 南极洲最高的冰崖崩塌，然后稳定下来

paras.en: "After we did that global analysis, we thought, ok, let's zoom in on the tallest cliffs and see how they're behaving," Needell says.
paras.zh: “在我们进行了全球分析之后，我们想，好吧，让我们放大最高的悬崖，看看它们的表现如何，”尼德尔说。

paras.en: The researchers selected four locations around Antarctica where satellites had recorded some of the tallest ice cliffs. Each stood approximately 100 meters high, with the tallest reaching 127 meters. The team then reconstructed how these cliffs changed at three-month intervals throughout the four-year study.
paras.zh: 研究人员选择了南极洲周围的四个地点，卫星记录了这些地点一些最高的冰崖。每一座都高约100米，最高的达到127米。然后，研究小组在四年的研究中重建了这些悬崖每隔三个月的变化情况。

paras.en: The results initially appeared to support the idea that extremely tall cliffs are unstable. These towering walls did collapse, and the glaciers behind them retreated at speeds substantially greater than those anticipated by existing MICI models.
paras.zh: 结果最初似乎支持极高的悬崖是不稳定的这一观点。这些高耸的墙壁确实倒塌了，它们后面的冰川后退的速度远远大于现有 MICI 模型预期的速度。

paras.en: However, the retreat did not continue indefinitely.
paras.zh: 然而，撤退并没有无限期地持续下去。

paras.en: "But that retreat was short-lived," Needell notes.
paras.zh: “但这种撤退是短暂的，”尼德尔指出。

paras.en: Instead of retreating farther inland in a continuous series of collapses, the glaciers stabilized and eventually advanced outward toward the ocean again.
paras.zh: 冰川并没有在一系列连续的崩塌中进一步向内陆退缩，而是稳定下来，最终再次向外推进到海洋。

paras.en: "It's this rapid retreat, punctuated by periods of stabilization," Needell says. "That was puzzling to us. Then, we thought: We need to look at all the things that affect cliff height."
paras.zh: “这是一种快速的撤退，其间不时出现稳定期，”尼德尔说。 “这让我们感到困惑。然后，我们想：我们需要研究影响悬崖高度的所有因素。”

paras.en: The unexpected pattern suggested that some overlooked physical processes were interrupting the collapse before it could develop into a sustained chain reaction.
paras.zh: 这种意想不到的模式表明，一些被忽视的物理过程在崩溃发展成持续的链式反应之前就中断了崩溃。

paras.en: Hidden Ridges Beneath the Ice Act as Natural Speed Bumps
paras.zh: 冰下隐藏的山脊充当天然减速带

paras.en: To understand what was stopping the retreat, the team examined the shape of the land beneath Antarctica's ice sheet.
paras.zh: 为了了解是什么阻止了撤退，研究小组检查了南极洲冰盖下的土地形状。

paras.en: This underlying terrain, known as bed topography, can strongly influence the height and stability of the ice above it. When the ground is relatively flat, the visible slope of the ice more closely reflects the thickness of the ice itself. But when the terrain rises into a ridge or bump, the ice resting on that elevated ground is thinner than its overall surface elevation might suggest.
paras.zh: 这种底层地形，称为河床地形，可以强烈影响其上方冰的高度和稳定性。当地面相对平坦时，冰的可见坡度更能反映冰本身的厚度。但是，当地形上升到山脊或凸起时，高地上的冰比其整体表面高度可能显示的要薄。

paras.en: These buried rises can function like natural speed bumps. By reducing the thickness of the overlying ice, they can make exposed cliffs shorter and less vulnerable to collapse.
paras.zh: 这些埋藏的隆起可以像天然的减速带一样发挥作用。通过减少覆盖冰层的厚度，它们可以使暴露的悬崖变得更短并且更不易崩塌。

paras.en: When the scientists compared the locations of stabilizing ice cliffs with measurements of Antarctica's underlying terrain, they found that the cliffs frequently stopped retreating where the ground rose beneath them.
paras.zh: 当科学家将稳定冰崖的位置与南极洲底层地形的测量结果进行比较时，他们发现悬崖经常在地面升高时停止后退。

paras.en: The researchers identified another important process. Taller cliffs tended to "thin out" more rapidly as they collapsed. Rather than remaining towering, unstable walls, they could quickly shrink into shorter cliffs that were better able to withstand further collapse.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现了另一个重要的过程。较高的悬崖在倒塌时往往会更快地“变薄”。它们不再是高耸、不稳定的墙壁，而是可以迅速收缩成更短的悬崖，更好地承受进一步的倒塌。

paras.en: These effects help explain why the researchers observed rapid initial ice loss followed by periods of stability, rather than the continuous retreat anticipated by earlier models.
paras.zh: 这些效应有助于解释为什么研究人员观察到冰最初快速流失，随后出现稳定期，而不是早期模型预期的持续消退。

paras.en: What the Discovery Means for Future Sea Level Rise
paras.zh: 这一发现对未来海平面上升意味着什么

paras.en: The findings could help scientists improve predictions of how Antarctica's ice sheet will respond to continued warming.
paras.zh: 这些发现可以帮助科学家更好地预测南极洲冰盖将如何应对持续变暖。

paras.en: Although the researchers observed some cliffs collapsing faster than expected, the rapid retreat was temporary in the locations they studied. This challenges the assumption that crossing a particular height threshold inevitably leads to runaway collapse.
paras.zh: 尽管研究人员观察到一些悬崖崩塌的速度比预期的要快，但在他们研究的地点，快速后退只是暂时的。这挑战了跨越特定高度阈值不可避免地导致失控崩溃的假设。

paras.en: The results do not mean Antarctica's ice sheet is safe from further losses. Instead, they reveal that predicting its future requires accounting for several interacting factors, including the shape of the land beneath the ice, the rate at which ice becomes thinner, the depth of surrounding water, and the stabilizing effects of broken ice.
paras.zh: 结果并不意味着南极洲的冰盖不会遭受进一步的损失。相反，他们表明，预测其未来需要考虑几个相互作用的因素，包括冰下陆地的形状、冰变薄的速度、周围水的深度以及破碎冰的稳定作用。

paras.en: "Now we know what to look for," Needell says. "We really need to know the bed topography, and we need to know the ice thinning rate, in order to get ice cliff instability right, because this value really matters in the context of projecting sea level rise."
paras.zh: “现在我们知道要寻找什么，”尼德尔说。 “我们确实需要了解河床地形，我们需要了解冰层的薄化率，以便正确确定冰崖的不稳定性，因为这个值在预测海平面上升的背景下确实很重要。”

paras.en: By incorporating these additional processes into ice sheet models, scientists may be able to produce more reliable estimates of Antarctica's future contribution to global sea level rise.
paras.zh: 通过将这些额外的过程纳入冰盖模型，科学家们或许能够对南极洲未来对全球海平面上升的贡献做出更可靠的估计。

paras.en: The research received partial support from NASA, the U.S. National Science Foundation, and the DOMINOS project, which is part of the International Thwaites Glacier Collaboration.
paras.zh: 该研究得到了美国宇航局、美国国家科学基金会和多米诺骨牌项目的部分支持，该项目是国际思韦茨冰川合作的一部分。

paras.en: Materials provided by Massachusetts Institute of Technology. Original written by Jennifer Chu. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由麻省理工学院提供。原创作者：朱珍妮。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

paras.en: - Caroline Needell, Catherine C. Walker, Jeremy N. Bassis. Empirical constraints on ice cliff calving. Science, 2026; 394 (6821): 311 DOI: 10.1126/science.aee0658
paras.zh: - 卡罗琳·尼德尔、凯瑟琳·C·沃克、杰里米·N·巴西斯。冰崖崩解的经验限制。科学，2026； 394 (6821): 311 DOI: 10.1126/science.aee0658

articles.title: Why hydrogen flames can glow orange, then turn nearly invisible

paras.en: Why hydrogen flames can glow orange, then turn nearly invisible
paras.zh: 为什么氢火焰会发出橙色光，然后几乎看不见

paras.en: - Hydrogen flames can shift from bright orange to nearly invisible depending on something unexpected: tiny amounts of sodium floating in the air. Scientists say this discovery could help make future hydrogen-powered stoves and ovens safer by replacing visual flame detection with specialized sensors.
paras.zh: - 氢火焰可能会从亮橙色转变为几乎看不见，具体取决于一些意外情况：空气中漂浮着微量的钠。科学家表示，这一发现可以通过用专门的传感器取代视觉火焰检测来帮助使未来的氢动力炉和烤箱更安全。

paras.en: Hydrogen flames can glow bright orange one day and become almost impossible to see the next, even when the burner settings remain exactly the same. Researchers at Adelaide University have now identified a surprising reason for this dramatic change, offering insights that could help make hydrogen-powered stoves, ovens, and other household appliances safer and more dependable.
paras.zh: 氢火焰有一天会发出明亮的橙色光，而第二天就几乎不可能看到，即使燃烧器设置保持完全相同。阿德莱德大学的研究人员现已发现了这一巨大变化的一个令人惊讶的原因，并提供了有助于使氢动力炉、烤箱和其他家用电器更安全、更可靠的见解。

paras.en: The study, published in Next Energy, found that much of the difference comes down to sodium, a naturally occurring element carried through the air in microscopic particles. Sea salt transported inland by the wind is one important source.
paras.zh: 这项发表在《Next Energy》上的研究发现，这种差异很大程度上归因于钠，一种以微小颗粒形式存在于空气中的天然元素。通过风输送到内陆的海盐是重要来源之一。

paras.en: When sodium is present in the surrounding air, hydrogen flames can take on a noticeable orange glow. But when sodium concentrations fall, the flames become much harder to see, even though the burner continues operating under the same conditions.
paras.zh: 当周围空气中存在钠时，氢火焰会发出明显的橙色光芒。但当钠浓度下降时，即使燃烧器在相同条件下继续运行，火焰也会变得更难看到。

paras.en: This discovery has important implications for the development of hydrogen appliances. Instead of depending on flame color to show whether a burner is running, engineers may need to incorporate other detection technologies. Improving these systems could help support the adoption of hydrogen as a lower-emissions alternative to natural gas.
paras.zh: 这一发现对于氢设备的发展具有重要意义。工程师可能需要结合其他检测技术，而不是依靠火焰颜色来显示燃烧器是否正在运行。改进这些系统可以帮助支持采用氢气作为天然气的低排放替代品。

paras.en: Why Hydrogen Flames Change Color With the Weather
paras.zh: 为什么氢火焰会随着天气而改变颜色

paras.en: Lead researcher Professor Paul Medwell, from the School of Electrical and Mechanical Engineering at Adelaide University, explained that studying hydrogen flames under ordinary environmental conditions is essential for developing appliances that people can safely and confidently use at home.*
paras.zh: 阿德莱德大学机电工程学院的首席研究员 Paul Medwell 教授解释说，研究普通环境条件下的氢火焰对于开发人们可以在家里安全、自信地使用的电器至关重要。*

paras.en: "Hydrogen has significant potential as part of a lower-emissions energy future, and we need to understand how it behaves in the real world if we want people to be confident using it.
paras.zh: “氢作为低排放能源未来的一部分具有巨大的潜力，如果我们希望人们有信心使用它，我们需要了解它在现实世界中的表现。

paras.en: "Our research helps explain why hydrogen flames can look different from one day to the next. That knowledge gives engineers valuable information to develop appliances and flame-detection systems that work reliably, regardless of changing environmental conditions."
paras.zh: “我们的研究有助于解释为什么氢火焰每天看起来都会有所不同。这些知识为工程师提供了宝贵的信息，以开发无论环境条件如何变化都能可靠工作的设备和火焰检测系统。”

paras.en: To investigate these changes, the researchers combined controlled laboratory experiments with outdoor testing around Adelaide. They examined how hydrogen flames responded to variations in atmospheric conditions, including shifting weather patterns and changes in the air reaching the burner.
paras.zh: 为了研究这些变化，研究人员将受控实验室实验与阿德莱德周围的户外测试结合起来。他们研究了氢火焰如何响应大气条件的变化，包括天气模式的变化和到达燃烧器的空气的变化。

paras.en: Over two weeks, the team monitored light emissions from hydrogen flames while keeping the burner settings unchanged. Despite the consistent operating conditions, the sodium-related light signal varied by more than 28 times between its lowest and highest recorded values.
paras.zh: 两周多以来，该团队在保持燃烧器设置不变的情况下监测氢火焰的光发射。尽管操作条件一致，但与钠相关的光信号在最低记录值和最高记录值之间变化超过 28 倍。

paras.en: Weather played a major role in those differences. Air that had passed over the ocean generally contained more sodium, producing flames with a stronger orange glow. When the air carried less sodium, the flames appeared considerably fainter.
paras.zh: 天气在这些差异中发挥了重要作用。经过海洋的空气通常含有更多的钠，产生更强烈的橙色光芒的火焰。当空气中钠含量减少时，火焰显得相当微弱。

paras.en: Hydrogen Flames Are Harder to See Than Natural Gas Flames
paras.zh: 氢气火焰比天然气火焰更难看见

paras.en: The researchers also examined how hydrogen flames compared with those produced by a conventional natural gas cooktop.
paras.zh: 研究人员还研究了氢火焰与传统天然气炉灶产生的火焰的比较。

paras.en: They found that hydrogen flames emitted less visible light on average, even when atmospheric conditions favored a brighter flame. This difference presents an additional challenge for appliances that use visible flames to indicate whether a burner is operating.
paras.zh: 他们发现，即使大气条件有利于更亮的火焰，氢火焰平均发出的可见光也较少。这种差异对于使用可见火焰来指示燃烧器是否正在运行的器具提出了额外的挑战。

paras.en: Hydrogen combustion can also produce faint blue and red light. However, the researchers found that these colors were easiest to detect in darkened surroundings, making them less useful as reliable visual indicators under everyday lighting conditions.
paras.zh: 氢气燃烧还可产生微弱的蓝光和红光。然而，研究人员发现这些颜色在黑暗环境中最容易被检测到，因此在日常照明条件下它们作为可靠的视觉指示器的用处不大。

paras.en: Together, the findings show why judging whether a hydrogen burner is operating based on appearance alone may be unreliable. A flame that is clearly visible under one set of conditions could become extremely difficult to detect when the surrounding air changes.
paras.zh: 总之，这些发现表明了为什么仅根据外观来判断氢气燃烧器是否正在运行可能不可靠。当周围空气发生变化时，在一组条件下清晰可见的火焰可能会变得极难检测到。

paras.en: Medwell emphasized that the results do not undermine hydrogen's potential as an energy source. Instead, they demonstrate why appliances must be engineered to accommodate the fuel's particular properties.
paras.zh: 梅德威尔强调，这些结果并没有削弱氢作为能源的潜力。相反，他们证明了为什么必须设计电器来适应燃料的特殊性能。

paras.en: "Different energy sources have different properties, and good engineering is about understanding those differences and designing for them.
paras.zh: “不同的能源具有不同的特性，好的工程就是理解这些差异并针对它们进行设计。

paras.en: "Rather than relying on a flame looking a particular color, we can investigate other ways of confirming that a burner is operating. Options include specialized ultraviolet or infrared flame detectors and temperature sensors.
paras.zh: “我们可以研究其他方法来确认燃烧器是否正在运行，而不是依靠看起来特定颜色的火焰。选项包括专门的紫外线或红外线火焰探测器和温度传感器。

paras.en: "By identifying the factors that influence flame visibility, we can help inform the development of hydrogen appliances that are fit for purpose in real homes and other everyday settings."
paras.zh: “通过确定影响火焰可见度的因素，我们可以帮助开发适合真实家庭和其他日常环境的氢气设备。”

paras.en: Such detection systems could provide a more dependable way to confirm that hydrogen is burning, regardless of whether its flame appears orange, faint blue, or is barely visible.
paras.zh: 这种检测系统可以提供一种更可靠的方法来确认氢气正在燃烧，无论其火焰是橙色、淡蓝色还是几乎看不见。

paras.en: By identifying how environmental sodium affects flame visibility, the research provides information that engineers can use when designing hydrogen appliances for kitchens and other everyday environments. That knowledge could help make the technology safer and more practical as interest in lower-emissions energy alternatives grows.
paras.zh: 通过确定环境中的钠如何影响火焰可见度，该研究提供了工程师在设计用于厨房和其他日常环境的氢设备时可以使用的信息。随着人们对低排放能源替代品兴趣的增长，这些知识可以帮助使该技术更安全、更实用。

paras.en: The project brought together researchers from Adelaide University, the University of New South Wales, and Gas Infrastructure Research Australia. Support came through the Future Fuels Cooperative Research Centre, with funding provided under the Australian Government's Cooperative Research Centres Program.
paras.zh: 该项目汇集了来自阿德莱德大学、新南威尔士大学和澳大利亚天然气基础设施研究中心的研究人员。未来燃料合作研究中心提供了支持，并由澳大利亚政府合作研究中心计划提供资金。

paras.en: The study, 'The role of sodium on hydrogen flame visibility in domestic settings,' was published in Next Energy
paras.zh: 该研究“钠对家庭环境中氢火焰能见度的作用”发表在《Next Energy》上

paras.en: *In 2023, the Australian Gas Infrastructure Group (AGIG) introduced Australia's first 100% hydrogen-powered home in Victoria. The demonstration showed that household gas appliances could operate entirely on hydrogen, a development described as a 'game changer'.
paras.zh: *2023 年，澳大利亚天然气基础设施集团 (AGIG) 在维多利亚州推出了澳大利亚第一座 100% 氢动力住宅。演示表明家用燃气器具可以完全依靠氢气运行，这一发展被称为“游戏规则改变者”。

paras.en: Materials provided by Adelaide University. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由阿德莱德大学提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

paras.en: - Paul R. Medwell, Jordan A.C. Kildare, Yilong Yin, Qing N. Chan, Michael J. Evans, Neil L. Smith, Peter J. Ashman, Douglas B. Proud. The role of sodium on hydrogen flame visibility in domestic settings. Next Energy, 2026; 13: 100962 DOI: 10.1016/j.nxener.2026.100962
paras.zh: - Paul R. Medwell、Jordan A.C. Kildare、Yilong Yin、Qing N. Chan、Michael J. Evans、Neil L. Smith、Peter J. Ashman、Douglas B. Proud。钠对家庭环境中氢火焰可见度的作用。下一代能源，2026； 13：100962 DOI：10.1016/j.nxener.2026.100962

articles.title: Experimental compound burns fat without sacrificing muscle

paras.en: Experimental compound burns fat without sacrificing muscle
paras.zh: 实验化合物燃烧脂肪而不牺牲肌肉

paras.en: - Researchers at UC Berkeley have identified a compound that could transform weight-loss treatment by helping the body burn more energy instead of suppressing appetite like Ozempic and Wegovy. In mice, the compound boosted energy expenditure by up to 18%, improved blood sugar control, reduced liver fat, and promoted weight loss without significant muscle loss. Even more promising, combining it with existing GLP-1 medications produced greater benefits than either treatment alone.
paras.zh: - 加州大学伯克利分校的研究人员发现了一种化合物，它可以帮助身体燃烧更多能量，而不是像 Ozempic 和 Wegovy 那样抑制食欲，从而改变减肥治疗。在小鼠中，该化合物可将能量消耗提高高达 18%，改善血糖控制，减少肝脏脂肪，并促进体重减轻，而不会导致肌肉明显损失。更有希望的是，将其与现有的 GLP-1 药物相结合比单独使用任何一种治疗方法都能产生更大的益处。

paras.en: A new approach to weight loss could help the body burn more fat while preserving muscle, potentially overcoming one of the major drawbacks of existing obesity treatments. Researchers at the University of California, Berkeley, have identified a compound that increases the amount of energy the body uses rather than simply reducing how much food a person eats.
paras.zh: 一种新的减肥方法可以帮助身体燃烧更多脂肪，同时保留肌肉，从而有可能克服现有肥胖治疗的主要缺点之一。加州大学伯克利分校的研究人员发现了一种化合物，它可以增加身体使用的能量，而不是简单地减少一个人吃的食物量。

paras.en: In experiments with mice, the compound improved blood sugar regulation, reduced harmful blood fats, and helped obese animals lose fat without a significant reduction in lean muscle mass. It also increased energy expenditure by up to 18%, even though the mice did not become more physically active or experience an increase in body temperature.
paras.zh: 在小鼠实验中，该化合物改善了血糖调节，减少了有害的血脂，并帮助肥胖动物减掉脂肪，而不会显着减少瘦肌肉质量。它还能使能量消耗增加高达 18%，尽管小鼠的体力没有变得更加活跃或体温没有升高。

paras.en: The findings, published in Science Advances, suggest a promising new direction for treating obesity, diabetes, and fatty liver disease. The experimental compound also appeared to enhance the benefits of popular weight-loss medications such as Ozempic and Wegovy when the treatments were used together. However, its effectiveness and safety have not yet been established in humans.
paras.zh: 发表在《科学进展》上的研究结果为治疗肥胖、糖尿病和脂肪肝疾病提出了一个有希望的新方向。当 Ozempic 和 Wegovy 等流行减肥药物一起使用时，该实验化合物似乎还可以增强这些药物的功效。然而，其在人类中的有效性和安全性尚未确定。

paras.en: A Different Approach to Weight Loss Than Ozempic
paras.zh: 与 Ozempic 不同的减肥方法

paras.en: Over the past five years, medications known as GLP-1 drugs have transformed the treatment of obesity and other metabolic conditions, including diabetes and fatty liver disease. Drugs marketed as Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro, and Zepbound have helped many patients achieve substantial weight loss while improving their ability to regulate blood sugar.
paras.zh: 在过去的五年里，GLP-1 药物已经改变了肥胖和其他代谢疾病（包括糖尿病和脂肪肝疾病）的治疗方法。以 Ozempic、Wegovy、Mounjaro 和 Zepbound 等商品名销售的药物已帮助许多患者实现了大幅减肥，同时提高了他们调节血糖的能力。

paras.en: Despite these benefits, the medications have important limitations. Nausea and other digestive problems can make treatment difficult for some patients. Because these drugs reduce appetite and food consumption, they can also increase the risk of inadequate nutrition and loss of muscle mass. Over time, losing too much muscle can contribute to weakness, frailty, and other health complications.
paras.zh: 尽管有这些好处，这些药物也有重要的局限性。恶心和其他消化问题可能会给一些患者带来治疗困难。由于这些药物会降低食欲和食物消耗，因此还会增加营养不足和肌肉质量损失的风险。随着时间的推移，失去过多的肌肉会导致虚弱、虚弱和其他健康并发症。

paras.en: Berkeley researchers wanted to investigate a fundamentally different strategy. Rather than focusing on reducing calorie intake, they explored whether it would be possible to increase the amount of energy the body burns.
paras.zh: 伯克利的研究人员想要研究一种完全不同的策略。他们没有专注于减少卡路里摄入量，而是探索是否有可能增加身体燃烧的能量。

paras.en: This process, known as energy expenditure, includes the calories used to maintain basic bodily functions, regulate metabolism, and support everyday activities. Increasing energy expenditure could potentially help people lose weight without relying exclusively on eating less.
paras.zh: 这一过程称为能量消耗，包括用于维持基本身体功能、调节新陈代谢和支持日常活动的卡路里。增加能量消耗可能会帮助人们减肥，而不必完全依赖于少吃。

paras.en: "Body weight responds to two levers: taking in fewer calories, or spending more energy," said Anders Näär, a professor of metabolic biology and nutrition at UC Berkeley and senior author of the study. "GLP-1s work almost entirely on the first, so we went after the second."
paras.zh: 加州大学伯克利分校代谢生物学和营养学教授、该研究的资深作者安德斯·纳尔 (Anders Näär) 表示：“体重受两个因素影响：摄入更少的卡路里，或消耗更多的能量。” “GLP-1 几乎完全对第一个起作用，所以我们追求第二个。”

paras.en: A Compound That Burns Fat While Preserving Muscle
paras.zh: 一种燃烧脂肪同时保护肌肉的化合物

paras.en: The researchers focused on a molecule called 5-tetradecyloxy-2-furoic acid (TOFA), which has an unusual combination of effects on the body's metabolism.
paras.zh: 研究人员重点研究了一种名为 5-十四烷氧基-2-糠酸 (TOFA) 的分子，它对人体的新陈代谢具有不同寻常的综合作用。

paras.en: TOFA interferes with the production of lipids, a broad category of fatty substances that includes cholesterol and triglycerides. These molecules serve important functions, but excessive levels of certain lipids can contribute to metabolic disorders and cardiovascular disease.
paras.zh: TOFA 会干扰脂质的产生，脂质是一类广泛的脂肪物质，包括胆固醇和甘油三酯。这些分子具有重要的功能，但某些脂质含量过高会导致代谢紊乱和心血管疾病。

paras.en: At the same time, TOFA activates genes involved in taking up and burning fat for energy. This combination allows the compound to influence both how the body produces fat and how it uses fat as fuel.
paras.zh: 同时，TOFA 激活参与吸收和燃烧脂肪以获取能量的基因。这种组合使得该化合物能够影响身体如何产生脂肪以及如何使用脂肪作为燃料。

paras.en: In mice, treatment with TOFA produced several encouraging results. The animals became more sensitive to insulin, the hormone that helps move glucose from the bloodstream into cells. Improved insulin sensitivity makes it easier for the body to control blood sugar, an important benefit for people with diabetes or insulin resistance.
paras.zh: 在小鼠中，TOFA 治疗产生了一些令人鼓舞的结果。这些动物对胰岛素变得更加敏感，胰岛素是一种有助于将葡萄糖从血液转移到细胞中的激素。改善胰岛素敏感性使身体更容易控制血糖，这对于糖尿病或胰岛素抵抗患者来说是一个重要的好处。
