paras.en: Bancroft also named former bowling coach David Saker, claiming he received encouragement from players and coaches about his work on the ball.
paras.zh: 班克罗夫特还点名了前保龄球教练大卫·萨克，声称他得到了球员和教练对他在球方面的工作的鼓励。

paras.en: He also alleged former head coach Darren Lehmann knew what was happening.
paras.zh: 他还声称前主教练达伦·莱曼知道发生了什么。

paras.en: "This event is crystal clear in my mind. Not only for the praise I received, but [because] I also remember a very different reaction," he wrote.
paras.zh: “这件事在我的脑海中清晰可见。不仅因为我收到的赞扬，而且[因为]我还记得一个非常不同的反应，”他写道。

paras.en: "Our media manager, Kate Hutchison, expressed her objection to what was happening.
paras.zh: “我们的媒体经理凯特·哈奇森（Kate Hutchison）对所发生的事情表示反对。

paras.en: "I recall her making it clear that she believed it was wrong, that she wanted nothing to do with it, and walking away from the discussion.
paras.zh: “我记得她明确表示她认为这是错误的，她不想与此事有任何关系，然后就退出了讨论。

paras.en: "I will never forget that. Somebody had spoken up."
paras.zh: “我永远不会忘记这一点。有人站出来说话了。”

paras.en: Bancroft said he withheld important details during the original investigation, including when the sandpaper use began, how long it continued and the involvement or awareness of others.
paras.zh: 班克罗夫特表示，他在最初调查期间隐瞒了重要细节，包括何时开始使用砂纸、持续了多长时间以及其他人的参与或意识。

paras.en: He said Cummins's recent denial was "the final straw" that prompted him to speak publicly.
paras.zh: 他表示，康明斯最近的否认是促使他公开发表言论的“最后一根稻草”。

paras.en: "It made me feel angry, betrayed and alone," he wrote.
paras.zh: “这让我感到愤怒、被背叛和孤独，”他写道。

paras.en: "What I saw, experienced and lived with — not only him, but everyone else on that tour in South Africa — is not the public account he gave in his press conference and in the years previously when he has spoken on this time."
paras.zh: “我所看到的、经历过的、和我一起生活的——不仅是他，还有南非之行中的其他人——并不是他在新闻发布会上以及几年前他在这次演讲中发表的公开言论。”

paras.en: Bancroft's international career was the worst affected of the sanctioned trio, making only two more appearances for Australia after the test series against South Africa in 2018.
paras.zh: 班克罗夫特的国际生涯是受制裁三人组中受影响最严重的，在2018年对阵南非的系列赛后，他只为澳大利亚队出场了两次。

paras.en: Steve Smith, the captain of the side during the ball tampering scandal, has been at his New York home while all this has played out, well and truly out of the limelight.
paras.zh: 史蒂夫·史密斯（Steve Smith）是球队篡球丑闻期间的队长，他一直待在纽约的家中，而这一切都已经结束，真正远离了聚光灯。

paras.en: Of course, his tears were among the most defining scenes of the entire scandal.
paras.zh: 当然，他的眼泪是整个丑闻中最具决定性的场景之一。

paras.en: In an early press conference, Smith admitted "the leadership group knew about" ball tampering, but lied by saying it was not sandpaper but tape with grit on it.
paras.zh: 在早期的新闻发布会上，史密斯承认“领导小组知道”球篡改，但撒谎说那不是砂纸，而是带有砂砾的胶带。

paras.en: He refused to name the other players involved in hatching the plan, saying that he took responsibility.
paras.zh: 他拒绝透露参与制定该计划的其他参与者的姓名，并表示他承担责任。

paras.en: "I'm incredibly sorry for trying to bring the game into disrepute the way we did."
paras.zh: “对于我们试图让这款游戏名誉扫地的做法，我感到非常抱歉。”

paras.en: At his infamous press conference in Sydney, when he broke down in tears in front of the press, he said that he would "regret this for the rest of my life".
paras.zh: 在悉尼臭名昭著的新闻发布会上，当他在媒体面前泪流满面时，他说他将“后悔终生”。

paras.en: He was banned for 12 months for his part in the plot, but has since returned and re-established himself as one of the premier batters of this generation, if not all time.
paras.zh: 他因参与阴谋而被禁赛 12 个月，但此后他又回归并重新确立了自己作为这一代顶尖击球手之一的地位，甚至是永远的地位。

paras.en: Smith has not spoken since Usman Khawaja's book was released, but he has still been in the heart of the coverage.
paras.zh: 自从乌斯曼·哈瓦贾的书出版后，史密斯就没有发表过讲话，但他仍然是报道的中心人物。

paras.en: "I told Smudge [Smith] that I was going to come clean to the media," Khawaja wrote in his book.
paras.zh: 卡瓦贾在他的书中写道：“我告诉斯马奇（史密斯）我将向媒体坦白。”

paras.en: "I couldn't believe the penalties he got. But Smudge being the man and leader he was, he talked me out of it.
paras.zh: “我简直不敢相信他受到的处罚。但是斯马奇作为一个男人和领袖，他说服了我不要这样做。

paras.en: "He wanted to take the blame. I argued with him, but he was having none of it. That's the first time I try to come out."
paras.zh: “他想承担责任。我和他争论，但他不同意。这是我第一次尝试出柜。”

paras.en: Shaun Marsh had said nothing recently about the Sandpapergate scandal.
paras.zh: 肖恩·马什最近没有就“沙纸门”丑闻发表任何言论。

paras.en: However, he was asked in 2022 whether he had been interviewed as part of Cricket Australia's investigation into the incident.
paras.zh: 然而，他在 2022 年被问到，作为澳大利亚板球协会对该事件调查的一部分，他是否接受过采访。

paras.en: "I wasn't [interviewed]," Marsh told the Sydney Morning Herald and The Age.
paras.zh: “我没有[接受采访]，”马什告诉《悉尼先驱晨报》和《时代报》。

paras.en: "I was a little bit [surprised] at the time. That's all I'll say."
paras.zh: “当时我有点[惊讶]。我只能说这么多。”

paras.en: Tim Paine became captain of the Australian cricket team following the events of Cape Town.
paras.zh: 开普敦事件后，蒂姆·潘恩成为澳大利亚板球队队长。

paras.en: Since then, he was stripped of the captaincy in 2021 following allegations of him sending inappropriate messages to a female colleague.
paras.zh: 此后，由于被指控向一名女同事发送不当信息，他于 2021 年被剥夺了队长职务。

paras.en: In his autobiography, Paine said he and the rest of the team were "stunned" at the footage of Bancroft and the sandpaper.
paras.zh: 潘恩在自传中表示，他和团队其他成员对班克罗夫特和砂纸的镜头感到“震惊”。

paras.en: "Everyone out there was shocked when they looked up on the big screen and saw Cameron Bancroft with a piece of sandpaper in his hand," Paine wrote.
paras.zh: “当所有人抬头看到大屏幕并看到卡梅伦·班克罗夫特手里拿着一张砂纸时，都感到震惊，”潘恩写道。

paras.en: "My heart sank, I was thinking, 'What the f***?' A sense of dread came over us all."
paras.zh: “我的心沉了下去，我在想，‘到底是什么？’我们所有人都感到恐惧。”

paras.en: Cameron Bancroft does mention Paine in his piece, but does not specifically say whether he spoke to him about the use of sandpaper.
paras.zh: 卡梅伦·班克罗夫特确实在他的文章中提到了潘恩，但没有具体说明他是否与潘恩谈论过砂纸的使用。

paras.en: "I also spoke with Tim Paine, who was in a key position behind the stumps to observe how the ball was moving," Bancroft wrote.
paras.zh: 班克罗夫特写道：“我还与蒂姆·潘恩进行了交谈，他处于树桩后面的关键位置，观察球的移动情况。”

paras.en: "How else am I to know if what I'm doing is effective or not if I don't have these conversations with the bowlers bowling with it and the wicketkeeper?
paras.zh: “如果我不与投球的投球手和守门员进行这些对话，我怎么知道我所做的是否有效？

paras.en: Hazlewood has kept his council since Usman Khawaja released his book.
paras.zh: 自从乌斯曼·哈瓦贾（Usman Khawaja）出版他的书以来，黑兹尔伍德一直保留着他的委员会。

paras.en: However, he is referenced in the pages of Sabr, albeit indirectly.
paras.zh: 然而，《Sabr》的页面中却间接提到了他。

paras.en: In Sabr, Khawaja writes that: "One of the bowlers went on [Fox Sports'] The Back Page TV show and was asked point blank if he'd known anything about the ball tampering".
paras.zh: 卡瓦贾在《萨布尔》中写道：“一名投球手参加了福克斯体育的《The Back Page》电视节目，并被直截了当地问他是否知道有关球篡改的任何事情”。

paras.en: "He flat out denied it. David [Warner] was seething, and understandably so. I remember him texting me and sending the clip.
paras.zh: “他断然否认。大卫（华纳）非常愤怒，这是可以理解的。我记得他给我发短信并发送了剪辑。

paras.en: "I didn't mind the guys staying quiet. Hell, I was doing the same thing. But to come out and say that on live TV really pissed me off. If you aren't willing to tell the whole story, just stay quiet.''
paras.zh: “我不介意这些人保持安静。天哪，我也在做同样的事情。但是在电视直播中站出来说这句话真的让我很生气。如果你不愿意讲述整个故事，那就保持安静。”

paras.en: Hazlewood was at least sticking to his guns, having denied all knowledge of the plot along with his fellow bowling unit.
paras.zh: 黑兹尔伍德至少坚持自己的立场，否认与他的保龄球同伴一起了解这一阴谋。

paras.en: They even released a statement along those lines in 2021, reiterating that they had no idea.
paras.zh: 他们甚至在 2021 年发表了类似的声明，重申他们不知道。

paras.en: Bancroft said reading that statement was "deeply painful".
paras.zh: 班克罗夫特表示，读到这份声明“非常痛苦”。

paras.en: "I had memories of conversations on the field in Port Elizabeth and Newlands, feedback about the ball and shared celebrations that made the statement difficult for me to digest."
paras.zh: “我记得在伊丽莎白港和纽兰兹球场上的谈话、有关舞会的反馈以及共同的庆祝活动，这些都让我难以消化这句话。”

paras.en: Like Hazlewood, Nathan Lyon has kept quiet since the revelations have started tumbling from the Australian Test team.
paras.zh: 和黑兹尔伍德一样，自澳大利亚测试队开始爆料以来，内森·里昂一直保持沉默。

paras.en: He did, alongside Mitch Starc, Pat Cummins and Josh Hazlewood, release a statement in 2021 in response to a Guardian interview that Cam Bancroft gave while he was playing County cricket.
paras.zh: 他确实与米奇·斯塔克、帕特·卡明斯和乔什·黑兹尔伍德一起在 2021 年发表了一份声明，回应卡姆·班克罗夫特在打县板球时接受的卫报采访。

paras.en: The statement read: "We pride ourselves on our honesty. So it's been disappointing to see that our integrity has been questioned by some journalists and past players in recent days in regard to the Cape Town Test of 2018.
paras.zh: 声明中写道：“我们为自己的诚实感到自豪。因此，最近几天我们的诚信受到一些记者和过去的球员在 2018 年开普敦测试中的质疑，这令人失望。”

paras.en: "We have already answered questions many times on this issue, but we feel compelled to put the key facts on the record again:
paras.zh: “我们已经就这个问题多次回答过问题，但我们觉得有必要再次将关键事实记录在案：

paras.en: "We did not know a foreign substance was taken onto the field to alter the condition of the ball until we saw the images on the big screen at Newlands
paras.zh: “直到我们在纽兰兹的大屏幕上看到这些图像之前，我们并不知道有异物被带到球场上来改变球的状况。

paras.en: "And to those who, despite the absence of evidence, insist that 'we must have known' about the use of a foreign substance simply because we are bowlers, we say this: The umpires during that Test match, Nigel Llong and Richard Illingworth, both very respected and experienced umpires, inspected the ball after the images surfaced on the TV coverage and did not change it because there was no sign of damage.
paras.zh: “对于那些在没有证据的情况下坚持‘我们一定知道’使用了异物的人，仅仅因为我们是保龄球手，我们这样说：在那场测试赛中，裁判员奈杰尔·隆和理查德·伊林沃斯都是非常受人尊敬且经验丰富的裁判，在图像出现在电视报道中后检查了球，并且没有改变它，因为没有损坏的迹象。

paras.en: "None of this excuses what happened on the field that day at Newlands. It was wrong and it should never have happened.
paras.zh: “这一切都不能成为那天在纽兰兹球场上发生的事情的借口。这是错误的，它根本不应该发生。

paras.en: "We've all learned valuable lessons and we'd like to think the public can see a change for the better in terms of the way we play, the way we behave and respect the game. Our commitment to improving as people and players will continue.
paras.zh: “我们都学到了宝贵的经验教训，我们希望公众能够看到我们的比赛方式、行为方式和尊重比赛方面的更好的变化。我们将继续致力于改善人们和球员。

paras.en: "We respectfully request an end to the rumour-mongering and innuendo.
paras.zh: “我们恭敬地要求停止散布谣言和影射。

paras.en: "It has gone on too long and it is time to move on."
paras.zh: “事情已经过去太久了，是时候继续前进了。”

paras.en: Nic Maddinson played his five Tests so far either side of the 2018 South Africa series, a decade-long gap in part due to a diagnosis and recovery from testicular cancer.
paras.zh: 尼克·马丁森迄今为止在 2018 年南非系列赛的两边都参加了五次测试，长达十年的差距部分是由于睾丸癌的诊断和康复。

paras.en: So he was not on hand to be a part of the scandal in South Africa eight years ago.
paras.zh: 因此，八年前南非的丑闻中，他并没有参与其中。

paras.en: It's not stopped him from chipping in since then though.
paras.zh: 但从那以后，这并没有阻止他参与进来。

paras.en: "It's obviously disappointing that it keeps coming up," Maddinson told Channel 10 after Sabr was released.
paras.zh: “这显然令人失望，它不断出现，”《Sabr》发行后，麦丁森告诉第 10 频道。

paras.en: "But it's time of year, isn't it? Where Christmas comes along and people have books to sell, so things come out.
paras.zh: “但现在是一年中的这个时候，不是吗？圣诞节到来时，人们有书要卖，所以东西就出来了。

paras.en: "It's just disappointing. I think the three guys that have been affected the most, it doesn't really help them at all to relive it.
paras.zh: “这真是令人失望。我认为这三个人受到的影响最大，这对他们重温这一切并没有真正的帮助。

paras.en: "Especially over the past month, having a great series in South Africa, obviously the crowd wasn't as hostile, maybe, as what people expected. But that stuff's still there every day at airports, and the general public making comments here and there. So I guess over time it would wear them down.
paras.zh: “特别是在过去的一个月里，在南非举办了一场精彩的系列赛，显然人群并不像人们预期的那样充满敌意。但这些东西每天都在机场里存在，公众到处发表评论。所以我想随着时间的推移，这会让他们疲惫不堪。

paras.en: "For it to pop up again, the start of the summer, going into a pretty big six months for the [Australia] team, it's obviously probably disappointing for those guys."
paras.zh: “在夏初，澳大利亚队将进入相当重要的六个月，对于这些人来说，这显然可能令人失望。”

paras.en: Scott Boland didn't make his Test debut until Boxing Day 2021 against England, so was nowhere near the sandpaper controversy.
paras.zh: 斯科特·博兰 (Scott Boland) 直到 2021 年节礼日对阵英格兰队才首次亮相测试赛，因此远没有引发砂纸争议。

paras.en: Nevertheless, he was caught in the crossfire of Usman Khawaja's book when Khawaja noted that Victoria were the best at "the dark arts" in Australian domestic cricket.
paras.zh: 然而，当卡瓦贾指出维多利亚是澳大利亚国内板球界最擅长“黑暗艺术”的人时，他陷入了乌斯曼·卡瓦贾书中的交锋。

paras.en: "I don't know what the 'dark arts' are. You probably have to ask Usman for that," Boland said ahead of Victoria's first Sheffield Shield game since the book was released.
paras.zh: “我不知道‘黑暗艺术’是什么。你可能得问乌斯曼，”自这本书出版以来，博兰在维多利亚第一场谢菲尔德盾比赛前说道。

paras.en: "I don't know — if you went back to club cricket, without cameras, you would probably see a lot of things happen.
paras.zh: “我不知道——如果你回到板球俱乐部，没有摄像机，你可能会看到很多事情发生。

paras.en: "From my point of view, I haven't really seen anything untoward."
paras.zh: “从我的角度来看，我并没有真正看到任何不愉快的事情。”

paras.en: The coaches have also begun responding to the latest allegations.
paras.zh: 教练们也开始回应最新的指控。

paras.en: Former head coach Darren Lehmann has addressed Cameron Bancroft's claims without taking a stance, while batting coach Graeme Hick has rejected suggestions he knew about the ball-tampering.
paras.zh: 前主教练达伦·莱曼(Darren Lehmann)在没有表明立场的情况下回应了卡梅伦·班克罗夫特(Cameron Bancroft)的说法，而击球教练格雷姆·希克(Graeme Hick)则否认了他了解球篡改事件的说法。

paras.en: Former bowling coach David Saker has not commented on the latest revelations, but his role has come under renewed scrutiny.
paras.zh: 前保龄球教练大卫·萨克没有对最新的爆料发表评论，但他的角色已经受到重新审视。

paras.en: Lehmann was head coach of the Australian team in Cape Town.
paras.zh: 莱曼是开普敦澳大利亚队的主教练。

paras.en: In the immediate aftermath, he specifically denied any knowledge of plans to use sandpaper and was cleared by Cricket Australia's investigation, but resigned from the role after the Cape Town Test.
paras.zh: 紧接着，他明确否认对使用砂纸的计划有任何了解，并得到了澳大利亚板球协会的调查证实，但在开普敦测试后辞去了这一职务。

paras.en: Usman Khawaja did not specify Lehmann by name in Sabr, but Bancroft sure did, saying that the former coach shouted at Peter Handscomb to run down onto the pitch and "get the f****** sandpaper off Bangers now," he wrote in his West Australian article.
paras.zh: 乌斯曼·卡瓦贾（Usman Khawaja）在《萨布尔》中没有具体指明莱曼的名字，但班克罗夫特确实提到了，他在西澳大利亚的文章中写道，这位前教练对彼得·汉德斯科姆（Peter Handscomb）大喊，让他跑到球场上，“现在就把班格斯的砂纸拿掉”。

paras.en: "In my opinion, if he didn't know, he wouldn't have said that.
paras.zh: “在我看来，如果他不知道，他就不会这么说。

paras.en: "And if it wasn't clear enough before, then it was obvious now."
paras.zh: “如果以前还不够清楚，那么现在就很明显了。”

paras.en: Bancroft also said Lehmann was present when David Warner suggested using sandpaper, but said he could not take it onto the ground because everyone would be looking at him.
paras.zh: 班克罗夫特还表示，当大卫·沃纳建议使用砂纸时，莱曼在场，但他不能把砂纸放在地上，因为每个人都会看着他。

paras.en: Lehmann, who was working as a pundit on ABC Sport during the coverage of Australia's ODI clash with England on Wednesday night, made a short statement on air before leaving the media centre.
paras.zh: 周三晚上，莱曼在澳大利亚广播公司体育频道 (ABC Sport) 报道澳大利亚与英格兰队的 ODI 冲突期间担任评论员，他在离开媒体中心之前在直播中发表了简短声明。

paras.en: "The allegations … I've got to sit back. It's only just come to light," Lehmann said on ABC Sport.
paras.zh: “这些指控......我必须袖手旁观。这才刚刚曝光，”莱曼在美国广播公司体育频道上说道。

paras.en: "So I just need to sit back and process all that and work through each allegation. That's what I will be doing over the next few days.
paras.zh: “所以我只需要坐下来处理所有这些并解决每一项指控。这就是我接下来几天要做的事情。

paras.en: "I need to have a really good read of it, don't I? What's been transpired, speaking to people, and just make sure I'm saying what I want to say and answer the questions you want to ask.
paras.zh: “我需要好好读读它，不是吗？与人们交谈所发生的事情，并确保我说的是我想说的话并回答你想问的问题。

paras.en: "It's a lot for everyone I presume. Yeah, not just me.
paras.zh: “我想这对每个人来说都意义重大。是的，不仅仅是我。

paras.en: "That's all you can do. The allegations and work through them and then respond accordingly. That would be the way to go. There's no point rushing into anything that's said. Just make sure I'm really clear which way I'm going."
paras.zh: “这就是你所能做的。接受指控并解决它们，然后做出相应的回应。这就是要走的路。没有必要急于说出任何话。只要确保我真的很清楚我要走哪条路就可以了。”

paras.en: Hick, the Zimbabwe-born, former England batter who played 65 Tests for his adopted nation, was Australia's batting coach from 2016 to 2020.
paras.zh: 希克出生于津巴布韦，前英格兰击球手，为他的移居国家打了 65 场测试赛，2016 年至 2020 年担任澳大利亚击球教练。

paras.en: He was made redundant by Cricket Australia as part of a series of cost-cutting measures in the wake of the COVID-19 pandemic.
paras.zh: 作为 COVID-19 大流行后一系列成本削减措施的一部分，澳大利亚板球协会解雇了他。

paras.en: Hick was asked about the allegations made in Khawaja's book by the Sydney Morning Herald.
paras.zh: 《悉尼先驱晨报》向希克询问了卡瓦贾书中的指控。

paras.en: "I have seen the various statements around the coaches and I'm very disappointed with the broad nature of them," he told the Herald.
paras.zh: “我看到了围绕教练的各种言论，我对他们的广泛性质感到非常失望，”他告诉先驱报。

paras.en: "Khawaja puts it simply: 'It was all of us. Not the batters, not the bowlers, not the staff. All of us.'
paras.zh: “卡瓦贾简单地说：‘是我们所有人。不是击球手，不是投球手，不是工作人员。是我们所有人。’

paras.en: "To me, what Khawaja is implying here is absolutely false."
paras.zh: “对我来说，卡瓦贾在这里暗示的内容绝对是错误的。”

paras.en: "In regard to any discussions around the ball-tampering in Port Elizabeth or Cape Town, I will say in true honesty that I did not hear or know anything.
paras.zh: “关于伊丽莎白港或开普敦有关球篡改的任何讨论，我会诚实地说，我没有听到或知道任何事情。

paras.en: "My first knowledge of all this was, like many, when it appeared on the big screen in Cape Town as I was sat on the outside balcony at the time."
paras.zh: “和许多人一样，我第一次知道这一切是当它出现在开普敦的大屏幕上时，当时我坐在外面的阳台上。”

paras.en: David Warner bit back on X at Hick's comments, questioning whether he should have ever even been Australia's batting coach in the first place.
paras.zh: 大卫·沃纳（David Warner）对希克的言论进行了反击，质疑他是否应该首先成为澳大利亚的击球教练。

paras.en: "Graeme Hick was only appointed because Cricket Australia was unwilling to pay Michael Di Venuto what he deserved," Warner wrote.
paras.zh: 华纳写道：“格雷姆·希克被任命只是因为澳大利亚板球协会不愿意向迈克尔·迪·韦努托支付他应得的报酬。”

paras.en: "As players, we valued Michael so highly that we even offered to contribute from our own salaries to retain him.
paras.zh: “作为球员，我们非常重视迈克尔，甚至愿意拿出自己的薪水来留住他。

paras.en: David Saker, who was Australia's bowling coach from 2016 to 2019, has barely spoken a word about Sandpapergate in the years since.
paras.zh: 2016年至2019年担任澳大利亚保龄球教练的戴维·萨克尔(David Saker)此后几年几乎没有谈论过“沙纸门”事件。

paras.en: In 2021 Saker told the BBC: "There was a lot of people to blame. It could have been me to blame, it could have been someone else.
paras.zh: 2021 年，萨克告诉 BBC：“有很多人应该受到责备。这可能是我的错，也可能是其他人的错。

paras.en: "It could have been stopped and it wasn't, which is unfortunate.
paras.zh: “它本可以被阻止，但事实并非如此，这很不幸。

paras.en: "You could point your finger at me, you could point your finger at Boof [Lehmann]. Could you point it at other people? Of course you could.
paras.zh: “你可以把矛头指向我，你可以把矛头指向布夫（莱曼）。你能把矛头指向其他人吗？当然可以。

paras.en: "The disappointing thing is it's never going to go away."
paras.zh: “令人失望的是它永远不会消失。”

paras.en: He has not made any public comments in recent weeks, but he's certainly been spoken about.
paras.zh: 最近几周他没有发表任何公开评论，但肯定有人在谈论他。

paras.en: Cameron Bancroft names Saker regularly in his piece, saying he remembers Saker being present when conversations were being held about getting the ball to reverse swing, adding later that Saker was "certainly present" when discussion turned to sandpaper.
paras.zh: 卡梅伦·班克罗夫特（Cameron Bancroft）经常在他的文章中提到萨克尔（Saker），他说他记得当讨论如何让球反向挥杆时萨克尔（Saker）在场，后来又补充说，当讨论转向砂纸时，萨克尔“肯定在场”。

paras.en: Bancroft also said, on the morning of day three in Port Elizabeth, now Gqeberha, his use of sandpaper in that Test "discussed and my role being acknowledged in front of the group."
paras.zh: 班克罗夫特还表示，第三天早上在伊丽莎白港（现在的格克贝哈），他在测试中使用砂纸的情况“得到了讨论，我的角色在大家面前得到了认可”。

paras.en: "Much like the celebrations when we took 4/28 the evening before, I received wraps and encouragement from members of the playing and coaching staff, especially David Saker," wrote Bancroft.
paras.zh: 班克罗夫特写道：“就像我们前一天晚上 4 月 28 日举行的庆祝活动一样，我收到了球员和教练组成员的包装和鼓励，尤其是大卫·萨克尔。”

paras.en: In relation to the Cape Town Test, Saker, who played Sheffield Shield cricket for Victoria and Tasmania before going on to coach England, among others, is again mentioned prominently.
paras.zh: 在开普敦测试中，萨克尔再次被重点提及，他曾在维多利亚和塔斯马尼亚队效力于谢菲尔德盾板球队，之后又执教英格兰队等球队。

paras.en: Usman Khawaja did not name names in his book, but did say that a coach spoke to Bancroft about using sandpaper on the ball.
paras.zh: 乌斯曼·哈瓦贾（Usman Khawaja）在他的书中没有点名，但确实表示一名教练与班克罗夫特谈过在球上使用砂纸的问题。

paras.en: Bancroft confirmed that coach was Saker.
paras.zh: 班克罗夫特证实教练是萨克尔。

paras.en: "It has been documented that a coach approached me during our fielding innings telling me that I needed to do more with the sandpaper on the ball to get it to swing," he wrote.
paras.zh: “有记录显示，在我们的防守局中，一位教练找到我，告诉我，我需要对球上的砂纸做更多的工作，才能让它摆动，”他写道。

paras.en: "That coach was David Saker and it is true."
paras.zh: “那个教练是大卫·萨克尔，这是真的。”

articles.title: Aussie has first-round lead in prestigious Tour Championship

paras.en: Karis Davidson leads first round of LPGA Tour Championship
paras.zh: 卡里斯·戴维森 (Karis Davidson) 领先 LPGA 巡回锦标赛首轮

paras.en: Australian Karis Davidson holds the clubhouse lead after the opening round of the LPGA Tour Championship.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚人卡里斯·戴维森 (Karis Davidson) 在 LPGA 巡回锦标赛首轮比赛后保持俱乐部领先。

paras.en: Davidson shot a seven-under 65 during her first round in Florida.
paras.zh: 戴维森在佛罗里达州的第一轮比赛中打出 65 杆，低于标准杆 7 杆。

paras.en: The second round will be held on Friday.
paras.zh: 第二轮比赛将于周五举行。

articles.title: Woman drugged and raped by men in scheme organised by husband

paras.en: Four men have been found guilty of raping 49-year-old Joanne Young.
paras.zh: 四名男子因强奸 49 岁的乔安妮·杨而被判有罪。

paras.en: Ms Young is calling on the government to stop similar crimes from happening.
paras.zh: 杨女士呼吁政府制止类似犯罪的发生。

paras.en: Warning: This story contains descriptions of rape and sexual abuse.
paras.zh: 警告：这个故事包含对强奸和性虐待的描述。

paras.en: A British woman who was drugged and then raped by men in a scheme her husband advertised online says the abuse has shattered her trust and destroyed her life.
paras.zh: 一名英国妇女在丈夫在网上宣传的一项计划中被下药，然后被男子强奸，她表示，这种虐待粉碎了她的信任，毁了她的生活。

paras.en: Joanne Young only learned that her husband of two decades, Philip Young, was advertising her for sex with strangers on websites when detectives came to their house two years ago.
paras.zh: 两年前，侦探来到乔安妮·杨 (Joanne Young) 家时，她才得知，与她结婚二十年的丈夫菲利普·杨 (Philip Young) 在网站上为她与陌生人发生性关系做广告。

paras.en: Police had been investigating extreme bestiality images which he had uploaded to the internet.
paras.zh: 警方一直在调查他上传到互联网上的极端兽交图片。

paras.en: When they seized his devices, they found intimate images and videos of his wife, restrained at the wrists and blindfolded, while other men engaged in sexual activity with her — all without her knowledge or consent.
paras.zh: 当他们没收他的设备时，他们发现了他妻子的亲密图像和视频，她的手腕被束缚，眼睛被蒙住，而其他男人则在她不知情或同意的情况下与她发生性行为。

paras.en: Speaking outside court after four of those men were found guilty of rape and sexual assaults, 49-year-old Ms Young said her case would mean more victims of sexual abuse could come forward, knowing they would be believed and understood.
paras.zh: 其中四名男子被判犯有强奸和性侵犯罪后，49 岁的杨女士在法庭外发表讲话说，她的案件意味着更多的性虐待受害者可以挺身而出，因为他们知道自己会被相信和理解。

paras.en: "Consent has to come from the person themselves," she said.
paras.zh: “必须得到本人的同意，”她说。

paras.en: "No-one should be able to give it on your behalf, and no-one should be able to rely on someone else's word that you agreed
paras.zh: “没有人可以代表你给予，也没有人可以相信你同意的别人的话

paras.en: "I urge the government to look at this as a priority so that women are properly protected in the future.
paras.zh: “我敦促政府将此视为优先事项，以便妇女在未来得到适当的保护。

paras.en: "I live with a pain that's hard to put into words and this is something that will affect our lives forever."
paras.zh: “我生活在一种难以言喻的痛苦之中，这将永远影响我们的生活。”

paras.en: Ms Young's case strongly echoed that of Gisele Pelicot, a French woman whose husband and 50 co-defendants were found guilty of rape or other sex offences.
paras.zh: 杨女士的案件与法国妇女吉赛尔·佩利科特（Gisele Pelicot）的案件强烈呼应，她的丈夫和 50 名共同被告被判犯有强奸或其他性犯罪罪。

paras.en: The trial at Winchester Crown Court was told Ms Young's then-husband, 50, placed advertised online for strangers of any age or race to have sex with his wife at their home in Swindon, south-west England.
paras.zh: 温彻斯特刑事法院的审判获悉，杨女士当时 50 岁的丈夫在网上发布广告，邀请任何年龄或种族的陌生人在他们位于英格兰西南部斯温顿的家中与他的妻子发生性关系。

paras.en: The former councillor drugged her, filmed the encounters in their bedroom, and later uploaded the videos to the internet.
paras.zh: 前议员给她下了药，在卧室里拍摄了这次遭遇，然后将视频上传到互联网上。

paras.en: Police found five such videos recorded between 2015 and 2022, as well as hundreds of images.
paras.zh: 警方发现了 5 个 2015 年至 2022 年间录制的此类视频以及数百张图像。

paras.en: "This abuse has cost me my life as I knew it,"
paras.zh: “据我所知，这种虐待让我失去了生命，”

paras.en: "The person I trusted most in the world betrayed me in the most horrific way. This has resulted in a devastating impact on the lives of myself and my children."
paras.zh: “我在世界上最信任的人以最可怕的方式背叛了我。这对我和我的孩子的生活造成了毁灭性的影响。”

paras.en: Police and prosecutors have praised Ms Young for the poise and bravery she has shown, waiving her right to lifelong anonymity to help secure the conviction of her husband, who admitted to rape and other offences in January.
paras.zh: 警方和检察官赞扬了杨女士表现出的镇定和勇敢，并放弃了她终身匿名的权利，以帮助确保她丈夫的定罪，她的丈夫在一月份承认了强奸和其他罪行。

paras.en: Four men were found guilty on Thursday. A fifth had already pleaded guilty.
paras.zh: 周四，四名男子被判有罪。第五人已经认罪。

paras.en: In another echo of the Pelicot case, the guilty men had argued that they thought Ms Young had consented and that it was a shared fantasy with her then-husband.
paras.zh: 与佩利科特案的另一个相似之处是，有罪的男子辩称，他们认为杨女士已经同意了，这是她与当时的丈夫共同的幻想。

paras.en: "It is hard to put into words the depth of Young's exploitation and abuse of Jo," Police Detective Superintendent Geoff Smith said.
paras.zh: “很难用语言来形容杨对乔的剥削和虐待的严重程度，”警探杰夫·史密斯说。

paras.en: "No-one should have to go through what she has experienced."
paras.zh: “没有人应该经历她所经历的事情。”

paras.en: He repeated Ms Young's comments about consent and said the actions of those who exploited her at her husband's behest were clearly wrong, "as in the Gisele Pelicot case in France".
paras.zh: 他重复了杨女士关于同意的评论，并表示那些在她丈夫的要求下剥削她的人的行为显然是错误的，“就像法国的吉赛尔·佩利科特案一样”。

paras.en: Ms Pelicot became a symbol of female courage and resilience after her ordeal and said she hoped the enormous interest in her case would help other women who had suffered sexual abuse.
paras.zh: 佩利科特女士在遭受磨难后成为女性勇气和韧性的象征，并表示她希望人们对她的案件的巨大兴趣能够帮助其他遭受性虐待的女性。

paras.en: That message was also echoed by Joanne Young, who said she was determined not to be defined by what had been done to her.
paras.zh: 乔安妮·杨（Joanne Young）也回应了这一信息，她表示她决心不因所发生的事情而被定义。

paras.en: "This abuse thrives in secrecy… I will now use my experience to try to help others. I also owe it to myself to live the best life I can with my children and loved ones as we move forward."
paras.zh: “这种虐待行为在秘密中蔓延……我现在将利用我的经验来尝试帮助他人。在我们前进的过程中，我也有责任与我的孩子和亲人一起过上最好的生活。”

articles.title: Dozens missing off Senegal as West African departures for Europe surge

paras.en: Dozens missing off Senegal as West African departures for Europe surge
paras.zh: 西非前往欧洲的航班激增，数十人在塞内加尔失踪

paras.en: Nearly 600 people have died trying to reach the Canary Islands from West Africa so far this year
paras.zh: 今年迄今为止，已有近 600 人在从西非前往加那利群岛的途中丧生

paras.en: Authorities were searching for survivors on Thursday after a boat carrying dozens of migrants capsized off Senegal's coast early the day before, local officials said, amid a surge in attempted crossings from West Africa to Spain's Canary Islands.
paras.zh: 当地官员表示，由于从西非前往西班牙加那利群岛的移民数量激增，一艘载有数十名移民的船只前一天早些时候在塞内加尔海岸倾覆，当局正在搜寻幸存者。

paras.en: Senegal's navy rescued more than 1,400 people trying to reach Europe aboard pirogues — traditional wooden fishing vessels — over a 48-hour period this week, it said in a post on X.
paras.zh: 塞内加尔海军在 X 上的一篇帖子中称，本周在 48 小时内解救了 1,400 多名试图乘坐独木舟（传统木制渔船）抵达欧洲的人。

paras.en: The latest shipwreck occurred near Yenne, a coastal town south of Dakar, around 2 a.m. GMT Wednesday morning, a local official told Reuters, adding that at least 50 people were aboard.
paras.zh: 当地官员告诉路透社，最新的沉船事故发生在格林威治标准时间周三凌晨 2 点左右，发生在达喀尔以南沿海城镇延恩附近，并补充说船上至少有 50 人。

paras.en: "It was at the time of transferring the migrants from the small fishing boats coming from the beach to the larger pirogue," the official said. "They hit a rock."
paras.zh: 这位官员说：“当时正是将移民从海滩上的小渔船上转移到较大的独木舟上的时候。” “他们撞到了一块石头。”

paras.en: Boubacar Séye, president of the nonprofit Horizons Sans Frontières, told Reuters on Thursday that four bodies had been recovered.
paras.zh: 非营利组织地平线无国界组织主席布巴卡尔·塞耶周四告诉路透社，已找到四具尸体。

paras.en: Migrant crossings from West Africa to Europe have surged this month, according to the UN refugee agency, with more than 8,000 people arriving in the Canary Islands during the first 12 days of November.
paras.zh: 据联合国难民署称，本月从西非前往欧洲的移民人数激增，11 月前 12 天内有超过 8,000 人抵达加那利群岛。

paras.en: - Death toll rises to 39 after migrant boat capsizes off Senegal
paras.zh: - 移民船在塞内加尔海域倾覆，死亡人数上升至39人

paras.en: - Children among at least 139 dead after migrant boat capsizes off Djibouti coast
paras.zh: - 移民船在吉布提海岸倾覆，造成至少 139 人死亡，其中包括儿童

paras.en: Spain has deployed a helicopter to patrol the coast in co-operation with the Senegalese navy, which has led to an increase in interceptions, according to the official in Yenne, who spoke on the condition of anonymity.
paras.zh: 耶内一位不愿透露姓名的官员表示，西班牙与塞内加尔海军合作部署了一架直升机在海岸巡逻，这导致拦截次数增加。

paras.en: The official said this co-operation could lead to the number of departures dropping.
paras.zh: 该官员表示，这种合作可能会导致出发航班数量下降。

paras.en: Spain's embassy in Dakar declined to comment and referred Reuters to a pinned post on its X account warning Senegalese that they will not be allowed to stay or circulate in Europe if they reach Spanish shores illegally.
paras.zh: 西班牙驻达喀尔大使馆拒绝发表评论，并向路透社提及其 X 账户上的一个固定帖子，警告塞内加尔人，如果他们非法抵达西班牙海岸，将不被允许在欧洲停留或流通。

paras.en: "Don't believe false promises. Don't risk your life," the post says.
paras.zh: 帖子中写道：“不要相信虚假的承诺。不要拿自己的生命冒险。”

paras.en: Almost 1,500 migrants reached Spain's Canary Islands on Saturday, the highest number recorded in a single day since 2020.
paras.zh: 周六，近 1,500 名移民抵达西班牙加那利群岛，这是自 2020 年以来单日记录的最高人数。

paras.en: Life jackets are seen inside the boat. (Misper Apawu/Reuters)
paras.zh: 船内可见救生衣。 （米斯珀·阿帕乌/路透社）

paras.en: The perilous journeys aboard wooden fishing vessels often turn deadly. Earlier this month, a sinking north of Dakar near the town of Kebemer killed more than 40 people.
paras.zh: 木制渔船上的危险旅程往往会导致致命。本月早些时候，达喀尔以北凯贝梅尔镇附近的一次沉船事故造成 40 多人死亡。

paras.en: Following that incident, President Bassirou Diomaye Faye said on X that his government would "fight against those who organize these crossings" and try to "provide our youth with reasons to have hope here at home."
paras.zh: 事件发生后，巴西总统巴西鲁·迪马耶·法耶 (Bassirou Diomaye Faye) 在 X 上表示，他的政府将“打击那些组织这些过境活动的人”，并努力“为我们的年轻人提供在国内抱有希望的理由”。

paras.en: At a cabinet meeting on Wednesday, Faye requested a detailed report on the challenges to curbing irregular migration and stressed the need to improve youth employment prospects, according to a government statement.
paras.zh: 根据一份政府声明，在周三的内阁会议上，费耶要求就遏制非正常移民所面临的挑战提供一份详细报告，并强调需要改善青年就业前景。

paras.en: A gendarme patrols the shore following an accident at sea involving migrants off the coast of Yenne, Senegal, on Thursday. (Misper Apawu/Reuters)
paras.zh: 周四，塞内加尔延内海岸发生涉及移民的海上事故后，一名宪兵在海岸巡逻。 （米斯珀·阿帕乌/路透社）

paras.en: Séye, of the Senegalese nonprofit Horizons Sans Frontières, called on authorities to address the causes of migration instead of relying on tougher policing.
paras.zh: 塞内加尔非营利组织“地平线无国界”组织的塞耶呼吁当局解决移民问题，而不是依赖更严厉的治安。

paras.en: "We need to wake up to the gravity of the situation. The strategy deployed until now is not working," he told Reuters on Thursday. "We need to fix the root causes of this problem."
paras.zh: “我们需要认识到局势的严重性。到目前为止部署的策略并没有发挥作用，”他周四告诉路透社。 “我们需要解决这个问题的根本原因。”

paras.en: Nearly 600 people have died trying to reach Spain's Canary Islands from West Africa so far this year, the UN refugee agency said this week.
paras.zh: 联合国难民机构本周表示，今年迄今为止，已有近 600 人在从西非前往西班牙加那利群岛的途中丧生。

articles.title: Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya ethnic minority, International Court of Justice rules

paras.en: Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya ethnic minority, International Court of Justice rules
paras.zh: 国际法院裁定缅甸对罗兴亚少数民族实施种族灭绝

paras.en: Court says 2017 campaign led to mass death, 'widespread acts of sexual violence' and ongoing refugee crisis
paras.zh: 法院称 2017 年的运动导致大规模死亡、“广泛的性暴力行为”和持续的难民危机

paras.en: In a landmark judgment, the United Nations' top court ruled Thursday that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya minority in a brutal 2017 military operation.
paras.zh: 周四，联合国最高法院做出了一项具有里程碑意义的判决，裁定缅甸在 2017 年的一次残酷军事行动中对罗辛亚少数民族实施了种族灭绝。

paras.en: International Court of Justice President Yuji Iwasawa said the court, in a 9-6 decision, found that Myanmar "has committed genocide against the Rohingya group in northern Rakhine state, in violation of its obligations under the Genocide Convention."
paras.zh: 国际法院院长岩泽雄二表示，法院以 9 比 6 的投票结果裁定，缅甸“对若开邦北部的罗兴亚人实施了种族灭绝，违反了《种族灭绝公约》规定的义务。”

paras.en: The court's 15-judge panel — which included Navi Pillay, the respected international jurist who won the Nobel Peace Prize last month — rejected Myanmar's defence that the 2017 campaign was a legitimate operation against insurgents.
paras.zh: 该法院的 15 名法官组成的陪审团——其中包括上个月获得诺贝尔和平奖的受人尊敬的国际法学家纳维·皮莱（Navi Pillay）——驳回了缅甸关于 2017 年行动是针对叛乱分子的合法行动的辩解。

paras.en: Iwasawa said that "the court finds that Myanmar's security forces killed thousands of Rohingya civilians, perpetrated widespread acts of sexual violence, as well as acts of extreme violence against children, and attacked fleeing Rohingya as they sought to flee in large numbers."
paras.zh: 岩泽说：“法院认定，缅甸安全部队杀害了数千名罗兴亚平民，对儿童实施了广泛的性暴力行为，并对儿童实施极端暴力行为，并在罗兴亚人大批寻求逃离时袭击了他们。”

paras.en: The decision marks the first time the court has ruled that a state committed genocide.
paras.zh: 该判决标志着法院首次裁定一个国家犯有种族灭绝罪。

paras.en: "This is a great day for the Rohingya, and it is a great day for all oppressed people, everywhere, who have been told that their suffering does not count and that no one is listening," said Yasmin Ullah, a Rohingya rights activist who sat in the court's Great Hall of Justice for the three-hour reading of the ruling.
paras.zh: “这对罗兴亚人来说是伟大的一天，对世界各地所有受压迫的人来说也是伟大的一天，他们被告知他们的痛苦不算数，也没有人在听，”罗兴亚人权利活动人士亚斯明·乌拉(Yasmin Ullah)说，他坐在法院的司法大厅，聆听了三个小时的裁决。

paras.en: The intent to destroy a group in whole or in part is a key element in establishing whether crimes amount to genocide under international law.
paras.zh: 全部或部分消灭一个群体的意图是确定犯罪行为是否构成国际法规定的种族灭绝的关键因素。

paras.en: The court said that evidence showed Myanmar forces killed about 10,000 Rohingya.
paras.zh: 法院称，证据显示缅甸军队杀害了约1万名罗兴亚人。

paras.en: UN Secretary General Antonio Guterres called the ruling "a demonstration of international justice and a reaffirmation that impunity for such horrific acts must not stand."
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯称这一裁决“体现了国际正义，并重申对这种可怕行为的有罪不罚现象绝不能持续”。

paras.en: Shortly after the ruling was read, British Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband said his government was expelling Myanmar's defence attaché from the U.K. and "calling urgently for a UN Security Council session to discuss the judgment."
paras.zh: 裁决宣读后不久，英国外交大臣埃德·米利班德表示，英国政府正在将缅甸国防武官驱逐出英国，并“紧急呼吁召开联合国安理会会议讨论裁决”。

paras.en: The Muslim-majority African nation of Gambia launched the proceedings at the International Court of Justice in 2019, asking it to rule that Myanmar has breached the 1948 Genocide Convention, order the nation to end any illegal activities targeting the Rohingya and ensure those responsible for genocide are punished.
paras.zh: 穆斯林占多数的非洲国家冈比亚于 2019 年向国际法院提起诉讼，要求国际法院裁定缅甸违反了 1948 年《种族灭绝公约》，命令该国停止任何针对罗兴亚人的非法活动，并确保对种族灭绝负责的人受到惩罚。

paras.en: In August 2017, Myanmar's military launched what it called a "clearance campaign" in Rakhine state in response to an attack by a Rohingya insurgent group. The campaign led to accusations that security forces committed mass rapes and killings and burned thousands of homes.
paras.zh: 2017年8月，缅甸军方在若开邦发起了所谓的“清剿行动”，以回应罗兴亚叛乱组织的袭击。这场运动导致人们指责安全部队实施大规模强奸和杀戮，并烧毁了数千所房屋。

paras.en: Rohingya children are seen wading through a flooded canal after heavy rain at the Kutupalong refugee camp in Bangladesh's Cox's Bazar on June 23. Thousands of Rohingya originally from Myanmar's Rakhine state live in squalid conditions at Cox's Bazar. (Munir Uz Zaman/AFP/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 6 月 23 日，在孟加拉国考克斯巴扎尔的库图帕隆难民营，人们看到罗兴亚儿童在大雨后涉水穿过被洪水淹没的运河。来自缅甸若开邦的数千名罗兴亚人在科克斯巴扎尔生活在肮脏的环境中。 （穆尼尔·乌兹·扎曼/法新社/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: Under the 1948 convention, to establish that genocide occurred, the court will have to find that there was an intent to destroy the Rohingya "in whole or in part."
paras.zh: 根据 1948 年公约，要确定发生了种族灭绝，法院必须认定存在“全部或部分”消灭罗兴亚人的意图。

paras.en: About 1.2 million Rohingya refugees now live in Bangladesh, primarily in crowded camps across Cox's Bazar district, where they endure harsh conditions marked by fire hazards, infectious diseases, monsoon landslides, inadequate sanitation and strict work restrictions.
paras.zh: 目前约有 120 万罗辛亚难民居住在孟加拉国，主要居住在科克斯巴扎尔地区拥挤的难民营中，他们在那里忍受着火灾、传染病、季风山体滑坡、卫生设施不足和严格的工作限制等恶劣条件。

paras.en: "Genocides have similarities in how they are committed so this decision will have an impact on other cases," said Melanie O'Brien, a professor of international law at the University of Western Australia.
paras.zh: 西澳大利亚大学国际法教授梅兰妮·奥布莱恩表示：“种族灭绝在实施方式上有相似之处，因此这一决定将对其他案件产生影响。”

paras.en: - CBC Investigates This Canadian family fuelled Myanmar's civil war with 'blood pearls'
paras.zh: - CBC 调查这个加拿大家庭用“血珍珠”煽动缅甸内战

paras.en: - 'Weaponization of aid': Myanmar accused of blocking rescue efforts after deadly earthquake
paras.zh: - “援助武器化”：缅甸被指控在致命地震后阻碍救援工作

paras.en: Gambia has asked for reparations for the Rohingya, including ordering Myanmar to grant them full citizenship and the right to return home.
paras.zh: 冈比亚已要求对罗辛亚人进行赔偿，包括命令缅甸给予他们完整的公民身份和返回家园的权利。

paras.en: Yasmin Ullah, a Rohingya human rights activist who fled Myanmar as a young child with her mother in the 1990s, says the demands in the Myanmar case are rooted in her community's desire for recognition and dignity.
paras.zh: 罗兴亚人权活动人士亚斯明·乌拉 (Yasmin Ullah) 小时候与母亲在 20 世纪 90 年代逃离缅甸，她表示，缅甸案件中的要求植根于她的社区对承认和尊严的渴望。

paras.en: "Because so far, we've just been pushed around into this limbo state," she said. "It's been almost 10 years now that Rohingya have been living in very, very precarious conditions across the Asia-Pacific."
paras.zh: “因为到目前为止，我们只是被推入了这种不稳定的状态，”她说。 “近十年来，亚太地区的罗兴亚人一直生活在非常非常不稳定的条件下。”

paras.en: Ko Ko Hlaing, left, Myanmar's minister of the president's office, sits in the courtroom Thursday at The Hague, Netherlands. (Patrick Post/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 周四，缅甸总统府部长科科莱（左）坐在荷兰海牙的法庭上。 （帕特里克·波斯特/美联社）

paras.en: The court's rulings are final and legally binding, but it has no way to enforce it beyond reporting noncompliance to the UN Security Council.
paras.zh: 法院的裁决是最终裁决并具有法律约束力，但除了向联合国安理会报告违规行为外，它没有其他办法执行裁决。

paras.en: In a previous judgment in 2007, the court said that Serbia "violated the obligation to prevent genocide" in the 1995 Srebrenica massacre, when Bosnian Serb forces murdered some 8,000 mostly Muslim men and boys in the Bosnian town.
paras.zh: 在2007年的先前判决中，法院称塞尔维亚在1995年斯雷布雷尼察大屠杀中“违反了防止种族灭绝的义务”，当时波斯尼亚塞族军队在波斯尼亚城镇杀害了约8000名男子和男孩，其中大部分是穆斯林。

paras.en: Judges at the Hague-based court have also been asked to weigh in on other allegations of genocide.
paras.zh: 总部位于海牙的法院的法官还被要求对其他种族灭绝指控进行权衡。

paras.en: - What's the difference between the ICC and the ICJ?
paras.zh: - 国际刑事法院和国际法院有什么区别？

paras.en: - Bob Rae gives testimony on Rohingya plight, conditions at Cox's Bazar
paras.zh: - 鲍勃·雷 (Bob Rae) 就罗兴亚人的困境和考克斯巴扎尔 (Cox's Bazar) 的条件提供证词

paras.en: South Africa has accused Israel of breaching the genocide convention during its offensive in Gaza, a claim Israel vehemently denies. That case is years from completion.
paras.zh: 南非指责以色列在进攻加沙期间违反了种族灭绝公约，但以色列强烈否认这一说法。该案距离完成还需要数年时间。

paras.en: Ukraine also has a case pending against Russia. Shortly after Moscow's full-scale invasion in February 2022, Kyiv accused Russia of fabricating genocide claims against Ukraine to justify the attack.
paras.zh: 乌克兰还有一起针对俄罗斯的案件正在审理中。 2022 年 2 月莫斯科全面入侵后不久，基辅指责俄罗斯捏造针对乌克兰的种族灭绝指控，为这次袭击辩护。

articles.title: Law firm has done $11.8M US worth of free legal work for Trump administration, Democrats say

paras.en: Law firm has done $11.8M US worth of free legal work for Trump administration, Democrats say
paras.zh: 民主党人称律师事务所已为特朗普政府提供了价值 1180 万美元的免费法律服务

paras.en: Congressional Democrats call disclosure evidence of 'corrupt bargain' with White House
paras.zh: 国会民主党人称披露了与白宫“腐败交易”​​的证据

paras.en: U.S. congressional Democrats probing law firms that made deals with President Donald Trump's administration said on Thursday that Kirkland & Ellis has provided at least $11.8 million US in free legal services to federal agencies, calling it evidence of a "corrupt bargain" with the White House.
paras.zh: 正在调查与唐纳德·特朗普政府达成交易的律师事务所的美国国会民主党人周四表示，凯易律师事务所已向联邦机构提供了至少 1180 万美元的免费法律服务，称其为与白宫进行“腐败交易”​​的证据。

paras.en: Democrats in the House and Senate are ramping up scrutiny of nine major law firms' agreements with Trump last year to provide nearly $1 billion US in free legal services in order to avoid executive orders targeting firms over their legal work, diversity policies and political affiliations.
paras.zh: 众议院和参议院的民主党人正在加大对去年与特朗普签署的九家主要律师事务所提供近 10 亿美元免费法律服务的协议的审查力度，以避免因律师事务所的法律工作、多元化政策和政治立场而受到行政命令的影响。

paras.en: Trump issued the executive orders early in his second term, part of a broader campaign of retribution against his perceived political enemies.
paras.zh: 特朗普在第二任期初期发布了这些行政命令，这是针对他所认为的政治敌人的更广泛报复行动的一部分。

paras.en: Kirkland performed about $4 million in pro bono work for the U.S. Commerce Department and $2.2 million for the U.S. Defence Department, Rep. Jamie Raskin and senators Richard Blumenthal and Adam Schiff said in a statement.
paras.zh: 众议员杰米·拉斯金 (Jamie Raskin) 以及参议员理查德·布卢门撒尔 (Richard Blumenthal) 和亚当·希夫 (Adam Schiff) 在一份声明中表示，柯克兰为美国商务部提供了约 400 万美元的无偿工作，为美国国防部提供了 220 万美元的无偿工作。

paras.en: The firm also provided free legal services to the U.S. Postal Service and U.S. International Development Finance Corporation, they said.
paras.zh: 他们说，该公司还向美国邮政服务和美国国际开发金融公司提供免费法律服务。

paras.en: - Trump takes aim at WilmerHale law firm, citing ties to lawyer Robert Mueller
paras.zh: - 特朗普以与律师罗伯特·穆勒(Robert Mueller)的关系为由瞄准WilmerHale律师事务所

paras.en: - Trump administration reverses course within a day, vows to continue court battles against 4 law firms
paras.zh: - 特朗普政府一天之内改变态度，誓言继续与 4 家律师事务所进行法庭斗争

paras.en: "The Trump Administration also unsuccessfully tried to involve Kirkland & Ellis in work supporting the President’s political vanity projects, such as the renaming of the Kennedy Center or supporting the illegal construction of his triumphal arch in Washington, D.C. — raising serious questions of whether other firms acceded to these demands,” the lawmakers said in a statement.
paras.zh: 立法者在一份声明中表示：“特朗普政府还试图让柯克兰和埃利斯参与支持总统的政治虚荣项目，例如肯尼迪中心的更名或支持在华盛顿特区非法建造凯旋门，这引发了其他公司是否同意这些要求的严重问题。”

paras.en: Neither Kirkland nor the White House responded to requests for comment.
paras.zh: 柯克兰和白宫均未回应置评请求。

paras.en: Trump said in April 2025 that the firm had agreed to provide $125 million in pro bono work to causes he supported.
paras.zh: 特朗普于 2025 年 4 月表示，该公司已同意为他支持的事业提供 1.25 亿美元的无偿工作。

paras.en: In a Nov. 5 letter to the lawmakers seen by Reuters, the firm said it had billed a total of more than $18.7 million in pro bono work relating to its deal with Trump, amounting to more than 15,000 hours of attorney work for the federal government and other clients.
paras.zh: 路透社看到，在 11 月 5 日致立法者的一封信中，该公司表示，它已为与特朗普交易相关的无偿工作收取了总计超过 1,870 万美元的费用，相当于为联邦政府和其他客户提供了超过 15,000 小时的律师工作。

paras.en: The firm disclosed the figures in response to requests from the Democratic lawmakers, who have vowed to continue their investigation in the next Congress. Democrats' sweeping victory in the November midterm elections will give them additional power to demand documents and testimony from the law firms about their deals and how the administration has sought to enforce them.
paras.zh: 该公司应民主党议员的要求披露了这些数据，民主党议员誓言将在下一届国会继续进行调查。民主党在 11 月中期选举中取得压倒性胜利，将赋予他们额外的权力，要求律师事务所提供有关其交易以及政府如何寻求执行这些交易的文件和证词。

paras.en: Raskin currently serves as the ranking member of the House judiciary committee. Blumenthal is ranking member of the Senate permanent subcommittee on investigations.
paras.zh: 拉斯金目前担任众议院司法委员会的高级成员。布卢门撒尔是参议院常设调查小组委员会的高级成员。

paras.en: Kirkland said in its letter that it began negotiating with the Trump administration after rival firm Skadden reached its own deal in March 2025.
paras.zh: 柯克兰在信中表示，在竞争对手世达公司于 2025 年 3 月达成自己的协议后，该公司开始与特朗普政府进行谈判。

paras.en: Kirkland said its White House agreement has had "little impact" on its pro bono work, telling lawmakers that the firm "still devotes substantial pro bono resources to interests that could be considered 'progressive.'"
paras.zh: 柯克兰表示，白宫协议对其公益工作“影响不大”，并告诉立法者，该公司“仍然将大量公益资源投入到可被视为‘进步’的利益中。”

paras.en: The law firm is represented by prominent Washington litigator Beth Wilkinson of Wilkinson Stekloff. She did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
paras.zh: 该律师事务所的代表是华盛顿著名诉讼律师 Wilkinson Stekloff 的 Beth Wilkinson。她没有立即回应置评请求。

paras.en: The law firms' agreements came after Trump issued executive orders targeting four firms. The orders sought to revoke lawyers' security clearances, restrict their access to federal buildings and end U.S. government contracts held by the firms' clients.
paras.zh: 这些律师事务所的协议是在特朗普针对四家律师事务所发布行政命令后达成的。这些命令旨在撤销律师的安全许可，限制他们进入联邦大楼，并终止公司客户持有的美国政府合同。

paras.en: Four judges last year struck down the orders, finding they violated the firms' constitutional free speech and due process rights. The Trump administration is appealing those rulings.
paras.zh: 去年，四名法官驳回了这些命令，认为它们侵犯了公司的宪法言论自由和正当程序权利。特朗普政府正在对这些裁决提出上诉。

articles.title: EU Commission confirms it was targeted in cyberattack using AI tools

paras.en: The European Commission confirmed on Thursday that it was targeted by a cyberattack through the use of AI tools.
paras.zh: 欧盟委员会周四证实，它遭到了使用人工智能工具的网络攻击。

paras.en: The incident was detected on October 22 and there was no evidence of a data breach affecting Commission staff as a whole, European Commission spokesperson Thomas Regnier told reporters.
paras.zh: 欧盟委员会发言人托马斯·雷尼尔 (Thomas Regnier) 告诉记者，该事件于 10 月 22 日被发现，没有证据表明数据泄露影响了整个委员会工作人员。

paras.en: "This was an AI-generated cybercampaign," he added.
paras.zh: “这是一场人工智能生成的网络活动，”他补充道。

paras.en: Regnier did not elaborate on the attack or name a perpetrator. He said the Commission "has taken the necessary steps in response."
paras.zh: 雷尼尔没有详细说明这次袭击，也没有透露肇事者的名字。他表示，委员会“已采取必要的应对措施”。

paras.en: This is the first time the bloc reported an AI-assisted cyberattack.
paras.zh: 这是该集团首次报告人工智能辅助的网络攻击。

paras.en: Regnier's statement came after Politico reported earlier on Thursday that the Commission had been targeted. The report said the cyberattack disrupted several systems for 10 days and might have compromised large amounts of personal data. The European Commission has roughly 33,000 employees.
paras.zh: 雷尼尔发表声明之前，Politico 周四早些时候报道称，该委员会已成为攻击目标。报告称，网络攻击使多个系统中断了 10 天，并可能泄露了大量个人数据。欧盟委员会约有 33,000 名员工。

paras.en: The Commission then convened its highest-level internal crisis management body for an urgent meeting about the cyber incidents, according to Politico.
paras.zh: 据 Politico 报道，该委员会随后召集了最高级别的内部危机管理机构，就网络事件召开了紧急会议。

paras.en: "We temporarily took down several applications, and most of them have since then been restored," Regnier said. He also stated that they did not detect any evidence of a data breach affecting Commission staff.
paras.zh: 雷尼尔说：“我们暂时删除了一些应用程序，其中大多数已恢复。”他还表示，他们没有发现任何影响委员会工作人员的数据泄露的证据。

paras.en: Recent hybrid attacks on supermarkets, air traffic controllers, blood banks and broadcasters across Europe have raised worries among leaders that this may be part of a coordinated attempt at hybrid warfare.
paras.zh: 最近欧洲各地针对超市、空中交通管制员、血库和广播公司的混合攻击引起了领导人的担忧，他们认为这可能是混合战争协调企图的一部分。

paras.en: France summoned the Iranian ambassador last week over cyberattacks that caused supermarket freezers to defrost, but Tehran has denied any involvement.
paras.zh: 法国上周因网络攻击导致超市冰柜除霜而召见伊朗大使，但德黑兰否认与此事有关。

articles.title: Xi Jinping, Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin have held trilateral talks ― but what did they achieve?

paras.en: Chinese President Xi Jinping hosted US President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin on Thursday for an unprecedented trilateral summit in Shenzhen, bringing together the leaders of the world's three most powerful military powers amid heightened geopolitical tensions.
paras.zh: 中国国家主席习近平周四在深圳接待了美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京，在深圳举行了前所未有的三边峰会，在地缘政治紧张局势加剧的情况下，世界三大军事强国的领导人齐聚一堂。

paras.en: Xi hailed the talks as "groundbreaking," saying discussions ranged from global governance and denuclearization to the war in Ukraine and energy security.
paras.zh: 习近平称赞这次会谈具有“开创性”，并表示讨论范围从全球治理和无核化到乌克兰战争和能源安全。

paras.en: The "peace declaration" released after their meeting made no mention of Russia's war in Ukraine or the US-led war in Iran.
paras.zh: 会晤后发布的“和平宣言”没有提及俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争或美国领导的伊朗战争。

paras.en: Instead, the three leaders agreed to pursue reforms of the United Nations, limit the role of the International Criminal Court and reaffirm their commitment to avoiding nuclear war. They also pledged to boost supplies of refined petroleum products to address global energy challenges.
paras.zh: 相反，三位领导人同意推行联合国改革，限制国际刑事法院的作用，并重申致力于避免核战争。他们还承诺增加精炼石油产品的供应，以应对全球能源挑战。

paras.en: The tightly choreographed meeting fueled concerns that Beijing, Washington and Moscow could seek to reshape the international order around competing spheres of influence.
paras.zh: 这次精心设计的会议引发了人们的担忧，即北京、华盛顿和莫斯科可能会围绕相互竞争的势力范围寻求重塑国际秩序。

paras.en: While Xi said the talks with Trump and Putin were "positive, constructive and fruitful," Trump heralded the gathering as "really making history."
paras.zh: 习近平表示，与特朗普和普京的会谈“积极、建设性、富有成果”，而特朗普则称赞这次聚会“真正创造了历史”。

paras.en: For Putin, the three-way talks, and his meetings with both leaders separately earlier, offered a chance to show the world that he was on par with the leaders of the US and China, despite Western efforts to isolate him since he launched the full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022.
paras.zh: 对于普京来说，三方会谈以及他早些时候分别与两位领导人的会晤提供了一个机会，向世界展示他与美国和中国领导人的立场是平等的，尽管自他于 2022 年 2 月发动全面入侵乌克兰以来西方一直在努力孤立他。

paras.en: Emma Chanlett-Avery, senior director for Political-Security Affairs at the Asia Society Policy Institute (ASPI), said Putin had the most to gain from the meeting as "he appeared on the world stage as one of the dominant players in the world."
paras.zh: 亚洲协会政策研究所（ASPI）政治安全事务高级主任艾玛·钱莱特-艾弗里（Emma Chanlett-Avery）表示，普京从此次会议中获益最多，因为“他作为世界主导者之一出现在世界舞台上”。

paras.en: Chim Lee, a senior analyst with The Economist Intelligence Unit (EIU), echoed this view.
paras.zh: 经济学人智库（EIU）高级分析师 Chim Lee 也赞同这一观点。

paras.en: The meeting itself is a "major outcome for Russia," he told DW, pointing to Russian media coverage that has cast it as "reinforcing Russia's standing in the world."
paras.zh: 他告诉德国之声，这次会议本身就是“俄罗斯的一项重大成果”，并指出俄罗斯媒体的报道称这次会议“加强了俄罗斯在世界上的地位”。

paras.en: Beijing reluctant to accept nuclear limits
paras.zh: 北京不愿接受核限制

paras.en: The joint statement also said the leaders are committed to work to reduce nuclear risks and prevent nuclear proliferation.
paras.zh: 联合声明还表示，两国领导人致力于减少核风险并防止核扩散。

paras.en: The last nuclear arms pact between Russia and the United States, known as New START, expired in February.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯和美国之间的最后一项核武器条约，即《新削减战略武器条约》，已于二月到期。

paras.en: Trump has said he wants "a new, improved and modernized" deal that includes China.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，他希望达成一项包括中国在内的“新的、改进的和现代化的”协议。

paras.en: But Beijing has so far been reluctant to accept limits as its estimated arsenal of around 500 warheads remains far smaller than those of Russia and the US.
paras.zh: 但迄今为止，北京方面一直不愿接受限制，因为其估计约有 500 枚弹头的武库仍远小于俄罗斯和美国。

paras.en: Moscow and Washington are believed to possess more than 5,000 warheads each.
paras.zh: 据信莫斯科和华盛顿各拥有超过 5,000 枚弹头。

paras.en: Lee said China is unlikely to participate in a trilateral institutionalized setting to control nuclear arms.
paras.zh: 李说，中国不太可能参与控制核武器的三边制度化环境。

paras.en: "The gap between China's nuclear arsenal and those of Russia and US is still quite large. From China's perspective, it doesn't seem to make a lot of sense to put the three powers in the same bucket in this area."
paras.zh: “中国的核武库与俄罗斯和美国的核武库差距仍然很大。从中国的角度来看，在这一领域将三个大国放在一起似乎没有多大意义。”

paras.en: The expert believes Trump attended the meeting as he is "actively thinking about his legacy in the final two years in office."
paras.zh: 这位专家认为，特朗普参加这次会议是因为他“正在积极思考他在任期最后两年的遗产”。

paras.en: "So, in this context, the idea of setting up a trilateral nuclear arms control arrangement would have been a very big achievement," Lee said.
paras.zh: “因此，在这种背景下，建立三边核军控安排的想法将是一项非常大的成就，”李说。

paras.en: But, in the end, the declaration said the countries would merely engage in "dialogue" on the issue, avoiding any explicit commitments to downsize their nuclear stockpiles.
paras.zh: 但最终，声明表示，两国只会就这个问题进行“对话”，避免做出任何削减核库存的明确承诺。

paras.en: China initially hesitated to organize the trilateral summit as it did not want to be explicitly tied to Russia's war in Ukraine and harm Beijing's efforts to present itself as a long-term force for global stability.
paras.zh: 中国最初对组织三边峰会犹豫不决，因为它不想与俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争明确挂钩，并损害北京将自己塑造为全球稳定长期力量的努力。

paras.en: The Chinese government, which is working to rebalance economic ties with the EU, was also wary of appearing to form a G3 club with Washington and Moscow, which could alienate other global partners.
paras.zh: 正在努力重新平衡与欧盟的经济关系的中国政府也对与华盛顿和莫斯科组成G3俱乐部持谨慎态度，因为这可能会疏远其他全球伙伴。

paras.en: Chanlett-Avery said that China had some degree of discomfort in convening this meeting, worried about getting involved in Ukraine issues.
paras.zh: 钱莱特-艾弗里表示，中方对召开这次会议有一定程度的不安，担心卷入乌克兰问题。

paras.en: But Beijing eventually "managed to get the outcome they wanted" and kept the European conflict out of the meeting's focus, she noted.
paras.zh: 但她指出，北京最终“设法取得了他们想要的结果”，并将欧洲冲突排除在会议的焦点之外。

paras.en: "China was able to show off Shenzhen and all of its sparkling high-tech features. They convened a successful international meeting that grabbed lots of headlines," she added. "So, I think China probably came out feeling okay."
paras.zh: “中国能够展示深圳及其所有闪闪发光的高科技特征。他们召开了一次成功的国际会议，占据了许多头条新闻，”她补充道。 “所以，我认为中国可能感觉还不错。”

paras.en: Prior to the summit, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy had warned of a "second Yalta," referring to the Yalta Conference held in Crimea in 1945.
paras.zh: 峰会之前，乌克兰总统泽连斯基曾警告称，“第二次雅尔塔会议”指的是 1945 年在克里米亚举行的雅尔塔会议。

paras.en: That meeting saw the Allied powers decide on the post-war European order following the end of World War II.
paras.zh: 在那次会议上，盟军决定了二战结束后的战后欧洲秩序。

paras.en: In Shenzhen, Putin stressed that Russia, the US and China, as victors in World War II and veto-wielding members of the UN Security Council, bore a "joint responsibility for maintaining international peace."
paras.zh: 普京在深圳强调，俄罗斯、美国和中国作为二战战胜国和拥有否决权的联合国安理会成员，对“维护国际和平负有共同责任”。

paras.en: But Ying-Yu Lin, Associate Professor at Graduate Institute of International Affairs and Strategic Studies at Taiwan's Tamkang University, said the Yalta comparison "is a bit of a stretch," given the vast differences between 1945 and now.
paras.zh: 但台湾淡江大学国际事务与战略研究所副教授林英宇表示，考虑到 1945 年与现在的巨大差异，雅尔塔的比较“有点牵强”。

paras.en: Putin also said that all three leaders "agree that it's a useful format," and such meetings could take place again.
paras.zh: 普京还表示，三位领导人都“同意这是一种有用的形式”，此类会议可能会再次举行。

paras.en: Lee, the EIU expert, said the trilateral setup "is unlikely to be just a one-off" and there will probably be more such meetings in the coming years.
paras.zh: 经济学人智库专家李表示，三边机制“不太可能只是一次性的”，未来几年可能会有更多此类会议。

paras.en: "Especially from the US side to have this kind of setup, there will be some interest in maintaining warm relations with both China and Russia," he underlined.
paras.zh: 他强调说：“特别是美国方面有这样的安排，将会有兴趣与中国和俄罗斯保持温暖的关系。”

articles.title: Iraq's risky standoff: The state vs. Iran-allied militias

paras.en: For years, there have all kinds of rumors about Jurf al-Sakhar, an area around 50 kilometers (31 miles) south of the Iraqi capital Baghdad. It is controlled by an Iraqi militia called Kataib Hezbollah, that's closely allied with Iran, and no Iraqi government troops or news media outlets have been allowed inside for around 12 years.
paras.zh: 多年来，有关伊拉克首都巴格达以南约 50 公里（31 英里）的 Jurf al-Sakhar 地区有各种各样的谣言。它由与伊朗密切结盟的伊拉克民兵真主党卡塔布控制，大约 12 年来不允许伊拉克政府军或新闻媒体进入。

paras.en: Rumors about what's happening in the area include allegations about secret prisons, mass graves, drone and weapons manufacturing and storage, as well as criminal activity such as oil smuggling. Jurf al-Sakhar is also allegedly a base for foreign, Hezbollah-supporting nationals from Iran, Yemen, Bahrain and Lebanon.
paras.zh: 关于该地区正在发生的事情的谣言包括有关秘密监狱、乱葬坑、无人机和武器制造和储存，以及石油走私等犯罪活动的指控。据称，尤尔夫·萨哈尔也是来自伊朗、也门、巴林和黎巴嫩的支持真主党的外国国民的基地。

paras.en: Recently two people — an Israeli researcherand a US journalist — who were kidnapped by an Iraqi militia are thought to have been held captive in this area.
paras.zh: 最近，两名被伊拉克民兵绑架的人——一名以色列研究人员和一名美国记者——据信被关押在该地区。

paras.en: Jurf al-Sakhar previously had an estimated 89,000 residents but after the extremist group known as the "Islamic State," or IS, rose to power in Iraq in 2014, much of the population was displaced in fighting. The area was eventually taken over by Kataib Hezbollah, a militia that had fought IS alongside other armed groups.
paras.zh: 尤尔夫·萨哈尔此前估计有 89,000 名居民，但在 2014 年“伊斯兰国”极端组织在伊拉克上台后，大部分居民在战斗中流离失所。该地区最终被卡塔布真主党占领，该民兵曾与其他武装团体一起对抗伊斯兰国。

paras.en: As a collective, the armed groups are referred to as the Popular Mobilization Forces, or PMF. Not all of them have pledged allegiance to Iran but Kataib Hezbollah, a Shiite Muslim majority group, has.
paras.zh: 作为一个集体，武装团体被称为人民动员部队（PMF）。并非所有人都宣誓效忠伊朗，但什叶派穆斯林占多数的卡塔布真主党却宣誓效忠。

paras.en: In the past 12 years, tens of thousands of the displaced people from here, mostly Sunni Muslims, have not been allowed to return and the area has been described as militarized.
paras.zh: 过去12年里，数以万计的流离失所者（其中大部分是逊尼派穆斯林）未被允许返回，该地区被描述为军事化地区。

paras.en: Its name was even changed by Kataib Hezbollah fighters, from Jurf al-Sakhar ("rocky bank") to Jurf al-Nasr ("bank of victory").
paras.zh: 它的名字甚至被真主党旅战士从 Jurf al-Sakhar（“岩石银行”）更改为 Jurf al-Nasr（“胜利银行”）。

paras.en: But recent events may shake Kataib Hezbollah's hold on this area.
paras.zh: 但最近发生的事件可能会动摇卡塔布真主党对该地区的控制。

paras.en: An early November report for the Iraqi government says that since 2021, the group has smuggled hundreds of millions of dollars' worth of state-owned oil, siphoned from pipelines around Jurf al-Sakhar.
paras.zh: 伊拉克政府 11 月初的一份报告称，自 2021 年以来，该组织从 Jurf al-Sakhar 周围的管道中走私了价值数亿美元的国有石油。

paras.en: Iraq's new government, headed by Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi, made several arrests based on the report and demanded that Kataib Hezbollah leave Jurf al-Sakhar by Friday, Nov. 20.
paras.zh: 以总理阿里·扎伊迪为首的伊拉克新政府根据该报告逮捕了数人，并要求真主党旅在 11 月 20 日星期五之前离开尤尔夫·萨哈尔。

paras.en: Kataib Hezbollah rejected al-Zaidi's ultimatum, with a spokesperson saying the group would not withdraw "not even over our dead bodies."
paras.zh: 卡塔布真主党拒绝了扎伊迪的最后通牒，其发言人表示，该组织“即使因为我们的尸体也不会撤军”。

paras.en: Al-Zaidi then ordered state security forces to surround the area, while Hezbollah reportedly brought in reinforcements.
paras.zh: 扎伊迪随后命令国家安全部队包围该地区，据报道真主党也派出了增援部队。

paras.en: Observers have described the standoff as one of the most consequential and riskiest confrontations between an Iraqi government and Iranian-backed militiasin Iraq in more than two decades.
paras.zh: 观察人士称，这场对峙是二十多年来伊拉克政府与伊朗支持的伊拉克民兵之间最严重、最危险的对抗之一。

paras.en: "It is a political signal that things will change, that he [al-Zaidi] wants to disarm militias, integrate them into state and claim back the state's authority," Ulf Laessing, head of the Syria and Iraq project for Germany's Konrad Adenauer Foundation, or KAS, told DW. "But it's a minefield and he needs to navigate carefully."
paras.zh: 德国康拉德·阿登纳基金会（Konrad Adenauer Foundation，KAS）叙利亚和伊拉克项目负责人乌尔夫·莱辛（Ulf Laessing）对德国之声表示：“这是一个政治信号，表明事情将会发生变化，他（扎伊迪）希望解除民兵武装，将他们纳入国家，并夺回国家权力。” “但这是一个雷区，他需要小心谨慎。”

paras.en: The standoff is also the result of long-running political tensions in Iraq, where the state is torn between its US allies on the one hand and Iranian allies on the other. Both hold sway in Iraq and are considered important relationships.
paras.zh: 这场对峙也是伊拉克长期政治紧张局势的结果，该国一方面在美国盟友，另一方面在伊朗盟友之间陷入撕裂。两者在伊拉克都具有影响力，并被认为是重要的关系。

paras.en: During Donald Trump's presidency of the US, and thanks to the US and Israel's war with Iran, there's been more pressure on Iraq to disarm Iran's allies inside the country. Al-Zaidi has set a deadline of next June to bring all weapons under the state's control.
paras.zh: 在唐纳德·特朗普担任美国总统期间，由于美国和以色列与伊朗的战争，伊拉克面临着更大的压力，要求其解除伊朗境内盟友的武装。扎伊迪设定了明年六月的最后期限，将所有武器置于国家控制之下。

paras.en: The situation in Jurf al-Sakhar became even more tense this week. Al-Zaidi announced a new security plan for the area that involves other members of the PMF, state security forces and the police. Kataib Hezbollah rejected the plan.
paras.zh: 尤尔夫萨哈尔的局势本周变得更加紧张。扎伊迪宣布了该地区的一项新安全计划，该计划涉及 PMF 其他成员、国家安全部队和警察。卡塔布真主党拒绝了该计划。

paras.en: "Al-Zaidi appears serious about ending Kataib Hezbollah's autonomous control of Jurf al-Sakhar," Hayder al-Shakeri, a research fellow at the British think tank Chatham House told DW. "Deploying federal forces and now establishing a new security command there shows this has moved beyond rhetoric."
paras.zh: 英国智库查塔姆研究所研究员海德尔·沙克里 (Hayder al-Shakeri) 告诉德国之声：“扎伊迪似乎很认真地想要结束真主党旅对尤尔夫·萨哈尔的自主控制。” “部署联邦部队并在那里建立新的安全指挥部表明这已经超越了言辞。”

paras.en: But how dangerous is Kataib Hezbollah really? After all, al-Zaidi was actually nominated for the prime minister's job by a political bloc known as the Coalition Framework, or CF — these are the politicians who represent the PMF in parliament. Kataib Hezbollah's political party, Harakat Huqooq, is part of the CF.
paras.zh: 但卡塔布真主党到底有多危险呢？毕竟，扎伊迪实际上是由一个名为“联盟框架”(CF) 的政治集团提名担任总理职务的——这些政治集团是在议会中代表 PMF 的政客。卡塔布真主党的政党 Harakat Huqooq 是 CF 的一部分。

paras.en: And other researchers have been critical on social media, noting that the PMF troops that will be given partial control over Jurf al-Sakhar (should Kataib Hezbollah withdraw) are associated with that group anyway.
paras.zh: 其他研究人员也在社交媒体上提出批评，指出将获得对尤尔夫·萨哈尔部分控制权的 PMF 部队（如果真主党旅撤军的话）无论如何都与该组织有联系。

paras.en: But Iraqi news media have also reported that there are divisions inside the CF, and apparently even within Kataib Hezbollah, about how to deal with the current standoff. Reportedly, some senior officials think that parts of Jurf al-Sakhar could be handed to federal forces in a gradual withdrawal, the London-based outlet Amwaj Media reported earlier this week, while some senior members of Kataib Hezbollah would seemingly prefer to hand the territory over to certain PMF brigades rather than to state security forces.
paras.zh: 但伊拉克新闻媒体也报道称，在如何应对当前僵局的问题上，CF内部甚至显然甚至在卡塔布真主党内部也存在分歧。据伦敦媒体 Amwaj Media 本周早些时候报道，一些高级官员认为，在逐步撤军的过程中，一些高级官员认为，Jurf al-Sakhar 的部分地区可能会被移交给联邦部队，而真主党旅的一些高级成员似乎更愿意将该领土移交给某些 PMF 旅，而不是国家安全部队。

paras.en: Late Thursday afternoon, the news agency Reuters reported that, according to three anonymous officials, all parties had come to an agreement that would allow government forces to enter Jurf al-Sakhar on Friday.
paras.zh: 周四下午晚些时候，路透社报道称，据三名匿名官员称，各方已达成协议，允许政府军于周五进入尤尔夫萨哈尔。

paras.en: A compromise is good because it avoids violence, KAS' Laessing said. "It might not be what al-Zaidi initially hoped for but it's still a political signal."
paras.zh: KAS 的莱辛说，妥协是好的，因为它可以避免暴力。 “这可能不是扎伊迪最初希望的，但这仍然是一个政治信号。”

paras.en: If it did come to actual fighting, the Iraqi military has more resources than Kataib Hezbollah, al-Shakeri explained. "[It] could probably take Jurf al-Sakhar if the political leadership and security institutions remained united," he said. "But there would be no easy victory. Kataib Hezbollah does not need to defeat the Iraqi army conventionally. It can impose costs through asymmetric attacks, political pressure and its networks inside the state."
paras.zh: 沙克里解释说，如果真的进行实际战斗，伊拉克军队比真主党旅拥有更多资源。 “如果政治领导层和安全机构保持团结，尤尔夫·萨哈尔可能会被夺走，”他说。 “但胜利并不容易。卡塔布真主党不需要以常规方式击败伊拉克军队。它可以通过不对称攻击、政治压力及其内部网络来施加成本。”

paras.en: How the reported compromise plays out in the coming days, will also impact other Iraqi militias and they will be watching closely. Because "the core issue is whether a faction can continue controlling territory and economic activity beyond effective government oversight," al-Shakeri explained.
paras.zh: 据报道，未来几天的妥协结果将如何实施，也将影响其他伊拉克民兵，他们将密切关注。因为“核心问题是一个派别能否在政府有效监督之外继续控制领土和经济活动，”沙克里解释道。

paras.en: "The most likely compromise may be to remove Kataib Hezbollah's monopoly rather than remove the PMF from Jurf al-Sakhar altogether," he continued. "That would still matter if it opened the area to regular state forces, if it protects the oil infrastructure and places security under a clearer government command structure."
paras.zh: “最有可能的妥协方案可能是取消卡塔布真主党的垄断，而不是完全取消尤尔夫·萨哈尔的PMF，”他继续说道。 “如果它向正规国家军队开放该地区，如果它保护石油基础设施并将安全置于更明确的政府指挥结构之下，那仍然很重要。”

paras.en: It could also lead to displaced residents being allowed back to their homes.
paras.zh: 它还可能导致流离失所的居民被允许返回家园。

paras.en: "But if one PMF faction simply replaces another while retaining its own networks and autonomy, then Zaidi has redistributed armed influence rather than fundamentally resolved the problem," al-Shakeri concluded.
paras.zh: “但是，如果一个PMF派系简单地取代了另一个派系，同时保留了自己的网络和自治权，那么扎伊迪就重新分配了武装影响力，而不是从根本上解决了问题，”沙克里总结道。

articles.title: ‘On the same page’: Hegseth hails US ties with Colombia’s de la Espriella

paras.en: Bogota, Colombia – United States Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth has hailed the White House’s close alliance with far-right Colombian President Abelardo de la Espriella during a brief visit to the capital, Bogota.
paras.zh: 哥伦比亚波哥大——美国国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯在对首都波哥大进行短暂访问期间，对白宫与极右翼哥伦比亚总统阿韦拉多·德拉埃斯普里埃拉的密切联盟表示赞赏。

paras.en: The US envoy met with top officials on Wednesday to discuss cooperation against organised crime and drug trafficking in the region.
paras.zh: 美国特使周三会见了高级官员，讨论合作打击该地区有组织犯罪和贩毒问题。

paras.en: They also announced Colombia as the likely host of next year’s meeting of the Americas Counter Cartel Coalition (AC3).
paras.zh: 他们还宣布哥伦比亚可能成为明年美洲反卡特尔联盟（AC3）会议的主办国。

paras.en: “It was an excellent meeting, and we’re completely on the same page. And I think the reason we’re on the same page is because both of our countries are led by strong, clear leaders,” Hegseth told reporters on Wednesday.
paras.zh: “这是一次非常棒的会议，我们完全意见一致。我认为我们意见一致的原因是我们两国都由强有力、明确的领导人领导，”赫格斯周三对记者表示。

paras.en: The US defence secretary landed at an Air Force base in Bogota around 1pm local time (18:00 GMT) Wednesday, before having a closed-door meeting with Colombian Defence Minister Jorge Mora and the General Commander of the Armed Forces Erik Rodriguez.
paras.zh: 美国国防部长于当地时间周三下午 1 点（格林威治标准时间 18:00）左右抵达波哥大的一个空军基地，随后与哥伦比亚国防部长豪尔赫·莫拉和武装部队总司令埃里克·罗德里格斯举行闭门会议。

paras.en: The military leaders discussed the difficulties of combatting the armed groups active in Colombia, particularly along the border with Venezuela, and the mounting challenge posed by their use of advanced drones, according to local media reports.
paras.zh: 据当地媒体报道，军方领导人讨论了打击活跃在哥伦比亚（特别是与委内瑞拉边境）的武装团体的困难，以及他们使用先进无人机所带来的日益严峻的挑战。

paras.en: De la Espriella, a political outsider, was elected on a promise to crush Colombia’s cartels through military force. Sergio Guzman, director of Colombia Risk Analysis, a political risk consultancy, said the president will require US support to achieve his goals.
paras.zh: 政界局外人德拉埃斯普里埃拉（De la Espriella）因承诺通过军事力量镇压哥伦比亚贩毒集团而当选。政治风险咨询公司哥伦比亚风险分析总监塞尔吉奥·古兹曼表示，总统将需要美国的支持才能实现他的目标。

paras.en: “Colombia’s fiscal situation suggests that the government needs as much assistance as it can get,” argued the analyst.
paras.zh: 这位分析师表示：“哥伦比亚的财政状况表明政府需要尽可能多的援助。”

paras.en: Though no new funding commitments materialised during the visit, Hegseth presided over the formal delivery of a Lockheed C-130 Hercules plane, used to transport troops and cargo, to the Colombian Air Force.
paras.zh: 尽管访问期间没有兑现新的资金承诺，但赫格斯主持了向哥伦比亚空军正式交付一架洛克希德 C-130 大力神飞机，用于运送部队和货物。

paras.en: “We’ve partnered more deeply with Colombia than ever before, and now we are just enhancing that cooperation and that partnership,” Hegseth told reporters.
paras.zh: 赫格斯告诉记者：“我们与哥伦比亚的合作比以往任何时候都更加深入，现在我们正在加强这种合作和伙伴关系。”

paras.en: Standing next to Hegseth at a news conference, Mora also announced that Colombia would host next year’s meeting of the AC3, also known as the Shield of the Americas.
paras.zh: 在新闻发布会上，莫拉站在赫格斯旁边，还宣布哥伦比亚将主办明年的 AC3 会议，该会议也被称为“美洲之盾”。

paras.en: Launched in March, the AC3 serves as an alliance of US-aligned nations in Latin America and the Caribbean, aimed at combatting organised crime through a military-centred approach.
paras.zh: AC3 于 3 月启动，是拉丁美洲和加勒比地区与美国结盟的国家的联盟，旨在通过以军事为中心的方法打击有组织犯罪。

paras.en: Colombia only recently joined the coalition when de la Espriella – who was endorsed by Trump – took power in August, replacing leftist Gustavo Petro, who regularly clashed with the White House.
paras.zh: 哥伦比亚最近才加入该联盟，当时得到特朗普支持的德拉埃斯普里埃拉于八月掌权，取代了经常与白宫发生冲突的左派古斯塔沃·佩特罗。

paras.en: The Trump administration has been pressuring members of the alliance to allow US strikes on their territory, as it seeks to expand its bombing campaign against suspected drug vessels in the Caribbean and Eastern Pacific to land operations.
paras.zh: 特朗普政府一直在向该联盟成员施压，要求其允许美国对其领土进行打击，因为它试图将针对加勒比海和东太平洋涉嫌贩毒船只的轰炸行动扩大到登陆行动。

paras.en: Though Hegseth announced at an August AC3 summit in Panama that de la Espriella had authorised joint military operations, The New York Times reported yesterday that the Colombian president had since shot down the idea of direct US intervention in Colombia.
paras.zh: 尽管赫格斯在巴拿马 8 月举行的 AC3 峰会上宣布德拉埃斯普里埃拉已授权联合军事行动，但《纽约时报》昨天报道称，哥伦比亚总统此后否决了美国直接干预哥伦比亚的想法。

paras.en: The New York Times also reported that Hegseth shortened his visit to Colombia as a result of the rejection of a bilateral military agreement.
paras.zh: 《纽约时报》还报道称，由于双边军事协议遭到拒绝，赫格塞斯缩短了对哥伦比亚的访问。

paras.en: Both Hegseth and de la Espriella described the report as “false”, highlighting ongoing close collaboration between the two militaries.
paras.zh: 赫格斯和德拉埃斯普里埃拉都称该报告是“虚假的”，强调了两军之间持续的密切合作。

paras.en: But de la Espriella noted that the move would require congressional approval, something that would be difficult, given unfavourable public opinion.
paras.zh: 但德拉埃斯普里埃拉指出，此举需要国会批准，鉴于公众舆论不利，这将是困难的。

paras.en: Guzman noted that Colombia’s rejection of direct US strikes likely deals a blow to the White House’s hopes for direct intervention against drug traffickers.
paras.zh: 古兹曼指出，哥伦比亚拒绝美国的直接打击可能会对白宫直接干预毒贩的希望造成打击。

paras.en: “Colombia is at the centre, the keystone of the strategy. So that’s quite a disappointment for [the Trump administration], I can imagine,” he said.
paras.zh: “哥伦比亚位于该战略的中心，是该战略的基石。我可以想象，这对（特朗普政府）来说相当令人失望，”他说。

paras.en: Hegseth also visited Venezuela on Wednesday, where he signed a bilateral deal pledging US military support for Caracas. He later departed Colombia for Ecuador and is also scheduled to make a brief stop in Honduras.
paras.zh: 赫格斯周三还访问了委内瑞拉，并在那里签署了一项双边协议，承诺美国对加拉加斯提供军事支持。随后他离开哥伦比亚前往厄瓜多尔，并计划在洪都拉斯短暂停留。

articles.title: Senate Republicans in US reject measure to limit Trump’s war powers in Iran

paras.en: United States Senate Republicans have voted against a measure that would have required President Donald Trump to end the war in Iran or seek congressional approval to continue military action, reaffirming their support for the conflict despite recent electoral losses widely attributed in part to public opposition to the war.
paras.zh: 美国参议院共和党人投票反对一项要求唐纳德·特朗普总统结束伊朗战争或寻求国会批准继续采取军事行动的措施，重申他们对这场冲突的支持，尽管最近的选举失败被广泛归因于公众反对战争。

paras.en: The resolution was defeated on Thursday 51 to 48. Senators voted largely along party lines. In June, the House of Representatives passed it 215 to 208.
paras.zh: 该决议于周四以 51 比 48 被否决。参议员们的投票基本上按照党派路线进行。 6月，众议院以215票对208票通过了该法案。

paras.en: Three Republicans – Susan Collins of Maine, Lisa Murkowski of Alaska and Rand Paul of Kentucky – voted with Democrats in favour of the measure. Only one Democrat, Senator John Fetterman of Pennsylvania, voted against it.
paras.zh: 三名共和党人——缅因州的苏珊·柯林斯(Susan Collins)、阿拉斯加州的丽莎·默科斯基(Lisa Murkowski)和肯塔基州的兰德·保罗(Rand Paul)——与民主党一起投票支持这项措施。只有一位民主党人、宾夕法尼亚州参议员约翰·费特曼投了反对票。

paras.en: Democratic Senator Tim Kaine of Virginia, a longtime advocate for restoring Congress’s constitutional authority over decisions to go to war, urged lawmakers to support the resolution. He argued that the election results reflected widespread dissatisfaction with the conflict and the rising cost of food, fuel and other goods.
paras.zh: 弗吉尼亚州民主党参议员蒂姆·凯恩长期主张恢复国会对战争决定的宪法权力，他敦促立法者支持该决议。他认为，选举结果反映了人们对冲突以及食品、燃料和其他商品成本上涨的普遍不满。

paras.en: “The unpopularity was made absolutely, manifestly clear in the election results of November 3,” Kaine said ahead of the vote.
paras.zh: “11 月 3 日的选举结果绝对、明显地表明了不受欢迎的情况，”凯恩在投票前表示。

articles.title: Trump’s case against NYT and Penguin Random House may proceed: Judge

paras.en: A federal judge has said United States President Donald Trump’s defamation lawsuit against The New York Times and book publisher Penguin Random House may proceed, a victory for Trump in his legal campaign against media companies he accuses of treating him unfairly.
paras.zh: 一名联邦法官表示，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普对《纽约时报》和图书出版商企鹅兰登书屋的诽谤诉讼可能会继续进行，这是特朗普在针对他指控不公平对待他的媒体公司的法律诉讼中取得的胜利。

paras.en: US District Judge Steven Merryday, an appointee of former President George HW Bush, handed down the ruling in federal court in Tampa, Florida, on Thursday.
paras.zh: 前总统乔治·H·W·布什任命的美国地区法官史蒂文·梅里戴于周四在佛罗里达州坦帕市联邦法院做出了裁决。

paras.en: Trump has filed several lawsuits against media companies since 2024, alleging they defamed him or fraudulently misled the public with false coverage. His critics have denounced the lawsuits as attacks on the free press.
paras.zh: 自2024年以来，特朗普已对媒体公司提起多起诉讼，指控它们诽谤他或通过虚假报道欺骗性地误导公众。他的批评者谴责这些诉讼是对新闻自由的攻击。

paras.en: The lawsuit against The New York Times and Penguin Random House cited a book about Trump by two New York Times reporters and what it characterised as “false, malicious, defamatory, and disparaging” articles that he says were aimed at sabotaging his chances in the 2024 presidential election, which he won.
paras.zh: 针对《纽约时报》和企鹅兰登书屋的诉讼引用了《纽约时报》两名记者撰写的一本有关特朗普的书，以及其中描述为“虚假、恶意、诽谤和诽谤”的文章，特朗普称这些文章旨在破坏他在 2024 年总统选举中获胜的机会。

paras.en: The Times and Penguin have denied defaming Trump and said in a court filing that his case is legally flawed and aimed at scoring political points.
paras.zh: 《泰晤士报》和《企鹅》否认诽谤特朗普，并在一份法庭文件中表示，他的案件在法律上存在缺陷，旨在获得政治分数。

paras.en: Representatives for The New York Times, Penguin Random House and Trump’s personal lawyers did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
paras.zh: 《纽约时报》、企鹅兰登书屋和特朗普私人律师的代表没有立即回应置评请求。

paras.en: Merryday threw out two of Trump’s claims but said the rest of his complaint plausibly alleged that statements accusing Trump of “planning and perpetrating complex crimes” were “based on incomplete, minimal information”.
paras.zh: 梅里戴驳回了特朗普的两项指控，但表示他的其余投诉似乎声称指控特朗普“策划和实施复杂犯罪”的声明“基于不完整、最少的信息”。

paras.en: The lawsuit against The Times and Penguin concerned two articles and a book that cast doubts on his origin story as a savvy businessman who ascended in the real estate and entertainment industries.
paras.zh: 针对《泰晤士报》和《企鹅》的诉讼涉及两篇文章和一本书，这些文章和一本书对他作为一名在房地产和娱乐行业崛起的精明商人的出身故事提出了质疑。

paras.en: Trump cited 22 statements from the book by Times journalist Peter Baker titled For Trump, a Lifetime of Scandals Heads Toward a Moment of Judgment, and 12 from the articles by Susanne Craig and Russ Buettner.
paras.zh: 特朗普引用了《纽约时报》记者彼得·贝克（Peter Baker）题为《对特朗普来说，一生的丑闻走向审判时刻》一书中的 22 条陈述，以及苏珊娜·克雷格（Susanne Craig）和拉斯·布特纳（Russ Buettner）文章中的 12 条陈述。

paras.en: They include assertions about Trump’s role in creating his hit reality TV show The Apprentice, his inheritance from his father, his business ventures and upbringing in New York City.
paras.zh: 其中包括有关特朗普在制作他的热门真人秀节目《学徒》中所扮演的角色、他从父亲那里继承的遗产、他的商业冒险和在纽约的成长经历的断言。

paras.en: The Times and Penguin said in a motion to dismiss that Trump’s lawsuit failed to explain how the statements were defamatory and included subjective opinions that cannot be proven true or false.
paras.zh: 《泰晤士报》和企鹅出版社在驳回动议中表示，特朗普的诉讼未能解释这些言论如何具有诽谤性，并且包含无法证明真假的主观意见。

paras.en: The latest victory comes days after another judge allowed Trump’s $10bn defamation lawsuit against the BBC to move forward. That civil case alleges that the British broadcaster deceptively edited a documentary on the January 6, 2021, riots on Capitol Hill to damage Trump’s reputation.
paras.zh: 最新的胜利发生在另一位法官允许特朗普针对 BBC 的 100 亿美元诽谤诉讼继续推进几天后。该民事案件指控英国广播公司欺骗性地剪辑了一部有关 2021 年 1 月 6 日国会山骚乱的纪录片，以损害特朗普的声誉。

paras.en: Trump, since resuming office last year, has undertaken a wider pressure campaign against the media and coverage he disagrees with. He has an ongoing $10bn lawsuit against The Wall Street Journal that he refiled in May after it had been dismissed. In September, he moved to bar CNN, MS Now and Politico from the White House and its press pool – a blanket ban a federal judge later blocked.
paras.zh: 特朗普自去年复职以来，对他不同意的媒体和报道采取了更广泛的压力行动。他正在对《华尔街日报》提起价值 100 亿美元的诉讼，该诉讼被驳回后，他于 5 月重新提起诉讼。 9 月，他禁止 CNN、MS Now 和 Politico 进入白宫及其媒体库——这一全面禁令后来被联邦法官否决。

paras.en: The US has fallen to a “historic low” in the Reporters Without Borders (RSF) annual press freedom tracker, continuing a decade-long decline, the organisation said earlier this year in its annual report.
paras.zh: 无国界记者组织 (RSF) 在今年早些时候的年度报告中表示，美国在年度新闻自由追踪中已跌至“历史最低点”，延续了长达十年的下降趋势。

paras.en: While the US, during the first year of Trump’s second term, remained in the “problematic” category, it dropped seven places from 57th in the world to 64th.
paras.zh: 尽管美国在特朗普第二任期的第一年仍属于“问题”类别，但其全球排名下降了 7 位，从第 57 位降至第 64 位。

paras.en: In a statement, Clayton Weimers, executive director of RSF’s North America office, said at the time that the US was experiencing a “press freedom crisis”.
paras.zh: 无国界记者组织北美办事处执行主任克莱顿·韦默斯在一份声明中表示，美国当时正在经历一场“新闻自由危机”。

paras.en: “Trump and his administration have carried out a coordinated war on press freedom since the day he took office, and we will live with the consequences for years to come,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“自上任之日起，特朗普及其政府就对新闻自由发动了一场协调一致的战争，我们将在未来几年承受其后果。”

articles.title: Iran's attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz escalate
articles.author: Aya Batrawy

paras.en: Iran's attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz escalate
paras.zh: 伊朗对霍尔木兹海峡船只的袭击升级

paras.en: Iran takes the offensive with attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz and airstrikes on several countries around the Persian Gulf.
paras.zh: 伊朗采取攻势，袭击霍尔木兹海峡的船只，并对波斯湾周边的几个国家进行空袭。

paras.en: Iran's attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz are ramping up. Data shows attacks have hit a record high since the start of the war. And it's not just ships that are blowing up in the Gulf. The U.S. has been striking an Iranian island. And Iran has launched drones at U.S. radars and air defense systems in two Arab Gulf countries. Joining us to talk about all these escalations is NPR correspondent in Dubai, Aya Batrawy. So let's start with the Iranian attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz. What makes this period different from others during the war?
paras.zh: 伊朗对霍尔木兹海峡船只的袭击正在加剧。数据显示，自战争爆发以来，袭击事件创历史新高。海湾地区爆炸的不仅仅是船只。美国一直在袭击伊朗的一座岛屿。伊朗还向两个阿拉伯海湾国家的美国雷达和防空系统发射了无人机。 NPR 驻迪拜记者 Aya Batrawy 与我们一起谈论所有这些升级事件。让我们从伊朗袭击霍尔木兹海峡船只事件开始。这一时期与其他战争时期有何不同？

paras.en: AYA BATRAWY, BYLINE: So, A, it's simply the sheer number of attacks. So in just one 24-hour period this week, Iran struck two ships, an oil tanker and another one carrying liquefied gas. And that vessel that was carrying gas exploded into a ball of fire. And the Indian crewmembers had to jump straight into the water without time to even get on lifeboats.
paras.zh: AYA BATRAWY 连线：所以，A，这只是攻击的绝对数量。因此，在本周的短短 24 小时内，伊朗袭击了两艘船只，一艘是油轮，另一艘是运载液化天然气的船只。那艘载有气体的容器爆炸成一团火球。印度船员甚至连救生艇都来不及，就直接跳入水中。
