paras.en: BATRAWY: That's according to Indian officials. Yeah. And Oman says its forces rescued the 24 men. But then also a tanker belonging to Abu Dhabi's oil company was struck that same day, with 11 crewmembers on that hospitalized and one missing. So this is a glimpse of just one day this week. They've been hitting ships daily. Now, the International Maritime Organization has some figures based on confirmed incidents, which I'll note here are conservative because not all crews report attacks.
paras.zh: BATRAWY：这是印度官员的说法。是的。阿曼表示其部队救出了这 24 名男子。但同一天，阿布扎比石油公司的一艘油轮也遭到袭击，船上 11 名船员住院，1 人失踪。这只是本周某一天的一瞥。他们每天都在撞击船只。现在，国际海事组织有一些基于已确认事件的数据，我在此指出这些数据是保守的，因为并非所有船员都报告了袭击事件。

paras.en: But even with that in mind, there were far more attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz in October than any month since the start of the war. And November is on pace to exceed that. And, obviously, this isn't just keeping oil prices high. It's also killing seafarers. Bulk carriers with fertilizers and other essential products from the Gulf are also facing similar threats. And some of these tankers have sunk or spilled their oil out.
paras.zh: 但即使考虑到这一点，10 月份霍尔木兹海峡发生的针对船只的袭击事件也比战争开始以来的任何一个月都要多。 11 月的速度有望超过这一数字。显然，这不仅仅是让油价保持高位。它还杀死了海员。来自海湾地区的化肥和其他必需品的散货船也面临着类似的威胁。其中一些油轮已经沉没或漏油。

paras.en: MARTÍNEZ: Spilled oil. Tell us about that.
paras.zh: 马丁内斯：漏油了。告诉我们这一点。

paras.en: BATRAWY: All right. So for several weeks, there were huge stretches of the UAE's coastline that were closed to the public after an oil tanker was struck on October 9. And that oil slick washed up on the shores of various emirates here. And the cleanup effort is ongoing in some of these places. So I want to share with you what I saw this week when I drove up to the emirate of Umm Al Quwain, where its entire coast is still closed off to the public.
paras.zh: 巴特劳伊：好的。因此，在 10 月 9 日一艘油轮被撞后，阿联酋大片海岸线对公众关闭了数周。浮油被冲到了各个酋长国的海岸上。其中一些地方的清理工作正在进行中。因此，我想与大家分享本周我开车前往乌姆盖万酋长国时所看到的情况，该酋长国的整个海岸仍然不对公众开放。

paras.en: I'm approaching an area with some benches that overlook the water. And the whole area smells like petrol. This is another consequence of this war that is now in its ninth month. I think this is the cleanup crew. I can see them cleaning up here. They're all wearing the hazard outfits.
paras.zh: 我正在接近一个区域，那里有一些可以俯瞰水面的长凳。整个地区都有汽油味。这是这场已经进入第九个月的战争的另一个后果。我认为这是清洁人员。我可以看到他们在这里打扫卫生。他们都穿着危险服装。

paras.en: BATRAWY: Yeah. So it smelled like petrol. And, look, these Gulf Arab countries, they don't want to have to seek permission and pay transit fees to Iran to use a waterway that was free to navigate before this war. So the U.S. is escorting ships that want to pass the strait. But attacks continue.
paras.zh: 巴特威：是的。所以闻起来像汽油。而且，你看，这些海湾阿拉伯国家，他们不想为了使用战前可以自由航行的水道而必须向伊朗寻求许可并向其支付过境费。因此，美国正在为想要通过该海峡的船只提供护航。但攻击仍在继续。

paras.en: MARTÍNEZ: Now, the U.S. has been responding to these attacks in the past few days. So what can you tell us about that?
paras.zh: 马丁内斯：现在，美国在过去几天一直在对这些袭击做出反应。那么您能告诉我们什么呢？

paras.en: BATRAWY: Sure. So Iran says the U.S. is flying drones over its airspace. And Iranian media have been reporting several days of strikes on Qeshm Island. It's an Iranian island that sits in the Strait of Hormuz. That island has radars and other military sites there.
paras.zh: 巴特威：当然。因此，伊朗称美国正在其领空上空飞行无人机。伊朗媒体连续几天报道了格什姆岛的袭击事件。这是位于霍尔木兹海峡的伊朗岛屿。该岛有雷达和其他军事基地。

paras.en: Now, a U.S. military official told NPR that a U.S. fighter aircraft did strike a missile launch site on that island this week. They say it's in response to Iran targeting U.S. personnel and assets. Now, Iran says it has launched counterstrikes against U.S. radars in Bahrain a few times over the past week and expanded attacks yesterday to also target air defense systems and missile launch sites belonging to the U.S. in Kuwait. So the thing is, while these attacks are still, you could say, somewhat limited, they are escalating.
paras.zh: 现在，一名美国军方官员告诉美国国家公共广播电台，一架美国战斗机本周确实袭击了该岛上的一个导弹发射场。他们表示，这是对伊朗针对美国人员和资产的回应。现在，伊朗表示，过去一周已多次对巴林的美国雷达发动反击，并于昨天扩大攻击范围，还针对美国在科威特的防空系统和导弹发射场。所以问题是，虽然这些攻击仍然是有限的，但它们正在升级。

paras.en: MARTÍNEZ: That's NPR's Aya Batrawy in Dubai. Thank you very much.
paras.zh: 马丁内斯：这是 NPR 驻迪拜的 Aya Batrawy。非常感谢。

paras.en: Accuracy and availability of transcripts for NPR programming may vary. Transcript text may also be revised to correct errors or match updates to audio. Audio may be edited after its original broadcast or publication. The authoritative record of NPR’s programming is the audio record.
paras.zh: NPR 节目文字记录的准确性和可用性可能会有所不同。转录文本也可能会被修改以纠正错误或匹配音频更新。音频可以在其原始广播或出版后进行编辑。 NPR 节目的权威记录是音频记录。

articles.title: Anthropic raises more than $100B in IPO. And, Dems nominate Jeffries for House speaker
articles.author: Brittney Melton

paras.en: Anthropic raises more than $100B in IPO. And, Dems nominate Jeffries for House speaker
paras.zh: Anthropic 在 IPO 中筹集了超过 100B 美元。并且，民主党提名杰弗里斯为众议院议长

paras.en: House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries has received the House Democrats' nomination to become speaker when the party regains the majority in the new year. This nomination, confirmed by a closed-door vote of 251 to 11, marks the start of the formal selection process for speaker. It will culminate in a House floor vote on Jan. 3, at the start of the new Congress. If successful, Jeffries will make history as the first Black Speaker of the House. Jeffries said after the closed door vote that he is committed to addressing cost-of-living issues, pledging to fight for lower costs in groceries, gas, housing and healthcare.
paras.zh: 众议院少数党领袖哈基姆·杰弗里斯已获得众议院民主党的提名，将在该党在新的一年重新获得多数席位时担任议长。这项提名以 251 比 11 的闭门投票得到确认，标志着发言人正式选拔过程的开始。它将在 1 月 3 日新一届国会开始时的众议院投票中达到顶峰。如果成功，杰弗里斯将创造历史，成为第一位黑人众议院议长。杰弗里斯在闭门投票后表示，他致力于解决生活成本问题，承诺争取降低食品杂货、天然气、住房和医疗保健的成本。

paras.en: - 🎧 Jeffries, who has served as the top Democrat in the minority since 2023, ran unopposed for the speaker position. But that is not the case in the Senate, NPR's Elena Moore tells Up First. Current minority leader Sen. Chuck Schumer faces a challenge from Sen. Chris Van Hollen for majority leader. Van Hollen has positioned himself as an anti-status quo, progressive leader. Both Van Hollen and Schumer have served in Congress for decades. The vote for that Senate position is set for early December.
paras.zh: - 🎧 自 2023 年以来一直担任少数党民主党领袖的杰弗里斯在没有对手的情况下竞选议长职位。但美国国家公共广播电台 (NPR) 的埃琳娜·摩尔 (Elena Moore) 告诉 Up First，参议院的情况并非如此。现任少数党领袖参议员查克·舒默面临着参议员克里斯·范霍伦对多数党领袖的挑战。范霍伦将自己定位为反现状、进步的领导者。范霍伦和舒默都在国会任职数十年。参议院这一职位的投票定于 12 月初进行。

paras.en: - ➡️ Rep. Robert Garcia, poised to chair the House Oversight Committee, sent document-preservation letters to more than a dozen of President Trump's allies and family members in preparation for investigations starting in January. These letters focus on four main areas: "Trump family corruption, corporate corruption, DHS misconduct and the White House Epstein cover-up."
paras.zh: - ➡️ 即将担任众议院监督委员会主席的众议员罗伯特·加西亚 (Robert Garcia) 向特朗普总统的十几位盟友和家人发送了文件保存信，为一月份开始的调查做准备。这些信件重点关注四个主要领域：“特朗普家族腐败、企业腐败、国土安全部不当行为和白宫爱泼斯坦的掩盖行为。”

paras.en: Trump, Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping met today in Shenzhen, China, on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum. Xi and Putin met separately the night before the trilateral meeting. Trump also had one-on-one meetings with Putin and Xi. It's the first time the three leaders have held a summit together.
paras.zh: 特朗普、俄罗斯总统普京和中国国家主席习近平今天在亚太经济合作论坛期间在中国深圳会面。习近平和普京在三边会议前一天晚上分别会面。特朗普还与普京和习近平进行了一对一的会面。这是三位领导人首次共同举行峰会。

paras.en: - 🎧 The three leaders had different agendas as they went into their meeting, NPR's Jennifer Pak says. Trump aimed to prioritize nuclear arms control. He said that they had a unique opportunity to reduce nuclear weapons, a stance Beijing has typically resisted due to its smaller stockpile compared to the U.S. and Russia. Putin sought discussions to end the war in Ukraine, but on Moscow's terms. The complexity of these issues makes substantial outcomes unlikely, Pak says. Xi aimed to position China as a stabilizing global force by bringing together Russia, its old ally, and the U.S., its direct competitor.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的 Jennifer Pak 表示，三位领导人在开会时有不同的议程。特朗普的目标是优先考虑核武器控制。他表示，他们有一个减少核武器的独特机会，但北京方面通常会抵制这一立场，因为与美国和俄罗斯相比，其库存较少。普京寻求讨论结束乌克兰战争，但要按照莫斯科的条件。朴说，这些问题的复杂性使得取得实质性成果的可能性不大。习近平的目标是通过将中国的老盟友俄罗斯和直接竞争对手美国联合起来，将中国定位为一支稳定全球的力量。

paras.en: Anthropic is set to debut on the Nasdaq exchange today. The company raised more than $100 billion in a record-breaking initial public offering that valued the company at around $1.5 trillion. The company sold 956 million shares at $83 each, surpassing its initial target range of $70 to $78. The seven founders sold over 23 million shares as part of the IPO, and the company's prospectus outlines plans to introduce an extra $26 billion in shares through private placements with Google, Microsoft and Nvidia.
paras.zh: Anthropic 将于今天在纳斯达克交易所上市。该公司在创纪录的首次公开募股中筹集了超过 1000 亿美元，公司估值约为 1.5 万亿美元。该公司以每股 83 美元的价格出售了 9.56 亿股股票，超过了最初 70 至 78 美元的目标范围。作为 IPO 的一部分，七位创始人出售了超过 2300 万股股票，该公司的招股说明书概述了通过向谷歌、微软和英伟达私募额外发行 260 亿美元股票的计划。

paras.en: - 🎧 In its IPO filing, Anthropic was optimistic that AI would have a bigger impact on the economy than industrialization, electricity, semiconductors and the internet, NPR's John Ruwitch says. The company's paperwork suggested that the addressable market for Anthropic's products could be as big as $40 trillion annually, exceeding the GDP of the United States. But CEO Dario Amodei has been outspoken about the danger of losing control over AI. The prospectus flagged some political risks, including the company's current dispute with the Pentagon over how its models can be used. Ruwitch says that now that Anthropic and SpaceX are on the market, OpenAI could potentially join next year.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的 John Ruwitch 表示，Anthropic 在其 IPO 文件中乐观地认为，人工智能对经济的影响将比工业化、电力、半导体和互联网更大。该公司的文件表明，Anthropic 产品的潜在市场每年可能高达 40 万亿美元，超过美国的 GDP。但首席执行官达里奥·阿莫迪(Dario Amodei)直言不讳地谈到了失去对人工智能控制的危险。招股说明书指出了一些政治风险，包括该公司目前与五角大楼就如何使用其模型存在争议。 Ruwitch 表示，既然 Anthropic 和 SpaceX 都已上市，OpenAI 可能会在明年加入。

paras.en: Ben Shapiro says he remains committed to his values during Trump's turbulent presidency. The conservative podcast host voted against Trump in 2016, but actively campaigned for him in 2024. Shapiro expressed disappointment in the president's tariffs, alleged corruption and the handling of the war in Iran. He says that Trump's strict immigration policies and the "whiff of corruption" surrounding the White House contributed to the GOP's midterm losses. The co-founder of the media company The Daily Wire warns that Republicans face an "uphill road in 2028," and he doesn't see Vice President JD Vance as the right GOP presidential candidate. Shapiro argues that Vance could alienate key voter groups like Hispanics, the working class, women and the college-educated. In conversation with Morning Edition's Steve Inskeep, Shapiro discussed who he thinks could be a potential 2028 GOP candidate, his new movie, Confession, and the recent decline in his show's YouTube subscriptions.
paras.zh: 本·夏皮罗表示，在特朗普动荡的总统任期内，他仍然坚持自己的价值观。这位保守派播客主持人在 2016 年投票反对特朗普，但在 2024 年积极为他竞选。夏皮罗对总统的关税、涉嫌腐败以及对伊朗战争的处理表示失望。他表示，特朗普严格的移民政策和白宫周围的“腐败气息”导致了共和党中期选举的失败。媒体公司《每日电讯报》的联合创始人警告说，共和党将在“2028 年面临一条艰难的道路”，他认为副总统 JD 万斯不是合适的共和党总统候选人。夏皮罗认为，万斯可能会疏远西班牙裔、工人阶级、女性和受过大学教育的关键选民群体。在与早间版的 Steve Inskeep 交谈时，夏皮罗讨论了他认为可能成为 2028 年共和党潜在候选人的人、他的新电影《Confession》以及最近他的节目的 YouTube 订阅量下降。

paras.en: Watch or listen to the interview or read the article about their discussion.
paras.zh: 观看或收听采访或阅读有关他们讨论的文章。

paras.en: The West-Eastern Divan Orchestra is an ensemble founded by Edward Said and Daniel Barenboim nearly 30 years ago in Germany to unite Middle Eastern musicians. Despite the deep personal grief and heightened tensions following the Hamas-led attack on Israel on Oct. 7, 2023, and the Gaza war, members of the orchestra strive to confront, rather than sidestep, political realities. Longtime musicians say Barenboim has helped them bridge painful cultural divides and foster enduring cross-border friendships. The space has also given some participants a safe space to discuss Gaza, allowing music to resolve the dissonance.
paras.zh: West-Eastern Divan Orchestra 是近 30 年前由爱德华·赛义德 (Edward Said) 和丹尼尔·巴伦博伊姆 (Daniel Barenboim) 在德国创立的一个乐团，旨在团结中东音乐家。尽管在 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯领导的对以色列的袭击以及加沙战争之后，个人深感悲痛，紧张局势加剧，但乐团成员仍努力面对而不是回避政治现实。资深音乐家表示，巴伦博伊姆帮助他们弥合了痛苦的文化鸿沟，培养了持久的跨境友谊。该空间还为一些参与者提供了讨论加沙的安全空间，让音乐解决了不和谐的问题。

paras.en: - Abdelrahman ElGendy has won the National Book Awards' non-fiction prize for his memoir, Huna, which recounts his six years as a political prisoner in Egypt.
paras.zh: - 阿卜杜勒拉赫曼·埃尔根迪 (Abdelrahman ElGendy) 凭借回忆录《胡纳》(Huna) 荣获国家图书奖非小说类小说奖，该书讲述了他在埃及担任政治犯的六年时光。

paras.en: - "Choosin' Texas" singer Ella Langley won six of the seven categories she was nominated for, including song of the year, at the Country Music Awards.
paras.zh: - 《Choosin' Texas》歌手埃拉·兰利 (Ella Langley) 在乡村音乐奖上获得了七个类别提名中的六个奖项，其中包括年度歌曲奖。

paras.en: - In this week's edition of Far-Flung Postcards, NPR's Esme Nicholson sends greetings from a Berlin square, where children play around a Käthe Kollwitz bronze cast. In the wake of World War I, the German artist's work often portrayed undernourished children in their mothers' arms.
paras.zh: - 在本周版的《遥远的明信片》中，美国国家公共广播电台 (NPR) 的埃斯梅·尼科尔森 (Esme Nicholson) 从柏林广场发出问候，广场上的孩子们围着凯绥·科尔惠支 (Käthe Kollwitz) 的青铜铸件玩耍。第一次世界大战后，这位德国艺术家的作品经常描绘母亲怀里营养不良的儿童。

articles.title: The U.N.'s top court rules Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya
articles.author: Lorcan Lovett

paras.en: The U.N.'s top court rules Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya
paras.zh: 联合国最高法院裁定缅甸对罗兴亚人实施种族灭绝

paras.en: The United Nations' top court ruled Thursday that Myanmar committed genocide against its Rohingya minority, the first time in the court's 80-year history that it has held a state responsible for the crime.
paras.zh: 联合国最高法院周四裁定，缅甸对罗兴亚少数民族实施种族灭绝，这是该法院80年历史上首次认定一个国家应对这一罪行负责。

paras.en: Judges of the International Court of Justice voted 9-6 that the military's 2017 crackdown was carried out with intent to destroy the long-persecuted Muslim minority. Myanmar's military-backed government has not yet responded to the ruling at the time of writing.
paras.zh: 国际法院法官以 9 比 6 的投票结果认为，军方 2017 年的镇压目的是消灭长期受迫害的穆斯林少数民族。截至撰写本文时，缅甸军方支持的政府尚未对裁决做出回应。

paras.en: Brought by Gambia under the 1948 Genocide Convention, the ruling will have repercussions far beyond Myanmar, according to a legal expert.
paras.zh: 一位法律专家表示，这项裁决是冈比亚根据 1948 年《种族灭绝公约》提出的，其影响将远远超出缅甸范围。

paras.en: But for Ma Roga Bibi, a Rohingya who fled Maungdaw township in northern Rakhine state, the impact was immediate.
paras.zh: 但对于逃离若开邦北部孟都镇的罗兴亚人马罗加比比来说，影响是立竿见影的。

paras.en: "I feel wonderful and grateful," said the 18-year-old, who lives in the world's largest refugee settlement in Bangladesh. "It was an emotional, historic day."
paras.zh: “我感觉棒极了，也心存感激，”这位 18 岁的年轻人说道，他住在世界上最大的难民营孟加拉国。 “这是激动人心、历史性的一天。”

paras.en: For several weeks in August and September 2017, the Myanmar military attacked and burned to the ground hundreds of Rohingya villages. Soldiers committed rapes and massacred women, men as well as children.
paras.zh: 2017 年 8 月和 9 月的几周内，缅甸军方袭击并烧毁了数百个罗辛亚村庄。士兵们强奸并屠杀妇女、男子和儿童。

paras.en: The court estimated that about 10,000 Rohingya were killed. It cited estimates that up to 2,109 Rohingya children younger than 5 died, and found the violence was systematic, including the burning of all or parts of 392 villages.
paras.zh: 法院估计约有 10,000 名罗辛亚人被杀害。据估计，多达 2,109 名 5 岁以下的罗辛亚儿童死亡，并发现暴力是系统性的，包括烧毁 392 个村庄的全部或部分地区。

paras.en: Ma Roga Bibi, then age 9, was one of about 700,000 people to flee to Bangladesh, joining earlier refugee waves. The camps sprawl across a narrow coastal strip a few miles from Cox's Bazar, a busy beach town near Myanmar. Rohingya are denied citizenship on both sides of the border.
paras.zh: 当时 9 岁的马罗加·比比 (Ma Roga Bibi) 是大约 70 万人逃往孟加拉国的人之一，加入了早期的难民潮。这些营地横跨狭窄的沿海地带，距离缅甸附近繁忙的海滨小镇科克斯巴扎尔几英里。罗兴亚人在边境两侧都被剥夺公民身份。

paras.en: "Recognition alone is not enough," she said. "We need justice, accountability, and the opportunity to return home with dignity."
paras.zh: “仅仅获得认可是不够的，”她说。 “我们需要正义、问责制和有尊严地回家的机会。”

paras.en: She wants to be a doctor, adding, "in our Rohingya community, there is no girl doctor."
paras.zh: 她想成为一名医生，并补充道，“在我们的罗兴亚社区，没有女医生。”

paras.en: Khin Khin Myint, 18, a refugee leader in activist group Rohingya Youth Voice from Buthidaung Township, also in Camp 16, said Rohingya women and girls have experienced "unimaginable suffering."
paras.zh: 18 岁的 Khin Khin Myint 是布迪当镇活动组织“罗兴亚青年之声”的难民领袖，该组织也位于 16 号营地，他说罗兴亚妇女和女孩经历了“难以想象的痛苦”。

paras.en: "We want the world to listen to survivors, recognize their courage, and include women in decisions about our future," she said. "We expect the international community to move beyond a statement of sympathy."
paras.zh: 她说：“我们希望世界倾听幸存者的心声，认可他们的勇气，并让女性参与有关我们未来的决策。” “我们期望国际社会不仅仅发表同情声明。”

paras.en: Myanmar had argued its military was conducting counterinsurgency operations against an armed group, the Arakan Rohingya Salvation Army. The court said the military failed to distinguish between civilians and alleged insurgents, and that the scale and nature of the violence could not be explained by counterterrorism.
paras.zh: 缅甸辩称，其军队正在针对武装组织若开罗兴亚救世军开展反叛乱行动。法院表示，军方未能区分平民和所谓的叛乱分子，暴力的规模和性质无法用反恐来解释。

paras.en: "The execution of Rohingya men and boys in some locations, the widespread sexual violence, the targeting of children and babies, the methodical burning of villages, and attacks on fleeing civilians are not consistent with an intent to conduct counterinsurgency operations," said ICJ president, Judge Yuji Iwasawa.
paras.zh: 国际法院院长岩泽雄二法官表示：“在一些地方处决罗辛亚男子和男孩、普遍存在的性暴力、以儿童和婴儿为目标、有条不紊地焚烧村庄以及袭击逃亡平民，这些行为与开展反叛乱行动的意图不符。”

paras.en: Antonia Mulvey, executive director of Legal Action Worldwide, a human rights group based in Geneva, said the court found evidence from the U.N. and rights organizations credible, and that counterterrorism operations were not a defense to Myanmar's argument.
paras.zh: 总部位于日内瓦的人权组织全球法律行动执行董事安东尼娅·马尔维表示，法院认为联合国和人权组织提供的证据是可信的，反恐行动并不能成为缅甸论点的辩护理由。

paras.en: She said the ruling will affect future genocide cases, including South Africa's case against Israel, on questions such as genocidal intent and state responsibility.
paras.zh: 她说，这一裁决将影响未来的种族灭绝案件，包括南非针对以色列的种族灭绝意图和国家责任等问题的案件。

paras.en: "Although every case must ultimately be decided on its own evidence," she said.
paras.zh: “尽管每个案件最终都必须根据自己的证据来决定，”她说。

paras.en: The judgment is binding on Myanmar and on all states that have ratified the Genocide Convention, she explained. All countries should review trade agreements, including arms and jet fuel supplies, and financial and economic ties with the junta, she said, while supporting accountability and reparations for the Rohingya. But the court, which hears disputes between states, can't enforce its decisions.
paras.zh: 她解释说，该判决对缅甸和所有批准《种族灭绝公约》的国家都具有约束力。她说，所有国家都应该审查贸易协定，包括武器和航空燃料供应，以及与军政府的金融和经济关系，同时支持对罗兴亚人的问责和赔偿。但审理各州之间争端的法院无法执行其裁决。

paras.en: In Myanmar, Rohingya are widely regarded as interlopers from Bangladesh, despite generations of roots in Myanmar.
paras.zh: 在缅甸，罗辛亚人尽管几代人都扎根于缅甸，但仍被广泛视为来自孟加拉国的闯入者。

paras.en: Iwasawa, however, identified the Rohingya as a distinct ethnic group, saying their language and art set them apart, and that they self-identify as such. He said they have been discriminated against by Myanmar "for decades" and qualify as a protected group.
paras.zh: 然而，岩泽认为罗兴亚人是一个独特的族群，称他们的语言和艺术使他们与众不同，并且他们也自我认同为这一群体。他说，他们“几十年来”一直受到缅甸的歧视，有资格成为受保护群体。

paras.en: The United States had previously reached a similar conclusion. In 2022, the Biden administration formally determined that Myanmar's military had committed genocide and crimes against humanity against the Rohingya during its 2016 and 2017 operations.
paras.zh: 美国此前也曾得出类似结论。 2022年，拜登政府正式认定缅甸军方在2016年和2017年的行动中对罗兴亚人犯下了种族灭绝罪和反人类罪。

paras.en: But tensions have mounted between the Trump administration and international justice bodies. In a statement to NPR on Thursday, the State Department expressed support for Rohingya refugees but raised doubts about the International Court of Justice. "The proper interpretation of the Genocide Convention is of paramount importance, as is preventing politicization of the ICJ. We are studying the decision to fully assess its implications," the State Department said.
paras.zh: 但特朗普政府与国际司法机构之间的紧张关系加剧。在周四向全国公共广播电台发表的声明中，美国国务院表达了对罗兴亚难民的支持，但对国际法院提出了质疑。美国国务院表示：“正确解释《灭绝种族罪公约》至关重要，防止国际法院政治化也同样重要。我们正在研究这一决定，以全面评估其影响。”

paras.en: In October, U.S. Ambassador to the U.N. Mike Waltz wrote online, "The ICJ must not be allowed to lower the legal threshold for proving genocide" so it can later be weaponized against U.S. and allied soldiers.
paras.zh: 10月，美国驻联合国大使迈克·沃尔兹（Mike Waltz）在网上写道，“决不能允许国际法院降低证明种族灭绝的法律门槛”，以便日后可以将其武器化以对付美国及其盟军士兵。

paras.en: Yet international human rights organizations and the United Nations applauded the court's judgment.
paras.zh: 然而国际人权组织和联合国对法院的判决表示赞赏。

paras.en: U.N. Secretary-General António Guterres called it "a powerful recognition of the Rohingya victims of genocide" and said it reaffirms that "impunity for such horrific acts must not stand."
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯称其为“对种族灭绝受害者的罗兴亚人的有力认可”，并表示“对这种可怕行为的有罪不罚现象绝不能持续”。

paras.en: The judgment does not order Myanmar to grant citizenship, saying such the issue fell outside the scope of the measures being considered to prevent future atrocities.
paras.zh: 该判决没有命令缅甸授予公民身份，称这个问题不属于为防止未来暴行而考虑采取的措施的范围。

paras.en: However, Myanmar must take steps to investigate people suspected of involvement in the crimes and prosecute them if warranted, said the court. It also found Myanmar must provide restitution and compensation, with the amount to be set in future proceedings.
paras.zh: 然而，法院表示，缅甸必须采取措施调查涉嫌参与犯罪的人，并在必要时起诉他们。它还发现缅甸必须提供归还和赔偿，金额将在未来的诉讼中确定。

paras.en: The order to enable displaced Rohingya to return runs into a hard reality: The territory is now controlled by ethnic Rakhine armed group the Arakan Army.
paras.zh: 让流离失所的罗辛亚人返回的命令遇到了一个严峻的现实：该领土现在由若开族武装组织若开军控制。

paras.en: Rakhine state has been ravaged by conflict between the military and the group, which now controls most of it.
paras.zh: 若开邦因军方与该组织之间的冲突而饱受蹂躏，该组织目前控制着该邦的大部分地区。

paras.en: Su Mon, a senior analyst at the independent conflict monitor Armed Conflict Location & Event Data, said the Rohingya in Myanmar and in the camps are "threatened by multiple armed groups," including Rohingya armed groups, the Arakan Army and the military.
paras.zh: 独立冲突监测机构武装冲突地点和事件数据的高级分析师苏蒙表示，缅甸境内和难民营中的罗兴亚人“受到多个武装团体的威胁”，包括罗兴亚武装团体、若开军和军方。

paras.en: Nearly all are stateless, she said, with few viable ways to earn a living or get food. Many are "on the verge of acute famine" because of aid shortfalls in the camps and a junta blockade in Rakhine.
paras.zh: 她说，几乎所有人都是无国籍人，几乎没有可行的谋生或获取食物的方法。由于难民营中的援助短缺以及军政府对若开邦的封锁，许多人“处于严重饥荒的边缘”。

paras.en: "Unless the broader conflict dynamics in Rakhine state improve or credible guarantees of safety are secured from all armed actors, the prospects for displaced Rohingya to return to their homes remain bleak," she added.
paras.zh: 她补充说：“除非若开邦更广泛的冲突动态得到改善，或者所有武装行动者都能提供可靠的安全保障，否则流离失所的罗兴亚人返回家园的前景仍然黯淡。”

paras.en: She urged the military to halt airstrikes, drone attacks and the use of advanced weaponry in northern Rakhine, lift its blockade and give humanitarian groups full access, including in Arakan Army-controlled areas.
paras.zh: 她敦促军方停止在若开邦北部的空袭、无人机袭击和使用先进武器，解除封锁并允许人道主义团体完全进入，包括在若开军控制的地区。

paras.en: Lorcán Lovett reported from Thailand. Michele Kelemen contributed reporting from Washington, D.C.
paras.zh: 洛尔坎·洛维特从泰国报道。米歇尔·凯莱门 (Michele Kelemen) 贡献了华盛顿特区的报道

articles.title: It's official: now avoid credit card interest into 2024

paras.en: If you're on a Galaxy Fold, consider unfolding your phone or viewing it in full screen to best optimize your experience.
paras.zh: 如果您使用的是 Galaxy Fold，请考虑展开手机或全屏查看手机，以最大程度地优化您的体验。

paras.en: If you're carrying credit card debt — or expecting upcoming expenses — interest can make it harder to get ahead.
paras.zh: 如果你背负着信用卡债务——或者预计即将发生的开支——利息可能会让你更难取得成功。

paras.en: The Citi Simplicity® Card gives you a clear window to reset.
paras.zh: Citi Simplicity® 卡为您提供了清晰的重置窗口。

paras.en: With no interest for 18 months on both balance transfers and purchases, you can focus on paying down what you owe or covering new expenses without interest piling up.
paras.zh: 余额转账和购买均无需支付 18 个月的利息，因此您可以专注于偿还欠款或支付新费用，而不会产生利息累积。

paras.en: 0% intro APR for 18 months on Balance Transfers is one of the longest interest-free periods available today.
paras.zh: 余额转账 18 个月的 0% 年利率是当今最长的免息期之一。

paras.en: Balance Transfers: 0%, 18 months on Balance Transfers
paras.zh: 余额转账：0%，余额转账 18 个月

paras.en: Applicants with a good to excellent credit score (670+) typically have the best odds of approval.
paras.zh: 信用评分良好至优秀（670+）的申请人通常获得批准的几率最高。

paras.en: There is an intro balance transfer fee of 3% of each transfer (minimum $5) completed within the first 4 months of account opening. After that, your fee will be 5% of each transfer (minimum $5)
paras.zh: 开户后 4 个月内完成的每笔转账（最低 5 美元）需缴纳 3% 的介绍性余额转账费。此后，您的费用将为每次转账的 5%（最低 5 美元）

paras.en: That lower 3% intro fee can reduce your upfront cost compared to cards that charge 5% from the start.
paras.zh: 与一开始就收取 5% 费用的信用卡相比，3% 的介绍费较低，可以降低您的前期成本。

paras.en: If you want flexibility — whether that’s paying down debt, managing new expenses, or both — this card gives you a defined window to do it without interest.
paras.zh: 如果您想要灵活性——无论是偿还债务、管理新开支，还是两者兼而有之——这张卡为您提供了一个明确的窗口，让您可以无利息地做到这一点。

paras.en: With 18 months of 0% intro APR on both balance transfers and purchases, you can choose how to use it based on what you need most right now.
paras.zh: 余额转账和购买均可享受 18 个月的 0% 年利率，您可以根据当前最需要的情况选择使用方式。

paras.en: You won’t even pay an annual fee to hold the card, and applying takes just a few minutes from your phone or computer.
paras.zh: 您甚至不需要支付年费来持有该卡，并且只需几分钟即可通过手机或计算机进行申请。

paras.en: But don’t wait too long — we often see 0% intro APR periods get cut without notice, so it’s smart to act while this one’s still available.
paras.zh: 但不要等待太久——我们经常看到 0% 的年利率优惠期在没有通知的情况下被削减，所以趁这个优惠仍然可用时采取行动是明智之举。

articles.title: 0% intro APR until 2024 is 100% insane

paras.en: If you're on a Galaxy Fold, consider unfolding your phone or viewing it in full screen to best optimize your experience.
paras.zh: 如果您使用的是 Galaxy Fold，请考虑展开手机或全屏查看手机，以最大程度地优化您的体验。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card (rates and fees) is one of the best cards you can get for paying down debt or financing a big purchase interest-free. It carries one of the longest 0% intro APR periods on the market, plus a $0 annual fee.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡（费率和费用）是您可以用来偿还债务或为大宗购物提供无息融资的最佳卡之一。它具有市场上最长的 0% 年利率之一，并且年费为 0 美元。

paras.en: The catch: once that intro APR window closes, the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card earns no rewards and hands you no ongoing perks. So it's not a great long-term keeper.
paras.zh: 问题是：一旦 APR 介绍窗口关闭，Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡将不会获得任何奖励，也不会为您提供持续的福利。所以它不是一个很好的长期保存者。

paras.en: If your only goal is to stop interest cold, the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is hard to beat. Here's my honest review.
paras.zh: 如果您的唯一目标是停止利息，富国银行 Reflect® 卡将是您的最佳选择。这是我的诚实评论。

paras.en: Intro APR 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers
paras.zh: 初始年利率 0% 初始年利率，自购买账户开户和合格余额转账起 21 个月内

paras.en: Purchases: 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases
paras.zh: 购买：自购买账户开户起 21 个月内 0% 初始年利率

paras.en: Balance Transfers: 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on qualifying balance transfers
paras.zh: 余额转账：合格余额转账开户后 21 个月内年利率为 0%

paras.en: This no-frills card is a solid choice if your priority is to avoid credit card interest for as long as possible. It offers an incredible 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers (17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR after). The balance transfer fee (5%; $5 min.) is higher than some cards, but if you want an equally long intro APR on purchases and balance transfers, this card is hard to beat.
paras.zh: 如果您的首要任务是尽可能长时间地避免信用卡利息，那么这张简单的卡是一个不错的选择。从购买账户开户和合格余额转账起，它提供令人难以置信的 0% 介绍年利率 21 个月（之后为 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率）。余额转账费用（5%；至少 5 美元）比某些卡要高，但如果您想要购买和余额转账时有同样长的年利率介绍，那么这张卡很难被击败。

paras.en: These cards are designed for people looking to pay off a large purchase or transfer a balance — so our ratings emphasize interest-free periods, fee structures, and how much time you really get to pay things down.
paras.zh: 这些卡是为那些希望还清大额购买或转移余额的人而设计的，因此我们的评级强调免息期、费用结构以及您真正还清贷款的时间。

paras.en: We don’t penalize cards for a lack of long-term rewards here – this category is all about interest savings, and our ratings reflect that.
paras.zh: 我们不会因为缺乏长期奖励而对信用卡进行处罚——这一类别主要是为了节省利息，我们的评级反映了这一点。

paras.en: We combine these factors with an evaluation of brand reputation and customer satisfaction to ensure you're getting the best high limit card recommendations. Our aim is to maintain a balanced best-of list featuring top-scoring high limit credit cards from reputable brands. 'Best for' category selections on this page are determined by our editors, and a single card may be recognized in multiple categories.
paras.zh: 我们将这些因素与品牌声誉和客户满意度评估相结合，以确保您获得最佳的高限额卡推荐。我们的目标是维持一个平衡的最佳列表，其中包括来自知名品牌的得分最高的高限额信用卡。此页面上的“最佳”类别选择由我们的编辑确定，单张卡片可能会在多个类别中被识别。

paras.en: Ordering within lists is influenced by advertiser compensation, including featured placements at the top of a given list, but our product recommendations are NEVER influenced by advertisers. Learn more about how Motley Fool Money rates credit cards.
paras.zh: 列表中的排序受到广告商补偿的影响，包括给定列表顶部的特色展示位置，但我们的产品推荐永远不会受到广告商的影响。详细了解 Motley Fool Money 如何对信用卡进行评级。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is best for people carrying high-interest debt or planning a large purchase they want to spread out over time.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡最适合背负高息债务或计划长期进行大额购买的人士。

paras.en: You get nearly two years of breathing room with no interest, which can save a lot of money while you pay things off.
paras.zh: 您将获得近两年的无息喘息空间，这可以在您还清债务的同时节省大量资金。

paras.en: If you're looking for cash back or travel rewards, this is not the card for you. The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card has no rewards program and no welcome bonus. It loses most of its value the moment the intro period ends.
paras.zh: 如果您正在寻求现金返还或旅行奖励，那么这张卡不适合您。 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡没有奖励计划，也没有欢迎奖金。一旦介绍期结束，它就失去了大部分价值。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card's headline feature is 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers. (A 17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR applies after.)
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的主要特点是，自开户购买和合格余额转账起 21 个月内，年利率为 0%。 （此后适用 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率。）

paras.en: That's one of the longest 0% APR periods you'll find anywhere -- which is why it earned Motley Fool Money's award for Best 0% Intro APR Card of 2026.
paras.zh: 这是您能在任何地方找到的最长的 0% 年利率卡之一 - 这就是为什么它获得 Motley Fool Money 颁发的 2026 年最佳 0% 年利率介绍卡奖。

paras.en: This long intro APR is particularly handy for large balances (think anything $5,000+). The longer the promo window, the less you need to pay each month to clear your balance while paying no interest.
paras.zh: 这个长篇介绍年利率对于大额余额（想想任何 5,000 美元以上的东西）特别方便。促销窗口越长，您每月需要支付的费用就越少，无需支付利息即可结清余额。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges no annual fee, so it costs nothing to keep in your wallet. For anyone building credit history -- or, like me, holding onto a top credit card for the long haul -- that's a real plus.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不收取年费，因此放在钱包中无需支付任何费用。对于任何建立信用记录的人来说——或者像我一样长期持有顶级信用卡——这是一个真正的优势。

paras.en: Keeping the card open can help your credit score by lengthening your average credit history over time.
paras.zh: 保持信用卡开放可以随着时间的推移延长您的平均信用记录，从而提高您的信用评分。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card includes cellphone protection when you pay your monthly phone bill with the card. It covers up to $600 per claim for theft or damage, with a $25 deductible, and you can file up to two claims per 12-month period.
paras.zh: 当您使用 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡支付每月的电话费时，该卡包含手机保护功能。每次盗窃或损坏索赔的赔付额最高为 600 美元，免赔额为 25 美元，并且每 12 个月最多可以提出两次索赔。

paras.en: I've never had to use cellphone insurance, but as a frequent phone-dropper and generally clumsy person, I've always loved having it in my back pocket.
paras.zh: 我从来没有使用过手机保险，但作为一个经常丢手机而且通常很笨拙的人，我一直喜欢把它放在我的后口袋里。

paras.en: We recommend comparing options to ensure the card you're selecting is the best fit for you. To make your search easier, here's a short list of standout credit cards.
paras.zh: 我们建议比较选项，以确保您选择的卡最适合您。为了让您的搜索更容易，这里列出了一些优秀的信用卡。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card earns no rewards. If you want a card with long-term perks like cash back or travel points, this isn't it.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不赚取任何奖励。如果您想要一张具有现金返还或旅行积分等长期福利的卡，那么这张卡不合适。

paras.en: A strong alternative is the Wells Fargo Active Cash® Card (rates and fees), which earns a flat 2% cash rewards on purchases for a $0 annual fee. It's our Best Overall Credit Card of 2026, and a fan favorite for flat-rate rewards.
paras.zh: 一个强有力的替代方案是 Wells Fargo Active Cash® 卡（费率和费用），该卡以 0 美元年费购买即可获得 2% 的固定现金奖励。这是我们 2026 年最佳整体信用卡，也是粉丝最喜欢的统一费率奖励卡。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges a balance transfer fee of 5%, min: $5 -- this is on the high side for a balance transfer card.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡收取 5% 的余额转账费用，最低 5 美元——这对于余额转账卡来说偏高。

paras.en: If you move a $10,000 balance, you'd owe a $500 fee, even though you'd pay the balance off at 0% during the intro period.
paras.zh: 如果您转移 10,000 美元的余额，则需要支付 500 美元的费用，即使您在介绍期内以 0% 的利率还清余额。

paras.en: Run the math before you transfer, because the fee should cost less than the interest you'd otherwise pay. If you won't clear the balance within the 0% APR period, then an alternative balance transfer card with a lower transfer fee may serve you better.
paras.zh: 在转账之前先计算一下，因为费用应该低于您原本支付的利息。如果您无法在 0% 年利率期间清除余额，那么转账费用较低的替代余额转账卡可能会为您提供更好的服务。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges a 3% foreign transaction fee, so you'll pay extra on purchases made outside the U.S. If you travel abroad and want to skip that cost, consider one of our favorite travel credit cards.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡收取 3% 的国外交易费，因此您在美国境外购物时需要支付额外费用。如果您出国旅行并想跳过这笔费用，请考虑我们最喜欢的旅行信用卡之一。

paras.en: It also has no purchase protection or extended warranty on purchases.
paras.zh: 它也没有购买保护或延长购买保修。

paras.en: You'll generally need good to excellent credit (Motley Fool Money estimates this to be a FICO® Score of about 670 or higher) to qualify for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card. Wells Fargo doesn't publish an official cutoff, and applicants closer to 700 tend to be the best-qualified candidates.
paras.zh: 您通常需要良好到优秀的信用（Motley Fool Money 估计 FICO® 分数约为 670 或更高）才有资格获得 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡。富国银行没有公布官方截止日期，接近 700 名的申请者往往是最合格的候选人。

paras.en: Keep in mind, your score isn't the only factor. Wells Fargo also weighs your income, existing debt, and overall credit history. You can check for pre-selected offers on Wells Fargo's site without a hard inquiry to gauge your chances first.
paras.zh: 请记住，您的分数并不是唯一的因素。富国银行还会衡量您的收入、现有债务和整体信用记录。您可以在富国银行网站上查看预先选定的优惠，无需进行严格询问即可首先评估您的机会。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card comes with a minimum credit limit of $1,000, and higher scores and income generally earn higher limits. Wells Fargo sets your limit individually based on your full credit profile, so two applicants can get very different lines of credit.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的最低信用额度为 1,000 美元，分数和收入越高，通常获得的信用额度也越高。富国银行根据您的完整信用状况单独设置您的限额，因此两个申请人可以获得截然不同的信用额度。

paras.en: Your starting limit isn't permanent, though. Once your account is open and in good standing, usually after six to 12 months, you can request an increase. Or, Wells Fargo may raise it automatically for on-time payments and low utilization.
paras.zh: 不过，您的起始限制并不是永久的。一旦您的账户开设且信誉良好，通常在 6 到 12 个月后，您就可以请求增加金额。或者，富国银行可能会因按时付款和利用率低而自动提高费用。

paras.en: To get the 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on qualifying balance transfers (then 17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR), you must complete qualifying transfers within 120 days of opening your account.
paras.zh: 要在开户后 21 个月内通过合格余额转账获得 0% 初始年利率（然后是 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率），您必须在开户后 120 天内完成合格转账。

paras.en: I recommend starting the transfer online or by phone as soon as you're approved. Having your old account details ready speeds things up.
paras.zh: 我建议您在获得批准后立即开始在线或通过电话转移。准备好旧帐户详细信息可以加快速度。

paras.en: One important note: you can't transfer a balance from another Wells Fargo or affiliated card. Transfers have to come from a different issuer, and the 5%, min: $5 transfer fee applies to each one.
paras.zh: 一个重要的注意事项：您无法从另一张富国银行或附属卡转移余额。转账必须来自不同的发行人，并且每笔转账均需缴纳 5%（最低 5 美元）的转账费。

paras.en: Applying for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is quick. Here's what to do:
paras.zh: 申请 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的速度很快。该怎么做：

paras.en: Approvals are usually instant, but can take a few days if Wells Fargo needs to verify some of your information.
paras.zh: 批准通常是即时的，但如果富国银行需要验证您的某些信息，则可能需要几天的时间。

paras.en: Yes, the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is worth it if your priority is paying off debt or financing a large purchase without interest. Very few cards give you a long no-interest runway like this.
paras.zh: 是的，如果您的首要任务是偿还债务或为大额购买提供无息融资，那么 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡是值得的。很少有卡可以给你这样一条漫长的无息跑道。

paras.en: It's not worth it if you want rewards or perks after the intro period, since it offers neither.
paras.zh: 如果您在介绍期后想要奖励或福利，那么这是不值得的，因为它两者都没有提供。

paras.en: Ready to make a dent in your debt? Apply for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card today -- awarded Motley Fool Money's Best 0% Intro APR Card of 2026.
paras.zh: 准备好减少债务了吗？立即申请 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡 - 荣获 Motley Fool Money 2026 年最佳 0% 年利率介绍卡。

paras.en: When the 0% intro APR period ends, any remaining balance starts accruing interest at your regular variable APR from that point forward. The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card doesn't charge deferred or retroactive interest, so you only pay on what's left -- not on the full original balance.
paras.zh: 当 0% 介绍年利率期结束时，任何剩余余额将开始按照您的常规可变年利率计息。 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不收取递延或追溯利息，因此您只需支付剩余金额，而不是全额原始余额。

paras.en: No, the 0% intro APR does not cover cash advances. Cash advances start accruing interest immediately at a separate, higher APR and come with their own fee. The intro offer only applies to purchases and qualifying balance transfers.
paras.zh: 不可以，0% 的年利率不包括现金预支。现金预支立即开始以单独的、较高的年利率计息，并收取自己的费用。介绍优惠仅适用于购买和符合条件的余额转账。

paras.en: Keeping the card open is usually the better move, even after your balance hits $0. If it has no annual fee, it costs nothing to hold, and the open account helps your credit score by supporting your total available credit and length of history.
paras.zh: 即使您的余额达到 0 美元，保持卡打开通常是更好的选择。如果它没有年费，那么持有它就不需要任何成本，并且开放账户通过支持您的总可用信用和历史长度来帮助您的信用评分。

articles.title: The most beautiful sections of China's Great Wall

paras.en: Editor’s Note: Monthly Ticket is a CNN Travel series that spotlights some of the most fascinating topics in the travel world. In September, we’re celebrating superlatives as we look at some of the world’s biggest, tallest and most expensive attractions and destinations.
paras.zh: 编者注：《月票》是 CNN 的旅游系列节目，重点关注旅游界一些最有趣的话题。九月，当我们参观世界上一些最大、最高和最昂贵的景点和目的地时，我们正在庆祝最高级。

paras.en: Having lived in Beijing for almost 12 years, I’ve had plenty of time to travel widely in China.
paras.zh: 在北京生活了近12年，我有足够的时间去中国各地旅行。

paras.en: I’ve visited more than 100 cities, not to mention countless towns and villages throughout the mainland’s 31 provinces.
paras.zh: 我去过100多个城市，更不用说遍布大陆31个省份的无数城镇和村庄。

paras.en: Looking back, I’ve come to realize it was my frequent visits to different parts of the Great Wall in Beijing that were a driving force behind my desire to explore the rest of the country and, along with it, the many sections of wall that lie outside the capital’s boundaries.
paras.zh: 回想起来，我逐渐意识到，正是我对北京长城不同部分的频繁访问，推动了我探索中国其他地区以及首都边界之外的许多长城的愿望。

paras.en: Work on the Great Wall began more than 2,500 years ago, its origins dating back to China’s Spring and Autumn Period of around 770 BCE to 476 BCE. Various sections were added in subsequent eras as competing dynasties and factions sought to exert their control.
paras.zh: 长城的修建始于 2500 多年前，其起源可以追溯到公元前 770 年至公元前 476 年左右的中国春秋时期。在随后的时代中，随着相互竞争的王朝和派系试图施加控制，各个部分被添加。

paras.en: Work eventually stopped in the 17th century.
paras.zh: 工程最终于 17 世纪停止。

paras.en: Though not a single, unbroken structure, the wall spans over 21,000 kilometers, winding through 15 provinces, 97 prefectures and 404 counties.
paras.zh: 长城虽然不是一个完整的结构，但全长超过 21,000 公里，蜿蜒穿过 15 个省、97 个地区和 404 个县。

paras.en: And while certain sections have been incredibly popular among tourists, many parts have slipped into obscurity, disrepair and sometimes oblivion.
paras.zh: 虽然某些部分非常受游客欢迎，但许多部分却变得默默无闻、年久失修，有时甚至被遗忘。

paras.en: Whether you’re planning to visit the Great Wall for the first time or the 50th, the following destinations are sure to make your trip to China even more worthwhile. (Check out the above video for dramatic aerial footage of some of these amazing sites.)
paras.zh: 无论您是第一次还是第 50 次游览长城，以下目的地一定会让您的中国之旅更加值得。 （查看上面的视频，了解其中一些令人惊叹的景点的戏剧性航拍镜头。）

paras.en: The Great Wall is not simply a brick and mortar bulwark; in certain places, towers on jagged mountain peaks, fortress towns or even wide rivers count as sections of “wall.”
paras.zh: 长城不仅仅是一座砖砌的堡垒，更是一座砖砌的堡垒。在某些地方，锯齿状山峰上的塔楼、要塞城镇甚至宽阔的河流都算作“墙”的一部分。

paras.en: The Turtle City, built in the Ming Dynasty (1368-1644) as part of the Great Wall’s “Yellow River Defense Line,” was completed in 1608 and was home to around 2,000 infantrymen and 500 cavalry units during peak use.
paras.zh: 龟城建于明朝（1368-1644 年），是长城“黄河防线”的一部分，于 1608 年竣工，在高峰期可容纳约 2,000 名步兵和 500 名骑兵。

paras.en: Today, this fortress city is located in the Sitan Township of Jingtai County in north central Gansu province.
paras.zh: 如今，这座要塞城市位于甘肃省中北部景泰县泗滩乡。

paras.en: While there aren’t many real turtles in the “Turtle City,” the garrison town got its nickname due to its unique shape.
paras.zh: 虽然“龟城”中真正的乌龟不多，但这座驻军小镇因其独特的形状而得名。

paras.en: The south gate acts as the head and the west and east gates as the flippers. The town’s oval wall is the body, while the north gate acts as its tail. As one of the most well-preserved and truly authentic walled cities left in China today, it’s definitely worth your time.
paras.zh: 南门为头，西门、东门为脚蹼。椭圆形城墙为城身，北门为城尾。作为当今中国保存最完好、最真实的城墙之一，这里绝对值得您花时间。

paras.en: Staying in the Jingtai County center is recommended. The ancient city is only a 30-minute cab ride from your lodgings, so you can visit whenever the light is best for photos.
paras.zh: 推荐住在景泰县城中心。从您的住处乘坐出租车仅需 30 分钟即可到达古城，因此您可以在光线最适合拍照的时候前往游览。

paras.en: When in Jingtai, try local specialties such as the five Buddha tofu and the Jingtai cold mixed noodles – both are spicy vegetarian dishes. A walk through the sprawling night market in Jingtai County People’s Square, which boasts more than 50 snack stalls, is also recommended for adventurous foodies.
paras.zh: 到了景泰，一定要尝尝当地的特色菜，比如五佛豆腐和景泰冷拌面——都是麻辣素菜。景泰县人民广场的夜市拥有 50 多个小吃摊位，值得喜欢冒险的美食家们前往逛一逛。

paras.en: Getting there: Lanzhou, the capital of Gansu province, has a major international airport and high-speed train connections from many cities in China. The drive to Yongtai Turtle City from downtown Lanzhou takes about 2.5 hours (195 kilometers). From Lanzhou Zhongchuan Airport, it’s only 1.5 hours (125 kilometers).
paras.zh: 交通：兰州是甘肃省的省会，拥有一个主要的国际机场和连接中国许多城市的高速列车。从兰州市区驾车至永泰龟城，车程约2.5小时（195公里）。距兰州中川机场仅1.5小时（125公里）。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are two parts of the same Stone Dragon – two contiguous sections of the Great Wall that together stretch for roughly 25 kilometers along Beijing’s mountaintops.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口是同一条石龙的两个部分——长城的两个连续部分，沿着北京的山顶绵延约 25 公里。

paras.en: Historical records show that millions of men spent centuries constructing the Great Wall. Stand atop the wall at either Mutianyu or Jiankou, and you’ll begin to comprehend the gravity of this statement.
paras.zh: 历史记录表明，数百万人花费了几个世纪的时间建造长城。站在慕田峪或剑口的城墙上，你就会开始理解这句话的严重性。

paras.en: These two sections are arguably the two most classic examples of Ming Dynasty Great Wall surviving today, and climbing either is guaranteed to be a life-changing experience.
paras.zh: 这两段可以说是现存明代长城中最经典的两个例子，攀登其中任何一段都将是一次改变人生的经历。

paras.en: Mutianyu is the best portion of the “tourist wall.” Restored in the 1980s, it’s very commercial but also superbly beautiful. Visitors not up for the hike can take a cable car to the top.
paras.zh: 慕田峪是“旅游墙”中最好的部分。它于 20 世纪 80 年代修复，非常商业化，但也非常美丽。不适合徒步的游客可以乘坐缆车到达山顶。

paras.en: To the west of Mutianyu, Jiankou is colloquially known as the “wild wall” – no ticket needed and not commercialized. That being said, as of 2020, hiking at Jiankou has become somewhat frowned upon by the local government because of safety concerns.
paras.zh: 慕田峪以西的剑口俗称“野墙”，不需门票，不商业化。尽管如此，从2020年开始，出于安全考虑，当地政府对剑口徒步有些不满。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are less than a 90-minute drive (without traffic) from downtown Beijing, yet it’s highly recommended to enjoy a night in the countryside if time allows.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口距离北京市中心不到 90 分钟车程（不堵车），但如果时间允许，强烈建议在乡村享受一晚。

paras.en: Jiankou can be accessed via Xizhazi village; if dates align, you might even be able to spend a few days with William Lindesay, world-renowned Great Wall historian, and his wonderful family at The Barracks, their wall-side courtyard home.
paras.zh: 经西栅子村可到达剑口；如果日期一致，您甚至可以与世界著名的长城历史学家威廉·林德赛 (William Lindesay) 和他的家人一起在军营 (The Barracks) 度过几天，这是他们位于墙边的庭院住宅。

paras.en: For lodgings around Mutianyu, The Brickyard is a superbly comfortable choice.
paras.zh: 对于慕田峪周边的住宿而言，瓦厂是一个非常舒适的选择。

paras.en: In fall and spring, shades of the wall’s gray brick contrast with nature’s vibrant colors. Peak autumn foliage and spring cherry blossoms provide stunning backdrops for photos.
paras.zh: 在秋季和春季，灰色砖墙的色调与大自然充满活力的色彩形成鲜明对比。秋天的枫叶和春天的樱花为照片提供了令人惊叹的背景。

paras.en: For winter sports enthusiasts, there’s skiing and skating next to the Wall at locations not far from Mutianyu.
paras.zh: 对于冬季运动爱好者来说，距离慕田峪不远的长城旁有滑雪场和滑冰场。

paras.en: Getting to Mutianyu: Restrictions on applying for temporary driving licenses in China were relaxed in September 2019, so renting a car as a foreign tourist is entirely possible. (International driving licenses are not accepted in China.)
paras.zh: 前往慕田峪：2019年9月，中国放宽了申请临时驾驶执照的限制，因此外国游客完全可以租车。 （中国不接受国际驾照。）

paras.en: You can also hire a car with a driver for the day or take the Mutianyu Special Tourism Bus from the Dongzhimen Wai Bus Station.
paras.zh: 您也可以当天租一辆带司机的汽车，或者从东直门外汽车站乘坐慕田峪旅游专线巴士。

paras.en: Getting to Jiankou: Renting a car or booking private transport is recommended. As Xizhazi is a small village, buses are scarce so it can take up to five hours to get there by public transport, as opposed to 90 minutes by car.
paras.zh: 前往剑口：建议租车或预订私人交通工具。由于西栅子是一个小村庄，公交车很少，因此乘坐公共交通工具最多需要 5 个小时才能到达那里，而开车则需要 90 分钟。

paras.en: Bataizi village sits just inside the Motianling section of the Great Wall and is home to the ruins of a Gothic church built in 1876 under the direction of a German missionary.
paras.zh: 八台子村位于磨天岭长城内，是一座哥特式教堂的遗址，这座教堂建于 1876 年，由一位德国传教士主持建造。

paras.en: The church has been damaged and repaired numerous times in its nearly 150-year history; the bell tower is the only part still standing.
paras.zh: 这座教堂在近150年的历史中曾多次遭到损坏和修复。钟楼是唯一仍然矗立的部分。

paras.en: The juxtaposition of its ruins against the rammed-earth Great Wall makes Bataizi a unique place to spend a morning or afternoon.
paras.zh: 其遗址与夯土长城并列，使八台子成为度过早晨或下午的独特场所。

paras.en: After finishing your hike along the wall and visiting the church ruins, drop in to the village’s “new” church to say hello to Father Pan; if you speak Chinese, he can answer any questions about the village’s long connection with Catholicism.
paras.zh: 完成沿着城墙的徒步旅行并参观教堂遗址后，顺便去村里的“新”教堂向潘神父问好；如果你会说中文，他可以回答有关该村与天主教的悠久联系的任何问题。

paras.en: Besides Bataizi, Datong should also be on your tourist map; visiting the Yungang Grottoes (a UNESCO world heritage site) and the Hengshan Hanging Temple will make your trip even more memorable.
paras.zh: 除了八台子，大同也应该出现在你的旅游地图上；参观云冈石窟（联合国教科文组织世界遗产）和恒山悬空寺将使您的旅行更加难忘。

paras.en: Late summer is an ideal time to visit Bataizi, as you’ll see a wonderful contrast between the Great Wall and the lush green hills.
paras.zh: 夏末是游览八台子的理想时机，因为您会看到长城和郁郁葱葱的青山之间的美妙对比。

paras.en: Getting there: Bataizi village is 80 kilometers west of Datong, one of Shanxi province’s largest and most famous cities. Zuoyun County is only 22 kilometers away from Bataizi – about a 35-minute drive.
paras.zh: 交通：八台子村位于山西省最大、最著名的城市之一大同以西 80 公里处。左云县距八台子仅22公里，车程约35分钟。

paras.en: Datong is easily accessible by plane or high-speed train from other cities in China; a taxi from downtown Datong to Bataizi should cost roughly 300 yuan (about $43).
paras.zh: 从中国其他城市乘坐飞机或高铁可轻松抵达大同；从大同市中心到八台子的出租车费用约为 300 元（约合 43 美元）。

paras.en: Alternatively, you can make your way to Zuoyun County by bus then hop in a taxi.
paras.zh: 或者，您也可以乘坐巴士前往左云县，然后乘坐出租车。

paras.en: In Datong, luxury seekers will want to head for the five-star Yunzhong Traditional Courtyard Hotel. Zuoyun County has one hotel that can accept foreigners: Zuoyun Jinshan International Hotel. Both can be found on popular hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: 在大同，追求奢华的游客将会前往五星级的云中传统四合院酒店。左云县有一家可以接待外国人的酒店：左云金山国际酒店。两者都可以在热门酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Laoniuwan (aka the Old Ox Bend Great Wall)
paras.zh: 老牛湾（又名老牛弯长城）

paras.en: As the locals say, Laoniuwan is where the Great Wall and the mighty Yellow River shake hands.
paras.zh: 当地人说，老牛湾是长城与浩瀚黄河握手的地方。

paras.en: The Laoniuwan Fortress was built in 1467, while the most famous tower of the Great Wall in this area, Wanghe Tower (literally meaning river-watching tower), was constructed in 1544.
paras.zh: 老牛湾城建于1467年，而该地区最著名的长城塔望河楼则建于1544年。

paras.en: Laoniuwan village is located in Pianguan County, part of Xinzhou city in Shanxi province, just across the river from Inner Mongolia.
paras.zh: 老牛湾村位于山西省忻州市偏关县，与内蒙古隔江相望。

paras.en: Late summer or early fall is a great time to visit, as you’ll avoid the potentially dangerous mountain roads during spring rainstorms, or being uncomfortably cold in a place without great infrastructure.
paras.zh: 夏末或初秋是游览的好时机，因为您可以避开春季暴雨期间潜在危险的山路，或者在没有良好基础设施的地方感到不舒服的寒冷。

paras.en: Along the Great Wall, there are only a few places where it meets bodies of water; of all those, this is the most stunning.
paras.zh: 长城沿线只有少数地方与水体交汇；其中，这是最令人惊叹的。

paras.en: A boat ride along the river is highly recommended. You’ll be able to soak in the natural beauty of the Yellow River Gorge while marveling at the steadfast resolve of these ancient architects.
paras.zh: 强烈推荐沿河乘船游览。您将能够沉浸在黄河峡谷的自然美景中，同时惊叹于这些古代建筑师的坚定决心。

paras.en: Getting there: Laoniuwan is difficult to get to by public transportation. The best option is to rent or book a car to take you from Datong to Laoniuwan via Bataizi – this way, you’ll be able to see two incredible locations along the Great Wall in one trip.
paras.zh: 交通：老牛湾乘坐公共交通不太方便。最好的选择是租赁或预订一辆车，从大同经八台子前往老牛湾——这样，您将能够在一次旅行中看到长城沿线的两个令人难以置信的景点。

paras.en: Pianguan is the nearest city, about one hour away. Pianguan does not have a train station or an airport. The only option is to arrive by bus. Shuozhou, 140 kilometers from Laoniuwan, has an airport opening later this year.
paras.zh: 偏关是最近的城市，大约一小时车程。偏关没有火车站和机场。唯一的选择是乘坐巴士到达。距离老牛湾 140 公里的朔州机场将于今年晚些时候开业。

paras.en: Construction on the Great Wall in Simatai began in 1373. It was expanded and reinforced periodically throughout the Ming Dynasty.
paras.zh: 司马台长城始建于 1373 年。明代期间不断扩建和加固。

paras.en: The Fairy Tower is one of the best-known towers of the wall at Simatai but also one of the least visited due to how difficult it is to access.
paras.zh: 仙塔是司马台最著名的城墙塔楼之一，但由于难以进入，也是参观人数最少的塔楼之一。

paras.en: Instead, aim to take in incredible views of the Fairy Tower from Wangjing Tower (just a few hundred meters away). It’s a journey that will satiate even the most adventurous hikers, yet can be done without any ropes, ladders or other essential safety gear.
paras.zh: 相反，您的目标是从望京塔（仅数百米外）欣赏仙女塔的壮丽景色。这是一次即使是最具冒险精神的徒步旅行者也能满足的旅程，而且无需任何绳索、梯子或其他必要的安全装备即可完成。

paras.en: As with a visit to Mutianyu/Jiankou, this section of wall is guaranteed to deliver stunning views any time of year. My only suggestion is to wait for a clear day (usually visibility is great the day after it rains or snows), as the view from Wangjing Tower is unobstructed in every direction.
paras.zh: 与游览慕田峪/剑口一样，这一段城墙保证在一年中的任何时候都能呈现出令人惊叹的景色。我唯一的建议是等待晴天（通常下雨或下雪后的第二天能见度很好），因为从望京塔的各个方向都一览无余。

paras.en: The hike to the Fairy Tower will leave you in awe of the Northern Barbarians’ supposed determination to reach the capital; the mountains are nearly impassable on foot, let alone by horse, with sheer cliff faces on either side.
paras.zh: 徒步前往仙塔，会让您对北蛮人到达首都的决心感到敬畏；这些山脉几乎无法步行通过，更不用说骑马了，两侧都是陡峭的悬崖。

paras.en: It makes for absolutely world-class hiking and an interesting history lesson.
paras.zh: 它绝对是世界一流的徒步旅行和有趣的历史课。

paras.en: Five-star lodgings are available at Hobo Farm; they also have an incredible restaurant that serves delicious Western and Chinese fare. For 4.5 star lodgings with a lower price tag, try Yatou’s Homestay. Both can be found on major hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: Hobo农场提供五星级住宿；他们还有一家令人难以置信的餐厅，供应美味的西餐和中餐。如果想要价格较低的 4.5 星级住宿，可以试试丫头民宿。两者都可以在主要的酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Getting there: Both the Fairy Tower and Wangjing Tower should be accessed via Tangjiazhai village, located in Beijing’s Miyun district.
paras.zh: 交通：仙女塔和望京塔均需经由位于北京密云区的唐家寨村到达。

paras.en: Tangjiazhai village is 140 kilometers from downtown Beijing, depending on your route. Booking a private car from the city is probably the most time-effective way to get there.
paras.zh: 唐家寨距离北京市中心 140 公里，具体取决于您的路线。从市区预订私家车可能是到达那里最省时的方式。

paras.en: You can also take a high-speed train from Beijing Station to Miyun district and switch to a bus or taxi from there.
paras.zh: 您也可以从北京站乘坐高铁到密云区，然后从那里换乘公交车或出租车。

paras.en: Constructed during the reign of Emperor Jiajing (1507-1567), this single-wall section stands seven meters tall in some spots – no small feat considering it was made by piling stones.
paras.zh: 这座单墙建筑建于嘉靖年间（1507-1567 年），有些地方高达 7 米，考虑到它是用石头堆砌而成，这可不是一件小事。

paras.en: It’s located just across the road from the town of Dushikou, in Chicheng in Hebei province.
paras.zh: 它位于河北省赤城独市口镇的马路对面。

paras.en: The piled-stone wall at Dushikou is unique, as many other sections of the Great Wall close to Beijing were constructed using kiln-fired bricks.
paras.zh: 独市口的石堆墙是独一无二的，因为许多靠近北京的长城都是用窑烧砖建造的。

paras.en: Dushikou is best visited in the summer, specifically July and August, when the rolling hills of the surrounding grasslands are peak green. Cool evenings make for perfect outdoor barbecue/bonfire weather.
paras.zh: 独石口的最佳旅游时间是夏季，特别是七月和八月，此时周围草原连绵起伏的山丘呈现出翠绿的景色。凉爽的夜晚是完美的户外烧烤/篝火天气。

paras.en: You’ll be able to find clean and comfortable farmhouse lodgings in Dushikou town; alternatively, Chicheng, 45 minutes away, has a range of hotels to choose from.
paras.zh: 在都市口镇你可以找到干净舒适的农家住宿；或者，距酒店 45 分钟路程的赤城也有多家酒店可供选择。

paras.en: Lamb skewers and roast leg of lamb are specialties in these parts, as this part of Hebei is very close to the border with Inner Mongolia. Noodle lovers should also try the local oat noodles, which are delicious.
paras.zh: 河北这一地区靠近内蒙古边境，羊肉串、烤羊腿是这些地区的特色菜。喜欢吃面食的人还应该尝尝当地的燕麦面，味道鲜美。

paras.en: Getting there: Thanks to all the infrastructure built for the 2022 Winter Olympics, the drive to Dushikou has been shortened by almost two hours. If you prefer not to drive, hop on a bus to Chicheng from the Liuliqiao Transport Hub in Beijing and take a 45-minute taxi ride to Dushikou.
paras.zh: 交通：得益于为 2022 年冬奥会建设的所有基础设施，前往都市口的车程缩短了近两个小时。如果您不想开车，可以从北京六里桥交通枢纽搭乘巴士前往赤城，然后乘坐出租车 45 分钟即可到达独市口。

paras.en: Note that public transportation will take one or two hours longer than private car.
paras.zh: 请注意，公共交通将比私家车多花一到两个小时。

articles.title: LAPD chief says policing the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics could cost up to $4B, far exceeding current funding

paras.en: Policing the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics could cost as much as $4 billion — four times the federal funding already approved — according to the city's police chief.
paras.zh: 据洛杉矶市警察局长称，维持 2028 年洛杉矶奥运会的治安费用可能高达 40 亿美元，是已批准的联邦资金的四倍。

paras.en: LAPD Chief Jim McDonnell told the Los Angeles Times Wednesday that security across Olympic venues could require between $3.5 billion and $4 billion, including approximately $1.3 billion for Los Angeles alone.
paras.zh: 洛杉矶警察局局长吉姆·麦克唐纳 (Jim McDonnell) 周三向《洛杉矶时报》表示，整个奥运场馆的安全保障可能需要 35 亿至 40 亿美元，其中仅洛杉矶就需要约 13 亿美元。

paras.en: "The billion dollars is certainly helpful," McDonnell told the outlet, while warning that the allocation would not cover even the city's policing needs during the Games.
paras.zh: “这十亿美元肯定是有帮助的，”麦克唐纳告诉媒体，同时警告说，这笔拨款甚至无法满足奥运会期间该市的警务需求。

paras.en: Congress provided $1 billion for Olympic security, planning and related costs through President Donald Trump's One Big Beautiful Bill Act, according to the House Homeland Security Committee.
paras.zh: 据众议院国土安全委员会称，国会通过唐纳德·特朗普总统的一项美丽法案法案，为奥运会安全、规划和相关费用提供了 10 亿美元。

paras.en: The staffing demands are also substantial. McDonnell told the Times that competition venues would need 9,400 officers daily during the busiest stretch, with the LAPD supplying roughly one-quarter to one-third and outside agencies providing the remainder.
paras.zh: 人员配备需求也很大。麦克唐纳告诉《泰晤士报》，在最繁忙的时期，比赛场馆每天需要 9,400 名警员，其中洛杉矶警察局提供大约四分之一到三分之一，其余部分由外部机构提供。

paras.en: His estimate came from discussions with other law enforcement leaders coordinating security, an LAPD spokesman told the newspaper.
paras.zh: 洛杉矶警察局发言人告诉该报，他的估计来自与其他协调安全的执法领导人的讨论。

paras.en: The U.S. Secret Service is leading security planning for the Olympics and Paralympics, which have been designated National Special Security Events. That designation brings federal, state and local agencies together to develop and implement the security operation.
paras.zh: 美国特勤局正在领导奥运会和残奥会的安全规划，这些活动已被指定为国家特别安全活动。该指定将联邦、州和地方机构联合起来制定和实施安全行动。

paras.en: Trump also established a White House task force in August 2025 to coordinate preparations, including security, transportation, counterterrorism and emergency response. The president chairs the task force, with the vice president serving as vice chair.
paras.zh: 特朗普还于2025年8月成立了白宫特别工作组，负责协调安全、交通、反恐和应急响应等准备工作。总统担任工作组主席，副总统担任副主席。

paras.en: The Olympic opening ceremony is scheduled for July 14, 2028.
paras.zh: 奥运会开幕式定于2028年7月14日举行。

articles.title: High school football drama includes a forfeit and resignation, Aikman HATES Buck & is the MLB season toast?

paras.en: 'Nightcaps' is a daily column that catches you up on the biggest sports, news and culture stories you may have missed while pretending to do work at your desk. It runs Monday-Friday on OutKick.com.
paras.zh: “Nightcaps”是一个每日专栏，为您提供在假装在办公桌前工作时可能错过的最大的体育、新闻和文化故事。它于周一至周五在 OutKick.com 上运行。

paras.en: Over the hump and safely into the second half of the week. We're seven days out from Thanksgiving, folks.
paras.zh: 渡过难关，安全进入下半周。各位，距离感恩节还有 7 天。

paras.en: I said it earlier this week, I'll say it now, and I'll say it again tomorrow — don't leave those turkeys in the freezer for much longer. You've got a 3-4 day window to thaw them completely, assuming they're your standard birds (12-15 pounds). If you've got a 20-pounder, get them out tomorrow at the latest. Maybe even tonight.
paras.zh: 我本周早些时候说过，现在会说，明天我还会再说一遍——不要把火鸡放在冰箱里太久。假设它们是您的标准鸡（12-15 磅），您有 3-4 天的时间来完全解冻它们。如果你有20磅重的炮，最迟明天就把它们拿出来。也许甚至今晚。

paras.en: I've made this mistake before. I spent all Thanksgiving morning one year dumping my bird into a bucket of water for 30 minutes, emptying it out, and refilling it with fresh water for hours on end.
paras.zh: 我以前也犯过这个错误。有一年，我整个感恩节早上都把鸟儿扔进一桶水里 30 分钟，然后倒空，然后又重新装满淡水，连续几个小时。

paras.en: Why? Because I didn't give her enough time to thaw in the fridge. Ideally, we want our birds completely thawed by Wednesday so we can baste and marinate overnight into Thursday. That gives you six days.
paras.zh: 为什么？因为我没有给她足够的时间在冰箱里解冻。理想情况下，我们希望我们的鸟在周三之前完全解冻，这样我们就可以在周四之前涂上油并腌制过夜。这给了你六天的时间。

paras.en: Welcome to a Thursday Nightcaps — the one where a high school football dilemma in New York has my attention as the playoffs heat up. We had a forfeit and a coach resignation, but was it fair? Ethical? Silly? Petty? All the above?
paras.zh: 欢迎来到周四的睡前比赛——随着季后赛的升温，纽约高中橄榄球的困境引起了我的注意。我们输了，教练也辞职了，但这公平吗？道德吗？愚蠢的？小气？以上都是吗？

paras.en: What else? I've got Rob Manfred being an absolute lunatic with his Thanksgiving comments on Wednesday, Troy Aikman's hatred of Joe Buck took another turn today, and has ANYONE watched the new "Madden" biopic with Nicolas Cage? It's now streaming, which means my timeline is flooded with different clips from the movie ...
paras.zh: 还有什么？我发现罗伯·曼弗雷德（Rob Manfred）在周三的感恩节评论中绝对是个疯子，特洛伊·艾克曼（Troy Aikman）对乔·巴克（Joe Buck）的仇恨今天又发生了转变，有人看过尼古拉斯·凯奇（Nicolas Cage）主演的新《Madden》传记片吗？它现在正在流式传输，这意味着我的时间线充满了电影中的不同片段......

paras.en: ... And it looks just horrible. Beyond horrible, really. It looks so bad I think I have to watch it tonight. I can't wait any longer. I'm enthralled.
paras.zh: ...它看起来很可怕。真的，太可怕了。看起来很糟糕，我想我今晚必须看它。我不能再等了。我很着迷。

paras.en: OK, grab you some popcorn and settle on in for a Thursday 'Cap!
paras.zh: 好吧，给你一些爆米花，然后准备周四的帽子！

paras.en: Where do we stand on this high school football drama?
paras.zh: 我们对这部高中橄榄球剧的立场如何？

paras.en: Let's go ahead and jump right in, because we've got a lot to get to and I'd like to get us outta here a bit early.
paras.zh: 让我们开始吧，因为我们还有很多事情要做，我想让我们早点离开这里。

paras.en: The big story in the world of high school football today, shockingly, comes from New York. Not exactly the mecca of the HSFB world, but every town has a story, right?
paras.zh: 令人震惊的是，当今高中橄榄球界的重大事件来自纽约。不完全是 HSFB 世界的圣地，但每个城镇都有一个故事，对吧？

paras.en: Middletown High School destroyed Valley Central, 48-15, in a playoff game earlier this month. It was a bloodbath. The Middies (great name) moved to a perfect 10-0 with the win, and advanced to the next round of the postseason.
paras.zh: 米德尔敦高中在本月早些时候的一场季后赛中以 48-15 击败了 Valley Central。这是一场血腥屠杀。 Middies（伟大的名字）凭借这场胜利取得了完美的 10-0 胜利，并晋级季后赛下一轮。

paras.en: Pretty cut and dry stuff, right? Wrong! Turns out, Middletown used a special teams player for a total of eight plays in the game (53 seconds), which was a no-no because he joined the team midway through the season and was NOT eligible for the playoffs.
paras.zh: 漂亮的切好的和干燥的东西，对吧？错误的！事实证明，米德尔敦队在比赛中总共使用了一名特勤队球员8次（53秒），这是不可以的，因为他是在赛季中途加入球队的，并且没有资格进入季后赛。

paras.en: Coaches for Middletown's next opponent noticed the infraction while watching game film for the upcoming contest, and reported the Middies to the league. After petitions and court hearings (that's right, court hearings!), the Middies were eventually forced to forfeit the game.
paras.zh: 米德尔敦下一个对手的教练在观看即将到来的比赛的比赛录像时注意到了这一违规行为，并向联盟报告了米德尔敦队的情况。经过请愿和法庭听证会（没错，法庭听证会！），Middies 最终被迫放弃比赛。

paras.en: This week, head coach Tim Strenfel — who had been at the helm for a decade — resigned.
paras.zh: 本周，执掌球队十年的主教练蒂姆·斯特伦费尔辞职。

paras.en: Two schools of thought here ... Well, three:
paras.zh: 这里有两种思想流派......好吧，三种：

paras.en: - To me, it seems like a pretty petty move by the opposing team to pull this card. Comes across as being scared to face Middletown. As a player, I'd be a little embarrassed by the move. I'm just being honest. The school district, obviously, agrees. They called the move "arbitrary and capricious," according to reports. It's not like this ineligible player had any impact on the game ... at all. He played for a total of 53 seconds. Middletown won by a billion. He didn't make a difference.
paras.zh: - 对我来说，对方队伍拉这张牌似乎是一个很小的举动。给人的印象是害怕面对米德尔敦。作为一名球员，我会对这一举动感到有点尴尬。我只是说实话。学区显然同意这一点。据报道，他们称此举“武断且反复无常”。这个不合格的玩家根本没有对游戏产生任何影响……。他一共打了53秒。米德尔敦赢了十亿。他没有改变。

paras.en: - That being said, rules are rules, right? Middletown didn't follow the rules. The kid wasn't allowed to play in the postseason, and he played in the postseason. Adults need to teach kids about accountability, right? That's part of sports, especially at the high school level. If you break the rules, there are consequences. That's life. High school sports are full of life lessons.
paras.zh: - 话虽这么说，规则就是规则，对吗？米德尔敦不遵守规则。这孩子不被允许参加季后赛，但他却参加了季后赛。成年人需要教导孩子责任感，对吗？这是体育运动的一部分，尤其是在高中阶段。如果你违反规则，就会产生后果。这就是生活。高中体育充满了人生教训。

paras.en: - But are we punishing kids for a silly oversight an adult(s) made? Seems like it. There are seniors on that team that unknowingly played their final snap of football ... ever. I'd give anything to go back and play high school sports again. Best years of my life. I at least got some closure with it. These kids got none. That's a bummer.
paras.zh: - 但是我们是否因为成年人的愚蠢疏忽而惩罚孩子呢？好像是这样。该队的一些高年级球员在不知不觉中踢出了他们的最后一场比赛……永远。我愿意付出一切来重新回到高中参加体育运动。我一生中最美好的年华。我至少得到了一些结论。这些孩子什么也没有得到。真是太糟糕了。

paras.en: Thoughts? Which side are we taking here? Fair or foul? Somewhere in between? I don't know why the coach resigned. Seems fishy to me. Why would he resign over this? Unless, of course, there's more to the story.
paras.zh: 想法？我们在这里站在哪一边？公平还是犯规？介于两者之间？不知道教练为什么辞职。我觉得很可疑。他为何要因此事辞职？当然，除非故事还有更多内容。

paras.en: For now, we know what we know. Where do YOU stand?
paras.zh: 目前，我们知道我们所知道的。你站在哪里？

paras.en: Manfred hates T-Day, Aikman hates Joe & we all hate Madden
paras.zh: 曼弗雷德讨厌 T-Day，艾克曼讨厌乔，我们都讨厌麦登

paras.en: OK, we've spent enough time in amateur athletics today. Let's rapid-fire this Thursday class into a big night of (crappy) FOOTBALL, and check in with Rob Manfred with MLB on the verge of another lockout.
paras.zh: 好吧，今天我们在业余田径运动上已经花了足够的时间了。让我们在周四的课程中快速进入一个（蹩脚的）足球之夜，并与罗布·曼弗雷德（Rob Manfred）一起检查美国职业棒球大联盟（MLB）正处于另一次停摆的边缘。

paras.en: "A decision on a lockout is one that we're going to make at the last possible moment," Manfred said Wednesday before leaping into the worst take I've ever heard in my life.
paras.zh: “我们将在最后一刻做出停摆决定，”曼弗雷德周三说道，然后就说出了我一生中听过的最糟糕的言论。

paras.en: "I'm not that big on Thanksgiving as a holiday. We'll make ourselves available wherever and whenever to bargain in an effort to make an agreement."
paras.zh: “我不太喜欢感恩节这个节日。我们会随时随地进行讨价还价，努力达成协议。”

paras.en: Who hates Thanksgiving? Seriously. Objectively, it's one of the dumber things I have ever heard in my life. I've talked to people who hate Halloween and Christmas. Some folks don't take Easter as seriously as others. New Year's Eve is pretty hit or miss with folks.
paras.zh: 谁讨厌感恩节？严重地。客观地说，这是我一生中听过的最愚蠢的事情之一。我和那些讨厌万圣节和圣诞节的人交谈过。有些人不像其他人那样认真对待复活节。新年前夜对于人们来说是很受欢迎或错过的。

paras.en: But Thanksgiving? Feel like that's a pretty universally loved holiday, especially in America. I'm not sure I've ever heard someone come out and just say, "I'm not that big on Thanksgiving as a holiday." That's just insane.
paras.zh: 但感恩节呢？感觉这是一个普遍喜爱的假期，尤其是在美国。我不确定我是否听过有人出来说：“我对感恩节这个假期没有那么大的兴趣。”这太疯狂了。

paras.en: If this is the guy we're counting on for baseball next season, stick a fork in that bird. It's over. She's cooked. Ain't happening.
paras.zh: 如果这就是我们下赛季棒球比赛中指望的人，那就用叉子插在那只鸟身上吧。结束了。她煮熟了。没有发生。

paras.en: Two more on the way out. First? Let's go from one angry person (Rob) to another (Troy!):
paras.zh: 还有两个正在出去。第一的？让我们从一个愤怒的人（罗布）转向另一个（特洛伊！）：

paras.en: The downfall of the once-impenetrable Troy Aikman-Joe Buck pairing continues to be staggering to watch. These dudes HATE each other at this point. ESPN execs must be sweating bullets every single time Troy Aikman gets a microphone put in front of him. He's a loose cannon.
paras.zh: 曾经坚不可摧的特洛伊·艾克曼和乔·巴克搭档的垮台仍然令人震惊。这些家伙在这一点上互相憎恨。每当特洛伊·艾克曼（Troy Aikman）面前有麦克风时，ESPN 的高管们一定会紧张得直冒汗。他是一门松散的大炮。

paras.en: And you know why? Because he's always been the star. He was a star in Dallas for a decade, and he's been a star in the booth for two decades. He's bigger than ESPN, and he knows it. He does not care what happens, or what he says.
paras.zh: 你知道为什么吗？因为他一直都是明星。十年来他一直是达拉斯的明星，二十年来他一直是展位上的明星。他比 ESPN 更重要，他知道这一点。他不在乎发生什么，也不在乎他说什么。

paras.en: Somehow, him and Joe Buck have kept it professional in the booth. But there is A LOT of football left this year, folks. There's just no chance they make it to the Super Bowl without an incident. None.
paras.zh: 不知何故，他和乔·巴克在展位上保持了专业性。但今年还有很多足球比赛要踢，伙计们。他们不可能不出事就进入超级碗。没有任何。

paras.en: OK, that's it for today. Good work, everyone. If tonight's stinker of a TNF game (Colts-Texans) doesn't do it for you, may I suggest checking out the new "Madden" biopic on Prime?
paras.zh: 好的，今天就这样。干得好，大家。如果今晚的 TNF 比赛（小马队与德克萨斯人队）不适合您，我可以建议您看看 Prime 上的新“Madden”传记片吗？

articles.title: Trump scores key win over House progressive accused of assaulting ICE agent

paras.en: The Trump administration scored another win in court Thursday over a House progressive who was accused of assaulting federal immigration agents at a facility in New Jersey in 2025.
paras.zh: 周四，特朗普政府在法庭上再次战胜了一名众议院进步派人士，这名进步派人士被指控于 2025 年在新泽西州的一处设施袭击联邦移民官员。

paras.en: Rep. LaMonica McIver, D-N.J., was denied her request that the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 3rd Circuit reconsider its August 2026 decision that would have her face at least two of the three charges related to a confrontation between Democrats and Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) at Delaney Hall in Newark, New Jersey.
paras.zh: 新泽西州民主党众议员拉莫尼卡·麦基弗 (LaMonica McIver) 要求美国第三巡回上诉法院重新考虑其 2026 年 8 月的决定，但遭到拒绝，该决定将使她面临与民主党与移民和海关执法局 (ICE) 在新泽西州纽瓦克德莱尼大厅发生对抗有关的三项指控中的至少两项指控。

paras.en: McIver previously tried to invoke the Constitution's Speech or Debate Clause in order to evade the charges, but the federal court's three-judge panel denied that motion in a 2-1 decision earlier this year. Thursday's order upholds that decision.
paras.zh: 麦基弗此前曾试图援引宪法的演讲或辩论条款来逃避指控，但今年早些时候联邦法院的三名法官小组以 2 比 1 的裁决驳回了这一动议。周四的命令维持了这一决定。

paras.en: "Donald Trump continues to send warning shots to Democrats in Congress and in all levels of power — but their case against me right now, in broad daylight, goes well beyond a warning. Because of a weaponized Department of Justice and because I dared to do my job and conduct oversight of ICE, I am facing 17 years in prison," McIver said in a statement. "Now, due to the disappointing decision by the Third Circuit, we are all one step closer to a world in which the President of the United States can try to imprison people simply because he does not like what they stand for."
paras.zh: 麦基弗在一份声明中表示：“唐纳德·特朗普继续向国会和各级权力机构的民主党人发出警告，但他们现在在光天化日之下对我提出的指控远远超出了警告的范畴。由于司法部武器化，而且因为我敢于履行职责并监督 ICE，我将面临 17 年监禁。” “现在，由于第三巡回法院令人失望的决定，我们都离这样一个世界又近了一步：美国总统可以仅仅因为不喜欢人们所代表的东西就试图监禁他们。”

paras.en: McIver called the result "disappointing" and said she and her lawyers "are looking at every possible option for what comes next."
paras.zh: 麦克莱弗称结果“令人失望”，并表示她和她的律师“正在考虑接下来发生的一切可能的选择”。

paras.en: An unannounced visit to the Delaney Hall detention center by a group of Democratic officials devolved into chaos in May 2025 that culminated in a physical standoff between federal lawmakers and ICE agents and the arrest of Newark Mayor Ras Baraka. McIver was charged with three counts, including assaulting and impeding federal officers.
paras.zh: 2025 年 5 月，一群民主党官员对德莱尼霍尔 (Delaney Hall) 拘留中心进行未经宣布的访问，结果陷入混乱，最终导致联邦立法者和 ICE 特工之间发生肢体对峙，纽瓦克市市长拉斯巴拉卡 (Ras Baraka) 被捕。麦克莱弗被指控犯有三项罪名，包括袭击和妨碍联邦官员。

paras.en: McIver initially argued that her actions fell under her constitutionally protected duties as a member of Congress and, therefore, she could not be prosecuted.
paras.zh: 麦基弗最初辩称，她的行为属于宪法保护的国会议员职责，因此她不能被起诉。

paras.en: But a 2-1 decision issued in August 2026 by Biden-appointed Judge Cindy Chung and Trump-appointed Judge Stephanos Bibas stated that McIver's argument of legislative immunity would not stand for two of the three counts, while the third count was sent back to a lower court for further review.
paras.zh: 但拜登任命的法官辛迪·钟(Cindy Chung)和特朗普任命的法官斯蒂芬诺斯·比巴斯(Stephanos Bibas)于2026年8月以2比1的比分做出裁决，表示麦基弗的立法豁免权论点不能支持三项罪名中的两项，而第三项罪名则被送回下级法院进一步审查。

paras.en: Court documents say McIver allegedly "slammed her forearm" into a federal officer trying to arrest Baraka. On that count, the federal appellate court agreed with a lower court decision that her "alleged intervention into the Mayor’s questionable arrest had no cognizable connection to any legislative function" protected by the Constitution.
paras.zh: 法庭文件称，麦克莱弗据称“用前臂猛击”一名试图逮捕巴拉卡的联邦官员。就此而言，联邦上诉法院同意下级法院的一项裁决，即她“对市长可疑逮捕的指控与受宪法保护的任何立法职能没有明显的联系”。

paras.en: The second count alleged that McIver used both of her forearms to "strike [an officer] as she returned inside of the secured area of Delaney Hall."
paras.zh: 第二项指控称，麦克莱弗“当一名警官返回德莱尼厅的安全区域时，用她的双前臂袭击了她”。

paras.en: The two judges wrote, "Like the acts charged in Count One, the acts of pushing past and forcibly striking someone are unambiguously non-legislative: they are not integral to the legislative process."
paras.zh: 两位法官写道：“就像罪状一中指控的行为一样，推过去和强行殴打某人的行为显然是非立法性的：它们不是立法程序的组成部分。”

paras.en: Judge Thomas Ambro wrote in dissent, "When an Executive Branch official prevents a Member from entering a DHS facility, she is denied effective access to an oversight inspection."
paras.zh: 托马斯·安布罗法官在异议中写道：“当行政部门官员阻止一名议员进入国土安全部设施时，她就被剥夺了有效接受监督检查的机会。”

paras.en: The case could make it all the way to the Supreme Court if McIver continues fighting against the charges.
paras.zh: 如果麦克莱弗继续反对这些指控，此案可能会一直上诉到最高法院。

articles.title: Ukraine allies warn ‘Yalta format’ will not bring about peace – as it happened
articles.author: Jakub Krupa (now) and Hamish Mackay (earlier)

paras.en: 'A Yalta format will not bring about peace,' Merz warns
paras.zh: 默茨警告：“雅尔塔形式不会带来和平”

paras.en: He says the leaders want “a peace for Ukraine that is both just and lasting,” with “more, not less, security for Europe and the world.”
paras.zh: 他表示，领导人希望“乌克兰实现公正而持久的和平”，并“为欧洲和世界提供更多而不是更少的安全”。

paras.en: “We will continue to support Kyiv for as long as is necessary. Should peace negotiations take place, we will be involved. Negotiations can only succeed if Ukraine and Europe are part of the process together. A “Yalta-style” format will not bring about peace.”
paras.zh: “只要有必要，我们将继续支持基辅。如果进行和平谈判，我们将参与。只有乌克兰和欧洲共同参与谈判，谈判才能成功。‘雅尔塔式’模式不会带来和平。”

paras.en: He says that as a gift he gave each of the guests a piece of the Berlin Wall, as an example of “what the Yalta arrangement represented for Berlin.”
paras.zh: 他说，作为礼物，他送给每位客人一块柏林墙，作为“雅尔塔安排对柏林的代表”的一个例子。

paras.en: “You may recall that in 1987, President Reagan stood here in Berlin and said: ‘Mr. Gorbachev, tear down this wall!’ Today, we say to President Putin: ‘end the war in Ukraine, and let us work together to find diplomatic solutions.’ We never again want to live in a divided Europe. We want to live in freedom and in peace – together.”
paras.zh: “你可能还记得，1987年，里根总统站在柏林说：‘戈尔巴乔夫先生，推倒这堵墙！’今天，我们对普京总统说：‘结束乌克兰战争，让我们共同努力寻找外交解决方案。’我们再也不想生活在分裂的欧洲。我们希望共同生活在自由与和平中。”

paras.en: And, on that note, we will be closing the blog for today.
paras.zh: 并且，就此而言，我们今天将关闭博客。

paras.en: European leaders showed a united and defiant front as they repeated their backing for Ukraine “for as long as it takes” at the latest summit of the Coalition of the Willing in Berlin, declaring no decisions on Ukraine and Europe can be made without their participation (17:58, 18:06, 18:11).
paras.zh: 欧洲领导人在最近一次柏林意愿联盟峰会上重申“只要需要”就支持乌克兰，并宣布如果没有他们的参与，就无法就乌克兰和欧洲做出任何决定（17:58、18:06、18:11），展现了团结和挑衅的阵线。

paras.en: Their comments appeared to play down the importance of Donald Trump’s summit with Russia’s Vladimir Putin and China’s Xi Jinping in Shenzhen (16:34), with German chancellor Friedrich Merz saying “a Yalta format will not bring about peace,” in a reference to secretive discussions between superpowers above the heads of those most affected (17:45, 17:50).
paras.zh: 他们的言论似乎淡化了唐纳德·特朗普与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京和中国国家主席习近平在深圳举行的峰会（16:34）的重要性，德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨表示“雅尔塔形式不会带来和平”，指的是受影响最严重的超级大国之间的秘密讨论（17:45, 17:50）。

paras.en: European leaders and US peace envoys insisted that some progress has been made in discussions on ending the Russian war of aggression in Ukraine, although they struck a cautious note about Putin’s intentions in the coming months (15:46, 18:38, 18:44).
paras.zh: 欧洲领导人和美国和平特使坚称，关于结束俄罗斯对乌克兰的侵略战争的讨论已经取得了一些进展，尽管他们对普京未来几个月的意图持谨慎态度（15:46、18:38、18:44）。

paras.en: US envoy Jared Kushner claimed that Russia’s leadership appears to be “comfortable” with the concept of Article 5-like security guarantees for Ukraine in any postwar settlement (18:29).
paras.zh: 美国特使贾里德·库什纳声称，俄罗斯领导层似乎对在任何战后解决方案中为乌克兰提供类似第五条的安全保障的概念感到“满意”(18:29)。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Russia’s Putin struck an uncompromising tone at his press briefing in Shenzhen, vowing “painful” response to Ukraine’s attacks on Kerch bridge and defending his maximalist demands (13:09, 13:34).
paras.zh: 与此同时，俄罗斯总统普京在深圳的新闻发布会上态度强硬，誓言对乌克兰袭击刻赤大桥做出“严厉”回应，并捍卫其最大化要求（13:09、13:34）。

paras.en: If you have any tips, comments or suggestions, email me at jakub.krupa@theguardian.com.
paras.zh: 如果您有任何提示、意见或建议，请发送电子邮件至 jakub.krupa@theguardian.com。

paras.en: I am also on Bluesky at @jakubkrupa.bsky.social and on X at @jakubkrupa.
paras.zh: 我还在 Bluesky 上@jakubkrupa.bsky.social 和 X 上@jakubkrupa。

paras.en: Is Europe now in the shadow of a Trump, Putin and Xi alliance? – podcast
paras.zh: 欧洲现在是否处于特朗普、普京和习近平联盟的阴影之下？ - 播客

paras.en: Andy Burnham is meeting western leaders in Berlin and Brussels this week, to discuss Ukraine and closer ties to the EU. Meanwhile, Donald Trump,Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping have met at the Apec summit in China.
paras.zh: 安迪·伯纳姆本周将在柏林和布鲁塞尔会见西方领导人，讨论乌克兰问题以及与欧盟建立更紧密的关系。与此同时，唐纳德·特朗普、弗拉基米尔·普京和习近平在中国举行的亚太经合组织峰会上会面。

paras.en: Is this the start of a global shift of power away from Europe, or was it just a hyped-up photo opportunity?
paras.zh: 这是全球权力从欧洲转移的开始，还是只是一个大肆宣传的拍照机会？

paras.en: Here is our latest “Politics Weekly” podcast on this if you want to catch up on today’s events:
paras.zh: 如果您想了解今天的活动，这里是我们最新的“政治周刊”播客：

paras.en: Separately, Poland’s Donald Tusk also told reporters on his way back to Poland that Trump’s comments after his meeting with Putin and Xi sounded “quite optimistic.”
paras.zh: 另外，波兰总统唐纳德·图斯克在返回波兰途中也对记者表示，特朗普在与普京和习近平会面后的言论听起来“相当乐观”。

paras.en: But Tusk quickly added that Trump’s “faith in Putin’s good will is probably unshakeable,” and he was a bit more sceptical about it.
paras.zh: 但图斯克很快补充说，特朗普“对普京善意的信念可能是不可动摇的”，他对此持怀疑态度。

paras.en: “It would be good if indeed sooner or later it turned out that Russia is seriously ready to undertake peace talks,” he said.
paras.zh: “如果事实证明俄罗斯迟早确实已经做好了进行和平谈判的准备，那就太好了，”他说。

paras.en: “I don’t think it’s likely that Russia will sit down at the negotiating table in any serious way before the winter is over.”
paras.zh: “我认为，在冬季结束之​​前，俄罗斯不太可能以任何严肃的方式坐在谈判桌上。”

paras.en: 'Some grounds for optimism' that talks can progress, Burnham says
paras.zh: 伯纳姆表示，谈判能够取得进展“有一些乐观的理由”

paras.en: The European leaders also get asked about Welt/Politico’s report earlier and the tone of Trump’s comments.
paras.zh: 欧洲领导人还被问及世界报/政治报早些时候的报告以及特朗普评论的语气。

paras.en: Burnham says that Trump’s comments focused on “horrific” loss of life during the war, saying “he spoke quite passionately about that subject.”
paras.zh: 伯纳姆说，特朗普的评论集中在战争期间“可怕的”生命损失，并表示“他对这个话题的谈论非常热情”。

paras.en: He stresses “nobody is winning this war,” and stresses that in his view there has been “huge progress” in now consensus that “there is no decision about Ukraine without Ukraine in the room and no decision about European security without Europe represented in the room.”
paras.zh: 他强调“没有人会赢得这场战争”，并强调，在他看来，目前的共识已经取得了“巨大进展”，即“如果没有乌克兰在场，就不会就乌克兰问题做出决定；如果没有欧洲代表在场，就不会就欧洲安全问题做出决定。”

paras.en: He says “there is a greater degree of alignment.”
paras.zh: 他说“两者之间存在更大程度的一致性”。

paras.en: “I would say for the first time in my period as prime minister of the United Kingdom, I see alignment; I see people saying the same thing; I see solidarity across the board in Europe; a strong, united European position.
paras.zh: “我想说，在我担任英国首相期间，我第一次看到了结盟；我看到人们说同样的话；我看到欧洲的全面团结；我看到了强大、团结的欧洲立场。

paras.en: And that gives some grounds for optimism that there can now be progress. But obviously, there is one person who can determine that more than anybody else, and that is president Putin.”
paras.zh: 这让我们有理由乐观地认为现在可以取得进展。但显然，有一个人比任何人都更能决定这一点，那就是普京总统。”

paras.en: Witkoff jumps in there to say that Trump has “adamantly supported a peaceful end to this war,” with clear instructions to engage with the coalition of the willing and work in all formats that can be helpful to end the war.
paras.zh: 威特科夫插话称，特朗普“坚决支持和平结束这场战争”，并明确指示与意愿联盟进行接触，并以一切有助于结束战争的方式开展工作。
