paras.en: “What I heard from him on the call today was that he mentioned these very same principles to the other two leaders who he was meeting with [Xi and Putin], so he made Ukraine, and a peaceful end to this war, a principal part of that trilateral today, and I think he’s to be commended for that.”
paras.zh: “我今天在电话中听到他向他会见的另外两位领导人（习近平和普京）提到了这些完全相同的原则，因此他使乌克兰以及和平结束这场战争成为今天三边的一个主要部分，我认为他因此值得赞扬。”

paras.en: Russia 'comfortable' with Article 5-like security guarantees for Ukraine, Kushner says
paras.zh: 库什纳表示，俄罗斯对乌克兰类似第五条的安全保障感到“满意”

paras.en: Kushner says that the US managed to get Moscow comfortable with the concept that any security agreement for Ukraine would be based on Article 5-type arrangement, like in Nato.
paras.zh: 库什纳表示，美国成功地让莫斯科接受这样一个概念，即任何针对乌克兰的安全协议都将基于类似北约的第5条类型的安排。

paras.en: (Not sure the Russians would say the same.)
paras.zh: （不确定俄罗斯人也会这么说。）

paras.en: He says “I know that there’s a lot of, scepticism and disbelief on that concept in Russia, but that’s why it’s important to restart the dialogue between Europe and Russia.”
paras.zh: 他说：“我知道俄罗斯对这个概念有很多怀疑和不信任，但这就是为什么重启欧洲和俄罗斯之间的对话很重要。”

paras.en: “I will say from America’s perspective, giving an Article Five like security guarantee is a really, really big deal. And I think that that’s something that President Trump is open to. but obviously it has to be in America’s interest to do that and … we have to make sure it is part of a broader security package.”
paras.zh: “我想说，从美国的角度来看，提供第五条之类的安全保证是一件非常非常大的事情。我认为特朗普总统对此持开放态度。但显然这样做必须符合美国的利益，而且……我们必须确保它成为更广泛的安全计划的一部分。”

paras.en: Merz gets a question on potential multilateral talks with Ukraine, Russia, Europe and the US, and confirms that’s the plan and adds that finding the right place for it shouldn’t be too difficult.
paras.zh: 默茨被问到有关与乌克兰、俄罗斯、欧洲和美国潜在多边会谈的问题，他确认了这一计划，并补充说，找到合适的地点应该不会太困难。

paras.en: He also goes back to his Yalta reference earlier, saying Europe was “parcelled up” by powers, and “we will not allow anything like that to happen again.”
paras.zh: 他还回到了之前提到的雅尔塔，称欧洲被列强“瓜分”，“我们不会允许类似的事情再次发生”。

paras.en: Macron says the focus is on safeguarding Europe’s security.
paras.zh: 马克龙表示，重点是维护欧洲安全。

paras.en: He said that a peace declaration agreed by Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping in China “does not lead to a reorganisation of the world”.
paras.zh: 他表示，唐纳德·特朗普、弗拉基米尔·普京和习近平在中国达成的和平宣言“不会导致世界重组”。

paras.en: “Today, if there is one critical factor in Europe’s reorganisation, its security, it is precisely the meeting that took place in Berlin,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“今天，如果说欧洲的重组有一个关键因素，那就是安全，那就是在柏林举行的会议。”

paras.en: Trump comes away from China talks thinking peace is achievable, Kushner says
paras.zh: 库什纳表示，特朗普在结束对华谈判后认为和平是可以实现的

paras.en: He says the meeting was “very substantive and successful,” and “essential in helping us shape our point of views,” as he confirms that Trump dialled in for parts of the talks.
paras.zh: 他表示，这次会议“非常实质性和成功”，“对于帮助我们形成观点至关重要”，他证实特朗普参与了部分会谈。

paras.en: He pointedly praises Italy’s Meloni, Poland’s Tusk, European Commission’s von der Leyen, Nato’s Rutte, Finnish president and Norwegian PMs, Stubb and Gahr Støre.
paras.zh: 他尖锐地赞扬了意大利的梅洛尼、波兰的图斯克、欧盟委员会的冯德莱恩、北约的吕特、芬兰总统和挪威总理斯塔布和加尔·斯托尔。

paras.en: He says Europe is “very united, and very, very strong in their support of Ukraine,” which he and Witkoff “relayed to president Trump.”
paras.zh: 他表示，欧洲“非常团结，并且非常非常坚定地支持乌克兰”，他和维特科夫“向特朗普总统转达了这一点”。

paras.en: He says, without revealing details, that Trump came away from the trilateral China meeting thinking “peace is achievable”.
paras.zh: 他表示，特朗普在结束三边中国会议时认为“和平是可以实现的”，但没有透露细节。

paras.en: “For us, success in an outcome would be to have a sovereign, secure, prosperous and free Ukraine at the end of the war,” he says.
paras.zh: “对我们来说，成功的结果就是在战争结束时拥有一个主权、安全、繁荣和自由的乌克兰，”他说。

paras.en: He says the talks have been making “a lot of progress” on postwar prosperity plan, security guarantees, and a plan to exchange prisoners of war.
paras.zh: 他表示，会谈在战后繁荣计划、安全保障和交换战俘计划方面取得了“很大进展”。

paras.en: On postwar security, he says that “Nato will be a central pillar” of proposals, with the right structures to avoid accidental escalations.
paras.zh: 关于战后安全，他表示“北约将成为提案的核心支柱”，并拥有避免意外升级的正确结构。

paras.en: Kushner also says that Russians appear to be “willing to trust” the US suggestion that Europeans need to be included in the process to make sure that whatever agreement is struck will be respected.
paras.zh: 库什纳还表示，俄罗斯人似乎“愿意相信”美国的建议，即欧洲人需要参与这一进程，以确保达成的任何协议都会得到尊重。

paras.en: The US envoys will be meeting with national security advisers next to agree on the detail of their proposals.
paras.zh: 美国特使接下来将与国家安全顾问会面，就其提议的细节达成一致。

paras.en: “President Trump wants to make a deal with Europe by his side,” he insists..
paras.zh: “特朗普总统希望与欧洲达成协议，”他坚称。

paras.en: “Our goal is really to end this war and to really help build a durable peace. We are very committed. President Trump, will do whatever it takes to do that. He’s instructed us to commit as much time as possible, and we will continue to do that in full coordination, and unity with our European partners.”
paras.zh: “我们的目标实际上是结束这场战争，真正帮助建立持久和平。我们非常坚定。特朗普总统将不惜一切代价做到这一点。他指示我们投入尽可能多的时间，我们将继续与我们的欧洲伙伴充分协调和团结。”

paras.en: 'Not for the aggressor to set out wide raging and unrealistic security demands' Burnham says
paras.zh: 伯纳姆说：“侵略者不会提出广泛的、激烈的、不切实际的安全要求”

paras.en: He says today’s meeting “has put on a huge show of support” for Kyiv, and “the mood was stronger, more united, more determined.”
paras.zh: 他说，今天的会议“展示了对基辅的巨大支持”，“气氛更加强烈、更加团结、更加坚定”。

paras.en: “Europe has a clear and consistent and united negotiating position. It’s not for the aggressor in this conflict to set out wide ranging and unrealistic security demands. That much we are all absolutely clear about.”
paras.zh: “欧洲拥有明确、一致和团结的谈判立场。这场冲突中的侵略者不应该提出广泛且不切实际的安全要求。这一点我们都绝对清楚。”

paras.en: He says the coalition is ready for discussions on European security, but only “if there is a peace agreement between Ukraine and Russia.”
paras.zh: 他表示，联盟已准备好就欧洲安全问题进行讨论，但前提是“乌克兰和俄罗斯之间达成和平协议”。

paras.en: He says the UK’s support for Ukraine will continue for “as long as it takes.”
paras.zh: 他表示，英国将“只要需要”就继续支持乌克兰。

paras.en: “Europe has a clear and consistent and united negotiating position. It’s not for the aggressor in this conflict to set out wide ranging and unrealistic security demands. That much we are all absolutely clear about.
paras.zh: “欧洲拥有明确、一致和团结的谈判立场。这场冲突中的侵略者不应该提出广泛且不切实际的安全要求。这一点我们都绝对清楚。

paras.en: And I hope that message is heard very clearly, in Moscow: for as long as it takes.”
paras.zh: 我希望莫斯科能够清楚地听到这一信息：只要需要，就可以。”

paras.en: “If we want to be credible in peace negotiations, then it is important that Ukraine defends itself and goes into these negotiations in a good position, and Ukraine can only do so if we continue supporting Ukraine.”
paras.zh: “如果我们想在和平谈判中保持可信度，那么乌克兰必须保卫自己并以有利的地位参与这些谈判，这一点很重要，只有我们继续支持乌克兰，乌克兰才能做到这一点。”

paras.en: “Everyone who is here today have to do everything in their power so that Ukraine has everything it needs in order to resist and to defend herself …”
paras.zh: “今天在座的每个人都必须尽其所能，以便乌克兰拥有抵抗和保卫自己所需的一切……”

paras.en: He says that faced with Russia’s maximalist demands, it’s time it is “the right point in time to discuss [Ukraine’s] Nato membership.”
paras.zh: 他表示，面对俄罗斯的最高要求，现在是“讨论[乌克兰]北约成员资格的正确时机”。

paras.en: Commenting on the current state of talks, he says Russia “did not submit any concrete and tangible proposals for peace.”
paras.zh: 他在评论目前的谈判状况时表示，俄罗斯“没有提出任何具体切实的和平建议”。

paras.en: He acknowledges that “the coming weeks will be critical” for Ukraine, and so the coalition gathered at the right moment.
paras.zh: 他承认，“未来几周对乌克兰来说至关重要”，因此联盟在正确的时刻聚集起来。

paras.en: He says there was every attempt made to “make this meeting as concrete as possible.”
paras.zh: 他说，我们已尽一切努力“使这次会议尽可能具体”。

paras.en: He thanks all partners for helping Ukraine and highlights “active efforts to ensure that we stand firm.”
paras.zh: 他感谢所有帮助乌克兰的合作伙伴，并强调“为确保我们坚定立场而做出的积极努力”。

paras.en: He thanks the EU for its “very substantial” proposed loan of £45bn.
paras.zh: 他感谢欧盟提议的 450 亿英镑“非常大”的贷款。

paras.en: He also highlights some of the priority areas for Ukraine, including the move to stop daily drone attacks (which he confirms hit the Austrian and the Dutch embassies), and deploy more air defence systems.
paras.zh: 他还强调了乌克兰的一些优先领域，包括停止日常无人机袭击（他确认袭击了奥地利和荷兰大使馆），并部署更多防空系统。

paras.en: He also says the next round of talks should include European leaders, and highlights the importance of security guarantees and Ukraine’s future membership in the EU.
paras.zh: 他还表示，下一轮会谈应包括欧洲领导人，并强调安全保障和乌克兰未来加入欧盟的重要性。

articles.title: UK and EU plan first talks on sending refused asylum seekers to third countries
articles.author: Rajeev Syal and Lisa O’Carroll

paras.en: The UK and the EU plan to establish formal talks for the first time about sending rejected asylum seekers to third-country hubs, according to a leaked document.
paras.zh: 根据一份泄露的文件，英国和欧盟计划首次就将被拒绝的寻求庇护者送往第三国中心进行正式谈判。

paras.en: A draft of a joint statement expected to be signed by Andy Burnham and Ursula von der Leyen at a summit on Friday morning states that both sides will establish “a structured dialogue” to discuss “returns to third countries”.
paras.zh: 安迪·伯纳姆（Andy Burnham）和乌苏拉·冯德莱恩（Ursula von der Leyen）预计将在周五上午的峰会上签署一份联合声明草案，其中指出双方将建立“结构性对话”来讨论“返回第三国”。

paras.en: Until now, the Home Office has been seeking bilateral agreements with third countries allowing the removal of migrants, but with no obvious success.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，内政部一直在寻求与第三国达成允许驱逐移民的双边协议，但没有取得明显的成功。

paras.en: Last week, five EU countries – Austria, Denmark, Germany, Greece and the Netherlands – announced an agreement in principle with Rwanda to establish a migrant “return hub” there in 2027.
paras.zh: 上周，奥地利、丹麦、德国、希腊和荷兰等五个欧盟国家宣布与卢旺达达成原则协议，将于 2027 年在那里建立移民“返回中心”。

paras.en: Burnham hinted at possible cooperation with EU countries last week when he told reporters that the UK had not had direct discussions with European governments involved in return hubs but “we will watch that [the five-country deal] with interest, learning from what went on in the past”. He said: “The public want us to do whatever we can to deal with illegal immigration.”
paras.zh: 伯纳姆上周暗示可能与欧盟国家合作，他告诉记者，英国尚未与参与回程中心的欧洲政府进行直接讨论，但“我们将饶有兴趣地关注（五国协议），并从过去发生的事情中吸取教训”。他说：“公众希望我们尽一切努力应对非法移民。”

paras.en: The UK has been fighting for deeper cooperation with the EU on migration, with the new deal on a “strategic dialogue” secured in the last two weeks by negotiators in Brussels.
paras.zh: 英国一直在争取与欧盟在移民问题上进行更深入的合作，过去两周布鲁塞尔谈判代表就“战略对话”达成了新协议。

paras.en: It is a key part of the UK-EU reset pact, which also covers a youth mobility scheme, tariffs on Chinese imports, food and drink exports to the EU and a wider restatement of commitment on defence and security.
paras.zh: 这是英国-欧盟重置协议的关键部分，该协议还涵盖青年流动计划、对中国进口商品征收关税、向欧盟出口食品和饮料以及更广泛地重申国防和安全承诺。

paras.en: Informed sources confirmed this was the first time the UK and the EU had agreed to “open a dialogue on returns” after the launch of the bloc’s Channel action plan in June this year.
paras.zh: 知情人士证实，这是自今年6月欧盟海峡行动计划启动以来，英国和欧盟首次同意“就回报问题展开对话”。

paras.en: Whitehall sources said the UK was now open to the possibility of sending rejected claimants to Rwanda – a recent pivot from the position under Keir Starmer’s government, which rejected the move.
paras.zh: 英国白厅消息人士称，英国现在对将被拒绝的索赔人送往卢旺达的可能性持开放态度——这是凯尔·斯塔默政府最近拒绝这一举动的立场的转变。

paras.en: According to a draft of the joint agreement, negotiations over third-country hubs will be part of increased cooperation to tackle irregular migration.
paras.zh: 根据联合协议草案，有关第三国中心的谈判将成为加强合作以解决非正常移民问题的一部分。

paras.en: The document states: “The EU and UK … will establish a structured dialogue on migration covering in particular the joint activities under the Channel action plan, action against irregular migration and migrant smuggling networks, strategic communication and border management, upstream cooperation and engagement with third countries, returns to third countries, pull factors for irregular migrants and legal pathway.”
paras.zh: 文件指出：“欧盟和英国……将就移民问题建立结构性对话，特别涵盖海峡行动计划下的联合活动、打击非正常移民和偷运移民网络的行动、战略沟通和边境管理、与第三国的上游合作和接触、返回第三国、非正常移民的拉动因素和法律途径。”

paras.en: In May, the UK and 45 other European countries signed an agreement that explicitly endorsed plans to send unwanted asylum seekers to third-country hubs.
paras.zh: 5 月，英国和其他 45 个欧洲国家签署了一项协议，明确支持将不需要的寻求庇护者送往第三国中心的计划。

paras.en: A political declaration from the 46 members of the Council of Europe, the body that oversees the European convention on human rights (ECHR), said states had an “undeniable sovereign right” to control their borders.
paras.zh: 负责监督欧洲人权公约 (ECHR) 的欧洲委员会 46 个成员发表的一份政治宣言表示，各国拥有控制其边界的“不可否认的主权权利”。

paras.en: It is understood that the UK has been seeking a deal with an unnamed third country, similar to the Italy-Albania agreement that allowed Rome to place detention centres in Albania. Albania has ruled out a bilateral agreement on a return hub with the UK.
paras.zh: 据了解，英国一直在寻求与一个未透露姓名的第三国达成协议，类似于允许罗马在阿尔巴尼亚设立拘留中心的意大利-阿尔巴尼亚协议。阿尔巴尼亚已排除与英国就回程枢纽达成双边协议的可能性。

paras.en: Previous discussions have reportedly centred on 11 countries: Armenia, Egypt, Ethiopia, Ghana, Libya, Mauritania, Rwanda, Senegal, Tunisia, Uganda and Uzbekistan. Montenegro has denied reports that it is considering housing refused asylum seekers.
paras.zh: 据报道，此前的讨论集中在 11 个国家：亚美尼亚、埃及、埃塞俄比亚、加纳、利比亚、毛里塔尼亚、卢旺达、塞内加尔、突尼斯、乌干达和乌兹别克斯坦。黑山否认了有关其正在考虑为被拒绝的寻求庇护者提供住房的报道。

paras.en: Starmer scrapped a Tory plan to forcibly send small-boat arrivals to Rwanda where their asylum claims would have been processed.
paras.zh: 斯塔默废除了保守党强行将小船抵达卢旺达的计划，他们的庇护申请将在那里得到处理。

paras.en: Before the election, the Conservative government had spent £700m on its Rwanda returns policy, which was meant to deter Channel crossings. The scheme hit legal and political obstacles from the start, with the UK supreme court eventually ruling it illegal.
paras.zh: 大选前，保守党政府在卢旺达退货政策上花费了 7 亿英镑，旨在阻止穿越英吉利海峡。该计划从一开始就遇到了法律和政治障碍，英国最高法院最终裁定其非法。

paras.en: Under Burnham, the Home Office has refused to close down the possibility of sending asylum seekers to Rwanda. This week, when asked if the UK might ever send asylum seekers to Rwanda, a Home Office spokesperson said: “The UK, like other European countries, is exploring innovative approaches including returns hubs to tackle illegal migration.”
paras.zh: 在伯纳姆的领导下，内政部拒绝排除将寻求庇护者送往卢旺达的可能性。本周，当被问及英国是否可能将寻求庇护者送往卢旺达时，内政部发言人表示：“英国与其他欧洲国家一样，正在探索包括遣返中心在内的创新方法来解决非法移民问题。”

paras.en: The UK has been looking for years to strengthen cooperation with France and other EU member states to tackle small boats carrying asylum seekers across the Channel.
paras.zh: 多年来，英国一直寻求加强与法国和其他欧盟成员国的合作，以解决载有寻求庇护者穿越英吉利海峡的小船问题。

paras.en: But sources say it is only in recent months that there has been a change of mood in the EU, with member states realising that the intensity of criminal trafficking across the Channel is “proving [to be] a pull factor” to enter the EU. Those that fail to make it to British shores remain in the EU’s migrant support system.
paras.zh: 但消息人士称，直到最近几个月，欧盟的情绪才发生了变化，成员国意识到，跨海峡犯罪贩运的强度“被证明是进入欧盟的一个拉动因素”。那些未能到达英国海岸的人仍留在欧盟的移民支持系统中。

paras.en: Responding to the planned cooperation on migrant hubs, Madeleine Sumption, the head of the Migration Observatory at Oxford University, said: “Its inclusion in the statement would confirm the now relatively widespread interest in ‘third country’ options.”
paras.zh: 牛津大学移民观察站负责人玛德琳·萨普申（Madeleine Sumption）在回应有关移民中心的合作计划时表示：“将其纳入声明将证实目前人们对‘第三国’选择相对广泛的兴趣。”

paras.en: In response, Imran Hussain, the director of external affairs at the Refugee Council, said return hubs were likely to be difficult and costly to run.
paras.zh: 难民委员会对外事务主任伊姆兰·侯赛因对此回应称，返回中心的运营可能会很困难且成本高昂。

paras.en: “Removing people to places they have never stepped foot will be difficult and distressing,” he said.
paras.zh: “将人们转移到他们从未涉足过的地方将是困难和痛苦的，”他说。

paras.en: “The last decade has shown that working with people to support their return to their countries is far more successful.”
paras.zh: “过去十年表明，与人们合作支持他们返回祖国要成功得多。”

paras.en: A Home Office spokesperson said: “While we are not part of this EU member state initiative, there is widespread international agreement on the need to have practical and workable solutions to deal with the global challenge of illegal migration.
paras.zh: 英国内政部发言人表示：“虽然我们不是这项欧盟成员国倡议的一部分，但国际社会普遍认为需要制定切实可行的解决方案来应对非法移民的全球挑战。

paras.en: “We continue to explore innovative approaches, including returns hubs, to build on the 80,000 people with no right to be in the UK returned or deported since July 2024. We have consistently made clear that we support the principle of returns hubs.”
paras.zh: “我们继续探索创新方法，包括设立退货中心，以帮助自 2024 年 7 月以来被遣返或驱逐出境的 80,000 名无权在英国的人。我们一直明确表示，我们支持退货中心的原则。”

articles.title: Howard-era minister Sharman Stone dies via voluntary assisted dying, aged 75
articles.author: Australian Associated Press

paras.en: Former Liberal MP Sharman Stone has died via voluntary assisted dying after spending much of her political career advocating that people should have autonomy over their bodies.
paras.zh: 前自由党议员沙曼·斯通 (Sharman Stone) 在她政治生涯的大部分时间里倡导人们应该对自己的身体拥有自主权后，通过自愿安乐死去世。

paras.en: Stone died aged 75 on Wednesday surrounded by family after a long fight against glioblastoma, an aggressive form of brain cancer. She was minister for workforce participation from 2006-07.
paras.zh: 斯通在与胶质母细胞瘤（一种侵袭性脑癌）的长期斗争后于周三在家人的陪伴下去世，享年 75 岁。她于 2006-07 年间担任劳动力参与部长。

paras.en: During her political career, Stone championed contentious medical research and supported access to abortion, and readily – and publicly – disagreed with former leader Tony Abbott on both topics.
paras.zh: 在她的政治生涯中，斯通支持有争议的医学研究并支持堕胎，并在这两个话题上公开地与前领导人托尼·阿博特持不同意见。

paras.en: Stone was one of the first female superintendents in the Victorian Office of Corrections, the first female director of the Victorian Farmers Federation, and the recipient of an economics PhD.
paras.zh: 斯通是维多利亚州惩教办公室第一位女性主管、维多利亚州农民联合会第一位女性主任，也是经济学博士学位的获得者。

paras.en: She was elected to federal parliament in 1996, serving through the Howard years in what was then the seat of Murray in northern Victoria.
paras.zh: 1996 年，她当选为联邦议会议员，在当时维多利亚州北部默里的选区任职，度过了霍华德时代。

paras.en: Stone was remembered as a strong voice for her local community, right up to her late days.
paras.zh: 直到晚年，斯通都被认为是当地社区的强有力代言人。

paras.en: “She was born and bred in the heart of the electorate she served – a sixth-generation northern Victorian from a farming family,” the opposition leader, Angus Taylor, said after her death.
paras.zh: “她在她所服务的选民的中心出生和长大——她是来自维多利亚北部农民家庭的第六代，”反对党领袖安格斯·泰勒在她去世后说道。

paras.en: “She understood the rugged and regenerative nature of the land and what makes regional Australia tick.”
paras.zh: “她了解这片土地的崎岖和再生特性，以及澳大利亚偏远地区的魅力所在。”

paras.en: Stone spent two decades in parliament and was characterised by her independence.
paras.zh: 斯通在议会工作了二十年，其特点是独立。

paras.en: She held several roles during the Howard government, including as parliamentary secretary to the environment and finance ministers.
paras.zh: 她在霍华德政府期间担任过多个职务，包括担任环境部长和财政部长的议会秘书。

paras.en: She also held the shadow environment portfolio after the Liberals’ defeat to Kevin Rudd.
paras.zh: 在自由党输给陆克文后，她还担任影子环境部长。

paras.en: Stone retired from politics in 2016, and served as the Australian ambassador for women and girls until 2020.
paras.zh: 斯通于 2016 年从政界退休，并担任澳大利亚妇女和女童大使直至 2020 年。

paras.en: Her celebration of life is expected to be held after the 28 November Victorian election.
paras.zh: 她的庆祝活动预计将在 11 月 28 日维多利亚州大选后举行。

articles.title: Trump, Putin and Xi release 'peace declaration' after historic meeting

paras.en: US President Donald Trump and his Russian and Chinese counterparts Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping have issued a "joint declaration of peace" following historic trilateral talks.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普、俄罗斯和中国总统弗拉基米尔·普京和习近平在历史性的三边会谈后发表了“联合和平宣言”。

paras.en: The three leaders met for 90 minutes in China's south-eastern city of Shenzhen, on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit.
paras.zh: 三位领导人在亚太经济合作组织 (APEC) 峰会期间在中国东南部城市深圳会晤了 90 分钟。

paras.en: While the presidents have previously had one-on-one meetings, these are their first trilateral talks.
paras.zh: 虽然两国元首此前曾进行过一对一会谈，但这是他们的首次三边会谈。

paras.en: In the declaration, they said "nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought" and that the countries planned to increase the production and supply of petroleum. They also said they were "committed to reform the UN" to respond more effectively to global challenges.
paras.zh: 他们在宣言中表示，“核战争不可能获胜，也绝不能打”，并表示各国计划增加石油生产和供应。他们还表示，他们“致力于改革联合国”，以更有效地应对全球挑战。

paras.en: Thursday's statement also flagged the issue of immunity enjoyed by state officials and said "they agreed that the International Criminal Court and other similar institutions must not abuse their jurisdiction".
paras.zh: 周四的声明还指出了国家官员享有的豁免权问题，并表示“他们同意国际刑事法院和其他类似机构不得滥用管辖权”。

paras.en: Trump praised the trilateral meeting calling it "a great and highly consequential trip", in a social media post while flying back to Washington on Air Force One.
paras.zh: 特朗普在乘坐空军一号飞回华盛顿时在社交媒体上发帖称赞这次三边会议，称其为“一次伟大且意义重大的旅行”。

paras.en: In the same post, the president announced he would host a news conference to talk about the trip on Friday at the White House.
paras.zh: 在同一篇文章中，总统宣布他将于周五在白宫召开新闻发布会，讨论这次旅行。

paras.en: While in China, Trump met Putin ahead of the trilateral, in their first meeting since August 2025, where the US president greeted his Russian counterpart as his "friend".
paras.zh: 在中国期间，特朗普在三边会议之前会见了普京，这是他们自 2025 年 8 月以来的首次会面，美国总统将俄罗斯总统称为“朋友”。

paras.en: He also spoke with Xi in a separate conversation, describing the pair's relationship as "very special".
paras.zh: 他还在一次单独的谈话中与习近平进行了交谈，称两人的关系“非常特殊”。

paras.en: Beyond the warmth and shared niceties, however, the three men had different goals and motivations for the sit-down.
paras.zh: 然而，除了热情和分享的美好之外，这三个人坐下来的目的和动机也不同。

paras.en: The opening remarks of the trilateral gave some indication about what was to be discussed during the closed-door meeting.
paras.zh: 三方的开场白暗示了闭门会议将讨论的内容。

paras.en: Before giving the floor to his fellow leaders, Xi said that "positive interaction among major powers is not a matter of choice, but a mandatory requirement".
paras.zh: 在向其他领导人发言之前，习近平表示，“大国良性互动不是选择，而是必然要求”。

paras.en: Putin followed this by highlighting a shared interest in ending the Ukraine war and said the conversation would also touch on food and energy security.
paras.zh: 普京随后强调了结束乌克兰战争的共同利益，并表示谈话还将涉及粮食和能源安全。

paras.en: China has officially remained neutral since Putin launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022, rejecting accusations from Kyiv and its allies that it has been tacitly supporting Moscow, including by exporting dual-use technology used by the Russian military.
paras.zh: 自普京于2022年对乌克兰发动全面入侵以来，中国一直正式保持中立，拒绝基辅及其盟友的指控，即中国一直默许支持莫斯科，包括出口俄罗斯军方使用的军民两用技术。

paras.en: Beijing has also repeatedly called for negotiations and a political settlement while avoiding condemnation of Russia's aggression.
paras.zh: 北京还多次呼吁进行谈判和政治解决，同时避免谴责俄罗斯的侵略行为。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Trump closed by saying the presidents of three of the world's largest countries have a "special responsibility" to maintain productive dialogue.
paras.zh: 与此同时，特朗普最后表示，世界上三个最大国家的总统负有保持富有成效的对话的“特殊责任”。

paras.en: "Too often past leaders have avoided talking to nations with whom they had disagreements," he said, adding: "We feel the opposite."
paras.zh: “过去的领导人常常避免与那些与他们有分歧的国家交谈，”他说，并补充说：“我们的感觉恰恰相反。”

paras.en: Trump referenced the three countries' nuclear capabilities and said they are "uniquely positioned to discuss how to reduce the number of nuclear weapons on Earth".
paras.zh: 特朗普提到了这三个国家的核能力，并表示它们“处于讨论如何减少地球上核武器数量的独特地位”。

paras.en: It is "vital" that they co-operate to "combat the threat of nuclear proliferation in other countries around the world", he said, adding: "That's what we're doing in Iran."
paras.zh: 他说，他们合作“对抗世界其他国家的核扩散威胁”是“至关重要的”，并补充说：“这就是我们在伊朗所做的事情。”

paras.en: "We're not going to let Iran have a nuclear weapon".
paras.zh: “我们不会让伊朗拥有核武器”。

paras.en: Trump then turned to Ukraine and said he and Putin have had a "long discussion" on the conflict there already.
paras.zh: 特朗普随后转向乌克兰，表示他和普京已经就那里的冲突进行了“长时间的讨论”。

paras.en: He added that Putin "and I hope the other side, would like to see an end to that war".
paras.zh: 他补充说，普京“我希望另一方希望看到这场战争结束”。

paras.en: Putin addressed the media following the trilateral meeting and described it as an "important chapter in the history of diplomacy".
paras.zh: 普京在三边会议后向媒体发表讲话，称其为“外交史上的重要篇章”。

paras.en: He said Ukraine and Europe were not yet ready to make compromises to resolve the conflict in Ukraine - but he said Russia had invited EU representatives to Moscow to better understand Europe's position.
paras.zh: 他表示，乌克兰和欧洲尚未准备好做出妥协来解决乌克兰冲突，但他表示，俄罗斯已邀请欧盟代表前往莫斯科，以更好地了解欧洲的立场。

paras.en: As the talks were under way in China, and even as Putin was holding his press conference claiming to be ready for peace, Ukraine's capital Kyiv was under attack from Russian drones.
paras.zh: 当会谈在中国进行时，就在普京召开新闻发布会声称已做好和平准备的时候，乌克兰首都基辅却遭到了俄罗斯无人机的袭击。

paras.en: Putin has repeatedly rejected all ceasefire offers from Ukraine, insisting on his maximalist demands which Kyiv and its European allies say are tantamount to de facto capitulation of Ukraine.
paras.zh: 普京一再拒绝乌克兰提出的所有停火提议，坚持他的最高要求，基辅及其欧洲盟友称这相当于乌克兰事实上的投降。

paras.en: In Shenzhen, the Kremlin leader also vowed a "far more painful" retaliation in response to Ukrainian attacks on the bridge connecting Russia to Ukraine's occupied peninsula of Crimea. A missile and drone attack on Tuesday destroyed its central road section.
paras.zh: 在深圳，克里姆林宫领导人还誓言将对乌克兰袭击连接俄罗斯和乌克兰占领的克里米亚半岛的桥梁进行“更加痛苦”的报复。周二的导弹和无人机袭击摧毁了其中央路段。

paras.en: There was no mention from Putin of almost five years of Russian attacks on power plants, bridges and residential buildings in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 普京没有提及俄罗斯近五年来对乌克兰发电厂、桥梁和住宅楼的袭击。

paras.en: The Russian president also directly addressed comparisons between his meeting with Trump and Xi and the 1945 Yalta Conference, where the leaders of the Soviet Union, Britain and the US met towards the end of World War Two.
paras.zh: 这位俄罗斯总统还直接将他与特朗普和习近平的会晤与1945年雅尔塔会议进行了比较，当时苏联、英国和美国领导人在第二次世界大战即将结束时举行了会晤。

paras.en: "Nobody divided up the world at Yalta. It simply codified the realities that had emerged after WW2.
paras.zh: “没有人在雅尔塔瓜分世界。它只是将二战后出现的现实编入法典。

paras.en: "And when it comes to today's conflicts, the realities on the ground will have to be accepted."
paras.zh: “当谈到今天的冲突时，必须接受当地的现实。”

paras.en: The Kremlin released a video showing Putin leaving the summit venue and saying goodbye to Xi.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫发布了一段视频，显示普京离开峰会会场并向习近平告别。

paras.en: "Thank you for organising this," Putin said. "I don't think anyone even expected everything to go so well."
paras.zh: 普京说：“感谢你们组织这次活动。” “我认为没有人预料到一切会如此顺利。”

paras.en: Meanwhile, China's president described his meeting with Putin and Trump as "positive, constructive, and highly productive", according to the country's state broadcaster CCTV.
paras.zh: 与此同时，据中国国家电视台中央电视台报道，中国国家主席形容他与普京和特朗普的会晤是“积极的、建设性的、富有成效的”。

paras.en: It added that Xi recalled "the history of fighting side-by-side during WW2", as the three leaders emphasised the importance of "cherishing the hard-won peace".
paras.zh: 声明补充说，习近平回顾了“二战期间并肩作战的历史”，三位领导人强调了“珍惜来之不易的和平”的重要性。

paras.en: Thursday's trilateral meeting was reportedly the idea of Putin.
paras.zh: 据报道，周四的三边会议是普京的主意。

paras.en: Some Russian newspapers called it a "diplomatic victory" as after Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine many Western leaders were trying to isolate him.
paras.zh: 一些俄罗斯报纸称其为“外交胜利”，因为在俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰后，许多西方领导人试图孤立他。

paras.en: The summit also marked the first time since Russia's war in Ukraine began that Putin took part in an international gathering attended by leaders from countries including Canada, Japan and Australia.
paras.zh: 这次峰会也是俄罗斯乌克兰战争爆发以来普京首次参加由加拿大、日本和澳大利亚等国领导人参加的国际聚会。

paras.en: US lawmakers responded with frustration to Trump's warmth towards America's geopolitical adversaries.
paras.zh: 美国立法者对特朗普对美国地缘政治对手的热情感到沮丧。

paras.en: "I was encouraged by some of the commitments that came out of the President's meetings in Asia, particularly the recognition that nuclear war must never be fought," Republican Senator John Curtis said in an emailed statement to the BBC.
paras.zh: 共和党参议员约翰·柯蒂斯在发给英国广播公司的电子邮件声明中表示：“总统在亚洲会议上作出的一些承诺令我感到鼓舞，特别是认识到永远不得打核战争。”

paras.en: But Curtis also said he was concerned about Trump's approach to the foreign leaders, adding that "Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping are not our friends".
paras.zh: 但柯蒂斯也表示，他对特朗普对待外国领导人的态度感到担忧，并补充说“弗拉基米尔·普京和习近平不是我们的朋友”。

paras.en: "We should not treat them as though they share our values or interests," Curtis, who sits on the Senate foreign relations committee, added.
paras.zh: 参议院外交关系委员会成员柯蒂斯补充说：“我们不应将他们视为与我们拥有共同的价值观或利益。”

paras.en: "Doing so risks undermining our national security, weakening trust with our allies, and sending the wrong message about where America stands."
paras.zh: “这样做可能会损害我们的国家安全，削弱我们与盟友的信任，并就美国的立场发出错误的信息。”

paras.en: Jeanne Shaheen, a ranking Democratic member on the same committee, chose harsher words in her comment.
paras.zh: 同一委员会的民主党资深成员珍妮·沙欣(Jeanne Shaheen)在评论中选择了更严厉的措辞。

paras.en: "President Trump's 'friend' is a murderous war criminal," she wrote on X.
paras.zh: “特朗普总统的‘朋友’是一名凶残的战犯，”她在 X 上写道。

paras.en: With additional reporting from Brandon Drenon
paras.zh: 布兰登·德雷农 (Brandon Drenon) 的补充报道

articles.title: Europe ready for talks with Russia on ending war in Ukraine, leaders say

paras.en: European leaders have said they are ready for negotiations with Russia on ending the war in Ukraine, in a strong show of support for Kyiv.
paras.zh: 欧洲领导人表示，他们准备与俄罗斯就结束乌克兰战争进行谈判，以表达对基辅的强烈支持。

paras.en: "Europe has a clear and consistent and united negotiating position," UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham said, while German Chancellor Friedrich Merz stressed that Moscow's "maximalist demands are not realistic".
paras.zh: 英国首相安迪·伯纳姆表示，“欧洲拥有明确、一致和团结的谈判立场”，而德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨则强调莫斯科的“极端要求并不现实”。

paras.en: They were speaking at Berlin's summit of Ukraine's allies known as the Coalition of the Willing.
paras.zh: 他们是在乌克兰盟友“自愿联盟”柏林峰会上发表讲话的。

paras.en: US President Donald Trump's envoys were also there, and his son-in-law Jared Kushner said Trump wanted to make a deal with Russia "with Europe by his side". Russia's Vladimir Putin has so far rejected any European role in the US led peace talks.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的特使也在场，他的女婿贾里德·库什纳表示，特朗普希望“在欧洲的支持下”与俄罗斯达成协议。迄今为止，俄罗斯总统普京拒绝欧洲在美国主导的和平谈判中发挥任何作用。

paras.en: Trump had earlier held historic trilateral talks in Shenzhen with Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping and later dialled into the Berlin summit from Air Force One.
paras.zh: 特朗普早些时候在深圳与普京和中国国家主席习近平举行了历史性的三边会谈，后来从空军一号拨通了柏林峰会。

paras.en: In a lengthy press conference following his talks with Trump and Xi, Putin addressed the question of multilateral peace talks, saying the Americans were "insistently" asking Russia to allow the Europeans to take part.
paras.zh: 在与特朗普和习近平会谈后举行的一场冗长的新闻发布会上，普京谈到了多边和平谈判的问题，称美国“坚持”要求俄罗斯允许欧洲参加。

paras.en: Putin claimed Russia was not against the idea but said Moscow wanted to clarify "what Europe will bring to these talks".
paras.zh: 普京声称俄罗斯并不反对这一想法，但表示莫斯科希望澄清“欧洲将为这些谈判带来什么”。

paras.en: "That is why, through diplomatic channels, we have invited the Europeans to come to Moscow in order to determine their positions. And after that, we will decide in what format we will continue the dialogue with Ukraine."
paras.zh: “这就是为什么我们通过外交渠道邀请欧洲人来到莫斯科以确定他们的立场。之后，我们将决定以何种形式继续与乌克兰对话。”

paras.en: But Putin also said that "every day" Russia heard that European leaders were talking about war coming in 2030. "But we are not planning to attack anyone... Is that normal? I do not think so," he said. Still, Putin added, Russia understood that "discussing issues linked to security in Europe is pointless without the Europeans".
paras.zh: 但普京还表示，俄罗斯“每天”都听到欧洲领导人谈论 2030 年即将发生的战争。“但我们不打算攻击任何人……这正常吗？我不这么认为，”他说。不过，普京补充说，俄罗斯明白“如果没有欧洲人的参与，讨论与欧洲安全相关的问题是毫无意义的”。

paras.en: Jared Kushner told reporters that the US president had come away from Shenzhen believing that "peace is achievable".
paras.zh: 贾里德·库什纳告诉记者，美国总统离开深圳时相信“和平是可以实现的”。

paras.en: Striking an upbeat note, Kushner said that the Russians were willing to trust the instinct of the US envoys "on our behalf" that the Europeans should be at the table and that Moscow was now "comfortable" with Ukraine having security guarantees based on the idea enshrined in Nato's Article Five that requires allies to come to a country's defence if it comes under attack.
paras.zh: 库什纳乐观地表示，俄罗斯人愿意相信“代表我们”的美国特使的直觉，即欧洲人应该参与谈判，而且莫斯科现在对乌克兰拥有基于北约第五条所载理念的安全保障感到“满意”，该条款要求盟友在一个国家受到攻击时予以保卫。

paras.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has long sought a guarantee equivalent to Nato's collective defence clause, and there has been little indication that Putin would accept that kind of condition. Russia has never accepted the idea of Ukrainian membership of Nato, but Article Five-style guarantees could theoretically be offered to Kyiv without being part of the Western defensive alliance.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基长期以来一直寻求相当于北约集体防御条款的保证，但几乎没有迹象表明普京会接受这种条件。俄罗斯从未接受乌克兰加入北约的想法，但理论上可以向基辅提供第五条式的保证，而无需加入西方防御联盟。

paras.en: Zelensky and the three European leaders - Merz, Burnham and French President Emmanuel Macron - were not as upbeat as Kushner, and the Ukrainian president made clear that the Russian president had spurned every proposal so far: "Putin has always said no."
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基和三位欧洲领导人——默茨、伯纳姆和法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙——并不像库什纳那么乐观，乌克兰总统明确表示，俄罗斯总统迄今为止拒绝了所有提议：“普京一直说不。”

paras.en: The German chancellor was equally sceptical, although he said with US involvement the chance of peace was increasing. Europe was willing to enter "serious discussions on European security" with Russia, he explained, "as long as it's matched with a serious discussion and only first a peace agreement with Ukraine".
paras.zh: 德国总理同样持怀疑态度，尽管他表示，随着美国的介入，和平的机会正在增加。他解释说，欧洲愿意与俄罗斯“就欧洲安全问题进行认真的讨论”，“只要与乌克兰进行认真的讨论，并且首先要达成和平协议”。

paras.en: "These talks have to begin, and we will accept if conditions are acceptable for Europe and Ukraine," said Merz.
paras.zh: 默茨说：“这些谈判必须开始，如果欧洲和乌克兰可以接受条件，我们就会接受。”

paras.en: There have been mixed messages from Moscow on European participation to the talks. Last week, following a visit to Moscow, Witkoff and Kushner appeared certain that Europe would soon have a seat at the negotiating table.
paras.zh: 莫斯科关于欧洲参与会谈的信息不一。上周，在访问莫斯科后，维特科夫和库什纳似乎确信欧洲很快就会在谈判桌上占有一席之地。

paras.en: But the Russians were more circumspect and this week Kremlin aide Yury Ushakov said a "great deal" would have to be done before the format could be expanded, suggesting that several more rounds of discussions would have to be held before any four-sided talks could take place.
paras.zh: 但俄罗斯人则更加谨慎，本周克里姆林宫助手尤里·乌沙科夫表示，在扩大这一形式之前，必须完成一项“伟大的协议”，并暗示在进行任何四方会谈之前，还必须进行几轮讨论。

paras.en: Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯于2022年2月对乌克兰发动全面入侵。

paras.en: While Russia has engaged with several rounds of talks over the last year, little in Moscow's rhetoric or actions suggests that the Kremlin is considering scaling down its war on Ukraine.
paras.zh: 尽管俄罗斯去年参加了几轮会谈，但莫斯科的言论或行动几乎没有表明克里姆林宫正在考虑缩小对乌克兰的战争规模。

paras.en: It continues to pound Kyiv's energy infrastructure to cripple it as winter takes hold, increasing numbers of civilian casualties are being recorded across the country, and Kremlin officials haven't budged from Russia's demands for Ukraine sovereign territory.
paras.zh: 随着冬季的到来，它继续冲击基辅的能源基础设施，使其瘫痪，全国范围内的平民伤亡人数不断增加，而克里姆林宫官员也没有改变俄罗斯对乌克兰主权领土的要求。

paras.en: As delegations were meeting in China and Germany on Thursday, several buildings in Kyiv's historic centre came under attack from drones. One person was killed in a strike on a residential building in the Podilskyi neighbourhood, while the Dutch and Austrian embassies as well as Saint Volodymyr's Cathedral reported damage.
paras.zh: 周四，当各国代表团在中国和德国举行会议时，基辅历史中心的几座建筑遭到无人机袭击。波多利斯基街区一栋住宅楼遭到袭击，造成一人死亡，荷兰和奥地利大使馆以及圣弗拉基米尔大教堂也报告遭到损坏。

paras.en: And today, Putin vowed that Moscow's response to a Ukrainian strike on the Crimean Bridge linking Russia with occupied Crimea would be "considerably more painful" than what Kyiv had achieved.
paras.zh: 今天，普京发誓，莫斯科对乌克兰袭击连接俄罗斯和被占领克里米亚的克里米亚大桥的反应将比基辅所取得的成就“更加痛苦”。

paras.en: He also said he had discussed a "possible ceasefire in a number of areas" but had decided against it after the attack on the bridge.
paras.zh: 他还表示，他曾讨论过“在多个地区可能停火”，但在桥梁遇袭后决定不这样做。

paras.en: Still, Putin claimed to be "interested" in ending the war and was ready for making compromises, while Ukraine and Europe were not.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，普京声称对结束战争“感兴趣”，并准备做出妥协，而乌克兰和欧洲则不然。

paras.en: "I assure you, we have no desire at all to continue this armed conflict," Putin said.
paras.zh: 普京说：“我向你们保证，我们根本不想继续这场武装冲突。”

articles.title: Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya minority, top UN court rules

paras.en: Myanmar has been found guilty of committing genocide against its Rohingya minority by the International Court of Justice (ICJ).
paras.zh: 国际法院（ICJ）判定缅甸犯有针对罗兴亚少数民族的种族灭绝罪。

paras.en: The verdict marks the first time a state has ever been found to have committed genocide by an international court.
paras.zh: 该判决标志着国际法庭首次判定一个国家犯有种族灭绝罪。

paras.en: Yuji Iwasawa, president of the UN's top court, said Myanmar had the "intention to destroy" a substantial part of the Rohingya population and engaged in "extensive destruction of evidence" to hide its crimes.
paras.zh: 联合国最高法院院长岩泽雄二表示，缅甸“意图消灭”很大一部分罗兴亚人，并“大规模销毁证据”以掩盖其罪行。

paras.en: A military crackdown in 2017 killed thousands of Rohingya and forced more than 700,000 to flee Buddhist-majority Myanmar, formerly known as Burma. Myanmar denied the claims against it, saying its forces had responded to attacks by armed groups.
paras.zh: 2017 年的一次军事镇压导致数千罗兴亚人死亡，并迫使超过 70 万人逃离佛教徒占多数的缅甸（以前称为缅甸）。缅甸否认了针对其的指控，称其军队对武装团体的袭击做出了回应。

paras.en: The court found on Thursday that "genocidal intent is the only reasonable inference that can be drawn from the evidence" it had seen.
paras.zh: 法院周四裁定，“种族灭绝意图是从其所看到的证据中可以得出的唯一合理推论”。

paras.en: The verdict was reached by a majority of nine votes to six among a panel of judges from around the world. The ICJ also found in favour by majority that Myanmar had violated several other parts of the 1948 Genocide Convention.
paras.zh: 来自世界各地的评审团以九票对六票的多数票作出了这一裁决。国际法院还以多数票裁定缅甸违反了 1948 年《种族灭绝公约》的其他几项规定。

paras.en: The case brought by The Gambia centred around so-called "clearance operations" initiated in 2017 in Rakhine State, where many of the Rohingya Muslim minority resided.
paras.zh: 冈比亚提起的案件围绕 2017 年在若开邦发起的所谓“清理行动”展开，该邦居住着许多罗兴亚穆斯林少数民族。

paras.en: After fighters from the Arakan Rohingya Salvation Army (Arsa) launched deadly attacks on more than 30 police posts there, Myanmar troops, backed by local Buddhist mobs, launched a wave of violence, prompting a mass exodus of Rohingya.
paras.zh: 若开罗兴亚救世军 (Arsa) 的战士对当地 30 多个警察哨所发动致命袭击后，缅甸军队在当地佛教暴民的支持下发起了一波暴力浪潮，导致罗兴亚人大规模外逃。

paras.en: Refugees recounted entire villages being burned down and the mass killing of civilians, while numerous survivors and eyewitnesses provided testimony that the Myanmar military had also raped and abused Rohingya women and girls.
paras.zh: 难民讲述了整个村庄被烧毁和大规模屠杀平民的故事，而许多幸存者和目击者则提供了证词，称缅甸军方还强奸和虐待了罗兴亚妇女和女孩。

paras.en: The ICJ determined that around 10,000 Rohingya were "violently killed" during the clearance operation, while more than 700,000 are thought to have fled to Bangladesh by foot or by sea. The court found that approximately 815,000 had been targeted in some way.
paras.zh: 国际法院确定，大约 10,000 名罗辛亚人在清理行动中被“暴力杀害”，而超过 700,000 人据信步行或乘船逃往孟加拉国。法院发现，大约 815,000 人以某种方式成为攻击目标。

paras.en: Iwasawa said Myanmar's military engaged in "indiscriminate" killings, the execution of men, "widespread" sexual violence, "extreme violence" against children and the deliberate burning of Rohingya homes.
paras.zh: 岩泽说，缅甸军方“不分青红皂白”地杀戮、处决男子、“广泛”的性暴力、针对儿童的“极端暴力”以及蓄意焚烧罗兴亚人的房屋。

paras.en: He said the military had also attacked Rohingya as they were fleeing to Bangladesh.
paras.zh: 他说，军方还在罗兴亚人逃往孟加拉国时袭击了他们。

paras.en: Myanmar, he added, had engaged in "extensive destruction of evidence" by burning or disposing of bodies, burned and bulldozed sites that were cleared and failed to prosecute those who had perpetrated the acts of violence.
paras.zh: 他补充说，缅甸通过焚烧或处置尸体、烧毁和推平场地来“大规模销毁证据”，这些场地已被清理干净，但未能起诉那些实施暴力行为的人。

paras.en: While the ICJ recognised the role Arsa played, it found there was "overlap" between an "anti-Rohingya hate speech campaign" - which portrayed the Rohingya as "sub-human" and "a violent threat" - and the clearance operations that made violence against the population more likely.
paras.zh: 虽然国际法院承认阿尔萨所扮演的角色，但它发现“反罗兴亚仇恨言论运动”（将罗兴亚人描绘成“次等人”和“暴力威胁”）与更有可能针对民众实施暴力的清理行动之间存在“重叠”。

paras.en: Myanmar consistently denied genocide against the Rohingya, saying its operations had targeted militant or insurgent threats in response to the Arsa attacks.
paras.zh: 缅甸始终否认对罗兴亚人进行种族灭绝，称其行动针对的是武装分子或叛乱威胁，以应对阿尔萨袭击。

paras.en: In January, government representative Ko Ko Hlaing told the ICJ that the country "was not obliged to remain idle and allow terrorists to have free reign". He said he had "no comment" following Thursday's verdict.
paras.zh: 一月份，政府代表科科莱告诉国际法院，该国“没有义务袖手旁观，任由恐怖分子肆意妄为”。他表示，对于周四的判决，他“不予置评”。

paras.en: The ICJ also looked at the wider treatment of Rohingya leading up to the clearance operation and found that policies like limiting married couples to two children were discriminatory and aimed to erode their rights.
paras.zh: 国际法院还研究了清理行动之前对罗兴亚人的更广泛待遇，发现限制已婚夫妇生育两个孩子等政策具有歧视性，旨在侵蚀他们的权利。

paras.en: It said Myanmar had an obligation to pay proportionate reparations, but said an exact figure could be determined at a later date.
paras.zh: 声明称，缅甸有义务支付相应赔偿金，但表示具体数字可能会在晚些时候确定。

paras.en: The court's decision was welcomed by Rohingya communities and human rights groups.
paras.zh: 法院的裁决受到罗兴亚社区和人权组织的欢迎。

paras.en: "This is like formal recognition of our suffering," says Mohammed Nowkim, a Rohingya who was driven out of Rakhine in 2017 and now lives in Canada. "The Rohingya have been waiting for justice for decades."
paras.zh: “这就像对我们所受苦难的正式承认，”2017 年被赶出若开邦、现居住在加拿大的罗兴亚人穆罕默德·诺金 (Mohammed Nowkim) 说。 “几十年来，罗兴亚人一直在等待正义。”

paras.en: Human Rights Watch said the ruling was "long-awaited recognition of the suffering the Rohingya have endured".
paras.zh: 人权观察表示，这项裁决“是对罗兴亚人所遭受苦难的期待已久的承认”。

paras.en: Meanwhile, UN human rights chief Volker TÃ¼rk said the "suffering, misery and humiliation" inflicted on the Rohingya people was a "stain on the conscience of humanity". He added that the court's decision "must now translate into real action".
paras.zh: 与此同时，联合国人权事务高级专员沃尔克·图尔克表示，罗兴亚人遭受的“痛苦、不幸和羞辱”是“人类良知上的污点”。他补充说，法院的裁决“现在必须转化为实际行动”。

paras.en: To implicate the Myanmar government in genocide, the court had to determine not just that terrible acts had been committed, but that there was an intent on the part of officials or arms of the state to partially or completely destroy the group.
paras.zh: 为了将缅甸政府牵涉到种族灭绝，法院不仅必须确定该组织实施了可怕的行为，而且还必须确定该组织的官员或军队有部分或完全摧毁该组织的意图。

paras.en: Thursday's ruling is without precedent. Myanmar now carries the stain of being the first state to have been found to have violated the 1948 Genocide Convention.
paras.zh: 周四的裁决是史无前例的。缅甸现在背负着成为第一个被发现违反 1948 年《种族灭绝公约》的国家的污点。

paras.en: The ICJ has only twice before ruled on claims of state-backed genocide in the years since the Genocide Convention was signed in the aftermath of the Holocaust, in both cases finding there was insufficient evidence to attribute the actions to the state.
paras.zh: 自大屠杀后签署《种族灭绝公约》以来，国际法院仅两次对国家支持的种族灭绝指控做出裁决，两次案件都发现没有足够的证据将这些行为归咎于国家。

paras.en: Dozens of individuals have been found guilty of genocide, but finding their actions were at the direct behest of the state requires a higher evidential bar to prove genocide, the gravest of crimes under international law.
paras.zh: 数十人被判犯有种族灭绝罪，但如果发现他们的行为是在国家的直接要求下进行的，则需要更高的证据标准来证明种族灭绝，这是国际法规定的最严重的罪行。

paras.en: Philippe Sands KC, a top human rights lawyer who helped bring the case, described it as an "historic judgment".
paras.zh: 帮助提起此案的顶级人权律师菲利普·桑兹·KC (Philippe Sands KC) 称这是一次“历史性判决”。

paras.en: He told BBC Radio 4's World at One programme that it was "right up there with the great moments of international justice: Nuremberg, Pinochet, and others", referring to the trials of Nazi leaders following World War Two and that of the Chilean dictator, respectively.
paras.zh: 他告诉英国广播公司第四台的世界同一个节目，它“与国际正义的伟大时刻一样：纽伦堡、皮诺切特和其他人”，分别指的是第二次世界大战后纳粹领导人的审判和智利独裁者的审判。

paras.en: However, the ICJ is not a criminal court and its powers of enforcement are limited. It cannot send military officials to prison, while it relies on the UN Security Council and political pressure to impose its rulings.
paras.zh: 然而，国际法院不是刑事法院，其执行权力有限。它不能将军事官员送进监狱，同时它依靠联合国安理会和政治压力来强制执行其裁决。

paras.en: The ruling will, though, have implications for other genocide cases pending with the ICJ, including one brought by South Africa against Israel over its war in Gaza.
paras.zh: 不过，这一裁决将对国际法院悬而未决的其他种族灭绝案件产生影响，其中包括南非因加沙战争而针对以色列提起的一起案件。

paras.en: Sands said that pending case had been the "elephant in the room" during the Myanmar hearings.
paras.zh: 桑兹表示，在缅甸听证会上，悬而未决的案件是“房间里的大象”。

paras.en: He added that, while ruling against Myanmar did not mean the court would find similarly with Gaza, if it had not found Myanmar responsible, the case against Israel "would, in effect, be over". Israel says the case against it is "wholly unfounded".
paras.zh: 他补充说，虽然对缅甸的裁决并不意味着法院会对加沙作出类似的裁决，但如果法院没有认定缅甸负有责任，那么针对以色列的案件“实际上就会结束”。以色列表示，针对它的指控“完全没有根据”。

paras.en: Antonia Mulvey, executive director of Legal Action Worldwide, told the BBC that the court had not accepted Myanmar's counter-terrorism defence and had found for the first time that rape and sexual violence was an act of genocide, positions it would bear in mind for future cases.
paras.zh: 全球法律行动执行董事安东尼娅·穆尔维 (Antonia Mulvey) 告诉 BBC，法院尚未接受缅甸的反恐辩护，并首次认定强奸和性暴力是种族灭绝行为，在未来的案件中法院将牢记这一立场。

paras.en: A spokesperson for the US State Department said "the proper interpretation" of the Genocide Convention is of "paramount importance", and so is "preventing politicisation" of the International Criminal Court. "We are studying the decision to fully assess its implications," they said.
paras.zh: 美国国务院发言人表示，对《种族灭绝公约》的“正确解释”“至关重要”，“防止国际刑事法院政治化”也是如此。他们说：“我们正在研究这一决定，以充分评估其影响。”

paras.en: They said they share the "grave concerns over the continued abuses of human rights against Rohingya Muslims and members of other minority groups", and added the US is the "leading donor for the Rohingya refugee humanitarian response".
paras.zh: 他们表示，“对罗兴亚穆斯林和其他少数群体成员的人权持续遭受侵犯感到严重关切”，并补充说美国是“罗兴亚难民人道主义应对措施的主要捐助者”。

paras.en: Following Thursday's ruling, UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband said the government was ordering Myanmar's defence attachÃ© be expelled and that he was summoning its charge d'affaires.
paras.zh: 在周四的裁决之后，英国外交大臣埃德·米利班德表示，政府正在下令驱逐缅甸国防武官，并传唤其临时代办。

paras.en: He pledged to set out "further action in the coming days to ensure those responsible are held to account" after a cross-party group of MPs called for the government to resume sanctions against Myanmar's military.
paras.zh: 在一群跨党派议员呼吁政府恢复对缅甸军方的制裁后，他承诺“在未来几天采取进一步行动，确保责任人受到追究”。

articles.title: How Paper-Based Friction Materials Power Modern Machinery

paras.en: How Paper-Based Friction Materials Power Modern Machinery

Have you ever wondered what enables everything from roaring construction machinery to agricultural machinery plowing the fields to industrial equipment shuttling through factories—the precise starting, smooth operation, and reliable braking they achieve?

The answer lies in a seemingly insignificant yet crucial core component: friction material. It acts as the "safety guard" and "power link" of machinery, ensuring every brake is safe and effective, and every power transmission is smooth and flawless.

Among the vast family of friction materials, wet friction materials are becoming the new favorite in modern machinery due to their exceptional reliability, safety, and exceptionally long lifespan. Among wet materials, paper-based friction materials stand out as a leading force thanks to their excellent overall performance, cost-effectiveness, and broad application prospects.
Today, let's delve deeper into the fascinating world of this "unsung hero"—paper-based friction materials.
What is Paper-Based Friction Material? — A Sponge-Like Power Core
Imagine a "sponge" with countless tiny pores—that's the most intuitive image of paper-based friction material.

It is a material with a reticular porous structure composed of three core components: reinforcing fibers, functional fillers, and a binder resin. This unique structure gives it extraordinary capabilities:
- Oil Storage Capacity: The porous structure acts like a miniature "oil depot," capable of storing large quantities of lubricant.

- Dynamic Lubrication: When the friction plate and mating plate engage and are subjected to pressure, the lubricant within the material is instantly squeezed onto the friction surface, forming a tough lubricant film, enabling smooth, gentle "wet" friction.
- Self-Recovery: When the friction plates separate, the material rebounds like memory foam, "absorbing" the lubricant back into the pores, ready for the next operation.

It is this dynamic cycle of "oil storage-oil squeezing-oil return" that allows paper-based friction materials to perform well in an oil bath environment, achieving a perfect combination of high durability and stable friction performance.
Exploring Core Performance: How Do Three Key Factors Affect It?

The performance of paper-based friction materials is not static. Like a top athlete, its performance is influenced by the "field," "equipment," and "condition." Let's examine how these three key factors shape its performance.
Factor 1: The "Stage Effect" of Lubricants

Paper-based friction materials are highly sensitive to lubricants, and different lubricants create distinct "stages" for their performance. Even the same friction material can exhibit significantly different friction characteristics (especially the kinetic friction coefficient) when exposed to different lubricants.
Figure 1: Kinetic friction coefficient curve for a paper-based friction material in gear oil
Figure 2: Dynamic friction coefficient curve of the same material in hydraulic oil

Interpretation: The above chart clearly shows that the same material behaves very differently in gear oil and hydraulic fluid. Furthermore, various additives added to lubricating oils (such as dispersants and anti-wear agents) can interact complexly with the material surface, further affecting its friction properties. Therefore, choosing the right oil for paper-based friction materials is the first step in achieving optimal performance.
Density is a trump card for paper-based friction materials. It is directly related to the material's porosity, leading to a delicate balancing act in terms of performance.

High density (low porosity) means a denser material, resulting in better strength and thermal conductivity, lower wear rate, and longer life. However, the downside is reduced oil storage capacity, which can lead to a lower coefficient of friction and compromise power transmission.

Low density (high porosity) means the material is more porous, resulting in greater oil storage capacity and a higher coefficient of friction, which can provide greater braking force or transmit torque. However, the downside is reduced mechanical strength and wear resistance, shortening service life.
Figure 3: Comparison of the dynamic coefficient of friction for materials of varying densities (Type 2 to Type 6, increasing density)
Figure 4: Comparison of wear rates of materials with different densities

Interpretation: Figures 3 and 4 vividly illustrate this balancing act. There's no such thing as absolute good or bad, only suitability. When selecting a paper-based friction material, the optimal trade-off between friction coefficient and durability must be determined based on specific application requirements (e.g., high torque versus long life).
Factor 3: Extreme Challenges of Operating Conditions

In addition to oil type and density, actual operating conditions, such as surface pressure, sliding speed, and oil temperature, pose extreme challenges to paper-based friction materials. These factors directly affect the temperature of the friction interface, the thickness and stability of the oil film, and thus dynamically alter the coefficient of friction.

Therefore, please remember: the coefficient of friction of a particular paper-based friction material is not a fixed value, but rather a performance range determined through extensive and repeated testing under specific operating conditions.
Broad Applications: Injecting a Powerful "Heart" into Machinery

Thanks to its excellent overall performance and customizability, Carlisle Brake & Friction's paper-based friction materials have been successfully applied to the core components of various heavy-duty machinery, becoming their powerful and reliable "heart."
We understand that different machines and applications require significantly different friction materials. For example:
- Service brakes for construction machinery (such as excavators and loaders) require materials that provide a stable, powerful braking force under high loads to ensure safety.
- Powershift transmissions for agricultural machinery (such as tractors) require materials that provide smooth engagement and excellent heat resistance to handle frequent shifting.
- Clutches for industrial machinery require materials that respond quickly and have a long lifespan to ensure continuous and efficient operation of production lines.

To this end, Carlisle Brake & Friction has developed a series of special paper-based friction materials for different application scenarios, providing each customer with the most suitable and reliable solution.
Continuous Innovation, Driving the Future
Technological advancement is endless. To meet increasingly demanding application requirements and broaden market prospects, Carlisle Brake & Friction remains at the forefront of innovation.

We are not only continuously optimizing the formulation and processing of paper-based friction materials to push their performance limits, but are also actively exploring next-generation wet friction materials with even higher performance. These R&D efforts have made significant progress, aiming to provide global customers with more diverse and advanced options, driving the infinite possibilities of future machinery.

articles.title: Celebrating 100-Years with Medina Mayor and Employees

paras.en: Celebrating 100-Years with Medina Mayor and Employees

MEDINA, OHIO — September 24, 2025 — Carlisle Brake & Friction (CBF), a global leader in the development and manufacture of high-performance brake and friction solutions, today welcomed Medina Mayor Dennis Hanwell, Economic Development Director Kimberly Marshall, and Executive Director of the Medina Chamber of Commerce Jaclyn Ringstmeier, for a special photo op at the company’s headquarters, located at 920 Lake Road. The event was a commemorative celebration of CarlisleCBF’s 100-year anniversary and its enduring presence in the Medina community.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The photo op featured Mayor Hanwell alongside Carlisle’s Operations Leader, David Smith, and a number of employees who have been with the company for decades. The occasion honored CarlisleCBF’s century of innovation and its deep roots in the Medina area, where it has been a significant employer and community partner.

"We are incredibly proud of our history and our strong connection to the city of Medina," said David Smith. "This milestone is a testament to the hard work and dedication of our employees, many of whom have been with us for decades. We are grateful for the continued support of Mayor Hanwell and the entire Medina community."

The photo op followed a recent employee and family event at the Medina plant that celebrated the 100-year milestone. The celebration was filled with games, face painting, food, and fun for all ages, reinforcing the company's commitment to its employees and their families.

Mayor Hanwell expressed his gratitude for CarlisleCBF’s presence in the city. “Carlisle has been a part of the Medina community for nearly 65 years, providing good jobs and a strong economic foundation,” said Mayor Hanwell. "We are proud to celebrate their 100-year anniversary and recognize the significant role they have played in our city’s growth and prosperity."
CarlisleCBF, a brand of CentroMotion, was founded in 1925 and has grown to become a global leader in its field, serving a wide range of markets including agriculture, construction, and mining.

Carlisle Brake & Friction, a CentroMotion brand, is a leading global provider of highly engineered and integrated brake and friction solutions for a wide range of industrial applications. With over 100 years of experience, the company is dedicated to delivering innovative, reliable, and high-performance products to its customers worldwide.

articles.title: SCANGRIP Introduces SPRAYMATCH Spray Gun LED Work Light
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: To help professional painters improve quality control in automotive refinishing and industrial coating applications, SCANGRIP has introduced SPRAYMATCH.

Designed for use with spray guns, the professional LED work light delivers bright, uniform illumination directly onto the wet surface. This helps painters evaluate coverage more accurately and detect imperfections early in the refinish process.

SPRAYMATCH is attached directly to the spray cup, making it easy to use across different spray guns commonly found in automotive and industrial environments. In addition, the work light is EX certified, allowing safe and legal use inside spraybooths.

articles.title: NABC Announces Winner of 2026 Changing and Saving Lives Award
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: The National Auto Body Council (NABC) announced that Shyllo Michaelis, chief strategy officer of Texas Collision Centers (TCC), was named the NABC Changing and Saving Lives Award winner for 2026 at the Collision Industry Red Carpet Awards event on Tuesday, Nov. 3, 2026. She was also honored as part of the 2026 NABC SEMA Celebration.

The NABC Changing and Saving Lives Award recognizes individuals in the collision repair industry who have delivered exemplary service in the NABC mission of Changing and Saving Lives Every Day, far beyond their role in the industry.

TCC is an 18-store, family-owned MSO dedicated to serving its communities and giving back to those who serve others. Since 2021, Michaelis has played an instrumental role in TCC’s partnership with the Recycled Rides program, helping restore and provide reliable transportation to individuals and families facing significant transportation challenges. Under her leadership, TCC has refurbished and donated numerous vehicles through the program each year.

“We are incredibly proud at Texas Collision Centers to be the recipient of the NABC Changing and Saving Lives award,” said Michaelis. “Texas Collision Centers is very grateful to be a member of the National Auto Body Council for a number of years and present some 30 NABC Recycled Rides in our community. We really appreciate the partnership with the insurance carriers who donate these vehicles and our paint, parts and service providers who help support the giftings. It’s an honor to give back to those in need and recognize the men and women who have served our country.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: In 2025, Michaelis and the TCC team refurbished 19 vehicles for the NABC, including a single-day presentation of 16 vehicles to 16 Texas veterans on Veterans Day — the largest single Recycled Rides gifting to date. articles.title: CREF’s 2026 Benchmark Awards Deliver $475,000 to Collision Schools
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: The Collision Repair Education Foundation (CREF) announced that 71 collision schools will receive a combined $475,000 through its 2026 Benchmark Awards program. Recipients were announced at CREF’s Benchmark Awards Breakfast held Nov. 4 in Las Vegas during the 2026 SEMA Show.

Schools were selected through CREF’s 2026 Collision School Career Readiness Benchmark Awards program, which provides financial assistance to help collision education programs overcome budgetary limitations and prepare students for careers. Benchmark Awards can be used, in line with the award category, to enhance program capabilities, attract new students or fuel innovative approaches to collision education.

These funds will help instructors strengthen programs, invest in tools and equipment, and provide hands-on training and technical skills. Based on current enrollment figures, the investments are expected to benefit more than 3,580 students this year, with improvements continuing to support future classes.

“Congratulations to the 2026 Benchmark Award recipients,” said Brenda Hogen, chair of CREF. “The Collision Repair Education Foundation is incredibly grateful to our industry partners whose generosity makes these awards possible year after year. Their continued investment demonstrates a shared commitment to strengthening collision education and ensuring that the next generation of repair professionals has the knowledge and skills needed to succeed in our industry. I also want to recognize the dedicated instructors who take the time to apply for these awards, demonstrating their determination to provide students with the best possible education despite the challenges they face.
