articles.title: See Stunning Images of the Universe Captured by Europe's Euclid Space Telescope, Which Is Building the Biggest 3D Map of the Cosmos

paras.en: After roughly 13 months of scientific observations, the Euclid space telescope—built by the European Space Agency (ESA)—has released its first big batch of data. The observations cover an area of the sky roughly equal to 9,500 full moons as viewed from Earth, and that’s just a tiny portion of what the observatory will capture as it builds the largest-ever 3D map of the cosmos.
paras.zh: 经过大约 13 个月的科学观测，欧洲航天局 (ESA) 建造的欧几里得太空望远镜发布了第一批大量数据。这些观测覆盖的天空区域大约相当于从地球上观看的 9,500 个满月，而这只是天文台在构建有史以来最大的 3D 宇宙地图时将捕获的数据的一小部分。

paras.en: The contents of the 1.7-million-gigabyte data drop, unveiled on November 12, are astounding. They include more than 900 million galaxies; more than 60 million potential quasars, the bright cores of faraway galaxies; and about 15,000 candidates of an elusive phenomenon called strong gravitational lensing, which can help shed light on a cosmic mystery: the dark universe.
paras.zh: 11月12日公布的170万GB数据的内容令人震惊。它们包括超过 9 亿个星系；超过 6000 万个潜在类星体，遥远星系的明亮核心；以及大约 15,000 个被称为强引力透镜的难以捉摸的现象的候选者，它可以帮助揭示宇宙之谜：黑暗宇宙。

paras.en: Euclid launched in July 2023 to journey to a spot nearly one million miles from Earth called Lagrange Point 2, joining NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope. ESA’s instrument aims to investigate two mysterious, invisible things: dark matter, which acts as cosmic glue, and dark energy, thought to be behind the universe’s accelerating expansion. Scientists suspect that together, they make up 95 percent of the universe, but neither can be measured directly. That’s why scientists are excited about the thousands of strong gravitational lensing candidates in this batch of data.
paras.zh: 欧几里得于 2023 年 7 月发射升空，前往距地球近 100 万英里的拉格朗日点 2，加入 NASA 的詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜。欧空局的仪器旨在研究两种神秘的、看不见的东西：充当宇宙胶水的暗物质和被认为是宇宙加速膨胀背后的暗能量。科学家怀疑它们共同构成了宇宙的 95%，但这两者都无法直接测量。这就是为什么科学家们对这批数据中数千个强引力透镜候选者感到兴奋的原因。

paras.en: Did you know? Another Lagrange Point 2 buddy
paras.zh: 你可知道？另一个拉格朗日点 2 伙伴

paras.en: NASA’s Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope is currently en route to the second Lagrange point, where it will search for exoplanets and help unravel the mysteries of dark matter and dark energy.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局的南希·格雷斯·罗马太空望远镜目前正在前往第二拉格朗日点的途中，在那里它将寻找系外行星并帮助解开暗物质和暗能量的奥秘。

paras.en: Gravitational lensing occurs when light from a distant galaxy gets distorted by a galaxy between it and the light detector—in this case, Euclid. The way the light gets warped around the obstacle allows researchers to indirectly investigate the dark universe.
paras.zh: 当来自遥远星系的光被其与光探测器（在本例中为欧几里得探测器）之间的星系扭曲时，就会发生引力透镜效应。光线在障碍物周围扭曲的方式使研究人员能够间接调查黑暗宇宙。

paras.en: “How strongly the light is bent tells us how much matter a galaxy contains, including invisible components like dark matter. With thousands of lenses, we can study how dark matter is spread through galaxies and understand how galaxies form and evolve over cosmic time,” Natalie Lines, an astrophysicist at the University of Portsmouth in England and Euclid team member, tells Reuters’ Will Dunham.
paras.zh: 英国朴茨茅斯大学天体物理学家、欧几里得团队成员娜塔莉·莱恩斯（Natalie Lines）告诉路透社的威尔·邓纳姆（Will Dunham）：“光线弯曲的强度告诉我们一个星系含有多少物质，包括暗物质等不可见成分。通过数千个透镜，我们可以研究暗物质如何在星系中传播，并了解星系如何在宇宙时间内形成和演化。”

paras.en: The 15,000 strong gravitational lensing candidates in Euclid’s recent batch of data, officially called Data Release 1-Foundation, collectively represent the largest catalog of this phenomenon. It’s even bigger than all previous databases combined, according to a statement.
paras.zh: Euclid 最近一批数据中的 15,000 个强引力透镜候选数据（官方称为 Data Release 1-Foundation）共同代表了这一现象的最大目录。根据一份声明，它甚至比以前所有数据库的总和还要大。

paras.en: Euclid can also see different wavelengths, or spectra, within the light from a galaxy—similar to how a prism splits white light into a rainbow—which can reveal its distance, origin and composition. With these measurements, scientists can start building a 3D map of the universe and its cosmic web of galaxy clusters. And it really is just a start; Data Release 1-Foundation includes only around 14 percent of the entire portion of the sky that Euclid will observe.
paras.zh: 欧几里得还可以看到来自星系的光中的不同波长或光谱——类似于棱镜如何将白光分裂成彩虹——这可以揭示其距离、起源和成分。通过这些测量，科学家可以开始构建宇宙及其星系团宇宙网的 3D 地图。这确实只是一个开始；数据发布 1-Foundation 仅包含欧几里得观测到的整个天空部分的 14% 左右。

paras.en: That small percentage includes spectra from more than 160 million sources as well as gorgeous images—puzzle pieces of large sky mosaics. And Euclid is special because it’s collecting data on a huge portion of the sky in incredible detail.
paras.zh: 这一小部分包括来自超过 1.6 亿个来源的光谱以及华丽的图像——大型天空马赛克拼图。欧几里得很特别，因为它以令人难以置信的细节收集了大部分天空的数据。

paras.en: While there are bigger sky surveys at lower resolution, as well as smaller, pinpointed observations at high resolution, Euclid remarkably achieves both metrics, Andy Taylor, an astrophysicist at the University of Edinburgh in Scotland and Euclid team member, tells the Guardian’s Nicola Davis.
paras.zh: 苏格兰爱丁堡大学天体物理学家、欧几里得团队成员安迪·泰勒告诉《卫报》的尼古拉·戴维斯，虽然有较低分辨率的大型天空观测，以及高分辨率的较小、精确的观测，但欧几里得显着地实现了这两个指标。

paras.en: “The technological leap that’s Euclid is that we can keep that high resolution, but now we can basically map huge volumes of the sky, huge volumes of the universe,” Taylor explains.
paras.zh: “欧几里得的技术飞跃在于我们可以保持高分辨率，但现在我们基本上可以绘制大量的天空、大量的宇宙，”泰勒解释道。

paras.en: And more observations will be released soon, with the full Data Release 1 expected to drop in mid-2027.
paras.zh: 更多观测结果将很快发布，完整的数据版本 1 预计将于 2027 年中期发布。

paras.en: “So much discovery is yet to come,” says Valeria Pettorino, ESA’s Euclid project scientist, in the statement.
paras.zh: 欧空局欧几里得项目科学家瓦莱里娅·佩托里诺（Valeria Pettorino）在声明中表示：“还有很多发现尚未到来。”

articles.title: A Child Tossed a Hat, and a Ceiling Fan Sent It Flying Into a Hippo's Zoo Enclosure, Where the Animal Ate It. Here's How the Care Team Is Responding

paras.en: It was an almost impossible series of events. At the Cincinnati Zoo, a child tossed a knit cap into the air, where a ceiling fan caught it and sent it flying to the side. The hat sailed through a one-foot opening above 12-foot-high viewing windows in Fiona the hippo’s enclosure. The animal ingested the item.
paras.zh: 这是一系列几乎不可能发生的事件。在辛辛那提动物园，一个孩子将一顶针织帽扔到空中，吊扇接住了它，并将其飞到一边。这顶帽子穿过河马菲奥娜围栏内 12 英尺高的观察窗上方的一英尺开口。动物吞下了该物品。

paras.en: “We probably couldn’t make [it] happen again if we tried,” Michelle Curley, a spokesperson for the zoo, says in a statement to Casey Weldon and Kristen Swilley of Axios.
paras.zh: 动物园发言人米歇尔·柯利 (Michelle Curley) 在给 Axios 的凯西·韦尔登 (Casey Weldon) 和克里斯汀·斯威利 (Kristen Swilley) 的一份声明中说：“如果我们尝试的话，我们可能无法让这种情况再次发生。”

paras.en: The incident, which occurred earlier this month, was an accident, the zoo states. Now, the veterinary and hippo care teams are monitoring Fiona around the clock and working to help her pass the object. They’ve given her fluids and an enema, as well as medications to reduce nausea and act like laxatives.
paras.zh: 动物园表示，本月早些时候发生的这起事件纯属意外。现在，兽医和河马护理团队正在全天候监视菲奥娜，并努力帮助她排出异物。他们给她输液和灌肠，以及减轻恶心和泻药作用的药物。

paras.en: “We know from consulting with specialists … that surgery isn’t an option for full-grown hippos,” Mike Wenninger, director of animal health at the Cincinnati Zoo, said in a video update on Tuesday. “Our best chance for success with Fiona would be if she can pass this on her own.”
paras.zh: 辛辛那提动物园动物健康主任迈克·温宁格在周二的视频更新中表示：“通过咨询专家，我们得知……对于成年河马来说，手术不是一种选择。” “我们在菲奥娜身上取得成功的最佳机会是她能自己克服这个困难。”

paras.en: On Monday, the team wrote that they are “cautiously optimistic” on Facebook. “We know how much Fiona means to so many of you.”
paras.zh: 周一，该团队写道，他们对 Facebook 持“谨慎乐观”态度。 “我们知道菲奥娜对你们很多人来说有多重要。”

paras.en: Fiona became widely beloved in 2017 after she was born six weeks prematurely, weighing just 29 pounds, instead of the average 55 to 120 pounds. In multiple tube feedings each day, caretakers gave her a custom milk formula, and they used an IV catheter to deliver fluids. The public followed eagerly along as she took her shaky first steps and recovered, and Fiona gained a base of lifelong fans. She even inspired a book and a line of beer.
paras.zh: 2017 年，菲奥娜 (Fiona) 早产六周，体重仅为 29 磅，而不是平均体重 55 至 120 磅，因此受到广泛喜爱。在每天多次管饲中，看护人员给她提供定制的配方奶粉，并使用静脉导管输送液体。当她迈出摇摇欲坠的第一步并恢复过来时，公众热切地关注着她，菲奥娜赢得了一批终生的粉丝。她甚至启发了一本书和一系列啤酒。

paras.en: A few days after ingesting the hat, Fiona’s appetite started to decrease. This week, her care team ran diagnostics again and repeated fluid therapy to promote her hydration. They borrowed a nine-foot scope from the Columbus Zoo to conduct a colonoscopy, but they couldn’t reach the hat in her digestive tract. An ultrasound suggested the hippo’s small intestine is bunching, as if she is passing something through it.
paras.zh: 吃了帽子几天后，菲奥娜的食欲开始下降。本周，她的护理团队再次进行诊断，并重复进行液体治疗以促进她的水分补充。他们从哥伦布动物园借了一个九英尺的望远镜来进行结肠镜检查，但他们无法到达她消化道中的帽子。超声波检查显示河马的小肠正在堆积，就好像她正在通过它一样。

paras.en: “At this point, what we can do is supportive care,” Wenninger said in the video. “We’re trying to give her all of her favorite foods and try to get her to keep passing things through.”
paras.zh: “此时，我们能做的就是支持性护理，”温宁格在视频中说。 “我们正在努力给她所有她最喜欢的食物，并努力让她继续传递东西。”

paras.en: Ron Magill, goodwill ambassador and conservation liaison for the Zoo Miami Foundation, tells CNN’s Chris Boyette that it is not uncommon for zoo animals to consume items that have been accidentally dropped into their enclosures.
paras.zh: 迈阿密动物园基金会亲善大使兼保护联络员罗恩·马吉尔 (Ron Magill) 告诉美国有线电视新闻网 (CNN) 的克里斯·博耶特 (Chris Boyette)，动物园里的动物吃掉不小心掉进围栏里的物品的情况并不少见。

paras.en: The major concern for Fiona is “primarily that it doesn’t cause an obstruction in her digestive tract, which could lead to impaction and damage leading to serious infection and sepsis,” Magill tells CNN.
paras.zh: 马吉尔告诉美国有线电视新闻网，菲奥娜主要担心的是“它不会导致她的消化道阻塞，这可能会导致嵌塞和损伤，从而导致严重感染和败血症”。

paras.en: Fiona will remain off exhibit while her care team continues to monitor her. As the public awaits more updates from the zoo, many are hoping that the resilient hippo recovers.
paras.zh: 菲奥娜将不再参加展览，而她的护理团队将继续监视她。当公众等待动物园的更多消息时，许多人都希望这只坚韧的河马能够康复。

paras.en: “Fiona’s a trooper,” Curley tells Axios.
paras.zh: “菲奥娜是一名士兵，”柯利告诉 Axios。

articles.title: Hours Before It Was Expected to Sell for Up to $3.5 Million, This Frida Kahlo Painting Was Whisked From the Auction Block

paras.en: Since it was announced last month that a celebrated Frida Kahlo painting would be put up for auction at Christie’s highly anticipated 20th Century Evening Sale, excitement and intrigue had steadily built.
paras.zh: 自从上个月宣布弗里达·卡罗 (Frida Kahlo) 的一幅著名画作将在佳士得备受期待的 20 世纪晚间拍卖会上拍卖以来，人们的兴奋和好奇就逐渐升温。

paras.en: Experts estimated that Kahlo’s 1952 Congreso de los pueblos por la paz (Congress of the Peoples for Peace), would fetch between $2.5 million and $3.5 million, a 52 percent increase from its most recent sale just six years ago. The piece shared the pre-auction spotlight with other high-profile works, including a Wassily Kandinsky masterpiece, a Gustav Klimt canvas and a long-lost Georgia O’Keeffe landscape that was recently rediscovered in a Manhattan closet.
paras.zh: 专家估计，卡罗 1952 年创作的《人民争取和平大会》的售价将在 250 万至 350 万美元之间，比六年前的最新拍卖价格上涨了 52%。这件作品与其他备受瞩目的作品一起在拍卖前受到关注，其中包括瓦西里·康定斯基的杰作、古斯塔夫·克里姆特的画布以及最近在曼哈顿壁橱中重新发现的久违的乔治亚·欧姬芙风景画。

paras.en: But this week, just hours before the first bids were set to be submitted, Kahlo’s painting was pulled from the sale amid questions of its provenance. The interceding effort was led by a group called Defendamos la Colección Gelman (Let’s Defend the Gelman Collection), which seeks to protect Mexico’s cherished cultural artifacts from illegally leaving the country.
paras.zh: 但本周，就在提交第一批投标的前几个小时，卡洛的画作因出处受到质疑而被从拍卖中撤下。这项调解工作是由一个名为 Defendamos la Colección Gelman（让我们捍卫盖尔曼收藏）的组织领导的，该组织旨在保护墨西哥珍贵的文物免遭非法出境。

paras.en: In a statement issued this week, the group says that the painting was included in a 1957 inventory that Kahlo’s husband, the famed painter Diego Rivera, created for the Casa Azul Trust, which left thousands of the pair’s artworks, artifacts and personal items to the Mexican people. The group goes on to allege that the work “left the Casa Azul for strange reasons and came into the hands of a New York gallery owner, and after several transfers and an auction it ended up in private hands that are now offering it, through Christie’s, for between $2 million and $3.5 million,” El País’ Beatriz Guillén reports.
paras.zh: 在本周发布的一份声明中，该组织表示，这幅画被收录在卡洛的丈夫、著名画家迭戈·里维拉 (Diego Rivera) 1957 年为 Casa Azul Trust 创作的库存中，该信托基金为墨西哥人民留下了数千件两人的艺术品、手工艺品和个人物品。该组织接着声称，这件作品“由于奇怪的原因离开了 Casa Azul，落入了一位纽约画廊老板的手中，经过多次转让和拍卖，最终落入私人手中，现在通过佳士得以 200 万至 350 万美元的价格出售这件作品”，《国家报》的 Beatriz Guillén 报道。

paras.en: A representative from the Frida Kahlo Museum told ARTnews’ Tessa Solomon: “In accordance with established protocols, the auction house Christie’s has been informed that the work is part of an ongoing investigation being conducted by the competent Mexican authorities … An investigation file exists that gathers information on several works, including Congreso de los pueblos por la paz.”
paras.zh: 弗里达·卡罗博物馆的一位代表告诉 ARTnews 的泰莎·所罗门：“根据既定协议，佳士得拍卖行已获悉该作品是墨西哥主管当局正在进行的调查的一部分……现有调查文件收集了多件作品的信息，其中包括《Congreso de los pueblos por la paz》。”

paras.en: This investigation was launched after Hilda Trujillo, who served as the director of the Frida Kahlo Museum from 2009 to 2020, published a tell-all blog post last year alleging that her own internal investigations clearly showed that multiple Kahlo artworks had gone missing from the collection in the years before she began her role.
paras.zh: 这项调查是在希尔达·特鲁希略（Hilda Trujillo）发起的。希尔达·特鲁希略（Hilda Trujillo）于 2009 年至 2020 年担任弗里达·卡罗博物馆（Frida Kahlo Museum）馆长，她去年发表了一篇揭露一切的博客文章，声称她自己的内部调查清楚地表明，在她上任之前的几年里，多件卡罗的艺术品从馆藏中失踪了。

paras.en: “The documents I was able to read from this report showed that pieces originally catalogued in 1957 now belonged to private collections,” Trujillo wrote in April 2025. “How and when did these artworks leave the Casa Azul?”
paras.zh: “我从这份报告中读到的文件显示，最初编目于 1957 年的作品现在属于私人收藏，”特鲁希略在 2025 年 4 月写道。“这些艺术品是如何以及何时离开卡萨阿祖尔的？”

paras.en: She added: “Pieces from the original collection are in private funds and I consider that, as a Mexican society, we are owed an explanation in this regard.”
paras.zh: 她补充道：“原始收藏品是由私人基金资助的，我认为，作为墨西哥社会，我们应该在这方面做出解释。”

paras.en: Among the specific pieces Trujillo lists as wrongfully missing is the 1952 painting Congreso de los pueblos por la paz. By 1988, she wrote, records indicated it was in private hands, where it has remained ever since.
paras.zh: 特鲁希略列为错误失踪的具体作品之一是 1952 年的画作《Congreso de los pueblos por la paz》。她写道，到 1988 年，记录显示它已掌握在私人手中，并一直保留至今。

paras.en: Gabriela Mosqueda, a Mexican curator, tells the New York Times’ Victoria Burnett that the Mexican government, which has been called upon to better protect its cultural items, “did nothing” in the aftermath of Trujillo’s accusations. “I have little hope that the government will put its house in order,” she adds.
paras.zh: 墨西哥策展人加布里埃拉·莫斯奎达 (Gabriela Mosqueda) 向《纽约时报》的维多利亚·伯内特 (Victoria Burnett) 表示，被要求更好地保护其文化物品的墨西哥政府在特鲁希略的指控之后“没有采取任何行动”。 “我对政府整顿内部秩序的希望不大，”她补充道。

paras.en: Kahlo created the painting to commemorate the 1952 Congress of the Peoples for Peace, held in Vienna, Austria. It features a white dove perching on a fruited tree, which separates night from day.
paras.zh: 卡罗创作这幅画是为了纪念 1952 年在奥地利维也纳举行的人民和平大会。它的特点是一只白鸽栖息在一棵果树上，将黑夜与白天分开。

paras.en: “The finest representatives of art and science from every country on Earth proclaimed before Congress their determination to preserve peace intact, knowing that this defense is the best defense of themselves and their creative potential,” the magazine Tiempo wrote in a 1953 editorial, according to El País.
paras.zh: 据《国家报》报道，《Tiempo》杂志在 1953 年的一篇社论中写道：“地球上每个国家最优秀的艺术和科学代表都向国会宣布了他们维护和平完整的决心，他们知道这种防御是对他们自己及其创造潜力的最好防御。”

paras.en: Kahlo’s painting is not the only high-profile painting in recent weeks to have its sale disputed. Earlier this month, a French court annulled the $1.6 million sale of a Camille Pissarro landscape after allegations that it had been looted by Nazis during World War II. And this week, the contested auction of a $180 million Van Gogh painting—alleged to have been originally sold under Nazi pressure in the 1930s—was allowed to move ahead after a settlement with its rightful heirs was reached.
paras.zh: 卡罗的画作并不是最近几周唯一一幅因拍卖而引起争议的高调画作。本月早些时候，法国一家法院取消了以 160 万美元出售卡米尔·毕沙罗 (Camille Pissarro) 风景画的交易，此前该画作被指控在二战期间被纳粹掠夺。本周，一幅价值 1.8 亿美元的梵高画作的拍卖——据称最初是在 1930 年代在纳粹压力下出售的——在与其合法继承人达成和解后获准继续进行。

articles.title: Taylor Swift & Jack Antonoff, Ludwig Göransson Win at 2026 Hollywood Music in Media Awards: Full Winners List
articles.author: Paul Grein

paras.en: Taylor Swift and Jack Antonoff and Ludwig Göransson began their long march to widely predicted Oscar glory on Wednesday, Nov. 18 when the 17th annual Hollywood Music in Media Awards (HMMA) were presented at the Avalon in Hollywood, Calif.
paras.zh: 11 月 18 日星期三，第 17 届年度好莱坞音乐媒体奖 (HMMA) 在加利福尼亚州好莱坞的阿瓦隆颁奖典礼上，泰勒·斯威夫特 (Taylor Swift)、杰克·安东诺夫 (Jack Antonoff) 和路德维希·戈兰森 (Ludwig Göransson) 开始了他们向广泛预测的奥斯卡荣耀迈进的漫长征程。

paras.en: “I Knew It, I Knew You,’’ which Swift and Antonoff wrote for Toy Story 5, won song – animated film. Swift accepted her first HMMA in a prerecorded video shown during the ceremony. (Swift was in Nashville on the same night, set to perform on the CMA Awards, where “I Knew It, I Knew You” was nominated for single of the year.)
paras.zh: 斯威夫特和安东诺夫为《玩具总动员 5》创作的《我知道，我知道你》赢得了动画电影歌曲奖。斯威夫特在颁奖典礼上播放的预先录制的视频中接受了她的第一个 HMMA。（斯威夫特当天晚上在纳什维尔，准备在 CMA 颁奖典礼上表演，其中《我知道，我知道你》获得了年度单曲提名。）

paras.en: Göransson’s score for The Odyssey won score – feature film. Last year, Göransson won two HMMAs for his work on Sinners and went on to win both the Oscar and Golden Globe for best original score.This wasGöransson’s eighth HMMA; his second in this category.
paras.zh: 戈兰森为《奥德赛》配乐赢得了故事片配乐奖。去年，戈兰森凭借《罪人》获得了两项 HMMA 奖，并随后赢得了奥斯卡和金球奖最佳原创配乐奖。这是戈兰森的第八部 HMMA；这是他在这一类别中的第二个。

paras.en: Legendary songwriter Diane Warren won her third HMMA for “One Right Here” from Maserati: The Brothers. She performed the song during the show joined by Tia Simon and Joshua Wentz. “One Right Here” was recorded by Andrea Bocelli and Jennifer Hudson for the upcoming film.
paras.zh: 传奇词曲作家黛安·沃伦 (Diane Warren) 凭借《玛莎拉蒂：兄弟》(Maserati: The Brothers) 的《One Right Here》第三次赢得 HMMA。她在蒂亚·西蒙（Tia Simon）和约书亚·温茨（Joshua Wentz）的陪同下在演出中演唱了这首歌。 “One Right Here”由安德烈亚·波切利和詹妮弗·哈德森为即将上映的电影录制。

paras.en: Lana Del Rey and David Arnold won song – video game (console & PC) for “First Light” from 007 First Light, which they co-wrote and Del Rey performed.
paras.zh: 拉娜·德雷 (Lana Del Rey) 和大卫·阿诺德 (David Arnold) 凭借《007 First Light》中的歌曲《First Light》赢得了视频游戏歌曲（游戏机和 PC）奖，这首歌由他们共同创作，德尔雷演唱。

paras.en: The Rise of the Red Hot Chili Peppers: Our Brother, Hillel, directed by Ben Feldman, won music documentary – special program.
paras.zh: 本·费德曼 (Ben Feldman) 执导的《红辣椒的崛起：我们的兄弟希勒尔》(The Rise of the Red Hot Chili Peppers: Our Brother, Hillel) 荣获音乐纪录片特别节目奖。

paras.en: Linda Perry performed her song “What Lies With You” from Linda Perry: Let It Die Here and won for song – documentary film. The Decemberists frontman Colin Meloy performed his nominated song “The Better Part of Bravery” from Wildwood, and Brother Verses Brother stars Ethan Gold and Ari Gold performed their nominated song “Brothers Keep Goin’ Anyway” from the film.
paras.zh: 琳达·佩里 (Linda Perry) 表演了《琳达·佩里：让它死在这里》(Linda Perry: Let It Die Here) 中的歌曲“What Lies With You”，并获得了歌曲纪录片奖。 Decemberists 主唱科林·梅洛伊 (Colin Meloy) 演唱了《怀尔德伍德》中的提名歌曲《The Better Part of Bravery》，《Brother Verses》中的兄弟明星伊森·戈尔德 (Ethan Gold) 和阿里·戈尔德 (Ari Gold) 演唱了电影中的提名歌曲《兄弟继续前进》(Brothers Keep Goin’ Anyway)。

paras.en: The Isley Brothers, joined by David Kushner and Pink Beard, opened the ceremony with a performance of Warren’s song “By Any Means” from the film of the same name. The video for “By Any Means,” directed by Fran Strine, won the HMMA for music video.
paras.zh: 艾斯利兄弟 (Isley Brothers) 与大卫·库什纳 (David Kushner) 和粉红胡子 (Pink Beard) 一起表演了沃伦同名电影中的歌曲《By Any Means》，拉开了颁奖典礼的序幕。弗兰·斯特林 (Fran Strine) 执导的《By Any Means》视频荣获 HMMA 音乐视频奖。

paras.en: Michael star Jaafar Jackson won his first HMMA for song – onscreen performance (film) for “Bad.” Daveed Diggs won song – onscreen performance – TV show/limited series for “Raise Him Up” from The Boys, which he co-wrote with composer Christopher Lennertz.
paras.zh: 迈克尔明星贾法尔·杰克逊 (Jaafar Jackson) 凭借歌曲《Bad》的银幕表演（电影）赢得了他的第一个 HMMA。戴维德·迪格斯 (Daveed Diggs) 凭借与作曲家克里斯托弗·伦纳茨 (Christopher Lennertz) 共同创作的《男孩们》(Raise Him Up) 歌曲《Raise Him Up》赢得了歌曲-银幕表演-电视节目/限定剧奖。

paras.en: La Bola Negra composer Raül Refree won for both score – independent film and song – independent film for “La Nieve.” The song was co-written by Guitarricadelafuente, Raül Refree, and Lucas Duran, and performed by Guitarricadelafuente.
paras.zh: 《La Bola Negra》作曲家 Raül Refree 凭借《La Nieve》赢得了独立电影配乐和独立电影歌曲两项大奖。这首歌由 Guitarricadelafuente、Raül Refree 和 Lucas Duran 共同创作，并由 Guitarricadelafuente 演唱。

paras.en: Behemoth! won music-themed film, biopic or musical, and its director Tony Gilroy was honored for his commitment to the art of film music in Los Angeles.
paras.zh: 巨兽！赢得了音乐主题电影、传记片或音乐剧，其导演托尼·吉尔罗伊因其对洛杉矶电影音乐艺术的承诺而获奖。

paras.en: The award for score – short film [live action]) went to The Seventh Turn composer Michael Wandmacher, who transformed Evanescence frontwoman Amy Lee‘s voice into a full multi-instrumental film score.
paras.zh: 短片配乐奖（真人表演）颁给了《第七转》的作曲家迈克尔·万德马赫 (Michael Wandmacher)，他将《伊凡塞斯》主唱艾米·李 (Amy Lee) 的声音改编成了完整的多乐器电影配乐。

paras.en: Assassin’s Creed Black Flag Resynced received two HMMAs. Composers Brian Tyler and Stephen Lukach won score – video game (console & PC), and Ubisoft Music won soundtrack album.
paras.zh: 《刺客信条：黑旗》重新同步后收到了两个 HMMA。作曲家布莱恩·泰勒 (Brian Tyler) 和斯蒂芬·卢卡奇 (Stephen Lukach) 赢得了视频游戏配乐（游戏机和 PC），育碧音乐 (Ubisoft Music) 赢得了原声带专辑。

paras.en: The HMMAs honor composers, songwriters, music supervisors and artists for outstanding contributions to music in film, television, video games, and other visual media. Here’s the full list of nominations for the 2026 Hollywood Music in Media Awards, with winners marked:
paras.zh: HMMA 旨在表彰对电影、电视、视频游戏和其他视觉媒体中的音乐做出杰出贡献的作曲家、词曲作者、音乐总监和艺术家。以下是 2026 年好莱坞音乐媒体奖提名的完整名单，并标记了获奖者：

articles.title: ‘Never Go Backwards, Just Make Things Bigger and Better’: How Paul O’Neill Chartered Trans-Siberian Orchestra’s Journey Ahead
articles.author: Lars Brandle

paras.en: When Trans-Siberian Orchestra turned 20 back in 2016, the troupe’s enduring success was as surprising to founder Paul O’Neill as anyone in or outside of the camp.
paras.zh: 2016 年，当跨西伯利亚管弦乐团成立 20 周年之际，该剧团的持久成功令创始人保罗·奥尼尔以及该乐团内外的任何人都感到惊讶。

paras.en: “I would love to say that we planned for it to resonate like this, but it was just pure luck,” acknowledged O’Neill, who passed away the following year at the age of 61. And that it was an endeavor almost entirely based around the Christmas holiday made it seem even less likely.
paras.zh: 奥尼尔承认：“我很想说，我们计划让它产生这样的共鸣，但这纯粹是运气。”奥尼尔于次年去世，享年 61 岁。而且，这是一项几乎完全围绕圣诞假期的努力，这使得它看起来更不可能。

paras.en: “Normally you have five or six other platinum albums, then you take on Christmas,” O’Neill noted. “Of course, we took it on first and the rest of the year on later. It’s all worked out.”
paras.zh: “通常情况下，你会有五到六张其他白金专辑，然后你就会在圣诞节接受，”奥尼尔指出。 “当然，我们首先接受了它，然后在今年剩下的时间里接受了它。一切都解决了。”

paras.en: That’s certainly an understatement for TSO, which celebrates the 30th anniversary of its triple-platinum debut album, Christmas Eve and Other Stories, this year with its annual, two-company concert tour opening Nov. 19 in Green Bay, Wisc., and Council Bluffs, Iowa. The 97 performances through Dec. 30 will again feature the soundtrack and narration from The Ghosts of Christmas Eve, TSO’s 1999 made-for-TV film, and other material amidst the usual fusillade of arena-filling special effects and pyrotechnics, with two shows a day at most stops.
paras.zh: 对于 TSO 来说，这无疑是一种轻描淡写的说法，今年，TSO 庆祝其三白金首张专辑《平安夜和其他故事》问世 30 周年，并于 11 月 19 日在威斯康星州格林湾和爱荷华州康瑟尔布拉夫斯举行了年度两家公司巡回演唱会。截至 12 月 30 日的 97 场演出将再次采用 TSO 1999 年制作的电视电影《平安夜的幽灵》中的配乐和旁白，以及其他素材，以及通常充满舞台的特效和烟火表演，最多每天两场演出。

paras.en: During the past three decades TSO has released six studio albums — four platinum or better, three Christmas-themed — and an EP, along with the multi-platinum singles “Christmas Eve/Sarajevo 12/24” and “Christmas Cannon.” The 2005 track “Wizards in Winter” also hit platinum, and a fan’s synchronized home display soundtracked by the tune was turned into an ad campaign for Miller Lite.
paras.zh: 在过去的三十年里，TSO 发行了六张录音室专辑（四张白金或以上，三张以圣诞节为主题）和一张 EP，以及多白金单曲“Christmas Eve/Sarajevo 12/24”和“Christmas Cannon”。 2005 年的歌曲“Wizards in Winter”也达到了白金销量，粉丝同步的家庭显示屏配乐也被改编成了 Miller Lite 的广告活动。

paras.en: Since 1999, meanwhile, the tours have sold more than 20 million tickets, grossing more than $1 billion. This year, too, TSO will continue its practice of donating $1 from each ticket sold to local charities.
paras.zh: 与此同时，自 1999 年以来，巡回演出已售出超过 2000 万张门票，总收入超过 10 亿美元。今年，TSO 也将继续其做法，从每张售出的门票中捐赠 1 美元给当地慈善机构。

paras.en: “One of the first things Paul taught us was, ‘Listen, just try to make great art, try to make the best of this as we can, and with a little bit of luck everything will fall into place,'” Al Pitrelli, TSO’s musical director and guitarist with the West company, tells Billboard via phone. “Boy, those words come true every time we hit the stage. His integrity and work ethic carried us through 21 years of touring and 25 years of recording, and with his family at the helm and everybody’s dedication to this, there’s really no end in sight.”
paras.zh: “保罗教给我们的第一件事就是，‘听着，试着创造伟大的艺术，尽我们所能地充分利用这一点，如果运气好的话，一切都会水到渠成，’”TSO 的音乐总监兼 West 公司的吉他手 Al Pitrelli 通过电话告诉 Billboard。 “男孩，每次我们登上舞台时，这些话都会成真。他的正直和职业道德带领我们度过了 21 年的巡演和 25 年的录音，在他的家人的掌舵和每个人的奉献精神下，这真的是永无止境。”

paras.en: “Christmas Eve/Sarajevo 12/24” was the opening shot for TSO. Inspired by the true story of cellist Vedran Smallovic, who would play Christmas carols atop rubble in war-torn Sarajevo even amidst attacks during the Bosnian War, it was written by O’Neill, Jon Oliva and Robert Kinkel and first recorded by Savatage — a band O’Neill began producing and writing for in 1987 — for its 1995 concept album Dead Winter Dead. TSO drummer Jeff Plate, who had recently joined Savatage, remembers that “there was a lot of conversation about whether this song should even be on the record. Was it too weird having a Christmas song on this rock/metal record? But it was awesome. There was really something special to it.”
paras.zh: “平安夜/萨拉热窝 12/24”是 TSO 的开场镜头。受大提琴家维德兰·斯莫洛维奇 (Vedran Smallovic) 的真实故事启发，即使在波斯尼亚战争期间，他也会在饱受战争蹂躏的萨拉热窝的废墟上演奏圣诞颂歌，这首歌由奥尼尔 (O’Neill)、乔恩·奥利瓦 (Jon Oliva) 和罗伯特·金克尔 (Robert Kinkel) 创作，并由奥尼尔 (O’Neill) 于 1987 年开始制作和创作的乐队 Savatage 首次录制，并收录在 1995 年的概念专辑《Dead Winter Dead》中。最近加入 Savatage 的 TSO 鼓手杰夫·普拉特 (Jeff Plate) 回忆道，“关于这首歌是否应该收录在唱片中，有很多讨论。在这张摇滚/金属唱片上收录一首圣诞歌曲是不是太奇怪了？但这太棒了。它确实有一些特别的东西。”

paras.en: It was released as the album’s second single and climbed both the Hot Mainstream Rock Tracks and Hot Adult Contemporary Track charts, with enough radio to play to give O’Neill an idea.
paras.zh: 它作为专辑的第二首单曲发行，并登上了热门主流摇滚曲目和热门成人当代曲目排行榜，并有足够的电台播放给奥尼尔带来了灵感。

paras.en: “It became an instant holiday hit,” Plate says. “This was the vehicle for Paul to create the Trans-Siberian Orchestra.”
paras.zh: “它立即成为假日热门产品，”普拉特说。 “这是保罗创建跨西伯利亚管弦乐团的工具。”

paras.en: Pitrelli, who was part of Savatage along with Plate and Oliva at the time, joined the “Sarajevo” brain trust in creating songs for Christmas Eve and Other Stories, based on a narrative created by O’Neill.
paras.zh: Pitrelli 当时与 Plate 和 Oliva 一起是 Savatage 的一员，他加入了“萨拉热窝”智囊团，根据奥尼尔创作的叙事为平安夜和其他故事创作歌曲。

paras.en: “We’d get together at Paul’s apartment in New York City,” he says, “and literally sit around what we called the kitchen table with four Korg Mi1s, whatever keyboards we had available, a couple guitars, a couple practice amps, an ashtray and a bunch of cassette recorders. Paul would say, ‘Here’s an idea, who’s got a musical thought?’ and we’d throw ideas around and Paul would go, ‘Ooh, I like that. Let’s run with that’ and press record on the tape recorder,’ get it down and then, ‘OK, who’s got something else?’ and move on to the next song.
paras.zh: “我们会在保罗位于纽约市的公寓里聚会，”他说，“坐在我们所谓的餐桌旁，周围有四台 Korg Mi1，无论我们有什么键盘，几把吉他，几个练习音箱，一个烟灰缸和一堆盒式录音机。保罗会说，‘这是一个想法，谁有音乐想法？’我们会到处提出想法，保罗会说，‘哦，我喜欢这个。让我们一起运行吧。 ”然后按录音机上的录音键，把它记下来，然后，“好吧，谁还有其他的东西？”然后继续播放下一首歌曲。

paras.en: “It was three months of having fun, because what did it matter? It had never been done before, so we weren’t up against it. We were just being artists from four different backgrounds, collaborating, throwing out our respective ideas. And Paul saw the big picture and picked and chose what he thought was appropriate.”
paras.zh: “这三个月很有趣，因为这有什么关系？以前从未做过，所以我们没有反对。我们只是来自四个不同背景的艺术家，合作，提出我们各自的想法。保罗看到了大局，并选择了他认为合适的东西。”

paras.en: The formally trained Pitrelli says the quartet did share a fondness for progressive rock and its blending of classical and rock motifs that they felt was well-suited to the Orchestra component of the Trans-Siberian sound.
paras.zh: 受过正规训练的皮特雷利表示，四重奏组确实对前卫摇滚有着共同的喜爱，并且喜欢古典与摇滚主题的融合，他们认为这非常适合跨西伯利亚音乐中管弦乐队的组成部分。

paras.en: “I grew up listening to a lot of Yes, Emerson, Lake & Palmer, King Crimson and (Pink) Floyd, Queen,” he says. “So the orchestral piece made sense in the context of soundtrack and story; it wasn’t far-fetched at all. We just toughened it up and made it a little more aggressive…and then brought in the holiday component and wove those themes and songs into what we were doing.
paras.zh: “我从小就听了很多 Yes, Emerson、Lake & Palmer、King Crimson 和 (Pink) Floyd, Queen，”他说。 “所以管弦乐作品在配乐和故事的背景下是有意义的；它一点也不牵强。我们只是加强了它，让它更有攻击性……然后引入了节日元素，并将这些主题和歌曲融入到我们正在做的事情中。

paras.en: “We put it all together and took it into the studio. Two or three months later (October 1996) we had a record out, and then it sold three million copies that first year. So it was like, ‘Alright, we’re a band. This is cool, and it’s working. People like it!'”
paras.zh: “我们把它们放在一起并带到录音室。两三个月后（1996 年 10 月）我们出了一张唱片，第一年就售出了 300 万张。所以当时的感觉是，‘好吧，我们是一支乐队。这很酷，而且很有效。人们喜欢它！’”

paras.en: Adam Lind, who was managing Savatage with Krebs Communications and now works with both acts for Night Castle Management Inc., adds that, “The part that surprised me was Paul’s accompanying story and poetry. I didn’t know it was coming ’til it was dropped on our desks…The music, for me, was so out of the ordinary and so powerful that it shocked me when I heard it. I wasn’t at all surprised that people loved it…(but) we didn’t know how important and influential it would be.”
paras.zh: 亚当·林德 (Adam Lind) 曾与克雷布斯通讯公司 (Krebs Communications) 一起管理 Savatage，现在在 Night Castle Management Inc. 与这两个乐队合作，他补充道：“让我感到惊讶的是保罗所附的故事和诗歌。直到它被扔到我们的桌子上我才知道它会来……对我来说，音乐是如此与众不同，如此强大，以至于当我听到它时，我感到震惊。人们喜欢它，我一点也不感到惊讶……（但是）我们不知道它会有多重要和有影响力。”是。”

paras.en: Lind notes, also, that, “Atlantic (Records) as a whole didn’t understand it, but they were great supporters like Jason Flom, who tirelessly worked every angle and pulled every favor to get it in front of people, and all of a sudden it had momentum.”
paras.zh: 林德还指出，“大西洋唱片公司作为一个整体并不理解这一点，但他们是像杰森·弗洛姆这样的伟大支持者，他孜孜不倦地从各个角度努力，竭尽全力将其呈现在人们面前，突然之间，它就有了动力。”

paras.en: TSO released one more album, the double-platinum Christmas Attic in 1998, before taking the next step to become a road act. “We were making records, selling millions of copies, but I almost felt like I was in the Steely Dan of Christmas,” Pitrelli remembers. And there was certainly skepticism about the idea of TSO as a live band — though those were allayed when the seven initial theater shows in 1999 all sold out.
paras.zh: TSO 于 1998 年又发行了一张双白金专辑《Christmas Attic》，之后又迈出了成为公路表演者的一步。 “我们正在制作唱片，销量数百万张，但我几乎感觉自己身处圣诞节的钢丹之中，”皮特雷利回忆道。当然，人们对 TSO 作为现场乐队的想法表示怀疑——尽管当 1999 年最初的七场剧院演出全部售完后，这些怀疑得到了缓解。

paras.en: “I think Paul’s presentation and vision of the live show was the secret sauce,” Lind says. “Knowing Paul, it was in his brain the whole time. One of his many talents with being a producer with an ability to see greatness in other people. Over two years he put his friends from his years in the industry together, just as he did for the first record.”
paras.zh: “我认为保罗的现场表演和愿景是秘诀，”林德说。 “了解保罗，这一直在他的脑海里。他的众多才能之一就是作为一名制作人，有能力看到别人的伟大之处。两年多的时间里，他把自己在这个行业多年的朋友聚集在一起，就像他在制作第一张唱片时所做的那样。”

paras.en: Pitrelli remembers sitting with O’Neill in the dressing room of Philadelphia’s Tower Theatre on opening night, still not certain about what lay ahead. “It was like, ‘I don’t understand; who bought all these tickets, dude?’ Who is this audience,” the guitarist says. “When the houselights went down and the curtain dropped, I looked out at the audience and right in front of me was this older couple, grandparents wearing crocheted seaters, and right next to them was a dude wearing a Slayer hoodie. Welcome to the demographic of TSO; that was the weirdest thing that had ever happened to me, musically.”
paras.zh: 皮特雷利记得开幕之夜与奥尼尔一起坐在费城塔剧院的更衣室里，仍然不确定接下来会发生什么。 “这就像，‘我不明白；谁买了所有这些门票，伙计？’这些观众是谁，”吉他手说。 “当屋内灯光熄灭，幕布落下时，我向观众望去，就在我面前的是一对年长的夫妇，祖父母穿着钩编的座椅，他们旁边是一个穿着 Slayer 连帽衫的家伙。欢迎来到 TSO 的人群；这是我在音乐上发生过的最奇怪的事情。”

paras.en: Plate recalls being “so nervous” at the same show, and looking at the crowd before to see “metalhead kids, long hair and black T-shirts, and then there were families and children. And in the front row was this gentleman with a tuxedo on his wife had a beautiful red dress. I thought, ‘Omigod, these people are here to see an orchestra!’ But it was just magic; the band, the story, everything just clicked.
paras.zh: 普拉特回忆起在同一场演出时“非常紧张”，看着前面的人群，看到“金属头孩子，长发和黑色 T 恤，然后是家人和孩子。前排是一位穿着燕尾服的绅士，他的妻子穿着漂亮的红色连衣裙。我想，‘天啊，这些人来这里是为了看管弦乐队！’但这只是魔法；乐队、故事，一切都恰到好处。

paras.en: “And at the end of the show the band took a bow and the man in the tuxedo gave me a high five. It set the tone for all these years later.”
paras.zh: “演出结束时，乐队鞠躬，穿燕尾服的男人给了我一个高五分。这为后来的所有事情定下了基调。”

paras.en: TSO quickly grew into the two-company, arena-filling endeavor it is now, hauling 325 tons of equipment around in 38 trucks, with a crew of 250. And rest assured it’s definitely a concern where size matters, and bigger is better.
paras.zh: TSO 迅速发展成为现在这样一家由两家公司组成、充满活力的企业，用 38 辆卡车运输 325 吨的设备，员工人数为 250 人。请放心，这绝对是一个问题，因为规模很重要，而且越大越好。

paras.en: “Every year we always say the same thing — ‘How the heck are we going to beat this?'” O’Neill, a self-confessed “pyro whore,” said during 2016. “It’s a good problem to be having, and it forces us to come up with something new, something different. We know all the special effects companies. They all know that if they invent great special effects that’s insanely expensive there is one band that is dumb enough to buy it, and that’s us. It’s just worth it.”
paras.zh: “每年我们都会说同样的话——‘我们究竟要怎样才能打败这个？’”自认是“火焰妓女”的奥尼尔在 2016 年说道，“这是一个很好的问题，它迫使我们想出一些新的、不同的东西。我们了解所有的特效公司。他们都知道，如果他们发明了昂贵的特效，就会有一个乐队愚蠢到会买下它，而这就是我们。”

paras.en: TSO tour director Elliot Saltzman says that “What would Paul do?” has remained a credo since O’Neill’s passing. “His theory was to never go backwards, just make things bigger and better,” Saltzman explains. Planning for each year’s tour begins in earnest during March, starting with drawings from longtime production designer Bryan Hartley, and continues with several meetings in Las Vegas to consider lighting, effects and other aspects of the show — an exacting, detailed dialogue that Saltzman says runs even through rehearsals that begin during October in Omaha, Neb.
paras.zh: TSO 巡演总监 Elliot Saltzman 说：“保罗会怎么做？”自从奥尼尔去世以来，这一直是一个信条。 “他的理论是永远不要倒退，只是让事情变得更大更好，”萨尔茨曼解释道。每年巡演的规划从三月份开始，从长期制作设计师布莱恩·哈特利 (Bryan Hartley) 的图纸开始，然后在拉斯维加斯召开几次会议，考虑灯光、效果和演出的其他方面——萨尔茨曼说，这种严格、详细的对话甚至贯穿了 10 月份在内布拉斯加州奥马哈开始的排练。

paras.en: “The idea is to really capture the audience and say, ‘Yes, maybe it’s a story you’ve heard before, but the way it’s portrayed this year is different, and that makes it fresh and new,” says Saltzman, who also oversees the logistics of transporting band crew and stage from an evening performance and having it ready for a matinee in another city the following day. “We have basically three or four different stories we use, so we’ve got to increase the excitement every year and give them a reason to come and hear them again.
paras.zh: 萨尔茨曼说：“我们的想法是真正吸引观众，并说，‘是的，也许这是一个你以前听过的故事，但今年的描述方式不同，这使它变得新鲜和新颖。’他还负责运输乐队工作人员和舞台从晚间演出到第二天在另一个城市的日场演出的后勤工作。 “我们基本上使用了三到四个不同的故事，因此我们必须每年增加兴奋度，并给他们一个再次来听他们的理由。

paras.en: “I talk to people and read comments — ‘This is my 28th show,’ ‘This is my 90th show…and this was the best one yet!’ So we seem to be doing it right.”
paras.zh: “我与人们交谈并阅读评论 - ‘这是我的第 28 场演出’，‘这是我的第 90 场演出……这是迄今为止最好的一场！’所以我们似乎做得对。”

paras.en: O’Neill considered the live edition of The Ghosts of Christmas Eve, which first aired on the Fox Family Channel, to be “a big experiment” when TSO presented it on stage in 2015. “We weren’t sure it was going to work,” he acknowledged the following year. “But it worked so well we decided to do it again this year.” Its combination of relative brevity and a “greatest hits” nature of songs from the first two TSO albums has turned it into a something of a staple; this year’s tour marks Ghosts’ eight performance, and fourth in the past five years.
paras.zh: 当 TSO 于 2015 年将《平安夜的幽灵》首次在福克斯家庭频道播出时，奥尼尔认为现场版是“一次重大实验”。第二年他承认，“我们不确定它是否会成功”。 “但效果非常好，我们决定今年再做一次。”它的相对简洁性和前两张 TSO 专辑中歌曲的“精选”性质相结合，使其成为一种主打歌曲；今年的巡演是 Ghosts 的第八次演出，也是过去五年中的第四次。

paras.en: “People love this show,” drummer Plate says. “It’s always worked whenever we’ve done it. It moves along swiftly. The TV special is on all sorts of channels during the holiday season and has become kind of a tradition, too, so it all works hand in hand.”
paras.zh: “人们喜欢这个节目，”鼓手普拉特说。 “每当我们这样做的时候，它总是有效的。它进展得很快。电视特别节目在假期期间在各种频道上播放，并且也已经成为一种传统，所以这一切都是齐头并进的。”

paras.en: Pitrelli adds that, “The story is so universal and has such lovely, happy ending. I just think people love it, myself included. And we listen to the comments; I know our management team is constantly scouring the Internet for feedback, and people say the same thing — ‘We love the story, and they made it even better than the previous year.’ So it’s back by popular demand, and I’m OK with that.”
paras.zh: 皮特雷利补充道，“这个故事非常具有普遍性，结局非常可爱、幸福。我认为人们喜欢它，包括我自己。我们会听取评论；我知道我们的管理团队不断在互联网上寻找反馈，人们也说同样的话——‘我们喜欢这个故事，他们把它做得比前一年更好。’所以它是应大众的要求而回归的，我对此很满意。”

paras.en: More surprises, meanwhile, come during the rest of the show, drawing from the other TSO albums, both Christmas and secular, and in recent years even including songs from Savatage, which itself began touring again last year with Pitrelli, Plate and other members who are also part of TSO.
paras.zh: 与此同时，更多惊喜出现在演出的其余部分，借鉴了 TSO 的其他专辑，包括圣诞节和世俗专辑，近年来甚至包括 Savatage 的歌曲，该专辑本身去年开始与 Pitrelli、Plate 和其他 TSO 成员一起再次巡演。

paras.en: “It’s not the same band, but they’re certainly related (because) the same people wrote (TSO)’ songs,” Pitrelli says. And Plate explains that, “If you listen to that band you can hear and see hints of what Paul O’Neill was thinking, and how it turned into (TSO). So doing some (Savatage) songs just fits.”
paras.zh: “这不是同一支乐队，但他们肯定有联系（因为）是同一个人写了（TSO）的歌曲，”皮特雷利说。 Plate 解释说，“如果你听那个乐队的歌，你可以听到并看到 Paul O'Neill 的想法以及它如何变成 (TSO) 的暗示。所以做一些 (Savatage) 歌曲很合适。”

paras.en: That TSO will go on for the foreseeable future is a given. But there are also hopes that the group’s catalog will expand at some point.
paras.zh: TSO 在可预见的未来将持续下去是必然的。但也有人希望该组织的目录在某个时候能够扩大。

paras.en: The last TSO album Letters From the Labyrinth, came out during 2015, and TSO did perform a new song, “Christmas Carousels” — an expansion of a track from 2004’s The Lost Christmas Eve — during 2022. Meanwhile, O’Neill left behind several unrecorded projects that he spoke freely about — among them: Romanov: When Kings Must Whisper, about the 1917 Russian Revolution; The Path of the Fairytale Moon; and an expanded, rewritten version of Savatage’s 1990 concept album Gutter Ballet.
paras.zh: TSO 的上一张专辑《Letters From the Labyrinth》于 2015 年发行，TSO 在 2022 年期间确实表演了一首新歌“Christmas Carousels”，这是 2004 年《The Lost Christmas Eve》中一首歌曲的扩展。与此同时，奥尼尔留下了几个他自由谈论的未录制项目，其中包括：《罗曼诺夫：当国王必须低语时》，讲述了 1917 年的俄罗斯革命；《Romanov: When Kings Must Whisper》，讲述了 1917 年的俄罗斯革命；童话月亮的路径；以及 Savatage 1990 年概念专辑《Gutter Ballet》的扩展重写版本。

paras.en: “Paul left us a huge body of unfinished work we need to get to,” Pitrelli says, “but we got blind-sided when we lost him and we’re still kind of licking our wounds a little bit. It’s just extremely daunting. There’s always talk about that, but (touring) has become such a full-time job throughout the year that we’re just trying to move forward on this and make sure it’s great.”
paras.zh: “保罗给我们留下了大量未完成的工作，我们需要完成，”皮特雷利说，“但是当我们失去他时，我们措手不及，我们仍然在舔伤口。这真是令人畏惧。总是有人谈论这个，但（巡演）已经成为全年的全职工作，我们只是在努力向前推进并确保它很棒。”

paras.en: Plate says he’d like to see one of those works finished and would also like to see TSO try another spring tour, which it did during 2010-2012 in North America and Europe. “It’s difficult in this day and age to go out on tour, no matter who you are,” he acknowledges, “and Trans-Siberian Orchestra is not a small group. If we don’t have the luxury of the holiday it changes things, so it may not be feasible. But it would be nice if we could.”
paras.zh: 普拉特说，他希望看到其中一件作品完成，也希望看到 TSO 尝试另一次春季巡演，该巡演曾于 2010 年至 2012 年在北美和欧洲进行过。 “在当今这个时代，无论你是谁，出去巡演都很困难，”他承认，“西伯利亚交响乐团不是一个小团体。如果我们没有奢侈的假期，事情就会改变，所以这可能不可行。但如果我们能做到的话那就太好了。”

paras.en: Trans-Siberian tour dates, ticket information and more can be found via trans-siberian.com.
paras.zh: 可通过 trans-siberian.com 找到横贯西伯利亚之旅的日期、门票信息等。

articles.title: 50 Cent Steps Out With Reebok G-Unit G6 Reboot
articles.author: Lars Brandle

paras.en: Curtis “50 Cent” Jackson‘s reboot with Reebok is making a comeback, just in time for Christmas.
paras.zh: 柯蒂斯·“50 Cent”·杰克逊与锐步 (Reebok) 的合作即将卷土重来，正好赶上圣诞节。

paras.en: The hip-hop veteran recently teamed up with the sportswear specialist for the G-Unit G6, a blast from the past sneaker which were unveiled in August in its original red, white and blue colorway and proved to be a hit with 50 Cent’s followers. Those shoes re-launch globally on Friday, Nov. 20.
paras.zh: 这位嘻哈老手最近与运动服专家合作推出了 G-Unit G6，这款运动鞋是对过去运动鞋的一次冲击，该运动鞋于 8 月以其最初的红、白、蓝配色推出，并受到 50 Cent 粉丝的欢迎。这些鞋款将于 11 月 20 日星期五在全球重新上市。

paras.en: The basketball and street fashion-inspired gear initially rolled out in 2003, the year when Fifty blew up on airwaves and charts around the globe. The one that got away, “In Da Club,” logged nine weeks at No. 1 on the Hot 100, and the New Yorker followed it up two months later with “21 Questions,” featuring the late Nate Dogg, which spent a full month atop the national singles survey. His smash album Get Rich or Die Tryin’ held the top spot on the Billboard 200 for six weeks, and lent its name to the 2005 semi-autobiographical film, which gave 50 Cent his first starring role.
paras.zh: 这款受篮球和街头时尚启发的装备最初于 2003 年推出，这一年 50 风靡全球广播电台和排行榜。其中一首“In Da Club”在百强单曲排行榜上连续九周排名第一，两个月后《纽约客》紧随其后推出了由已故 Nate Dogg 主演的“21 Questions”，该曲在全国单曲调查中整整一个月都位居榜首。他的热门专辑《Get Rich or Die Tryin’》在 Billboard 200 排行榜上连续六周占据榜首，并以该专辑的名字命名了 2005 年的半自传电影，该电影让 50 Cent 首次担任主演。

paras.en: That partnership made Jackson one of the first musicians to lead a major footwear franchise. “Creating it the first time was special,” Jackson recounts in an interview with GQ. “I worked with Todd (Krinsky) and the team on everything and they really let me make it mine. It wasn’t just a sneaker—it became part of the culture.”
paras.zh: 这种合作关系使杰克逊成为第一批领导主要鞋类特许经营权的音乐家之一。 “第一次创作它很特别，”杰克逊在接受《GQ》采访时回忆道。 “我与托德（克林斯基）和团队在所有事情上都进行了合作，他们真的让我把它变成我的。它不仅仅是一双运动鞋，它成为了文化的一部分。”

paras.en: Krinsky, who started with Reebok in 1993, working in the mailroom, is now CEO. “Our relationship with 50 has always gone beyond sneakers,” he remarks in a statement. “He helped define an important chapter in Reebok’s history, and together we created something that had a lasting impact on sport style and culture. Bringing the G-Unit G6 back is an opportunity to celebrate that legacy while introducing it to a new generation.”
paras.zh: 克林斯基 (Krinsky) 于 1993 年加入锐步 (Reebok)，当时在收发室工作，现在担任首席执行官。 “我们与 50 的关系始终超越了运动鞋，”他在一份声明中说道。 “他帮助定义了 Reebok 历史上的重要篇章，我们共同创造了对运动风格和文化产生持久影响的东西。G-Unit G6 的回归是一个庆祝这一传统的机会，同时将其介绍给新一代。”

paras.en: Tastes changed and by 2006 that original partnership had moved, with over four million pairs sold in those three years. Nostalgia and licensed kit, however, make for a powerful combination. “We’ve been talking about it for a while,” 50 continues. “Reebok is back, the G-Unit fans are still here, and there’s a whole new generation discovering us. The timing just felt right.”
paras.zh: 品味发生了变化，到 2006 年，最初的合作伙伴关系发生了变化，三年内售出了超过 400 万双。然而，怀旧和授权套件构成了一个强大的组合。 “我们已经讨论了一段时间了，”50 继续说道。 “Reebok 回来了，G-Unit 粉丝仍然在这里，全新一代都在发现我们。时机恰到好处。”

paras.en: The G-Unit G6 will be available from $130 at Reebok’s U.S. site, and for A$210 in Australia. “The takeover goes global,” reads 50 Cent’s social post. Check it out below.
paras.zh: G-Unit G6 在锐步美国网站的售价为 130 美元起，在澳大利亚的售价为 210 澳元。 “收购走向全球，”50 Cent 的社交帖子写道。看看下面。

articles.title: Taylor Swift Performs “Our Song” and “I Knew It, I Knew You” at the CMAs
articles.author: Ethan Millman

paras.en: Taylor Swift played a mashup of “Our Song” and “I Knew It, I Knew You” during her first CMAs performance in 13 years on Wednesday night.
paras.zh: 周三晚上，泰勒·斯威夫特 (Taylor Swift) 在 13 年来的首次 CMA 表演中演奏了《我们的歌》和《我知道，我知道你》的混搭曲。

paras.en: To kick off the performance, the global superstar started backstage as she danced past other country icons — including Brad Paisley, Little Big Town, Sugarland, Brooks & Dunn, Lainey Wilson and Eric Church — while singing her single from the Toy Story 5 soundtrack. She then grabbed her guitar and made her way onstage, where she was joined by Keith Urban on banjo.
paras.zh: 为了拉开表演序幕，这位全球巨星在后台开始表演，她一边跳舞，一边跳过其他乡村音乐偶像——包括 Brad Paisley、Little Big Town、Sugarland、Brooks & Dunn、Lainey Wilson 和 Eric Church——同时演唱《玩具总动员 5》原声带中的单曲。然后她抓起吉他走上舞台，演奏班卓琴的基思·厄本 (Keith Urban) 也加入了她的行列。

paras.en: Swift later mixed in one of her first-ever hit tracks, “Our Song,” from her 2006 self-titled debut studio album before concluding her performance with the ending of “I Knew It, I Knew You,” which is also up for single of the year at the CMAs.
paras.zh: 随后，斯威夫特在她 2006 年首张同名录音室专辑中的首首热门歌曲《Our Song》中进行了混音，然后以《I Knew It, I Knew You》结束了她的表演，这首歌也获得了 CMA 年度单曲奖。

paras.en: Swift’s CMAs appearance reflects the pop superstar’s return to the country scene she first came up in 20 years ago. Last month, she became the youngest-ever inductee into the Country Music Hall of Fame.
paras.zh: 斯威夫特的 CMA 亮相反映出这位流行巨星重返 20 年前首次出现的乡村音乐舞台。上个月，她成为乡村音乐名人堂有史以来最年轻的入选者。

paras.en: Her CMAs appearance is the latest in a busy year for Swift, who was also inducted into the broader Songwriters Hall of Fame over the summer and is currently a front-runner in the Oscar race for best original song.
paras.zh: 她在 CMA 的亮相是斯威夫特忙碌的一年中最新的一次，她还在今年夏天入选了更广泛的歌曲作者名人堂，目前是奥斯卡最佳原创歌曲竞赛的领跑者。

paras.en: She also earned five Grammy nominations earlier this week, with Life of a Showgirl getting an album of the year nod, while its single “The Fate of Ophelia” is nominated for record of the year and “I Knew It, I Knew You” is up for song of the year.
paras.zh: 本周早些时候，她还获得了五项格莱美提名，其中《Life of a Showgirl》获得了年度专辑提名，单曲《The Fate of Ophelia》获得了年度唱片提名，而《I Knew It, I Knew You》则获得了年度歌曲提名。

articles.title: Indigenous Queer Drama ‘Princess’ Is Dedicated to “Everyone Fighting for Their Freedom, Their Identity”
articles.author: Georg Szalai

paras.en: Princess, or Ñusta in the Andean indigenous language Quechua, is not your standard coming-of-age film. At the heart of Ecuadorian writer-director Christian Rojas’ lyrical debut feature is Kallpa, 12, who has a big dream: to be chosen as Ñusta, the princess in the teenager’s Andean community’s Winter Solstice Festival. But having been born in the body of a boy, Kallpa is barred from taking part. Rigid tradition and community rejection mean that Kallpa must find a new home and family among a group of local trans women.
paras.zh: 《公主》，或者安第斯土著语言盖丘亚语中的“Ñusta”，并不是标准的成人电影。厄瓜多尔作家兼导演克里斯蒂安·罗哈斯 (Christian Rojas) 的抒情长片处女作的主角是 12 岁的卡尔帕 (Kallpa)，他有一个远大的梦想：被选为安第斯社区青少年冬至节的公主乌斯塔 (Ñusta)。但由于以男孩的身体出生，卡尔帕被禁止参加。僵化的传统和社区的排斥意味着卡帕必须在当地的跨性别女性群体中找到新的家和家庭。

paras.en: Kuri Fuerez stars alongside La Bruja de Texcoco, Bruno Giganti, Quispe Nuna, Romel Vargas, Kayita Quizhpe and Adele Pesantez. Princess, which is a co-production between Ecuador, Mexico, Argentina, Peru and Bolivia, features cinematography by Christian Hidalgo and editing by Jorge Macaya and Cristian Bermeo. The producers are María Ángeles Palacios and Daniela Fuentes Moncada. MMM Film Sales is handling sales.
paras.zh: Kuri Fuerez 与 La Bruja de Texcoco、Bruno Giganti、Quispe Nuna、Romel Vargas、Kayita Quizhpe 和 Adele Pesantez 一起主演。 《公主》由厄瓜多尔、墨西哥、阿根廷、秘鲁和玻利维亚联合制作，由克里斯蒂安·伊达尔戈担任摄影，豪尔赫·马卡亚和克里斯蒂安·贝尔梅奥担任剪辑。制片人是玛丽亚·安赫莱斯·帕拉西奥斯和丹妮拉·富恩特斯·蒙卡达。 MMM Film Sales 负责销售。

paras.en: Princess, featuring dialogue in Spanish and Quechua, just celebrated its world premiere in the First Feature Competition of the 30th edition of the Tallinn Black Nights Film Festival (PÖFF) in Estonia.
paras.zh: 以西班牙语和盖丘亚语对白为特色的《公主》刚刚在爱沙尼亚第 30 届塔林黑夜电影节 (PÖFF) 首届故事片竞赛中庆祝其全球首映。

paras.en: After the premiere screening, Rojas and members of the production and creative team discussed Princess with the audience.
paras.zh: 首映结束后，罗哈斯与制作创意团队成员与观众讨论了《公主》。

paras.en: “Ñusta was born when I was 10 years old, after I had experienced sexual abuse that [affected] my childhood and my life for a long time,” Rojas shared. “I dedicate this film to those who have survived, to those who are still fighting, and to those who open their eyes every day [with] the strength to keep on [being] who they are – everyone fighting for their freedom, their identity, and their right to a life without fear.”
paras.zh: “Ñusta 在我 10 岁时出生，当时我经历了性虐待，这影响了我的童年和生活很长一段时间，”罗哈斯分享道。 “我将这部电影献给那些幸存者，献给那些仍在战斗的​​人们，献给那些每天睁开眼睛，有力量继续做自己的人——每个人都在为自己的自由、自己的身份以及无恐惧生活的权利而奋斗。”

paras.en: Rojas lauded his collaborators as “the best team I could ever have,” concluding: “I say thank you to everyone for being part of it, part of healing this wound collectively – and not just my wound, but those wounds of everyone who’s still fighting and thinks they’re alone. We have to resist, raise our voice, and hug each other as a family.”
paras.zh: 罗哈斯称赞他的合作者是“我能拥有的最好的团队”，最后说道：“我要感谢大家的参与，共同治愈这个伤口——不仅仅是我的伤口，还有每个仍在战斗并认为自己孤独的人的伤口。我们必须抵抗，提高我们的声音，像一家人一样互相拥抱。”

paras.en: Safeguarding and ensuring a safe space, especially for the young actors, was a core focus for the Princess team. “The indigenous families … knew the story from beginning to end, but not the children,” Rojas said. “We had a psychologist on set and in pre-production, trying to develop this secure place for everyone so that we could actually enjoy making this movie.”
paras.zh: 保护和确保安全的空间，特别是对于年轻演员来说，是公主团队的核心关注点。 “土著家庭……从头到尾都知道这个故事，但孩子们却不知道，”罗哈斯说。 “我们在片场和前期制作中都有一位心理学家，试图为每个人开发这个安全的地方，以便我们能够真正享受制作这部电影。”

paras.en: And the writer-director shared: “It was important to me for the children to feel like it was a game that they were playing, and that it was not a rigid process. So with this amazing team, what we did was play and go through it by playing.” One of the elements they used in the creative process with the kids was “a map of emotions,” Rojas said.
paras.zh: 这位编剧兼导演分享道：“对我来说，让孩子们感觉这是他们正在玩的游戏，而且这不是一个严格的过程，这一点很重要。因此，在这个出色的团队中，我们所做的就是玩，并通过玩来完成它。”罗哈斯说，他们在与孩子们一起创作的过程中使用的元素之一是“情感地图”。

paras.en: The Princess team also emphasized the importance of working in and with the local community with respect. “We didn’t want to extract anything,” the director emphasized. “What we wanted was real participation and reciprocity.”
paras.zh: 公主团队还强调了尊重当地社区并与当地社区合作的重要性。 “我们不想提取任何东西，”导演强调道。 “我们想要的是真正的参与和互惠。”

paras.en: The film team also included members of different indigenous communities, including some leaders within those communities who work on diversity and related issues.
paras.zh: 电影团队还包括不同土著社区的成员，包括这些社区内致力于多样性和相关问题的一些领导人。

paras.en: The movie, set in 1997, includes an infamous real-life event that scarred Ecuador’s queer community that year. Police in the city of Cuenca back then raided a trans beauty pageant and arrested several people, who were then exposed to abuse and violence in custody.
paras.zh: 这部电影以 1997 年为背景，其中包括当年令厄瓜多尔酷儿群体伤痕累累的臭名昭著的现实事件。当时昆卡市警方突袭了一场跨性别选美比赛，逮捕了几人，随后这些人在拘留期间遭受虐待和暴力。

paras.en: “In terms of the visuals, we wanted to create the universe where Kallpa could travel, because this is a journey, and we wanted to always be with Kallpa on his journey,” Hidalgo explained. “And second, we wanted to be very close, so we are always with Kallpa.”
paras.zh: “就视觉效果而言，我们希望创造一个卡尔帕可以旅行的宇宙，因为这是一次旅程，我们希望在他的旅程中始终与卡尔帕在一起，”伊达尔戈解释道。 “其次，我们想要非常亲密，所以我们总是和卡尔帕在一起。”

paras.en: The sound also plays into Princess‘ aesthetic of closeness, allowing the audience to hear things we cannot see from a distance.
paras.zh: 这种声音也体现了公主的亲近美学，让观众听到我们从远处看不到的东西。

paras.en: When it came time to screen Princess for the community, “I was really afraid,” Rojas shared. But he felt validated when “a 70-year-old lady stood up and said, ‘We need to talk about these stories here in our community.'”
paras.zh: 当为社区放映《公主》时，“我真的很害怕，”罗哈斯分享道。但当“一位 70 岁的女士站起来说，‘我们需要在我们的社区谈论这些故事’时，他感到自己受到了认可。”

paras.en: Watch a trailer for Princess right here.
paras.zh: 在这里观看《公主》的预告片。

articles.title: “Wicker Nipples” and All: ‘Wicker’ Cinematographer Celebrates Steamy Film’s Viral Success
articles.author: Ryan Gajewski

paras.en: Wicker‘s filmmaking team is relishing its viral moments and box office success — not to mention its horny memes.
paras.zh: 《威克》的电影制作团队正在享受它的病毒时刻和票房成功——更不用说它的性感模因了。

paras.en: During a screening of Wicker at ToruńCamerimage Film Festival in Poland on Thursday, cinematographer Lol Crawley introduced the movie and expressed appreciation for it having become a social media sensation. Olivia Colman stars in directors Eleanor Wilson and Alex Huston Fischer’s romantic fantasy as a lonely woman who commissions a basket weaver (Peter Dinklage) to create a husband (Alexander Skarsgard) for her.
paras.zh: 周四在波兰托伦电影节放映《威克》期间，电影摄影师洛尔·克劳利介绍了这部电影，并对它在社交媒体上引起轰动表示赞赏。奥利维亚·科尔曼 (Olivia Colman) 在导演埃莉诺·威尔逊 (Eleanor Wilson) 和亚历克斯·休斯顿·费舍尔 (Alex Huston Fischer) 的浪漫幻想片中饰演一名孤独的女人，委托一名篮子编织工（彼特·丁拉基饰）为她创造一个丈夫（亚历山大·斯卡斯加德饰）。

paras.en: “It’s my fourth time back at the festival and having the honor of screening a film in competition, so thank you so much to Camerimage,” Crawley said from the stage about the festival that honors cinematography. “I really do hope you enjoy it as much as we enjoyed making it.”
paras.zh: “这是我第四次回到电影节，并有幸放映一部竞赛影片，非常感谢 Camerimage，”克劳利在舞台上谈到这个以电影摄影为荣的电影节时说道。 “我真的希望你喜欢它，就像我们喜欢制作它一样。”

paras.en: Crawley went on to recount the movie’s unlikely path from the festival circuit to internet obsession: “The film premiered at Sundance in January of this year, and since the trailer came out and thanks to all the love on social media, it’s just kind of snowballed. It’s gone from its premiere to wicker nipples being available and cardboard cutouts of Alex [Skarsgard] in all his fine wicker glory.”
paras.zh: 克劳利接着讲述了这部电影从电影节巡回放映到互联网痴迷的不太可能的过程：“这部电影于今年 1 月在圣丹斯电影节首映，自从预告片发布以来，由于社交媒体上的所有喜爱，它就像滚雪球一样滚雪球。从首映到柳条奶嘴可用，以及亚历克斯（斯卡斯加德）在他所有精美柳条荣耀中的纸板剪纸。”

paras.en: Wicker has managed to heat things up since Black Bear released it theatrically on Oct. 23. With the makings of a sleeper hit, the film has grossed $23.7 million domestically and an additional $13.4 million internationally through Tuesday. In his review for The Hollywood Reporter, critic Richard Lawson noted its “winning mix of irreverence and compassion.”
paras.zh: 自从《黑熊》于 10 月 23 日在院线上映以来，《威克》的热度就不断上升。凭借这部票房大片的成功，截至周二，该片的国内票房收入为 2,370 万美元，国际票房收入为 1,340 万美元。评论家理查德·劳森在《好莱坞报道》的评论中指出，该片“将不敬与同情融为一体”。

paras.en: The cinematographer acknowledged that the project, notable for its comedic moments, has a bit of a different tone than his previous work. Crawley won Camerimage’s coveted Golden Frog in 2024 for lensing The Brutalist before going on to win the Academy Award for the film.
paras.zh: 这位电影摄影师承认，该项目以其喜剧时刻而闻名，与他之前的作品有一些不同的基调。克劳利因拍摄《野兽派》而于 2024 年荣获 Camerimage 令人垂涎的金蛙奖，随后又凭借该片荣获奥斯卡金像奖。

paras.en: “It’s a fantastic dark fable — quite different material for me,” Crawley added of Wicker. “But very, very enjoyable experience and very, very proud to present the film.”
paras.zh: “这是一个奇妙的黑暗寓言——对我来说是完全不同的材料，”克劳利在谈到威克时补充道。 “但是非常非常愉快的经历，并且非常非常自豪能够呈现这部电影。”

paras.en: Later, after a festival representative had finished translating Crawley’s speech into Polish for the crowd, the Wicker cinematographer quipped, “Now I know what ‘wicker nipples’ is in Polish, which is a takeaway for me.”
paras.zh: 后来，电影节代表为观众将克劳利的演讲翻译成波兰语后，柳条电影摄影师打趣道：“现在我知道波兰语中的‘柳条乳头’是什么了，这对我来说是一个收获。”

articles.title: Trump holds talks separately with Putin and Xi ahead of their historic trilateral meeting

paras.en: SHENZHEN, China — U.S. President Donald Trump met with Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping separately on Thursday, ahead of a scheduled trilateral with his Russian and Chinese counterparts, according to pool notes and Chinese state media.
paras.zh: 中国深圳——据联营记录和中国官方媒体报道，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周四分别会见了弗拉基米尔·普京和习近平，随后预定与俄罗斯和中国总统举行三方会谈。

paras.en: Earlier on Thursday, the leaders and other members of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation gathered for a summit. Trump and Xi entered the room side by side.
paras.zh: 周四早些时候，亚太经济合作组织领导人和其他成员齐聚一堂，举行峰会。特朗普和习近平并肩进入房间。

paras.en: Xi said China would provide $20 million to support APEC cooperation, and establish a "Center for Asia-Pacific Community Studies in Shenzhen to conduct policy research and exchanges and provide intellectual support."
paras.zh: 习近平表示，中国将提供2000万美元支持APEC合作，并在深圳设立“亚太共同体研究中心，开展政策研究交流、提供智力支持”。

paras.en: Later in the morning session, Trump said that he opposed regulating artificial intelligence as it would "stifle" the industry.
paras.zh: 上午晚些时候，特朗普表示，他反对监管人工智能，因为这会“扼杀”该行业。

paras.en: "The United States has been a Pacific power for hundreds of years, and we continue to work to promote growth and stability, sovereignty, prosperity, and peace throughout this region," Trump said.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示：“数百年来，美国一直是太平洋地区的强国，我们将继续努力促进整个地区的增长与稳定、主权、繁荣与和平。”

paras.en: U.S. officials said last week that Trump did not plan to raise Nvidia's Jensen Huang and allegations of an affair with a Chinese spy at his meetings.
paras.zh: 美国官员上周表示，特朗普不打算在会议上提及英伟达的黄仁勋以及与中国间谍有染的指控。

paras.en: "By hosting APEC in Shenzhen, China took the opportunity to showcase another of its economic powerhouse cities, this time one that is home to some of the country's leading technology companies and innovators," AmCham China President Michael Hart said.
paras.zh: 中国美国商会会长迈克尔·哈特 (Michael Hart) 表示：“通过在深圳举办亚太经合组织会议，中国借此机会展示了其又一个经济强国城市，这一次是中国一些领先科技公司和创新者的所在地。”

paras.en: "The scale of China's economic strength and technological ambition is clear to U.S. businesses," he said. "They recognize the importance of the Chinese market, but also understand that they need to remain competitive, innovative, and prepared to compete in an increasingly sophisticated business environment."
paras.zh: “美国企业很清楚中国经济实力和技术雄心的规模，”他说。 “他们认识到中国市场的重要性，但也明白他们需要保持竞争力、创新性，并准备好在日益复杂的商业环境中竞争。”

articles.title: APEC final day in photos: Trump, Xi and Putin shake hands; Takaichi kept at a distance

paras.en: World leaders including the U.S. President Donald Trump and Russia's Vladimir Putin gathered Thursday for the second day of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit, ahead of a historic trilateral meeting between the U.S., Russia and China later in the day.
paras.zh: 包括美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京在内的世界领导人周四齐聚一堂，参加亚太经济合作组织峰会的第二天，随后美国、俄罗斯和中国将在当天晚些时候举行历史性的三边会议。

paras.en: International Monetary Fund Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva kicked off Thursday's agenda after China's President Xi Jinping's welcome note. Georgieva said that artificial intelligence and energy supply shocks had accelerated global inflation in many economies, calling for monetary policy tightening.
paras.zh: 在中国国家主席习近平致欢迎辞后，国际货币基金组织总裁克里斯塔利娜·格奥尔基耶娃拉开了周四的议程。格奥尔基耶娃表示，人工智能和能源供应冲击加速了许多经济体的全球通胀，呼吁收紧货币政策。

paras.en: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi was met with another cold reception. She spent several minutes trying to talk to Xi who did not appear to respond with no interpreter present.
paras.zh: 日本首相高市早苗再次遭到冷遇。她花了几分钟试图与习近平交谈，但在没有翻译在场的情况下，习近平似乎没有回应。

paras.en: Trump held separate bilateral meetings with Putin and Xi earlier in the day. The president praised Xi's leadership and said Washington was negotiating deals with several major APEC economies.
paras.zh: 当天早些时候，特朗普与普京和习近平分别举行了双边会晤。总统赞扬习近平的领导能力，并表示华盛顿正在与几个主要亚太经合组织经济体就协议进行谈判。

paras.en: In their first in-person talks in over a year, Trump told Putin that "We've known each other for a long time, and I think a lot of wonderful things can come out of this — or at least start," referring to Putin as a "friend."
paras.zh: 在一年多以来的首次面对面会谈中，特朗普告诉普京，“我们已经认识很长时间了，我认为这可以带来很多美好的事情——或者至少是开始”，并将普京称为“朋友”。

paras.en: The three leaders are due to hold their first-ever trilateral meeting later Thursday, with the Middle East conflict, Russia's war in Ukraine, trade and artificial intelligence likely on the agenda. Expectations for the historic three-way meeting to yield any concrete outcome remain low.
paras.zh: 三位领导人将于周四晚些时候举行首次三边会议，中东冲突、俄罗斯乌克兰战争、贸易和人工智能可能会列入议程。对这次历史性三方会议产生任何具体成果的期望仍然很低。

paras.en: The summit will conclude Trump's whirlwind Asia trip, after which the American president will return to Washington, D.C.
paras.zh: 此次峰会将结束特朗普旋风般的亚洲之行，随后美国总统将返回华盛顿特区。

paras.en: Here are the highlights in photos from the second and final day of the APEC summit:
paras.zh: 以下是 APEC 峰会第二天也是最后一天的照片亮点：

articles.title: Takaichi gets chilly reception in China on first Japan leader visit since 2019

paras.en: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi received a subdued welcome on her first trip to China as premier, signaling Beijing's limited appetite for repairing ties strained by a simmering row over Taiwan.
paras.zh: 日本首相高市早苗作为首相首次访华时受到了温和的欢迎，这表明北京方面对修复因台湾问题一触即发而紧张的关系的兴趣有限。

paras.en: At gatherings such as this week's Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Shenzhen, protocol details — including who greets a visiting leader at the airport and where they are positioned in official photographs — often convey political messages.
paras.zh: 在本周在深圳举行的亚太经济合作组织峰会等聚会上，礼节细节——包括谁在机场迎接来访的领导人以及他们在官方照片中的位置——通常会传达政治信息。

paras.en: Takaichi was met on the tarmac Wednesday by a retired Chinese diplomat, rather than a serving official, and Japan's ambassador to China, Kenji Kanasugi.
paras.zh: 周三，高市在停机坪上会见了一位退休的中国外交官，而非现任官员，以及日本驻华大使金杉贤二。

paras.en: The low-key reception contrasted sharply with the warmer welcomes given to other visiting leaders, including South Korean President Lee Jae Myung, while U.S. President Donald Trump was greeted personally by Chinese President Xi Jinping.
paras.zh: 这种低调的接待与韩国总统李在明等其他来访领导人受到的热烈欢迎形成鲜明对比，而美国总统唐纳德·特朗普则受到了中国国家主席习近平的亲自迎接。

paras.en: In the leaders' group photo, Takaichi was placed in the back row, off to the side and several places from Xi, who stood alongside Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin.
paras.zh: 在领导人合影中，高市被安排在后排，距离习近平好几个位置，而习近平则与特朗普和俄罗斯总统普京并肩而立。

paras.en: "Beijing sought to downgrade her official status to that of a head of government rather than a head of state," said Jeremy Chan, senior analyst at Eurasia Group.
paras.zh: 欧亚集团高级分析师杰里米·陈(Jeremy Chan)表示：“北京试图将她的官方地位降级为政府首脑，而不是国家元首。”

paras.en: During Thursday morning's greeting line, Takaichi spent several minutes trying to talk to the Chinese leader without an interpreter present, while most leaders exchanged handshakes and kept walking.
paras.zh: 在周四早上的问候语中，高一花了几分钟试图在没有翻译在场的情况下与中国领导人交谈，而大多数领导人交换了握手并继续行走。

paras.en: "It has become increasingly difficult for her to engage in formal or even informal conversations with Xi," said Kei Koga, an associate professor at Nanyang Technological University in Singapore, who sees Takaichi's intention as to still "project the image that she could still communicate with him despite the ongoing tensions."
paras.zh: 新加坡南洋理工大学副教授古贺圭表示，“对她来说，与习近平进行正式甚至非正式的对话变得越来越困难。”他认为，高一的意图仍然是“表现出尽管局势持续紧张，但她仍然可以与他沟通的形象”。

paras.en: At a press briefing Thursday afternoon, Takaichi said Japan's position on Taiwan remained unchanged as stated in the 1972 Japan-China Communique, adding that her leadership has been communicating with Chinese counterparts on rare earth export controls.
paras.zh: 高市在周四下午的新闻发布会上表示，日本在台湾问题上的立场与1972年日中公报中所阐述的立场保持不变，并补充说，她的领导层一直在与中国同行就稀土出口管制问题进行沟通。

paras.en: Takaichi's subdued reception signaled Beijing's lack of enthusiasm to repair ties with Tokyo, analysts said, potentially prolonging China's curbs on critical mineral exports that have gripped Japanese industries for the past year.
paras.zh: 分析人士表示，高市的冷遇表明北京缺乏修复与东京关系的热情，这可能会延长中国对过去一年困扰日本工业的关键矿产出口的限制。

paras.en: "China's frosty reception of Takaichi shows quite clearly that Beijing is not yet ready to forgive her over her remarks about Taiwan," Chan said, expecting the bilateral relationship to remain strained until Takaichi leaves office.
paras.zh: 陈说：“中国对高一的冷淡接待清楚地表明，北京尚未准备好原谅她有关台湾的言论。”他预计，在高一卸任之前，双边关系将继续紧张。

paras.en: That could leave Japan grappling with continued restrictions on rare earth supplies from China next year, said Tianchen Xu, senior economist at the Economist Intelligence Unit.
paras.zh: 经济学人智库高级经济学家徐天辰表示，这可能会让日本明年面临中国稀土供应的持续限制。

paras.en: Relations deteriorated sharply after Takaichi said in November 2025 that a Taiwan Strait crisis could constitute a situation threatening Japan's survival and warrant a self-defense response.
paras.zh: 高一在 2025 年 11 月表示，台海危机可能构成威胁日本生存的局势，需要采取自卫反应后，两国关系急剧恶化。

paras.en: While the substance broadly aligned with Japan's existing security policy, previous prime ministers had generally avoided stating it so explicitly in a Taiwan scenario.
paras.zh: 虽然该内容与日本现有的安全政策大体一致，但历任首相通常都避免在台湾的情况下如此明确地表述这一点。

paras.en: China reacted angrily and demanded that Takaichi retract the remarks. She has not done so, while stating that the door to dialogue with Beijing remains open, with minimal high-level contact over the past year.
paras.zh: 中方愤怒回应，要求高一收回言论。她没有这样做，但表示与北京对话的大门仍然敞开，过去一年高层接触很少。

paras.en: China has since tightened restrictions affecting Japan, including controls on dual-use and rare earth exports with potential military uses. It also discouraged its citizens from traveling to Japan and halted Japanese seafood imports.
paras.zh: 此后，中国加强了对日本的限制，包括对军民两用和具有潜在军事用途的稀土出口的控制。它还阻止其公民前往日本旅行，并停止进口日本海鲜。

paras.en: Takaichi's visit marked the first trip to China by a Japanese prime minister since Shinzo Abe traveled to Chengdu in December 2019 for a trilateral summit with Chinese and South Korean leaders.
paras.zh: 高市的访问是自2019年12月安倍晋三前往成都与中韩领导人举行三边峰会以来日本首相首次访华。

paras.en: No formal Takaichi-Xi meeting has been publicly scheduled during her visit. Meanwhile, Xi is expected to join Trump and Putin for a historic trilateral gathering on Thursday, alongside a bilateral meeting with Trump.
paras.zh: 高市奚访问期间并未公开安排正式会面。与此同时，预计习近平将于周四与特朗普和普京一起参加历史性的三边聚会，同时与特朗普举行双边会晤。

paras.en: Takaichi needs to show a "reflection of what she said about Taiwan a year ago," said Huiyao Wang, founder of the Beijing-based Center for China and Globalization, which is often seen as close to Beijing's thinking.
paras.zh: 总部位于北京的中国与全球化中心创始人王辉耀表示，高市需要“反思她一年前关于台湾的言论”，该中心通常被视为接近北京的想法。

paras.en: Wang said Tokyo should show greater flexibility, pointing to Trump's comments that the U.S. would avoid getting involved in the Taiwan issue. He argued that Japan holding firm on the issue would not help relations with Beijing.
paras.zh: 王说，东京应该表现出更大的灵活性，并指出特朗普关于美国将避免卷入台湾问题的言论。他认为，日本在这个问题上坚持立场无助于改善与北京的关系。

paras.en: Such reflection, he said, "would really help to clarify some of those misunderstandings between the two countries."
paras.zh: 他说，这种反思“确实有助于澄清两国之间的一些误解”。

paras.en: — CNBC's Evelyn Cheng contributed to this report.
paras.zh: — CNBC 的 Evelyn Cheng 对本报告作出了贡献。

articles.title: Why the bipartisan BAAJA permitting bill could quietly revolutionize nuclear power

paras.en: A massive change to the U.S. energy system could be on the way. Congress is considering a new bill—the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act (BAAJA), which, if it becomes law, will speed the construction of new electricity transmission at a time when power demand, particularly from data centers, is skyrocketing.
paras.zh: 美国能源系统可能即将发生巨大变化。国会正在考虑一项新法案——《美国两党负担能力和就业法案》(BAAJA)，如果该法案成为法律，将在电力需求（尤其是数据中心的电力需求）飙升之际加快新电力传输的建设。

paras.en: The bill has split climate advocates because it would accelerate the addition of wind and solar power to the nation’s grid but would also ease permitting for fossil fuel infrastructure such as natural gas pipelines. Another industry is also watching BAAJA closely: nuclear power.
paras.zh: 该法案引起了气候倡导者的分歧，因为它将加速风能和太阳能发电进入国家电网，但也将放宽对天然气管道等化石燃料基础设施的许可。另一个行业也在密切关注 BAAJA：核电。

paras.en: The nuclear industry seems poised for a comeback, particularly new small and micro-sized reactors that use less nuclear fuel and are easier to construct than traditional plants. The key industry regulator, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC), has already begun updating its procedures to accommodate these new types of reactors.
paras.zh: 核工业似乎已准备好卷土重来，特别是新型小型和微型反应堆，它们使用的核燃料更少，而且比传统核电站更容易建造。主要行业监管机构核管理委员会 (NRC) 已开始更新其程序以适应这些新型反应堆。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Four amendments added to the BAAJA bill earlier this month focus on nuclear regulation, potentially speeding permitting and licensing, as well as increasing transparency around nuclear energy. The industry has many challenges, but streamlining permitting could make the difference in getting new power online, experts say. Permitting can account for about 40 percent of the decade or so it takes to plan and construct a new nuclear plant.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，BAAJA 法案增加了四项修正案，重点关注核监管、可能加快许可和许可以及提高核能透明度。专家表示，该行业面临许多挑战，但简化许可可能会对获得新电力产生影响。规划和建造一座新核电站大约需要十年左右的时间，其中 40% 需要获得许可。

paras.en: “Nuclear energy is probably the most highly regulated of our energy-generation sources,” says Ashley Finan, a nuclear scientist and a fellow at Columbia University’s Center on Global Energy Policy, “so there are a lot of places where that regulation can be made more efficient if we take the time to do so thoughtfully.”
paras.zh: “核能可能是我们监管最严格的能源，”哥伦比亚大学全球能源政策中心研究员、核科学家阿什利·菲南 (Ashley Finan) 表示，“因此，如果我们花时间深思熟虑，在很多地方都可以提高监管效率。”

paras.en: Here’s how BAAJA could provide the resurging nuclear industry with a boost.
paras.zh: 以下是 BAAJA 如何为复兴的核工业提供推动。

paras.en: For every type of energy source, BAAJA would relax some of the mandates of the National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA), a 1970 law that requires federal agencies to assess the environmental effects of a project before approving it. The bill would also reduce processes required by other federal laws, such as the National Historic Preservation Act. These changes have drawn opposition from some environmental groups and tribal nations because they would remove certain avenues to raise concerns or advocate for protections for cultural or archaeological sites.
paras.zh: 对于每种类型的能源，BAAJA 都会放宽《国家环境政策法案》(NEPA) 的一些规定，该法案于 1970 年颁布，要求联邦机构在批准项目之前评估项目的环境影响。该法案还将减少其他联邦法律（例如《国家历史保护法》）要求的程序。这些变化引起了一些环保组织和部落国家的反对，因为它们将消除某些引起关注或倡导保护文化或考古遗址的途径。

paras.en: “It is a wholesale change to these review processes as they apply to every single thing the federal government will do moving forward,” says Wesley Furlong, a staff attorney at the Native American Rights Fund, which opposes the changes.
paras.zh: “这是对这些审查程序的彻底改变，因为它们适用于联邦政府今后要做的每一件事，”美国原住民权利基金会的专职律师韦斯利·弗隆表示，该基金会反对这些改变。

paras.en: Provisions of the bill that would speed the addition of new transmission lines and generally reduce red tape around permitting are also likely to make new nuclear projects more appealing, says Erik Cothron, manager of research and strategy at the Nuclear Innovation Alliance, a nonprofit think tank focused on nuclear policy. But the four nuclear-focused changes are particularly exciting, he adds.
paras.zh: 核创新联盟（一家专注于核政策的非营利性智囊团）的研究和战略经理埃里克·科思伦（Erik Cothron）表示，该法案中的条款将加快新输电线路的增加，并普遍减少审批方面的繁文缛节，这也可能使新的核项目更具吸引力。但他补充说，四个以核为重点的变化尤其令人兴奋。

paras.en: The first of these stipulations would remove the requirement that the NRC hold hearings for uncontested permitting and licensing decisions for nuclear reactors and enrichment facilities. Currently, these hearings must be held even in cases in which there are no objections to a new construction permit or operating license, adding costs for companies and slowing down the process. “That’s a really straightforward change that we know will save time,” Finan says.
paras.zh: 其中第一项规定将取消 NRC 就核反应堆和浓缩设施的无争议许可和许可决定举行听证会的要求。目前，即使在没有反对新的施工许可证或经营许可证的情况下，也必须举行这些听证会，这增加了公司的成本并减慢了进程。 “这是一个非常简单的改变，我们知道这会节省时间，”菲南说。

paras.en: The second would allow uranium enrichment facilities to begin construction during the permitting process rather than having to wait for an enrichment permit. This change doesn’t guarantee that the company will be granted a permit to work with nuclear materials, Cothron says. But starting construction early is a financial risk a company may take on if it is confident about its enrichment permit and wants to speed its process.
paras.zh: 第二个将允许铀浓缩设施在许可过程中开始建设，而不必等待浓缩许可证。科斯伦表示，这一变化并不能保证该公司将获得使用核材料的许可。但如果公司对其浓缩许可证有信心并希望加快进程，那么提前开始建设可能会带来财务风险。

paras.en: Another amendment would increase the basic pay cap for NRC staff to keep pay rates competitive with the private sector and retain enough employees to efficiently run the permitting process.
paras.zh: 另一项修正案将提高 NRC 工作人员的基本工资上限，以保持工资水平与私营部门的竞争力，并保留足够的员工来有效地运行许可流程。

paras.en: A final stipulation would increase the Department of Energy’s requirements to publish announcements about actions involving nuclear facilities, such as changes to safety standards, and to report its actions to Congress on a yearly basis. These modifications aren’t designed to speed the regulatory process but rather to increase transparency about the DOE’s oversight, Cothron says, which would help improve public trust.
paras.zh: 最终规定将提高能源部发布有关核设施行动公告的要求，例如安全标准的变更，并每年向国会报告其行动。科斯伦表示，这些修改并不是为了加快监管流程，而是为了提高能源部监督的透明度，这将有助于提高公众的信任。

paras.en: Financing is a major challenge in the nuclear industry, and steps to make the regulatory process shorter and more predictable can help attract investors, Cothron says.
paras.zh: 科斯伦表示，融资是核工业面临的一项重大挑战，采取措施缩短监管流程、提高可预测性有助于吸引投资者。

paras.en: Nevertheless, Finan says, there are other issues to tackle, including the difficulty of securing high-grade enriched uranium fuel, especially from domestic suppliers, and the pervasive problem of cost overruns.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，菲南表示，还有其他问题需要解决，包括难以获得高品位浓缩铀燃料，尤其是从国内供应商那里获得，以及普遍存在的成本超支问题。

paras.en: Much of the enthusiasm around these changes in the nuclear industry is not about building entirely new plants but about restarting old reactors and upgrading existing plants to produce more power, Finan says. By 2032, the NRC is expecting to receive 31 applications to “uprate” existing plants, potentially adding 2,421 megawatts of electric power to the grid. Any kind of permitting efficiency improvements will help bring those uprates online, Finan says.
paras.zh: 菲南说，人们对核工业这些变化的热情主要不是为了建造全新的核电站，而是为了重启旧反应堆和升级现有核电站以产生更多的电力。到 2032 年，NRC 预计将收到 31 份“升级”现有电厂的申请，可能为电网增加 2,421 兆瓦的电力。菲南说，任何允许提高效率的措施都将有助于将这些费用提高到网上。

paras.en: Meanwhile nuclear power companies are also working to restart shuttered plants such as the Crane Clean Energy Center (formerly Three Mile Island) in Pennsylvania and the Palisades Nuclear Power Plant in Michigan. Microsoft and Google are backing some of these projects with guarantees to buy their power to feed the companies’ growing need for data centers.
paras.zh: 与此同时，核电公司也在努力重启关闭的工厂，例如宾夕法尼亚州的克兰清洁能源中心（前身为三英里岛）和密歇根州的帕利塞兹核电站。微软和谷歌正在支持其中一些项目，并保证购买它们的电力来满足公司对数据中心日益增长的需求。

paras.en: Those new facilities that do come online are unlikely to be the huge power plants of yore. Instead the industry is looking to deploy small modular reactors (SMRs), which produce less power than traditional reactors but can be preassembled and shipped to a site for installation, making construction and permitting easier. A typical 300-megawatt SMR can power about 300,000 homes. In September the Tennessee Valley Authority received the first NRC permit for an SMR, which it plans to install near the city of Oak Ridge, Tenn. The aim is for the site to start producing power in 2033.
paras.zh: 那些确实上线的新设施不太可能是以前的大型发电厂。相反，该行业正在寻求部署小型模块化反应堆（SMR），这种反应堆产生的电力比传统反应堆少，但可以预先组装并运送到现场进行安装，从而使施工和许可变得更加容易。典型的 300 兆瓦 SMR 可为约 300,000 个家庭供电。 9 月，田纳西河谷管理局获得了第一个 NRC 的 SMR 许可证，计划在田纳西州橡树岭市附近安装 SMR。目标是该地点于 2033 年开始发电。

paras.en: Even smaller reactors, called microreactors, may also be on the horizon: The units are compact enough to ship by truck or train and can produce up to 20 megawatts of thermal energy to provide power to rural communities, factories or data centers. Microreactors are still in the development stage, but earlier this year the company Valar Atomics submitted a proposal to the Bureau of Land Management to build a microreactor-powered data center on public land near Price, Utah. That proposal is still under review.
paras.zh: 甚至更小的反应堆（称为微反应堆）也可能即将出现：这些装置足够紧凑，可以通过卡车或火车运输，并且可以产生高达 20 兆瓦的热能，为农村社区、工厂或数据中心提供电力。微反应器仍处于开发阶段，但今年早些时候，Valar Atomics 公司向土地管理局提交了一份提案，要求在犹他州普莱斯附近的公共土地上建造一个由微反应器驱动的数据中心。该提案仍在审查中。

paras.en: BAAJA doesn’t directly address the new regulations that need to be in place for these new technologies, but the NRC has made major strides in its own process, Cothron says. They’ll need to keep updating along with the technology, should SMRs and microreactors take off.
paras.zh: Cothron 表示，BAAJA 并没有直接解决这些新技术需要制定的新法规，但 NRC 在自己的流程中取得了重大进展。如果小型反应堆和微反应器蓬勃发展，他们需要不断更新技术。

paras.en: It would be a shift from thinking about “how the NRC can perform licensing activities for one or two reactors per year,” he says, to considering “dozens of reactors per year.”*
paras.zh: 他说，这将是一个转变，从考虑“NRC 如何每年为一两个反应堆进行许可活动”，到考虑“每年数十个反应堆”。*

paras.en: *Editor’s Note (11/18/26): This sentence was edited after posting to correct the description of Erik Cothron’s statement.
paras.zh: *编者注（11/18/26）：这句话在发布后进行了编辑，以更正 Erik Cothron 声明的描述。

articles.title: Key Senate committee refuses to vote on Trump’s nominee to lead the National Science Foundation, Jim O’Neill

paras.en: Just hours after the Trump administration dropped its nominee to lead the Food and Drug Administration, a key Senate committee pulled the plug on a vote for the White House nominee to lead the National Science Foundation (NSF) as well.
paras.zh: 就在特朗普政府放弃领导美国食品和药物管理局的提名人数小时后，参议院一个重要委员会终止了对白宫提名人领导国家科学基金会（NSF）的投票。

paras.en: On Tuesday the White House announced it would not move forward with Heidi Overton’s candidacy for commissioner of the Food and Drug Administration. And on Wednesday, during opening remarks for a hearing of the Senate Committee on Health, Education, Labor and Pensions, Senator Bill Cassidy of Louisiana said Jim O’Neill, who previously served as acting director of the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, would not be considered to lead the NSF.
paras.zh: 周二，白宫宣布不会推进海蒂·奥弗顿 (Heidi Overton) 的食品和药物管理局局长候选人资格。周三，在参议院健康、教育、劳工和养老金委员会的听证会上，路易斯安那州参议员比尔·卡西迪表示，此前担任疾病控制和预防中心代理主任的吉姆·奥尼尔不会被考虑领导国家科学基金会。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: O’Neill “did not do enough to stand up for science and against irresponsible decisions and statements from [Secretary of Health and Human Services Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.],” Cassidy said. “His role in the firing of Dr. Susan Monarez raised further concerns about the independent judgment he would bring to NSF.”
paras.zh: 卡西迪说，奥尼尔“在捍卫科学和反对[卫生与公众服务部部长小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪]不负责任的决定和声明方面做得不够。” “他在解雇苏珊·莫纳雷斯博士中所扮演的角色进一步引发了人们对他将向国家科学基金会提出的独立判断的担忧。”

paras.en: Monarez was fired as CDC director in 2025, a move she blamed on her refusal to approve vaccine recommendations that lacked evidence or to fire agency employees without cause.
