articles.title: COP31: The push to protect warming oceans reaches the negotiating table

paras.en: COP31: The push to protect warming oceans reaches the negotiating table
paras.zh: COP31：保护海洋变暖的努力进入谈判桌

paras.en: From identifying marine life with a cup of seawater to drawing on Indigenous knowledge to prevent wildfires, scientists and communities showcased both cutting-edge and time-tested ways to protect nature at COP31 on Tuesday. Yet turning innovation into action remains a challenge, with funding gaps persisting and ministers struggling to bridge divisions over fossil fuels and climate finance as negotiations enter their final days.
paras.zh: 从用一杯海水识别海洋生物到利用土著知识来预防野火，科学家和社区在周二的 COP31 上展示了保护自然的前沿且经过时间考验的方法。然而，将创新转化为行动仍然是一项挑战，资金缺口持续存在，随着谈判进入最后几天，部长们努力弥合化石燃料和气候融资方面的分歧。

paras.en: - Oceans: New research finds that more than 95 per cent of coastal and island nations include ocean measures in their climate plans.
paras.zh: - 海洋：新研究发现，95%以上的沿海国家和岛屿国家将海洋措施纳入其气候计划中。

paras.en: - Nature: Twenty-three countries endorse a wildfire prevention plan that draws on Indigenous knowledge and science.
paras.zh: - 自然：二十三个国家批准了一项利用本土知识和科学的野火预防计划。

paras.en: - Climate impacts: Dominica, Myanmar and Honduras top a new ranking of countries hardest hit by extreme weather over 30 years.
paras.zh: - 气候影响：多米尼克、缅甸和洪都拉斯在 30 年来受极端天气影响最严重的国家排名中名列前茅。

paras.en: - Negotiations: A draft text leaves ministers with major differences to resolve before Friday’s deadline. COP31 is set to close on 20 November.
paras.zh: - 谈判：文本草案让部长们在周五的截止日期之前解决了重大分歧。 COP31 定于 11 月 20 日闭幕。

paras.en: Bob Marley’s Get Up, Stand Up greeted ministers arriving at COP31 in Antalya on Tuesday, as protesters urged them to fight for climate justice.
paras.zh: 周二，鲍勃·马利 (Bob Marley) 的《站起来，站起来》向抵达安塔利亚 COP31 的部长们致意，抗议者敦促他们为气候正义而战。

paras.en: “Standing up” is the easy part. Reaching agreement is proving considerably harder.
paras.zh: “站起来”是比较容易的部分。事实证明，达成一致要困难得多。

paras.en: The 18-page draft cover decision circulated on Monday remains a maze of competing proposals, while ministers take turns outlining national priorities in the plenary.
paras.zh: 周一分发的 18 页封面决定草案仍然充满了相互竞争的提案，而部长们则轮流在全体会议上概述国家优先事项。

paras.en: Away from the wrangling over text, the day’s spotlight fell on oceans and forests, nature’s great climate defenders, now facing mounting pressure from the very crisis they help contain.
paras.zh: 除了文本争论之外，当天的焦点集中在海洋和森林上，它们是大自然伟大的气候捍卫者，现在面临着它们帮助遏制的危机带来的越来越大的压力。

paras.en: Despite their critical role in regulating the climate, oceans have often been overlooked in international climate negotiations. Now, they feature prominently in the first draft of a possible COP31 deal, reflecting efforts by co-hosts Australia and Türkiye to strengthen ocean-related climate action.
paras.zh: 尽管海洋在调节气候方面发挥着关键作用，但在国际气候谈判中却常常被忽视。现在，它们在可能的 COP31 协议的初稿中占据显着位置，反映了共同主办国澳大利亚和土耳其为加强与海洋相关的气候行动所做的努力。

paras.en: Whether those provisions survive the final round of negotiations, however, remains uncertain.
paras.zh: 然而，这些条款能否在最后一轮谈判中幸存下来仍不确定。

paras.en: For Marine Lecerf, Head of International Policy at the Ocean and Climate Platform, the priority is not securing new commitments but delivering on existing ones.
paras.zh: 对于海洋与气候平台国际政策主管马琳·莱瑟夫来说，首要任务不是确保新的承诺，而是兑现现有的承诺。

paras.en: “We’re not asking for a new mandate, we're asking for acceleration,” she told journalists on Tuesday.
paras.zh: “我们不是要求新的授权，而是要求加速，”她周二告诉记者。

paras.en: A new analysis presented at COP31 underscores that challenge. More than 95 per cent of coastal and island nations now include ocean-related measures in their national climate plans, the study found. Yet around 60 per cent of those commitments depend on additional financing or technical support.
paras.zh: COP31 上提出的一项新分析强调了这一挑战。研究发现，超过 95% 的沿海和岛屿国家现已将与海洋相关的措施纳入其国家气候计划中。然而，其中大约 60% 的承诺依赖于额外的融资或技术支持。

paras.en: For Brianna Fruean, a Pacific youth climate envoy, that funding gap is already being felt by communities taking adaptation into their own hands.
paras.zh: 对于太平洋青年气候特使布里安娜·弗鲁安（Brianna Fruean）来说，将适应行动掌握在自己手中的社区已经感受到了资金缺口。

paras.en: In Fiji, for example, residents of Naidiri village have financed their own marine protected area, restoring coral reefs and fish stocks to safeguard the waters on which they depend.
paras.zh: 例如，在斐济，奈迪里村的居民资助了自己的海洋保护区，恢复珊瑚礁和鱼类资源，以保护他们赖以生存的水域。

paras.en: “They shouldn't be taking money out of their own pockets to pay for these adaptation measures,” she said.
paras.zh: “他们不应该从自己的口袋里掏钱来支付这些适应措施，”她说。

paras.en: The ocean has been one of humanity's greatest allies against climate change, absorbing around 90 per cent of the excess heat generated by global warming. But that protection comes at a cost, as warming waters threaten coral reefs, fisheries and coastal communities.
paras.zh: 海洋一直是人类应对气候变化最强大的盟友之一，吸收了全球变暖产生的约 90% 的多余热量。但这种保护是有代价的，因为海水变暖威胁着珊瑚礁、渔业和沿海社区。

paras.en: Yet much of the ocean remains unexplored.
paras.zh: 然而，大部分海洋仍未被勘探。

paras.en: “Satellites cannot see beyond the surface of the ocean,” Joanna Post, Head of Ocean Observations at UNESCO’s Intergovernmental Oceanographic Commission, told UN News.
paras.zh: 联合国教科文组织政府间海洋学委员会海洋观测负责人乔安娜·波斯特告诉《联合国新闻》：“卫星无法看到海洋表面以外的地方。”

paras.en: “We’ve only mapped about 28 per cent of the seafloor. And there are species out there we haven't yet discovered.”
paras.zh: “我们只绘制了大约 28% 的海底地图。而且还有一些物种我们尚未发现。”

paras.en: To close those knowledge gaps, UNESCO and its partners are turning to an unlikely source: a cup of seawater.
paras.zh: 为了缩小这些知识差距，教科文组织及其合作伙伴正在转向一个意想不到的来源：一杯海水。

paras.en: Using environmental DNA, or ‘eDNA’, scientists can identify species from the genetic traces they leave behind. UNESCO's eDNA Expeditions programme is using the technology at 25 marine sites worldwide, with local communities and schoolchildren helping collect samples every three months.
paras.zh: 利用环境 DNA（即“eDNA”），科学家可以根据物种留下的遗传痕迹来识别物种。联合国教科文组织的 eDNA 探险计划正在全球 25 个海洋地点使用该技术，当地社区和学童每三个月帮助收集一次样本。

paras.en: As warming waters drive species into new habitats, the findings could help governments identify which marine areas most need protection.
paras.zh: 随着海水变暖促使物种进入新的栖息地，这些发现可以帮助政府确定哪些海洋区域最需要保护。

paras.en: But far more data is needed. At COP31, Canada and the European Union sought additional support for the OceanEye International Alliance, a partnership with UNESCO aimed at strengthening global ocean monitoring.
paras.zh: 但还需要更多的数据。在 COP31 上，加拿大和欧盟为 OceanEye 国际联盟寻求更多支持，该联盟与教科文组织合作，旨在加强全球海洋监测。

paras.en: “Ocean observations and data have quietly informed decision-making for a long time,” Post said. “They’re often unrecognized, but they’re powerful.”
paras.zh: “长期以来，海洋观测和数据一直悄悄地为决策提供信息，”波斯特说。 “他们常常不为人所知，但他们很强大。”

paras.en: She called for sustained investment in ocean monitoring rather than continued reliance on short-term research projects.
paras.zh: 她呼吁对海洋监测进行持续投资，而不是继续依赖短期研究项目。

paras.en: Türkiye also unveiled its Marine Litter Action Platform on Tuesday, connecting pollution-prevention initiatives with expertise and financing, including efforts to tackle abandoned fishing nets that entangle turtles, seabirds and other marine wildlife.
paras.zh: 土耳其周二还推出了海洋垃圾行动平台，将污染预防举措与专业知识和资金联系起来，包括努力解决缠绕海龟、海鸟和其他海洋野生动物的废弃渔网。

paras.en: Meanwhile, in Chad, Indigenous communities have long relied on the stars, clouds and movements of animals to anticipate rains, droughts and other environmental changes.
paras.zh: 与此同时，在乍得，土著社区长期以来一直依靠星星、云彩和动物的活动来预测降雨、干旱和其他环境变化。

paras.en: “They are our best school and our best technology,” Indigenous climate advocate Hindou Oumarou Ibrahim told UN News, describing knowledge passed down through generations.
paras.zh: “他们是我们最好的学校和我们最好的技术，”原住民气候倡导者印度杜·奥马鲁·易卜拉欣（Hindou Oumarou Ibrahim）在描述代代相传的知识时告诉《联合国新闻》。

paras.en: That same wisdom is helping countries rethink how they prepare for increasingly destructive wildfires.
paras.zh: 同样的智慧正在帮助各国重新思考如何为破坏性日益增强的野火做好准备。

paras.en: At COP31, 23 countries endorsed the Antalya Action Plan on Integrated Fire Management, backed by the UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), shifting the focus from fighting fires to preventing them.
paras.zh: 在联合国粮食及农业组织 (FAO) 的支持下，23 个国家在 COP31 上批准了《安塔利亚综合火灾管理行动计划》，将重点从扑救转移到预防。

paras.en: “Learning from Indigenous Peoples’ traditional practices and uses of fire can really help teach us how to live with good fire,” FAO forestry expert Amy Duchelle told UN News.
paras.zh: “学习土著人民的传统习俗和用火确实有助于教会我们如何用善火生活，”粮农组织林业专家艾米·杜谢尔告诉《联合国新闻》。

paras.en: The approach includes carefully managed burning to maintain healthier landscapes, reduce fuel loads and lower the risk of devastating wildfires.
paras.zh: 该方法包括精心管理燃烧，以保持更健康的景观、减少燃料负载并降低毁灭性野火的风险。

paras.en: - Forests: Ghana became the first African country to receive forest carbon credits under the ART TREES standard, recognizing efforts to curb deforestation across 2.5 million hectares.
paras.zh: - 森林：加纳成为第一个根据 ART TREES 标准获得森林碳信用额的非洲国家，表彰其为遏制 250 万公顷森林砍伐所做的努力。

paras.en: - Peatlands: A new initiative aims to restore 30 million hectares of degraded peatlands and mobilize $100 billion for conservation and climate action.
paras.zh: - 泥炭地：一项新举措旨在恢复 3000 万公顷退化的泥炭地，并筹集 1000 亿美元用于保护和气候行动。

paras.en: - Coral reefs: More than $30 million was announced for reef conservation projects in 22 developing countries.
paras.zh: - 珊瑚礁：宣布为 22 个发展中国家的珊瑚礁保护项目提供超过 3000 万美元的资金。

paras.en: - Indigenous rights: More than 50 Indigenous and community organizations urged governments to honour commitments to protect their lands, calling for stronger rights and direct conservation funding.
paras.zh: - 原住民权利：50 多个原住民和社区组织敦促各国政府履行保护其土地的承诺，呼吁加强权利和直接保护资金。

paras.en: - Oceans: The European Union joined the Blue NDC Challenge, an initiative led by France and Brazil to help countries put ocean commitments in their climate plans into practice.
paras.zh: - 海洋：欧盟加入了蓝色国家数据中心挑战，这是一项由法国和巴西牵头的倡议，旨在帮助各国将其气候计划中的海洋承诺付诸实践。

paras.en: New ranking reveals countries hardest hit by extreme weather
paras.zh: 新排名显示受极端天气影响最严重的国家

paras.en: As countries showcased new ways to protect nature, a new report released at COP31 highlighted the growing human cost of climate change.
paras.zh: 随着各国展示保护自然的新方法，COP31 上发布的一份新报告强调了气候变化造成的人类成本不断增加。

paras.en: Dominica, Myanmar and Honduras were the countries hardest hit by extreme weather over the past three decades, according to Germanwatch’s Climate Risk Index 2027.
paras.zh: 根据 Germanwatch 的 2027 年气候风险指数，多米尼克、缅甸和洪都拉斯是过去三十年来受极端天气影响最严重的国家。

paras.en: “Behind these figures are families who lost their homes, children unable to attend school, farmers who lost their crops, and communities isolated for weeks,” Honduras's Vice Minister of Finance, Roberto Chang López, told journalists, recalling the devastation caused by Hurricane Mitch.
paras.zh: 洪都拉斯财政部副部长罗伯托·张·洛佩斯在回忆飓风米奇造成的破坏时告诉记者：“这些数字背后是失去家园的家庭、无法上学的儿童、失去庄稼的农民以及被隔离数周的社区。”

paras.en: The ranking examines not only economic losses but also deaths and the number of people affected by disasters, including those injured or displaced, across 178 countries.
paras.zh: 该排名不仅考察了 178 个国家的经济损失，还考察了死亡人数以及受灾害影响的人数，包括受伤或流离失所的人数。

paras.en: According to the NGO, extreme weather claimed more than 916,000 lives and affected over 5.5 billion people worldwide between 1996 and 2025. Heatwaves accounted for 40 per cent of deaths, while floods affected the greatest number of people.
paras.zh: 据该非政府组织称，1996 年至 2025 年间，极端天气夺走了全球超过 916,000 人的生命，影响了超过 55 亿人。热浪造成的死亡人数占 40%，而洪水影响的人数最多。

paras.en: For 2025 alone, Jamaica topped the ranking following Hurricane Melissa, ahead of Sri Lanka and Spain.
paras.zh: 仅在 2025 年，牙买加就在梅丽莎飓风之后位居榜首，领先于斯里兰卡和西班牙。

paras.en: Follow the latest developments from COP31 through our new podcast, Talk & Action, and our special daily coverage of the conference.
paras.zh: 通过我们的新播客、Talk & Action 以及我们对会议的每日特别报道，关注 COP31 的最新进展。

articles.title: World News in Brief: Ebola cases double in DR Congo, chemical exposure starts before birth, Türk concern over EU-Rwanda transfer plan

paras.en: World News in Brief: Ebola cases double in DR Congo, chemical exposure starts before birth, Türk concern over EU-Rwanda transfer plan
paras.zh: 世界新闻简讯：刚果民主共和国埃博拉病例翻倍，出生前就开始接触化学品，土耳其对欧盟-卢旺达转移计划的担忧

paras.en: Opening the third meeting of WHO’s Emergency Committee on the Bundibugyo virus disease epidemic, Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said children were “paying a terrible price”. They account for more than a quarter of confirmed cases and a third of deaths, and seven in ten children under five with confirmed Ebola have died.
paras.zh: 世卫组织总干事谭德塞在世卫组织本迪布焦病毒病疫情紧急委员会第三次会议开幕式上表示，儿童正在“付出可怕的代价”。他们占确诊病例的四分之一以上和死亡人数的三分之一，五岁以下感染埃博拉病毒的儿童中有十分之七已死亡。

paras.en: “The risk beyond the DRC’s borders is not theoretical,” he said. Kenya has reported nine cases linked to an imported case, including two deaths, and Nigeria has reported one imported case.
paras.zh: “刚果民主共和国境外的风险并不是理论上的，”他说。肯尼亚报告了 9 例与输入病例有关的病例，其中 2 例死亡，尼日利亚报告了 1 例输入病例。

paras.en: He also expressed concern that some countries continue to apply blanket travel restrictions, which hinder the response and discourage countries from reporting outbreaks quickly.
paras.zh: 他还对一些国家继续实行全面旅行限制表示担忧，这阻碍了应对工作，并阻碍各国迅速报告疫情。

paras.en: Elaborating on the progress made, Dr Tedros said rapid transmission has been halted in most of the early epicentres, and the number of laboratories able to test for the virus has risen from two to more than two dozen. Two candidate vaccines developed specifically for Bundibugyo virus will be added to an ongoing vaccine trial in the coming weeks.
paras.zh: 谭德塞博士在阐述所取得的进展时表示，大多数早期疫情中心的快速传播已经停止，能够检测病毒的实验室数量已从两个增加到两打以上。专为本迪布焦病毒开发的两种候选疫苗将在未来几周内添加到正在进行的疫苗试验中。

paras.en: “But progress in some places is not control of the outbreak as a whole,” Dr. Tedros warned. Between 400 and 500 new cases are still reported every week, and two-thirds of confirmed deaths occur outside Ebola treatment centres, a sign that infections are being identified too late.
paras.zh: 谭德塞博士警告说：“但某些地方的进展并不能从整体上控制疫情。”每周仍报告 400 至 500 例新病例，三分之二的确诊死亡病例发生在埃博拉治疗中心之外，这表明发现感染病例为时已晚。

paras.en: Exposure to hormone-disrupting chemicals can begin before birth
paras.zh: 接触干扰激素的化学物质可能在出生前就开始了

paras.en: Exposure to endocrine-disrupting chemicals (EDCs) can begin before birth, with a broader range of effects on human and environmental health than previously understood, a new report released by the UN Enviornment Programme (UNEP) and WHO revealed on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 联合国环境规划署（UNEP）和世界卫生组织（WHO）周二发布的一份新报告显示，接触内分泌干扰化学物质（EDC）可能在出生前就开始，对人类和环境健康的影响范围比此前所了解的更为广泛。

paras.en: The chemicals, which can interfere with the body’s hormones, have been detected in blood, breast milk and cord blood. Early exposure can have lasting effects on brain development, growth and reproductive health.
paras.zh: 这些化学物质会干扰人体的激素，已在血液、母乳和脐带血中检测到。早期接触会对大脑发育、生长和生殖健康产生持久影响。

paras.en: The State of the Science on Endocrine-Disrupting Chemicals 2026 is the first major global update since 2012. It finds stronger evidence linking EDCs to effects on fertility, brain development, thyroid and other hormone regulation, metabolism, immunity and cardiovascular health. In fish, birds, amphibians and mammals, exposure has been linked to impaired reproduction, development and behaviour.
paras.zh: 《2026 年内分泌干扰化学品科学状况》是自 2012 年以来首次全球重大更新。它发现了更有力的证据，证明内分泌干扰物对生育、大脑发育、甲状腺和其他激素调节、新陈代谢、免疫和心血管健康的影响。对于鱼类、鸟类、两栖动物和哺乳动物来说，接触该物质会导致繁殖、发育和行为受损。

paras.en: “These effects can be long-lasting and, in some cases, irreversible,” said Sheila Aggarwal Khan, Director of UNEP’s Industry and Economy Division.
paras.zh: 环境署工业和经济司司长希拉·阿加瓦尔·汗 (Sheila Aggarwal Khan) 表示：“这些影响可能是持久的，在某些情况下甚至是不可逆转的。”

paras.en: More than 350,000 chemicals and chemical mixtures are registered for production and use globally, yet only a small fraction have been evaluated for endocrine-disrupting properties. According to the study, the global cost of diseases associated with EDC exposure could amount to one per cent or more of global GDP.
paras.zh: 全球有超过 350,000 种化学品和化学混合物注册用于生产和使用，但只有一小部分经过了内分泌干扰特性评估。根据这项研究，全球与 EDC 接触相关的疾病造成的损失可能达到全球 GDP 的百分之一或更多。

paras.en: “Protecting health means preventing harmful exposures before they occur,” said Bruce Gordon, acting Director of WHO’s Department of Environment, Climate Change, One Health and Migration.
paras.zh: 世卫组织环境、气候变化、同一个健康和移民司代理司长布鲁斯·戈登说：“保护健康意味着在有害接触发生之前预防它们。”

paras.en: The report was launched at the first International Conference of the Global Framework on Chemicals, which runs in Geneva until 20 November.
paras.zh: 该报告是在第一届全球化学品框架国际会议上发布的，该会议在日内瓦举行，直至 11 月 20 日结束。

paras.en: Türk raises rights concerns over EU-Rwanda transfer proposal
paras.zh: 蒂尔克对欧盟-卢旺达转移提案提出权利担忧

paras.en: UN human rights chief Volker Türk has raised concern about the human rights risks of a proposal to transfer people from five European Union countries to Rwanda, “where they have no genuine connection and which has its own set of human rights challenges”.
paras.zh: 联合国人权事务高级专员沃尔克·蒂尔克对一项将人员从五个欧盟国家转移到卢旺达的提议的人权风险表示担忧，“他们在那里没有真正的联系，而且卢旺达也面临着一系列人权挑战”。

paras.en: Mr. Türk said his Office was not privy to the text of the proposal.
paras.zh: 图尔克先生表示，他的办公室并不了解该提案的文本。

paras.en: “The solution does not lie in single measures – often very costly – of finding countries far away to deal with one aspect of migration governance, or in externalising human rights obligations,” he said.
paras.zh: 他表示：“解决方案并不在于采取单一措施——通常成本高昂——寻找遥远的国家来处理移民治理的某一方面问题，或者将人权义务具体化。”

paras.en: Instead, he called for the drivers of migration to be tackled head-on, including through investment that creates viable opportunities at home.
paras.zh: 相反，他呼吁正面解决移民的驱动因素，包括通过投资在国内创造可行的机会。

paras.en: Those drivers include human rights challenges, huge inequalities, an inequitable economic and financial system that disadvantages many countries in the Global South, a surge in violent conflicts and heightened geopolitical tensions.
paras.zh: 这些驱动因素包括人权挑战、巨大的不平等、不公平的经济和金融体系（对南半球许多国家不利）、暴力冲突激增以及地缘政治紧张局势加剧。

paras.en: At the same time, societies in the Global North are rapidly ageing and grappling with labour shortages, Mr. Türk noted.
paras.zh: 图尔克先生指出，与此同时，北半球国家的社会正在迅速老龄化，并面临劳动力短缺的问题。

paras.en: He called for a comprehensive approach to migration governance anchored in human rights, including expanded regular migration pathways.
paras.zh: 他呼吁采取以人权为基础的全面移民治理方法，包括扩大正常移民途径。

articles.title: COP31 deadlock persists as countries launch new ‘climate reality check’

paras.en: COP31 deadlock persists as countries launch new ‘climate reality check’
paras.zh: 随着各国启动新的“气候现实检查”，COP31僵局持续存在

paras.en: With the clock running down at COP31 in Antalya, countries on Wednesday launched a new global check on whether climate promises are being kept, even as ministers remained deadlocked over some of the summit’s toughest questions: who pays, how fast the world moves away from fossil fuels and whether a greener future can be called “just” if poorer countries cannot afford it.
paras.zh: 随着安塔利亚 COP31 会议的时间临近，各国于周三启动了一项新的全球检查，以检查气候承诺是否得到兑现，尽管部长们在峰会上一些最棘手的问题上仍陷入僵局：谁支付费用、世界以多快的速度摆脱化石燃料，以及如果较贫穷国家负担不起，更绿色的未来是否可以被称为“公正”。

paras.en: - Global Stocktake: Countries launched the second five-yearly check of collective progress under the Paris Agreement.
paras.zh: - 全球盘点：各国启动了《巴黎协定》下第二次集体进展五年期检查。

paras.en: - Negotiations: Twenty-one issues remain unresolved, and new draft texts are due early Thursday as ministers try to narrow differences.
paras.zh: - 谈判：仍有二十一个问题悬而未决，新的文本草案将于周四早些时候发布，部长们正试图缩小分歧。

paras.en: - Just transition: A giant signed banner outside the talks underscored civil society’s demand: protect workers and communities as economies go green.
paras.zh: - 公正过渡：会谈外的巨型签名横幅强调了民间社会的需求：在经济走向绿色的同时保护工人和社区。

paras.en: - Human, Social Development and Gender Day: From women’s invisible work to the future of jobs, the focus shifted to what climate policy means for people.
paras.zh: - 人类、社会发展和性别日：从女性的无形工作到就业的未来，焦点转向气候政策对人们意味着什么。

paras.en: The second Global Stocktake is essentially the Paris Agreement’s five-yearly reality check measuring whether national plans and promises add up to enough action to cut emissions, adapt to climate change and support countries most in need.
paras.zh: 第二次全球盘点本质上是《巴黎协定》的五年一次现实检查，衡量国家计划和承诺是否足以采取足够的行动来减少排放、适应气候变化和支持最需要的国家。

paras.en: The first Stocktake, completed in COP28 Dubai in 2023, helped spur agreements to triple renewable energy capacity, double gains in energy efficiency and accelerate the transition away from fossil fuels in energy systems.
paras.zh: 第一次盘点于 2023 年在迪拜举行的 COP28 会议上完成，有助于推动达成协议，将可再生能源产能提高三倍，能源效率提高一倍，并加速能源系统中从化石燃料的过渡。

paras.en: This one concludes in 2028 – the last before 2030.
paras.zh: 本次会议将于 2028 年结束，也是 2030 年之前的最后一次。

paras.en: For UN climate chief Simon Stiell, countdown has already begun.
paras.zh: 对于联合国气候变化负责人西蒙·斯蒂尔来说，倒计时已经开始。

paras.en: “We have two years”, he said, calling on governments to turn the first stocktake’s targets into real-world progress.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们还有两年的时间”，并呼吁各国政府将第一次盘点的目标转化为现实世界的进展。

paras.en: “Yes, geopolitical headwinds are fierce, but an ambitious outcome is within reach.”
paras.zh: “是的，地缘政治阻力很猛烈，但雄心勃勃的结果是可以实现的。”

paras.en: A key question is whether governments will have the latest science when the next Stocktake wraps up
paras.zh: 一个关键问题是，下次盘点结束时，政府是否会掌握最新的科学知识

paras.en: The Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC), the UN-backed body that assesses climate research, is facing a dispute over timing. Several vulnerable countries want its next major reports completed in time to inform the process, while others, including Russia, Saudi Arabia and China, argue the schedule is too compressed and could limit meaningful participation by developing-country scientists.
paras.zh: 政府间气候变化专门委员会（IPCC）是联合国支持的评估气候研究的机构，目前正面临时间安排的争议。一些脆弱国家希望及时完成下一份主要报告，为这一进程提供信息，而俄罗斯、沙特阿拉伯和中国等其他国家则认为时间表过于紧凑，可能会限制发展中国家科学家的有意义的参与。

paras.en: IPCC Chair Jim Skea explained the assessments would cover some of the biggest questions now facing negotiators.
paras.zh: IPCC 主席 Jim Skea 解释说，评估将涵盖谈判人员目前面临的一些最大问题。

paras.en: “The Working Group Two report…will cast light on collective progress towards achieving the global goal on adaptation,” he said. “It will address adaptation finance for the first time and responses to losses and damages.”
paras.zh: “第二工作组的报告……将揭示实现全球适应目标的集体进展，”他说。 “它将首次解决适应融资问题以及对损失和损害的应对措施。”

paras.en: Earlier this week, scientists and climate leaders at COP31 called for the Panel, and its independence, to be funded and defended.
paras.zh: 本周早些时候，COP31 上的科学家和气候领导人呼吁为该小组及其独立性提供资金和捍卫。

paras.en: Meanwhile, in a mid-week letter to delegations, the COP31 Presidency said 21 issues remain unresolved, including adaptation, finance, mitigation and just transition, with new texts on these “negotiating tracks” due early Thursday and little room left for extra time.
paras.zh: 与此同时，COP31主席在周中致各代表团的信中表示，仍有21个问题尚未解决，包括适应、融资、缓解和公正过渡，有关这些“谈判轨道”的新文本将于周四早些时候发布，留给加时的空间已经所剩无几。

paras.en: A fresh version of the wider political deal is also in the works after the first draft exposed divisions over fossil fuels, finance, the 1.5°C goal, electrification and science.
paras.zh: 在初稿暴露了化石燃料、金融、1.5°C目标、电气化和科学方面的分歧之后，更广泛的政治协议的新版本也在酝酿之中。

paras.en: Yes, geopolitical headwinds are fierce, but an ambitious outcome is within reach – UN climate chief Simon Stiell
paras.zh: 是的，地缘政治逆风很猛烈，但雄心勃勃的成果是可以实现的——联合国气候变化负责人西蒙·斯蒂尔

paras.en: Türkiye’s 35x35 target – raising electricity’s share of global final energy use to 35 per cent by 2035 – now has the backing of 75 countries.
paras.zh: 土耳其的 35x35 目标——到 2035 年将电力在全球最终能源使用中的份额提高到 35%——现已得到 75 个国家的支持。

paras.en: In the late afternoon, Ministers met behind closed doors for a Divan, a Turkish-style political open exchange that had as a goal to narrow their differences.
paras.zh: 下午晚些时候，部长们闭门举行了一次 Divan，这是一种土耳其式的政治公开交流，其目标是缩小分歧。

paras.en: Outside the negotiation rooms, observers told UN News they were rather confident the conference run at least one extra night. COP31 is set to close on Friday.
paras.zh: 在谈判室外，观察员告诉《联合国新闻》，他们相当有信心会议至少能多举办一晚。 COP31 定于周五闭幕。

paras.en: Some carried giant banners and megaphones; others headed straight to the press conference rooms. Either way, civil society groups had blunt messages for the negotiators.
paras.zh: 有些人举着巨大的横幅和扩音器；有些人则举着巨大的横幅和扩音器。其他人则直接前往新闻发布室。无论哪种方式，民间社会团体都向谈判者传达了直率的信息。

paras.en: Seher Raheja of India’s Centre for Science and Environment said finance talks were drifting towards delay rather than agreement. She said that in one room, the entire text remained in brackets – COP shorthand for no agreement at all.
paras.zh: 印度科学与环境中心的塞赫·拉赫贾 (Seher Raheja) 表示，财务谈判正朝着推迟而不是达成协议的方向发展。她说，在一个房间里，整个文本都保留在括号中——COP 的简写，表示根本没有达成一致。

paras.en: “It’s kicking the can down the road,” she said. “You cannot demand ambition from developing countries while withholding the means to deliver it.”
paras.zh: “这是在把罐子踢到路上，”她说。 “你不能要求发展中国家有雄心壮志，却又不提供实现这一目标的手段。”

paras.en: On adaptation, Pooja Dave of Climate Action Network International was even blunter.
paras.zh: 在适应方面，国际气候行动网络的普贾·戴夫 (Pooja Dave) 甚至更加直言不讳。

paras.en: “You made a promise, a commitment, and you are breaking that commitment,” she said. “This is literally about our survival.”
paras.zh: “你做出了承诺，做出了承诺，但你却违背了这个承诺，”她说。 “这确实关系到我们的生存。”

paras.en: She questioned the value of negotiating ever more elaborate ways to measure adaptation if countries lack the resources to protect people from worsening climate impacts.
paras.zh: 她质疑，如果各国缺乏资源来保护人们免受日益恶化的气候影响，那么谈判更加复杂的方法来衡量适应措施是否有价值。

paras.en: “When there is no adaptation on the ground, what are we monitoring?”
paras.zh: “当地面没有适应时，我们在监测什么？”

paras.en: That familiar fight over who pays and who gets protected ran through Wednesday’s Human, Social Development and Gender Day.
paras.zh: 关于谁付费、谁受到保护的这场熟悉的争论贯穿了周三的人类、社会发展和性别日。

paras.en: What does a just transition actually mean?
paras.zh: 公正过渡到底意味着什么？

paras.en: One of the biggest unresolved fights at COP31 is over just transition: how to move away from high-emitting industries without leaving workers and communities to bear the cost.
paras.zh: COP31 上尚未解决的最大争论之一是关于公正转型：如何在不让工人和社区承担成本的情况下摆脱高排放行业。

paras.en: Economist Mariana Mazzucato told UN News the debate is too often reduced to finding more money.
paras.zh: 经济学家玛丽安娜·马祖卡托 (Mariana Mazzucato) 告诉《联合国新闻》，争论往往被简化为寻找更多资金。

paras.en: “We don't fix markets. We shape the market to deliver inclusive and sustainable growth,” she said.
paras.zh: “我们不固定市场。我们塑造市场以实现包容性和可持续增长，”她说。

paras.en: That means building social concerns into climate policy from the start, including how public money is spent and the conditions attached to investment.
paras.zh: 这意味着从一开始就将社会关注纳入气候政策，包括公共资金的使用方式以及投资的附加条件。

paras.en: Lithium may be essential for electrification, she noted. But if extracting it depletes water supplies, exploits workers or sidelines Indigenous communities, “they're part of the problem.”
paras.zh: 她指出，锂对于电气化可能至关重要。但如果开采它会耗尽水资源、剥削工人或使土著社区边缘化，“他们就是问题的一部分。”

paras.en: “Climate [action] should be how we deliver a better economy.”
paras.zh: “气候[行动]应该是我们实现更好经济的方式。”

paras.en: Questions of fairness also ran through Wednesday's gender discussions.
paras.zh: 周三的性别讨论中也贯穿了公平问题。

paras.en: At a high-level event, Brazilian climate negotiator Lilian Chagas argued that excluding women from climate planning makes action not only less fair, but less effective.
paras.zh: 在一次高级别活动中，巴西气候谈判代表莉莲·查加斯 (Lilian Chagas) 认为，将女性排除在气候规划之外不仅会降低行动的公平性，而且会降低效率。

paras.en: “Without supporting women in science, we risk depriving our countries of the solutions needed to limit global temperature rise. Without assessing the specific impacts of climate change on women's health, we risk failing in our adaptation policies.”
paras.zh: “如果不支持女性从事科学工作，我们的国家就有可能无法获得限制全球气温上升所需的解决方案。如果不评估气候变化对女性健康的具体影响，我们的适应政策就有可能失败。”

paras.en: Tuvalu Prime Minister Feleti Teo made a similar point through the experiences of women on Funafuti, the country’s capital, who monitor disappearing shellfish, ration rainwater and move crops inland as seas rise.
paras.zh: 图瓦卢总理费莱蒂·泰奥（Feleti Teo）通过该国首都富纳富提妇女的经历也表达了类似的观点，她们监测消失的贝类、配给雨水以及随着海平面上升将农作物移至内陆。

paras.en: “A finance ministry will not fund what nobody has measured, and a negotiator cannot defend people nobody has described,” he said.
paras.zh: “财政部不会资助没有人衡量过的事情，谈判者也无法为没有人描述过的人辩护，”他说。

paras.en: “They did not cause this crisis. Resilience has a limit. And beyond that limit is survival.”
paras.zh: “这场危机不是他们造成的。韧性是有极限的。超越这个极限就是生存。”

paras.en: For Shen Xiaomeng, Vice-Rector of the United Nations University and Director of UNU-EHS, the discussion pointed to a more fundamental question: what is development actually for?
paras.zh: 对于联合国大学副校长、UNU-EHS主任沉晓萌来说，这次讨论指向了一个更根本的问题：发展到底是为了什么？

paras.en: Economic growth alone is not enough, she argued.
paras.zh: 她认为，仅靠经济增长是不够的。

paras.en: “We tend to think development is always good," she said. "But I think it's a bit like an airplane taking off and never knowing where to land.”
paras.zh: “我们倾向于认为发展总是好的，”她说。 “但我认为这有点像一架飞机起飞，却不知道降落在哪里。”

paras.en: For Shen, the destination should be human well-being.
paras.zh: 对于沉先生来说，目的地应该是人类的福祉。

paras.en: “In the end, we all want to live a good life,” she said.
paras.zh: “最终，我们都希望过上美好的生活，”她说。

paras.en: “The final goal is that humanity will not only survive but also thrive. That is really about the well-being of the people, but that is based on planetary well-being.”
paras.zh: “最终目标是人类不仅能够生存，而且能够繁荣。这确实关系到人民的福祉，但这是基于地球的福祉。”

paras.en: Follow the latest developments from COP31 through our new podcast, Talk & Action, and our special daily coverage of the conference.
paras.zh: 通过我们的新播客、Talk & Action 以及我们对会议的每日特别报道，关注 COP31 的最新进展。

articles.title: Hamilton denies lack of trust with Ferrari after strategy issues

paras.en: Lewis Hamilton denies lack of trust with Ferrari after ignoring instructions from pit wall twice in recent races
paras.zh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿在最近的比赛中两次无视维修区墙壁的指示后，否认对法拉利缺乏信任

paras.en: Lewis Hamilton ignored instructions from his Ferrari team to pit at recent races in Singapore and Brazil; the Brit insists there is no trust issue; watch the Las Vegas GP weekend on Sky Sports F1, with qualifying at 4am on Saturday and the race at 4am on Sunday
paras.zh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿 (Lewis Hamilton) 在新加坡和巴西最近的比赛中无视法拉利车队的进站指示；英国人坚称不存在信任问题；在天空体育 F1 上观看拉斯维加斯大奖赛周末，周六凌晨 4 点排位赛，周日凌晨 4 点正赛

paras.en: Lewis Hamilton has insisted there is no lack of trust between himself and his Ferrari team despite having overridden orders from the pit wall twice in recent races.
paras.zh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿坚称，尽管在最近的比赛中两次推翻了维修区的命令，但他和他的法拉利车队之间并不缺乏信任。

paras.en: At the Singapore Grand Prix in October and the Sao Paulo Grand Prix earlier this month, Hamilton ignored instructions to pit, with his decision costing him places on both occasions.
paras.zh: 在十月份的新加坡大奖赛和本月早些时候的圣保罗大奖赛上，汉密尔顿无视进站的指示，他的决定两次都让他失去了位置。

paras.en: The incidents followed several moments earlier in the season where Hamilton had been left frustrated by strategic decisions from Ferrari that failed to optimise his chances.
paras.zh: 这些事件发生在本赛季早些时候的几个时刻，当时汉密尔顿对法拉利的战略决策感到沮丧，这些决策未能优化他的机会。

paras.en: - Las Vegas GP: UK schedule and how to watch on Sky Sports
paras.zh: - 拉斯维加斯大奖赛：英国赛程以及如何在天空体育上观看

paras.en: - F1 2026 Calendar | F1 2026 Standings | F1 Gossip Column
paras.zh: - F1 2026 日历 | F1 2026 积分榜 | F1八卦专栏

paras.en: - Not got Sky? Latest Sky Sports deals or stream F1 with no contract 📺
paras.zh: - 没有天空？最新天空体育优惠或无合同直播 F1 📺

paras.en: Asked ahead of this weekend's Las Vegas Grand Prix whether taking matters into his own hands was indicative of a lack of trust, Hamilton insisted he was pleased with the work of his race engineer Carlo Santi.
paras.zh: 在本周末的拉斯维加斯大奖赛之前，当被问及将事情掌握在自己手中是否表明缺乏信任时，汉密尔顿坚称他对赛车工程师卡洛桑蒂的工作感到满意。

paras.en: The seven-time world champion said: "No, it's definitely not trusting. I think it's just we're constantly working on our communication. I think that it's been a lot better this year.
paras.zh: 这位七届世界冠军说：“不，这绝对不是信任。我认为这只是我们不断努力进行沟通。我认为今年好多了。”

paras.en: "Carlo has done an amazing job, and I think there's been a couple of times where it's just those particular two times was not, particularly the last time, was just I didn't have the information I needed, and I got the call at the last minute.
paras.zh: “卡洛做得非常出色，我想有好几次，只是那两次不是，特别是最后一次，只是我没有得到我需要的信息，我在最后一刻接到了电话。

paras.en: "And we'll just continue to work on the processes. We're super united and working, I think in the right direction."
paras.zh: “我们将继续致力于流程。我们非常团结，正在努力，我认为方向是正确的。”

paras.en: Hamilton has also had to handle controversy with his team-mate Charles Leclerc, after a first-lap clash between the pair at the Mexico City Grand Prix resulted in something of a public fall out.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿还不得不处理与队友查尔斯·勒克莱尔的争议，两人在墨西哥城大奖赛第一圈的冲突导致了公众的争吵。

paras.en: Hamilton was highly critical of Leclerc for aggressively attempting to challenge him for the lead on the first lap, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking advantage of the squabble to win a race that Ferrari likely would have claimed a one-two in had their drivers held position.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿对勒克莱尔在第一圈积极地试图挑战他的领先位置表示强烈批评，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘利用这场争吵赢得了一场比赛，如果他们的车手保持领先的话，法拉利很可能会以二比一的成绩获胜。

paras.en: Both Hamilton and Leclerc said that a conversation in Brazil the week after the incident had resolved the situation, and the Brit on Wednesday reiterated his confidence in their working relationship moving forwards.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿和勒克莱尔均表示，事件发生后一周在巴西的一次谈话已经解决了问题，而英国人周三重申了他对他们的工作关系向前发展的信心。

paras.en: "I think Charles is a great driver," Hamilton said. "I think, as I said, the detail we went into about stuff like that in terms of when we close the visor, it's very clear we understand each other.
paras.zh: “我认为查尔斯是一位伟大的车手，”汉密尔顿说。 “我认为，正如我所说，我们在关闭遮阳板时所讨论的细节，很明显我们彼此理解。

paras.en: "We understand each other's boundaries and the ultimate goal, which is to get the best result for the team.
paras.zh: “我们了解彼此的界限和最终目标，那就是为球队取得最好的结果。

paras.en: "So, I don't feel that that will be a problem moving forwards, and I have no concerns or worries about racing him. I don't think he does with me either."
paras.zh: “所以，我不认为这会成为前进的问题，而且我对与他比赛没有任何顾虑或担忧。我认为他也不会和我一起比赛。”

paras.en: Hamilton admitted he is unsure whether Ferrari will be able to challenge for victory in Las Vegas given the circuit is unlikely to suit their car.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿承认，他不确定法拉利是否能够在拉斯维加斯挑战胜利，因为这条赛道不太适合他们的赛车。

paras.en: The circuit's long straight could expose Ferrari's power unit weaknesses, while the cold temperatures could lead to issues heating up their tyres sufficiently.
paras.zh: 赛道的长直道可能会暴露法拉利动力装置的弱点，而寒冷的气温可能会导致轮胎充分加热的问题。

paras.en: Hamilton said: "We've had a car that's been quick through corners. Obviously, yeah, you have the long straight here. I don't know how that's going to be for us.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿说：“我们的赛车过弯速度很快。显然，是的，这里有很长的直道。我不知道这对我们来说会怎样。”

paras.en: "We'll do the best job we can, but hopefully we can make up some of the time maybe in some of the corners. We'll have to wait and see."
paras.zh: “我们会尽我们所能，但希望我们能弥补一些时间，也许是在某些角落。我们必须拭目以待。”

paras.en: Regardless of how competitive Ferrari are, Hamilton says the team will use this weekend, and the upcoming final two races of the season in Qatar and Abu Dhabi, to attempt to optimise their plans for the start of the 2027 season.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿表示，无论法拉利的竞争力如何，车队都将利用本周末以及即将在卡塔尔和阿布扎比举行的本赛季最后两场比赛来尝试优化他们的 2027 赛季开始计划。

paras.en: "This is a period of time… we don't have any new components to test, but this is definitely a really important data point for us to understand and make some changes setup wise, and try some things that we can potentially try to see if everything's working, if there's different elements of the car that we can remove or add, thinking about next year," he said.
paras.zh: “这是一段时间……我们没有任何新的组件可供测试，但这绝对是一个非常重要的数据点，让我们了解并明智地进行一些设置更改，并尝试一些我们可以尝试的事情，看看一切是否正常，是否有不同的汽车元素可以删除或添加，考虑明年，”他说。

paras.en: "There's some big changes for next year. But otherwise, right now we have to focus on maintain second in the constructors' championship."
paras.zh: “明年会有一些重大变化。但除此之外，现在我们必须专注于保持车队积分榜第二名。”

articles.title: Price hopes undisputed history could lead her to Shields showdown

paras.en: Lauren Price hopes making undisputed history could lead her to Claressa Shields showdown: 'I want the big fights'
paras.zh: 劳伦·普莱斯希望创造无可争议的历史能让她与克拉丽莎·希尔兹摊牌：“我想要大战”

paras.en: Olympic gold medallist Lauren Price wants to test herself against Claressa Shields, Chantelle Cameron and Mikaela Mayer; Price will become Wales' first undisputed world champion in the four-belt era if she beats Michaela Kotaskova and hopes victory can lead to American star Shields
paras.zh: 奥运会金牌得主劳伦·普莱斯 (Lauren Price) 想与克拉丽莎·希尔兹 (Claressa Shields)、尚特尔·卡梅伦 (Chantelle Cameron) 和米凯拉·梅耶尔 (Mikaela Mayer) 较量以检验自己的实力；如果普莱斯击败米凯拉·科塔索娃，她将成为威尔士四金带时代无可争议的第一位世界冠军，并希望胜利能带领美国明星希尔兹夺冠

paras.en: Lauren Price believes becoming an undisputed champion could lead her to a showdown with American star Claressa Shields.
paras.zh: 劳伦·普莱斯 (Lauren Price) 相信，成为无可争议的冠军可能会让她与美国明星克拉丽莎·希尔兹 (Claressa Shields) 展开对决。

paras.en: Price faced off with Shields after her last fight but no agreement has been reached for them to box.
paras.zh: 普莱斯在上次比赛后与希尔兹对峙，但尚未就拳击事宜达成任何协议。

paras.en: Shields has been an undisputed champion in multiple divisions and has returned to middleweight after a period as the undisputed heavyweight champion.
paras.zh: 希尔兹一直是多个级别无可争议的冠军，并在担任无可争议的重量级冠军一段时间后重返中量级。

paras.en: Price, like Shields, won the Olympic gold medal at middleweight. She's unbeaten as a professional too. On Friday Price looks to add the now vacant WBO welterweight title to the WBA, WBC and IBF belts she already holds when she fights Michaela Kotaskova.
paras.zh: 普莱斯和希尔兹一样，赢得了中量级奥运会金牌。作为职业选手，她也保持不败。周五，普莱斯希望将目前空缺的 WBO 次中量级冠军头衔添加到她在与米凯拉·科塔索娃 (Michaela Kotaskova) 比赛时已经拥有的 WBA、WBC 和 IBF 腰带上。

paras.en: If she wins she will become Wales' first undisputed champion in the four-belt era.
paras.zh: 如果她获胜，她将成为威尔士在四金腰带时代无可争议的第一位冠军。

paras.en: "It hasn't sunk in yet," Price told Sky Sports. "When I turned over, that's the dream to become undisputed. I can honestly say if I achieve that on Friday then I've ticked every accolade in boxing.
paras.zh: “它还没有被人们所接受，”普莱斯告诉天空体育。 “当我翻身时，这就是成为无可争议的梦想。我可以诚实地说，如果我在周五实现这一目标，那么我就已经获得了拳击界的所有荣誉。

paras.en: "Regardless of the belts on the line, you step through the ropes and it's another fight. I just let the boxing do the talking and make sure I get that win and I win in style."
paras.zh: “不管绳子上有什么腰带，只要你跨过绳子，这就是另一场战斗。我只是让拳击来说话，确保我赢得胜利，而且我以风格赢得胜利。”

paras.en: If Price does go undisputed at welterweight, moving up through divisions will be the natural next step. Shields remains a target though that fight is yet to come to fruition.
paras.zh: 如果普莱斯确实毫无争议地跻身次中量级，那么下一步晋级将是自然而然的事情。尽管这场斗争尚未取得成果，希尔兹仍然是一个目标。

paras.en: "It has to make sense on both ends," Price said. "I'm giving away weight, fine. But it was in her back garden, I wanted to come back to Wales as well.
paras.zh: “它必须在两端都有意义，”普莱斯说。 “我正在放弃体重，好吧。但那是在她的后花园，我也想回到威尔士。

paras.en: On December 24 Chantelle Cameron and Mikaela Mayer, who vacated the WBO welterweight title, will rematch for the WBA, WBC and WBO super-welter championships. Price has an eye on fighting the winner.
paras.zh: 12月24日，腾出WBO次中量级冠军头衔的尚特尔·卡梅伦和米凯拉·梅耶尔将重赛，争夺WBA、WBC和WBO超中量级​​冠军头衔。普莱斯着眼于与胜利者战斗。

paras.en: "They're both great. But I believe Chantelle will win that fight again and that's a great fight for British boxing, I'm 100 percent up for it," Price said.
paras.zh: “他们都很棒。但我相信尚特尔将再次赢得这场比赛，这对英国拳击界来说是一场伟大的比赛，我百分百支持，”普莱斯说。

paras.en: "I think right now obviously myself, Cameron, Mayer's in there [the pound-for-pound list] and obviously Shields. For me we're the big names and that's what I want, I want the big fights."
paras.zh: “我认为现在显然我自己、卡梅伦、梅耶尔都在其中[逐磅名单]，显然还有希尔兹。对我来说，我们是大牌人物，这就是我想要的，我想要激烈的战斗。”

articles.title: F1 drivers back return of 'very cool' V8 engines in the future

paras.en: Formula 1 drivers back return of 'very cool' V8 engines in the future ahead of Las Vegas Grand Prix
paras.zh: 一级方程式赛车手支持未来在拉斯维加斯大奖赛之前回归“非常酷”的 V8 发动机

paras.en: Several Formula 1 drivers have backed the possibility of V8 engines returning to the sport as early as 2030; watch the Las Vegas GP weekend on Sky Sports F1, with Friday's practice sessions at 12.30am and 4pm
paras.zh: 几位一级方程式赛车手支持 V8 发动机最早在 2030 年重返这项运动的可能性；在天空体育 F1 观看拉斯维加斯大奖赛周末，周五中午 12.30 和下午 4 点进行练习赛

paras.en: Formula 1's drivers appear to be unanimous with the prospect of V8 engine returning to the sport in the 2030s.
paras.zh: 一级方程式赛车手们似乎一致认为 V8 发动机将在 2030 年代重返这项运动。

paras.en: Earlier this week, ahead of this weekend's Las Vegas Grand Prix, FIA president Mohammed Ben Sulayem teased the possibility of V8 engines with the sound of a screaming F1 car with a caption: "You spoke, we listened. V8s coming soon."
paras.zh: 本周早些时候，在本周末的拉斯维加斯大奖赛之前，国际汽联主席穆罕默德·本·苏拉耶姆用 F1 赛车的尖叫声调侃了 V8 发动机的可能性，并配文：“你说，我们听。V8 即将推出。”

paras.en: The FIA also published graphics on social media which suggested an agreement in principle had been reached by themselves, Formula 1 management and the engine manufacturers for V8 engines to return from 2030, but the post was deleted.
paras.zh: 国际汽联还在社交媒体上发布了图片，暗示他们、一级方程式管理层和发动机制造商已就 V8 发动机从 2030 年开始回归原则上达成协议，但该帖子已被删除。

paras.zh: - 拉斯维加斯大奖赛：英国赛程以及如何在天空体育上观看

paras.zh: - F1 2026 日历 | F1 2026 积分榜 | F1八卦专栏

paras.en: - Not got Sky? Latest Sky Sports deals or stream F1 with no contract 📺
paras.zh: - 没有天空？最新天空体育优惠或无合同直播 F1 📺

paras.en: The current regulations are set to run until 2031, which could be an explanation for the deleted post, while further details of the overall power unit, including whether an electrical element and a turbo will remain, need to be finalised.
paras.zh: 目前的规定将持续到 2031 年，这可能是对删除的帖子的解释，而整个动力装置的进一步细节，包括是否保留电气元件和涡轮机，需要最终确定。

paras.en: "I'd love to see it. When I look at the old videos of the old engines, they give me goosebumps," said Mercedes driver George Russell.
paras.zh: “我很想看到它。当我看到旧引擎的旧视频时，它们让我起鸡皮疙瘩，”梅赛德斯车手乔治拉塞尔说。

paras.en: "I think it's about just that high-pitched squeal that I'm missing from this era. The purists will say take away all electrical power, but I think when you look at how a lot of these cars have evolved in recent years, and the power output from some of these electrical motors these days, Formula 1 is going to continue to be the fastest race cars on the planet, you need to have it, that's just the reality.
paras.zh: “我认为这就是我在这个时代所怀念的那种高亢的尖叫声。纯粹主义者会说拿走所有的电力，但我认为，当你看看近年来这些汽车的发展情况，以及这些电动机的功率输出时，一级方程式赛车将继续成为地球上最快的赛车，你需要拥有它，这就是现实。

paras.en: "You need to have some sort of hybrid, because the power you get, you can't really produce that just solely on internal combustion.
paras.zh: “你需要某种混合动力，因为你所获得的动力，仅靠内燃是无法真正产生的。

paras.en: "If we go back to V8s, having some sort of electrical power as well, to give you that extra 400, 500 kilowatts to bring the cars to 1000+ horsepower, that's what we want.
paras.zh: “如果我们回到 V8 发动机，同时拥有某种电力，为您提供额外的 400、500 千瓦，使汽车达到 1000 马力以上，这就是我们想要的。

paras.en: "I think it's worth remembering as well actually, the final V8 era, they sounded awesome, but the cars, they actually weren't very fast. I don't think many people realise that."
paras.zh: “我认为实际上也值得记住，最后的 V8 时代，它们听起来很棒，但汽车实际上并不是很快。我认为很多人都没有意识到这一点。”

paras.en: New world champion Kimi Antonelli agreed with his Mercedes team-mate and claims "many people would look forward" to the return of V8 engines.
paras.zh: 新任世界冠军基米·安东内利同意他的梅赛德斯队友的观点，并声称“很多人都期待”V8 发动机的回归。

paras.en: "It's going be very cool to go back to more old style. Also, the cars will get lighter even further, probably 70kg, which is immense," he said.
paras.zh: “回归到更老式的风格会非常酷。而且，汽车会变得更轻，可能重 70 公斤，这是一个巨大的数字，”他说。

paras.en: "Definitely, I think it's a very exciting regulation change. Of course, we have got to first do well in this one."
paras.zh: “当然，我认为这是一个非常令人兴奋的监管变化。当然，我们必须首先在这方面做得很好。”

paras.en: Verstappen: F1 going in the right direction
paras.zh: 维斯塔潘：F1正朝着正确的方向前进

paras.en: Max Verstappen has been critical of the current power units which are around 53 per cent battery powered and led to an unusual style of driving and racing at some tracks, with the drivers sometimes unable to push flat out in a traditional manner.
paras.zh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘一直对当前的动力装置持批评态度，这些装置大约有 53% 是由电池供电的，这导致了一些赛道上不寻常的驾驶和比赛风格，车手有时无法以传统方式全力以赴。

paras.en: Verstappen, who warned driving in Las Vegas will be "painful" due to the long straights, feels the FIA have listened to the drivers and realised the 2026 regulations are "not what you want".
paras.zh: 维斯塔潘警告说，由于长直道，在拉斯维加斯驾驶将会“痛苦”，他认为国际汽联已经听取了车手的意见，并意识到 2026 年的规定“不是你想要的”。

paras.en: The four-time world champion stated he would get rid of the turbo in future power unit regulations, and effectively have a fully normally aspirated engine.
paras.zh: 这位四届世界冠军表示，他将在未来的动力装置法规中摆脱涡轮增压，并有效地拥有完全自然吸气的发动机。

paras.en: "In some tracks then you're not allowed to race because it will be too loud because if it's up to me I would take the turbo off," he explained.
paras.zh: “在某些赛道上，你不被允许参加比赛，因为声音太大，因为如果由我决定，我会关闭涡轮，”他解释道。

paras.en: "I would get rid, maybe you can use it as a push to pass, but not too much of the battery side. But then on some tracks, you're not allowed to race, so fuel consumption goes up a lot without a turbo, so you need a bigger tank if you don't want to do refuelling in the races, so I understand that you want to have a turbo.
paras.zh: “我会摆脱，也许你可以用它作为超车的推动力，但电池方面不要太多。但是在某些赛道上，你不被允许比赛，所以没有涡轮增压的话油耗会上升很多，所以如果你不想在比赛中加油，你需要一个更大的油箱，所以我理解你想要有涡轮增压。

paras.en: "If it's fully up to me, of course you go back to like a V10 or whatever. That sounds even better, but I know that not something realistic.
paras.zh: “如果完全由我决定，当然你会回到 V10 或其他什么。这听起来更好，但我知道这不现实。

paras.en: "This [news] is good. This is for sure in the right direction, but again, it's not confirmed yet. So there's still a few things I guess that they need to agree on."
paras.zh: “这个[消息]是好的。这肯定是在正确的方向上，但同样，它尚未得到证实。所以我认为他们仍然需要在一些事情上达成一致。”

paras.en: Lewis Hamilton, Fernando Alonso, Nico Hulkenberg Sergio Perez and Valtteri Bottas are the only drivers who drove in the previous V8 era which ended in 2013.
paras.zh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿、费尔南多·阿隆索、尼科·霍肯伯格、塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯和瓦尔特里·博塔斯是仅有的驾驶过 2013 年结束的 V8 时代的车手。

paras.en: Alonso said it's "frustrating" F1 has not had V8 engines since 2014, while Hamilton is keen to know more details about the proposed return of V8s.
paras.zh: 阿隆索表示，F1 自 2014 年以来就不再配备 V8 发动机，这“令人沮丧”，而汉密尔顿则渴望了解有关 V8 发动机回归计划的更多细节。

paras.en: "I think it's ultimately dependent on… it's all well going to V8. It depends on how they design it, regulation-wise, and going back to the good sound because that's I think been lacking since we've been in the V6 era," he said.
paras.zh: “我认为这最终取决于……V8 一切顺利。这取决于他们如何设计它，在监管方面，以及回到良好的声音，因为我认为这是自 V6 时代以来所缺乏的，”他说。

paras.en: "Yeah, bring back the smaller exhaust and get that sound back.
paras.zh: “是的，带回较小的排气装置并恢复声音。

paras.en: "But you could have that, and as long as we don't have the engine dying halfway down the straight, then I think that'd be better."
paras.zh: “但你可以这样做，只要我们不让发动机在直道中途熄火，那么我认为那会更好。”

articles.title: Live: AFL draft to turn dreams into reality for footy's next superstars
articles.author: Chris De Silva and Dean Bilton

paras.en: Thu, 3 Sept, 8:10 pm, Final score, Dockers 40, Hawks 72
paras.zh: 9 月 3 日星期四，晚上 8:10，最终比分，码头工人 40，老鹰 72

paras.en: AFL draft round one live updates: Dougie Cochrane set for number one pick, Bombers and Tigers face big calls
paras.zh: AFL选秀第一轮实时更新：道吉·科克伦（Dougie Cochrane）将成为第一顺位，轰炸机队和老虎队面临重大考验

paras.en: The 2026 AFL draft has arrived, with the first round of selections set to deliver the game's next batch of superstars to their new homes.
paras.zh: 2026 年 AFL 选秀已经到来，第一轮选秀将把下一批超级巨星送入新家。

paras.en: Follow every pick and get all the analysis as the night unfolds in our live blog.
paras.zh: 在我们的实时博客中关注每一个选择并在夜晚展开时获取所有分析。

paras.en: West Coast sitting pretty with pick three
paras.zh: 西海岸坐得很漂亮，选三

paras.en: Love your work guys - Hoping for Mellody to the Eagles, but don't think we can lose at pick 3 in this draft
paras.zh: 热爱你们的工作，伙计们 - 希望梅洛迪能加入老鹰队，但不认为我们会在这次选秀中输掉第 3 顺位

paras.en: I agree with you Simon, the Eagles can't go wrong and I imagine they know that. Ethan Drever slips? Wonderful! Arki Butler is still available? Great news! Heath Mellody best available at their pick? Tremendous!
paras.zh: 我同意你的观点，西蒙，老鹰队不会出错，我想他们也知道这一点。伊森·德雷弗滑倒了？精彩的！阿尔基·巴特勒还有空吗？好消息！希斯·梅洛迪 (Heath Melody) 是他们的最佳选择？巨大的！

paras.en: I think Mellody is most likely and is also a fantastic fit for a developing midfield group. His two-way running, elite footskills and defensive ability could be a perfect foil for Harley Reid and Willem Duursma in a few years.
paras.zh: 我认为梅洛迪最有可能，而且也非常适合发展中的中场团队。他的双向跑动、出色的脚法和防守能力可能会在几年内成为哈雷·里德和威廉·杜尔斯马的完美陪衬。

paras.en: Hello folks, I'll be joining forces with Chris tonight to chuck my two cents in about these picks and players as it all unfolds. I reckon this draft is an absolute lottery from about pick 10 onwards, so here are a few questions to keep in mind before it all kicks off?
paras.zh: 大家好，今晚我将与克里斯一起，随着这一切的展开，对这些选秀权和球员提出我的两分钱。我认为这次选秀从第 10 顺位开始绝对是彩票，所以在这一切开始之前需要记住以下几个问题？

paras.en: - Where does Harry van Hattum go? Sounds like Richmond's second pick is the likely landing spot, but if he isn't taken there this prodigious ruck talent could slip all the way out of the top 10. Which would be mad.
paras.zh: - 哈利·范·哈图姆去哪里？听起来里士满的第二顺位是可能的落脚点，但如果他不被带到那里，这位巨大的拉克天才可能会一路滑出前十名。这太疯狂了。

paras.en: - When are the bids coming? The Cochrane bid will come at pick one, but what about Cody Walker? Ethan Matthews? Caylen Murray? A surprise or two late in the night?
paras.zh: - 出价什么时候来？科克伦的出价将是第一个，但科迪·沃克呢？伊桑·马修斯？凯伦·穆雷？深夜一两个惊喜？

paras.en: - What about the trades? We think GWS will get Port's pick 12. We think Adelaide will get up the order somehow. We think Collingwood and Sydney might be up to something. The order posted above will shift dramatically tonight.
paras.zh: - 交易怎么样？我们认为GWS将获得波特的12号签。我们认为阿德莱德会以某种方式获得订单。我们认为科林伍德和悉尼可能在做某事。今晚上面发布的顺序将发生巨大变化。

paras.en: - Who is the slider and who is the bolter? There will surely be one player taken tonight that nobody saw coming, and one that will dip far below the position experts had them.
paras.zh: - 谁是滑块，谁是爆弹手？今晚肯定会有一名没人预见到的球员被选中，而一名球员的位置将远远低于专家的预期。

paras.en: Another academy star incoming for the Giants
paras.zh: 另一位学院明星即将加盟巨人队

paras.en: The AFL's struggling Victorian clubs are absolutely sick of the quality of some of the kids coming through from the northern academies.
paras.zh: AFL 陷入困境的维多利亚俱乐部对一些来自北方学院的孩子的素质感到厌倦。

paras.en: One of the names read out tonight will be Ethan Matthews, who is a part of the GWS Giants academy.
paras.zh: 今晚宣读的名字之一是伊森·马修斯 (Ethan Matthews)，他是 GWS 巨人学院的一员。

paras.en: It'll be interesting to see where exactly inside the top 10 a bid comes in for him.
paras.zh: 看看他的出价到底在前十名中的哪个位置将会很有趣。

paras.en: Is this going to be tonight's 1-2 punch?
paras.zh: 这会是今晚的1-2拳吗？

paras.en: A look at Dougie Cochrane and Ethan Drever having a chat prior to the draft at Docklands.
paras.zh: 看看 Dougie Cochrane 和 Ethan Drever 在 Docklands 选秀前的聊天。

paras.en: Virtually every mock draft across the country has these two as the top two names to be read out tonight.
paras.zh: 事实上，全国各地的每一次模拟选秀都会将这两个名字作为今晚宣读的前两名名字。

paras.en: Surely we won't have any surprises will we?
paras.zh: 我们肯定不会有任何惊喜，不是吗？

paras.en: Everything you need to know ahead of the first round
paras.zh: 第一轮比赛前您需要了解的一切

paras.en: If you need a quick refresher on how everything is going to work tonight, then here is your one-stop shop.
paras.zh: 如果您需要快速了解今晚一切将如何进行，那么这里是您的一站式商店。

paras.en: A little guide on everything you need to know about the AFL draft.
paras.zh: 关于 AFL 选秀您需要了解的一切的小指南。

paras.en: Good evening and welcome to ABC Sport's live coverage of the 2026 AFL draft!
paras.zh: 晚上好，欢迎收看 ABC Sport 对 2026 年 AFL 选秀的现场直播！

paras.en: It feels like this one has been a long time coming, particularly for the fans of the teams on the bottom of the ladder.
paras.zh: 感觉这一场已经等了很长时间了，尤其是对于排名垫底球队的球迷来说。

paras.en: A reminder that the draft kicks off at 7pm AEDT at Docklands Stadium where Essendon, having won this season's wooden spoon, will be on the clock first.
paras.zh: 提醒一下，选秀将于澳大利亚东部时间晚上 7 点在港区体育场开始，赢得本赛季木勺奖的埃森登将首先到场。

paras.en: Which name will the Bombers read out? We'll soon find out!
paras.zh: 轰炸机会读出哪个名字？我们很快就会知道！

articles.title: Breaking: Police reveal fourth Melbourne Cup stolen as two accused appear in court
articles.author: Olivia Jenkins and Kristian Silva

paras.en: Two men have been charged after Melbourne Cup trophies and a Caulfield Cup were stolen during a series of break-ins at Melbourne racecourses during the Spring Racing Carnival.
paras.zh: 春季赛马嘉年华期间，墨尔本赛马场发生一系列入室盗窃事件，两名男子被盗，墨尔本杯奖杯和考菲尔德杯被盗。

paras.en: Police today revealed a fourth Melbourne Cup was taken during the heists, adding to the theft of three cups won by Makybe Diva.
paras.zh: 警方今天透露，在这起盗窃案中，第四座墨尔本杯被盗，继 Makybe Diva 赢得的三座奖杯被盗之后。

paras.en: A fourth Melbourne Cup has been stolen as police reveal the brazen theft of Makybe Diva's three Melbourne Cups and a Caulfield Cup are allegedly linked.
paras.zh: 第四个墨尔本杯被盗，警方透露，Makybe Diva 的三个墨尔本杯和一个考菲尔德杯涉嫌被盗。

paras.en: Police have charged Sama Mirzaagha and Chrysovalandis Tassakos over the heists, which unfolded over several days during Melbourne's cup carnival.
paras.zh: 警方已对 Sama Mirzaagha 和 Chrysovalandis Tassakos 提出指控，这起抢劫案发生在墨尔本杯赛狂欢节期间的几天内。

paras.en: The 1948 Caulfield Cup was allegedly swiped from Caulfield Racecourse during several break-ins at the track between November 4 and November 11.
paras.zh: 据称，11 月 4 日至 11 日期间，考尔菲尔德赛马场发生了数次闯入事件，1948 年考尔菲尔德杯被盗走。

paras.en: On Monday, thieves believed to be dressed as tradies stole legendary mare Makybe Diva's three consecutive Melbourne Cups, worth $3 million, from Flemington Racecourse.
paras.zh: 周一，据信打扮成技工的小偷从弗莱明顿赛马场偷走了传奇母马 Makybe Diva 连续三届墨尔本杯赛冠军，价值 300 万澳元。

paras.en: Police now allege both robberies are linked, and revealed that a fourth Melbourne Cup, a replica, had been stolen.
paras.zh: 警方现在声称这两起抢劫案有关联，并透露第四个墨尔本杯的复制品被盗。

paras.en: It was initially believed three cups won by Makybe Diva in 2003, 2004 and 2005 were the only items stolen from Flemington but police also allege a cup was stolen four days earlier.
paras.zh: 最初人们认为，Makybe Diva 在 2003 年、2004 年和 2005 年赢得的三座奖杯是弗莱明顿唯一被盗的物品，但警方还声称四天前有一个奖杯被盗。

paras.en: The Victoria Racing Club has remained tight-lipped about whether it was aware of the first robbery before Makybe Diva's cups were taken.
paras.zh: 维多利亚赛马俱乐部对于是否知道梅基比·迪瓦的奖杯被抢走之前发生的第一起抢劫案一直守口如瓶。

paras.en: Charged over the Flemington heist, Mr Mirzaagha, who was out on bail at the time, was not present for a brief hearing in the Melbourne Magistrates' Court, where his lawyers hit out at police.
paras.zh: 米尔扎加先生因弗莱明顿抢劫案受到指控，当时正在保释，他没有出席墨尔本地方法院的简短听证会，他的律师在听证会上猛烈抨击了警方。

paras.en: "There seems to have been a rush to charge, and investigating later," lawyer Justin Riazaty said.
paras.zh: 律师贾斯汀·里亚扎蒂（Justin Riazaty）表示：“似乎有人急于提出指控，然后再进行调查。”

paras.en: Mr Riazaty called the prosecution brief "flimsy" and said there were "serious deficiencies" in the case against his client.
paras.zh: 里亚扎蒂称检方陈述“站不住脚”，并表示针对他当事人的案件存在“严重缺陷”。

paras.en: However, prosecutor Jonathon McCarthy said the evidence included DNA, fingerprints and a large amount of CCTV footage. He also referred to Mr Mirzaagha and Mr Tassakos as being co-accused.
paras.zh: 不过，检察官乔纳森·麦卡锡表示，证据包括 DNA、指纹和大量闭路电视录像。他还称米尔扎加先生和塔萨科斯先生是同案被告。

paras.en: Further details about the alleged offending were not read out in court, and Magistrate Simon Zebrowski refused to publicly release a remand summary filed by police.
paras.zh: 有关涉嫌犯罪的更多细节并未在法庭上宣读，地方法官西蒙·泽布罗夫斯基拒绝公开发布警方提交的还押摘要。

paras.en: Mr Riazaty did not apply for bail on behalf of his client but said an application would be made "in due course".
paras.zh: 里亚扎蒂没有代表他的客户申请保释，但表示将“在适当的时候”提出申请。

paras.en: He said Mr Mirzaagha was normally prescribed medication and requested to be seen by a nurse in custody.
paras.zh: 他说，米尔扎加先生通常会接受药物治疗，并要求被拘留的护士会见。

paras.en: Mr Mirzaagha's charges include burglary, theft and dealing with property suspected of being the proceeds of crime.
paras.zh: 米尔扎加的指控包括入室盗窃、盗窃和处理涉嫌犯罪所得的财产。

paras.en: During an earlier hearing, Mr Mirzaagha's co-accused, Mr Tassakos, was granted bail on charges of burglary, theft, handling stolen goods, dealing with property suspected of being proceeds of crime, obtaining financial advantage and obtaining property by deception.
paras.zh: 在早些时候的听证会上，米尔扎加的同案被告塔萨科斯因入室盗窃、盗窃、处理赃物、处理涉嫌犯罪所得的财产、获取经济利益和通过欺骗手段获取财产等罪名获得保释。

paras.en: Mr Tassakos is charged in relation to both alleged heists and was supported in court by his parents.
paras.zh: 塔萨科斯先生因两起抢劫案而受到指控，并在法庭上得到了他父母的支持。

paras.en: It comes after police raided a Mount Waverley home in Melbourne's east as part of their hunt for the stolen cups, which remain missing.
paras.zh: 此前，警方突击搜查了墨尔本东部 Mount Waverley 的一处住宅，寻找被盗的杯子，但杯子至今下落不明。

paras.en: Both men are expected to face court again in February.
paras.zh: 预计两人将在二月份再次出庭。

articles.title: Mother, stepfather to stand trial over alleged murder of 12yo girl
articles.author: Dominic Cansdale

paras.en: A trial will be held into the 2022 death of 12-year-old Tiffani Scholten, who police allege was murdered by her mother and stepfather.
paras.zh: 警方将对 2022 年 12 岁女孩蒂法尼·斯科尔滕 (Tiffani Scholten) 的死亡事件进行审判，警方称她是被母亲和继父谋杀的。

paras.en: Carrissa Scholten, 36, and Aaron Richardson, 37, stand charged with one count each of murder as a domestic violence offence.
paras.zh: 36 岁的卡里萨·斯科尔滕 (Carrissa Scholten) 和 37 岁的亚伦·理查森 (Aaron Richardson) 分别被指控犯有一项家庭暴力谋杀罪。

paras.en: The pair are due to face Brisbane's Supreme Court at a date yet to be determined.
paras.zh: 两人将在布里斯班最高法院出庭，日期尚未确定。

paras.en: A mother and her long-term partner have been committed to stand trial over the murder of her 12-year-old daughter, who allegedly died from malnourishment on the Gold Coast four years ago.
paras.zh: 一名母亲和她的长期伴侣因谋杀她 12 岁的女儿而接受审判，据称她四年前在黄金海岸因营养不良而死亡。

paras.en: Carrissa Kay Scholten and Aaron Paul Richardson faced Southport Magistrates Court on Thursday, charged with the murder of Tiffani Jane Scholten.
paras.zh: 卡里萨·凯·斯科尔滕 (Carrissa Kay Scholten) 和亚伦·保罗·理查森 (Aaron Paul Richardson) 周四在绍斯波特地方法院受审，被指控谋杀蒂芙尼·简·斯科尔滕 (Tiffani Jane Scholten)。

paras.en: The 12-year-old, who the court heard was severely disabled, was found unresponsive at their home on Bellagio Crescent in Coomera, Gold Coast, on April 18, 2022.
paras.zh: 法庭获悉，这名 12 岁的男孩患有严重残疾，于 2022 年 4 月 18 日被发现在黄金海岸库梅拉 Bellagio Crescent 的家中失去知觉。

paras.en: After a protracted homicide investigation, the girl's mother Carrissa Kaye Scholten and her partner Aaron Paul Richardson were charged with murder in August 2024.
paras.zh: 经过旷日持久的凶杀案调查后，女孩的母亲 Carrissa Kaye Scholten 和她的伴侣 Aaron Paul Richardson 于 2024 年 8 月被指控犯有谋杀罪。

paras.en: Today, Magistrate Louisa Pink found there was sufficient evidence for the pair to stand trial.
paras.zh: 今天，地方法官路易莎平克发现有足够的证据让两人接受审判。

paras.en: Ms Scholten's sister, Cassandra Dunn, told the court that Mr Richardson's relationship with Carrissa Scholten was controlling and abusive.
paras.zh: Scholten 女士的姐姐 Cassandra Dunn 告诉法庭，理查森先生与 Carrissa Scholten 的关系是控制性和虐待性的。

paras.en: "[He was] short-tempered and possessive," Ms Dunn said.
paras.zh: “[他]脾气暴躁，占有欲强，”邓恩女士说。

paras.en: "He didn't like her hanging out with me; he didn't approve of that."
paras.zh: “他不喜欢她和我一起出去玩；他不赞成那样。”

paras.en: While she said there had been "a little altercation" between the couple physically, Ms Dunn told the court Mr Richardson had "snapped" in multiple phone calls and voicemails.
paras.zh: 虽然邓恩女士表示，这对夫妇之间发生了“一些肢体冲突”，但理查森先生在多个电话和语音邮件中“突然爆发”。

paras.en: Ms Dunn told the court Mr Richardson was a cocaine dealer who had "a fake power point [electrical outlet] in the bedroom that he was stashing things in", which she said her sister had shown her.
paras.zh: 邓恩女士告诉法庭，理查森先生是一名可卡因贩子，他“在卧室里有一个假电源插座，他把东西藏在里面”，她说她姐姐给她看了这个电源插座。

paras.en: She said she had heard that his "drug associates" were raided by police in the days leading up to Tiffani Scholten's death.
paras.zh: 她说，她听说蒂法尼·肖尔滕死前几天，他的“毒品同伙”遭到警方突击搜查。

paras.en: Ms Dunn said that Ms Scholten was too scared to seek medical help, over fears it would lead to investigations that could uncover Mr Richardson's alleged drug dealing.
paras.zh: 邓恩女士说，斯科尔滕女士太害怕了，不敢寻求医疗帮助，因为担心这会导致调查揭露理查森先生涉嫌的毒品交易。

paras.en: "She was scared to take Tiffani to the hospital because of how Aaron would react," she told the court.
paras.zh: “她害怕带蒂法尼去医院，因为亚伦的反应，”她告诉法庭。

paras.en: Southport Special School teacher aide, Brenda Walker, told the court she last saw Tiffani in December 2021 but that she did not return in 2022, missing 16 weeks of school.
paras.zh: 绍斯波特特殊学校的助教布伦达·沃克 (Brenda Walker) 告诉法庭，她最后一次见到蒂法尼是在 2021 年 12 月，但她在 2022 年没有回来，缺课了 16 周。

paras.en: Tiffani's teacher in 2021, Nicola Reid, told the court that Tiffani weighed 13 kilograms.
paras.zh: 蒂法尼2021年的老师尼古拉·里德告诉法庭，蒂法尼的体重为13公斤。

paras.en: She said Ms Scholten told her that Tiffani had Rett syndrome — a rare neurological disorder that caused growth issues — but that "nobody could really confirm" the diagnosis.
paras.zh: 她说，斯科尔滕女士告诉她，蒂法尼患有雷特综合症——一种导致生长问题的罕见神经系统疾病——但“没有人能真正证实”这一诊断。

paras.en: Ms Reid told the court that unlike other students with Rett syndrome, Tiffani did not appear to physically or verbally deteriorate during 2021 and had a healthy appetite.
paras.zh: 里德女士告诉法庭，与其他患有雷特综合症的学生不同，蒂法尼在 2021 年期间身体或语言似乎没有恶化，而且食欲健康。

paras.en: While the court heard Ms Scholten had attempted to feed Tiffani in the night leading up to her death, Justice Pink said: "There is evidence that she had not received medical care for a prolonged period before her death."
paras.zh: 虽然法庭获悉 Scholten 女士在死亡前一晚曾试图给蒂法尼喂食，但平克法官表示：“有证据表明，她在死亡前很长一段时间没有接受医疗护理。”

paras.en: Both Mr Richardson and Ms Scholten declined to speak in court.
paras.zh: 理查森先生和肖尔滕女士都拒绝在法庭上发言。

articles.title: Florida pastor convicted of U.S. charges in 2021 killing of Haitian president

paras.en: Florida pastor convicted of U.S. charges in 2021 killing of Haitian president
paras.zh: 佛罗里达州牧师因 2021 年杀害海地总统而被美国定罪

paras.en: Moïse killed during nighttime raid on his home in July 2021
paras.zh: 莫伊兹在 2021 年 7 月的夜间袭击中身亡

paras.en: A Florida pastor with dual Haitian-American citizenship was convicted Wednesday of U.S. charges arising from the 2021 assassination of Haitian president Jovenel Moïse, a killing that plunged the Caribbean nation into deep turmoil.
paras.zh: 周三，一名拥有海地裔美国双重国籍的佛罗里达州牧师因 2021 年海地总统若弗内尔·莫伊兹被暗杀事件而被美国定罪，这次谋杀使这个加勒比国家陷入了深度动荡。

paras.en: Christian Emmanuel Sanon was found guilty on charges including conspiring to kill Moïse after a nearly eight-week trial in federal court in Miami. He had faced a total of eight charges, the most serious one conspiracy to kidnap or kill a person outside the United States.
paras.zh: 在迈阿密联邦法院经过近八周的审判后，克里斯蒂安·伊曼纽尔·萨农被判有罪，罪名包括密谋杀害莫伊兹。他总共面临八项指控，其中最严重的一项是串谋绑架或杀害美国境外的人。

paras.en: Sanon showed little reaction as the verdict was announced in a federal courtroom in Miami. He faces up to life in prison at sentencing, which is set for Feb. 10. He remains in federal custody and was taken back to a detention centre after the trial concluded.
paras.zh: 当迈阿密联邦法庭宣布判决时，萨农没有做出什么反应。定于 2 月 10 日宣判时，他将面临终身监禁。他仍被联邦拘留，并在审判结束后被带回拘留中心。

paras.en: Prosecutors declined comment afterward. But Sanon's attorney, Zeljka Bozanic, said the defence team was disappointed with the jury's decision and would file an appeal at the appropriate time.
paras.zh: 检察官随后拒绝发表评论。但萨农的律师泽尔卡·博扎尼奇表示，辩护团队对陪审团的决定感到失望，将在适当的时候提出上诉。

paras.en: Haiti has not had a president since authorities said that a squad of mostly retired Colombian soldiers killed Moïse and wounded his wife in a nighttime raid at their home on July 7, 2021. The poorest country in the Americas, Haiti has a history of dictatorship, political upheaval and foreign intervention that has long hindered democratic rule.
paras.zh: 当局表示，2021 年 7 月 7 日，一队大部分是退役的哥伦比亚士兵在夜间袭击莫伊兹的家中杀死了莫伊兹，并打伤了他的妻子，此后海地就没有总统了。海地是美洲最贫穷的国家，有着独裁、政治动乱和外国干预的历史，长期以来阻碍了民主统治。

paras.en: Federal prosecutors said at trial that South Florida was a hub for planning and financing a plot to oust Moïse and install a president of the conspirators' choosing. The prosecutors said Sanon was the conspirators' initial choice for Moïse's replacement. They also said Sanon helped raise money for the conspiracy and arranged travel to Haiti and lodging for himself and others in that country.
paras.zh: 联邦检察官在审判中表示，南佛罗里达州是策划和资助推翻莫伊兹并扶植共谋者选择的总统的阴谋的中心。检察官表示，萨农是共谋者最初选择接替莫伊兹的人选。他们还表示，萨农帮助为这一阴谋筹集资金，并为他自己和该国的其他人安排了前往海地的旅行和住宿。

paras.en: - American Airlines resumes flights to Haiti, providing a vital route into the country
paras.zh: - 美国航空恢复飞往海地的航班，提供通往该国的重要航线

paras.en: - Nearly 6 million people facing severe hunger in Haiti
paras.zh: - 海地近 600 万人面临严重饥饿

paras.en: Sanon had acknowledged in trial testimony that he was in communication at one point with people trying to replace Moïse, but he pointed out that the group had moved on to another candidate long before the assassination. He denied any knowledge of plans to kill Moïse.
paras.zh: 萨农在审判证词中承认，他曾一度与试图取代莫伊兹的人进行过沟通，但他指出，早在暗杀发生之前，该组织就转向了另一位候选人。他否认了解杀害莫伊兹的计划。

paras.en: Sanon was born in Haiti and moved to the U.S. as a teenager. He testified that he worked with churches in Haitian immigrant communities in Florida and the Midwest.
paras.zh: 萨农出生于海地，青少年时期移居美国。他作证说，他与佛罗里达州和中西部海地移民社区的教会合作。

paras.en: A general election in Haiti is scheduled next year for a new president. Candidates include the widow of Moïse, a respected economist, a well-known prosecutor accused of multiple summary executions and a former president accused of drug trafficking and sponsoring gangs.
paras.zh: 海地定于明年举行大选，选出新总统。候选人包括莫伊兹的遗孀、一位受人尊敬的经济学家、一位被指控多次即决处决的著名检察官以及一位被指控贩毒和资助团伙的前总统。

paras.en: Moïse's supporters protest to demand justice a year after the president's assassination in Port-au-Prince, Haiti, in July 2022. (Odelyn Joseph/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 2022 年 7 月，总统在海地太子港遇刺一年后，莫伊兹的支持者举行抗议活动，要求伸张正义。（Odelyn Joseph/美联社）

paras.en: At the trial in Miami, prosecutors said the scheme to kill Moïse included paying about two dozen foreign mercenaries with money obtained from U.S. government programs that were intended to help businesses during the COVID-19 pandemic, according to court records. U.S. prosecutors have charged more than 40 people with crimes related to the assassination and a dozen have been convicted, including five who are serving life sentences.
paras.zh: 根据法庭记录，在迈阿密的审判中，检察官表示，杀害莫伊兹的计划包括向大约两打外国雇佣兵支付从美国政府项目中获得的资金，这些项目旨在在 COVID-19 大流行期间帮助企业。美国检察官已指控 40 多人犯有与暗杀有关的罪行，十几人已被定罪，其中 5 人正在服无期徒刑。

paras.en: The plot to oust Moïse began taking final shape in April 2021, when Sanon met in South Florida with a former Haitian senator and several U.S. businesspeople, according to an indictment. The group agreed that Sanon, once in power, would award contracts to two Florida-based companies — Counter Terrorist Unit Federal Academy and Counter Terrorist Unit Security, collectively known as CTU — for infrastructure projects, security forces and military equipment, according to investigators.
paras.zh: 起诉书称，驱逐莫伊兹的阴谋于 2021 年 4 月开始最终成形，当时萨农在南佛罗里达州与一名前海地参议员和几名美国商人会面。据调查人员称，该组织同意，萨农一旦掌权，将向两家总部位于佛罗里达州的公司——联邦学院反恐单位和安全反恐单位（统称为 CTU）授予基础设施项目、安全部队和军事装备合同。

paras.en: - El Salvador deploys hundreds of soldiers to Haiti: security official
paras.zh: - 萨尔瓦多向海地部署了数百名士兵：安全官员

paras.en: - At least 47 people killed in violent weekend attacks in Haiti, UN says
paras.zh: - 联合国表示，海地周末暴力袭击至少造成 47 人死亡

paras.en: CTU initially hired about 18 Colombian nationals with military training to provide security for Sanon, according to prosecutors. Conspirators also spent months obtaining weapons and body armour and attempting to build ties with Haitian gangs, officials said.
paras.zh: 据检察官称，CTU 最初雇佣了约 18 名受过军事训练的哥伦比亚国民，为萨农提供安全保障。官员称，共谋者还花了几个月的时间获取武器和防弹衣，并试图与海地帮派建立联系。

paras.en: By June 2021, the conspirators realized Sanon had neither the constitutional qualifications nor sufficient popular support to become president. They shifted their support to Wendelle Coq Thélot, a former Haitian Supreme Court judge who died in January 2025 while a fugitive.
paras.zh: 到 2021 年 6 月，阴谋者意识到萨农既不具备成为总统的宪法资格，也没有足够的民众支持。他们将支持转向前海地最高法院法官温德尔·科克·泰洛 (Wendelle Coq Thélot)，她于 2025 年 1 月在逃亡期间去世。

paras.en: Sanon was previously scheduled to be tried with four other men who were convicted earlier this year, but his case was separated from theirs and delayed for health reasons.
paras.zh: 萨农原本计划与今年早些时候被定罪的其他四名男子一起受审，但他的案件与他们的案件分开审理，并因健康原因而被推迟。

paras.en: At the earlier trial, Arcangel Pretel Ortiz, Antonio Intriago, Walter Veintemilla and James Solages were found guilty of conspiring to kill or kidnap the country's elected leader and of providing material support for the plot. They were also convicted of violating the U.S. Neutrality Act and also face possible life sentences. They await sentencing.
paras.zh: 在早些时候的审判中，大天使普雷特尔·奥尔蒂斯、安东尼奥·英特里亚戈、沃尔特·维恩特米拉和詹姆斯·索拉吉被判密谋杀害或绑架该国民选领导人并为该阴谋提供物质支持。他们还被判违反美国中立法案，并可能面临无期徒刑。他们等待宣判。

paras.en: Separately, in late September, 18 suspects arrested in the case were extradited from Haiti to the U.S.
paras.zh: 另外，9月下旬，该案被捕的18名嫌疑人被从海地引渡到美国。

articles.title: Anthropic prices IPO at $83 US per share, valuing AI giant at $1.51 trillion US
articles.author: Jeff Lagerquist

paras.en: Anthropic prices IPO at $83 US per share, valuing AI giant at $1.51 trillion US
paras.zh: Anthropic 将 IPO 定价为每股 83 美元，人工智能巨头估值达 1.51 万亿美元

paras.en: What you need to know about the company as it prepares to debut on Nasdaq
paras.zh: 当该公司准备在纳斯达克上市时，您需要了解该公司的哪些信息

paras.en: Anthropic has set a stock price of $83 US per share for its hotly anticipated initial public offering (IPO), with shares of the U.S. artificial intelligence giant set to debut on the Nasdaq exchange on Thursday.
paras.zh: Anthropic 为其备受期待的首次公开募股 (IPO) 定下每股 83 美元的股价，这家美国人工智能巨头的股票将于周四在纳斯达克交易所上市。

paras.en: At $83 US per share, Anthropic, the company behind the popular Claude chatbot, is valued at approximately $1.51 trillion US, a figure that includes unvested employee stock options and other promised shares.
paras.zh: Anthropic（广受欢迎的 Claude 聊天机器人背后的公司）以每股 83 美元的价格计算，其估值约为 1.51 万亿美元，其中包括未归属的员工股票期权和其他承诺的股票。

paras.en: This surpasses the $70 to $78 US range from Anthropic's Nov. 10 regulatory filing. In a news release Wednesday, the company also upsized its offering by 155 million shares.
paras.zh: 这超出了 Anthropic 11 月 10 日监管文件中 70 至 78 美元的区间。在周三发布的新闻稿中，该公司还将发行数量增加了 1.55 亿股。

paras.en: The debut valuation is massive compared to anything in Canada, representing more than a quarter of the combined market value of every company listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange.
paras.zh: 与加拿大任何公司相比，首次上市估值都很高，占多伦多证券交易所上市公司总市值的四分之一以上。

paras.en: The money raised in the offering alone exceeds every major Canadian IPO combined over the past 30 years.
paras.zh: 仅此次发行筹集的资金就超过了过去 30 年来加拿大每一次大型 IPO 的总和。

paras.en: Ernest Wong, head of research at Toronto-based Baskin Wealth Management, notes that Anthropic dwarfs the most valuable company on the TSX, Royal Bank, which is currently worth $377 billion.
paras.zh: 总部位于多伦多的 Baskin Wealth Management 研究主管 Ernest Wong 指出，Anthropic 令多伦多证券交易所市值最高的公司皇家银行 (Royal Bank) 相形见绌，后者目前的估值为 3,770 亿美元。

paras.en: "That really speaks to the global nature of large U.S. tech companies today," he told CBC News on Wednesday. "These are large companies that touch every aspect of our lives, and the revenue and valuation reflect that."
paras.zh: “这确实说明了当今美国大型科技公司的全球性质，”他周三告诉 CBC 新闻。 “这些大公司涉及我们生活的方方面面，收入和估值反映了这一点。”

paras.en: - Just Asking wants to know: What questions do you have about the AI boom, what it means for the economy, and what happens if this is a bubble that eventually bursts? Send us your questions before our Nov. 21 show.
paras.zh: - Just Ask 想知道：您对人工智能的繁荣有什么疑问，它对经济意味着什么，以及如果这是一个最终破裂的泡沫，会发生什么？在 11 月 21 日展会之前将您的问题发送给我们。

paras.en: The $83 US per share IPO price announced on Wednesday is the price paid by institutional investors and retail buyers who secured pre-IPO allocations through participating brokers. The actual market price will be determined after trading is underway on Thursday.
paras.zh: 周三宣布的每股 83 美元的 IPO 价格是机构投资者和散户买家通过参与经纪商获得 IPO 前分配的价格。实际市场价格将在周四交易后确定。

paras.en: Here's what you should know about the company and its stock market debut.
paras.zh: 以下是您应该了解的有关该公司及其股票上市的信息。

paras.en: Anthropic started as a niche AI research lab in 2021. Its founders left rival OpenAI because they felt that company was too focused on profits, ignoring risks and giving too much control to investors.
paras.zh: Anthropic 成立于 2021 年，是一家小众人工智能研究实验室。其创始人离开了竞争对手 OpenAI，因为他们认为该公司过于关注利润，忽视风险，并给予投资者过多的控制权。

paras.en: The company gained momentum in 2024 when it released the Claude 3.5 Sonnet chatbot. This version beat OpenAI's GPT-4o on major performance benchmarks at a fraction of the cost of previous frontier AI models.
paras.zh: 该公司在 2024 年发布了 Claude 3.5 Sonnet 聊天机器人，势头强劲。该版本在主要性能基准上击败了 OpenAI 的 GPT-4o，而成本仅为之前前沿 AI 模型的一小部分。

paras.en: Unlike other tech giants like Apple or Microsoft, Anthropic is not a traditional for-profit company. It's organized as a public benefit corporation, meaning its board has a legal mandate to balance public safety against maximizing shareholder returns.
paras.zh: 与苹果或微软等其他科技巨头不同，Anthropic 不是一家传统的营利性公司。它是一家公益公司，这意味着其董事会拥有平衡公共安全与股东回报最大化的法律授权。

paras.en: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei is a leading advocate for AI safety, arguing the industry should slow development to let safety measures catch up.
paras.zh: Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei) 是人工智能安全的主要倡导者，他认为该行业应该放慢发展速度，让安全措施迎头赶上。

paras.en: "We will slow down as much as necessary in order to make sure that every successive AI technology that we release is actually safe," he said at a United Nations Security Council meeting on artificial intelligence in September.
paras.zh: 他在 9 月份的联合国安理会人工智能会议上表示：“我们将尽可能放慢速度，以确保我们后续发布的每一项人工智能技术实际上都是安全的。”

paras.en: Under Nasdaq's listing and trading rules, newly listed shares do not begin trading immediately after the 9:30 a.m. ET opening bell.
paras.zh: 根据纳斯达克的上市和交易规则，新上市股票不会在美国东部时间上午 9:30 开盘后立即开始交易。

paras.en: Nasdaq temporarily holds the stock in a price-discovery auction, giving the exchange and bankers leading the sale time to match incoming bids and offers into an opening price.
paras.zh: 纳斯达克暂时在价格发现拍卖中持有该股票，让交易所和主导销售的银行家有时间将传入的出价和报价与开盘价相匹配。

paras.en: Some Canadian brokerages, like Wealthsimple and major bank platforms, had options for everyday investors to request shares in advance at the fixed offer price, prior to the Nasdaq auction.
paras.zh: 一些加拿大经纪公司，如 Wealthsimple 和主要银行平台，可以让普通投资者在纳斯达克拍卖之前以固定报价提前索取股票。

paras.en: However, the supply of shares is often limited, and investors may face holding restrictions or penalties for selling right away.
paras.zh: 然而，股票的供应往往有限，投资者可能会面临持有限制或立即出售的处罚。

paras.en: What do we know about Anthropic's financial performance?
paras.zh: 我们对 Anthropic 的财务业绩了解多少？

paras.en: Anthropic lost $42 billion US in 2025, according to regulatory filings with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.
paras.zh: 根据向美国证券交易委员会提交的监管文件，Anthropic 在 2025 年损失了 420 亿美元。

paras.en: In the first nine months of this year, the company booked an $104 billion US net loss. However, this was largely driven by non-cash accounting charges tied to its soaring pre-IPO valuation.
paras.zh: 今年前9个月，该公司净亏损1040亿美元。然而，这主要是由于与IPO前估值飙升相关的非现金会计费用所致。

paras.en: Meanwhile, sales have been brisk. In the first nine months of 2026, Anthropic generated $33.24 billion US in revenue — a 1,206 per cent increase year-over-year. Its annualized sales pace hit roughly $81 billion US in October.
paras.zh: 与此同时，销售一直很活跃。 2026 年前 9 个月，Anthropic 创造了 332.4 亿美元的收入，同比增长 1,206%。 10 月份其年化销售额约为 810 亿美元。

paras.en: Anthropic also has big spending plans. Unlike Google or Microsoft, Anthropic has historically rented its computing power rather than owning physical data centres. It's locked into roughly $450 billion US in long-term computing and data-centre commitments through 2030.
paras.zh: Anthropic也有庞大的支出计划。与谷歌或微软不同，Anthropic 历来都是租用其计算能力，而不是拥有物理数据中心。到 2030 年，它的长期计算和数据中心承诺约为 4500 亿美元。

paras.en: Since Anthropic is laser-focused on building and selling AI models, its shares are seen as a unique "pure play" on the artificial intelligence boom.
paras.zh: 由于 Anthropic 专注于构建和销售人工智能模型，因此其股票被视为人工智能热潮中独特的“纯粹游戏”。

paras.en: That sets it apart from most stocks associated with AI, which typically have other businesses.
paras.zh: 这使其与大多数与人工智能相关的股票区分开来，这些股票通常还有其他业务。

paras.en: Take Google's parent company Alphabet, for example. It's considered an AI "hyperscaler," but it has a massive suite of non-AI businesses, like YouTube and Android smartphones.
paras.zh: 以谷歌母公司Alphabet为例。它被认为是人工智能“超大规模企业”，但它拥有大量非人工智能业务，例如 YouTube 和 Android 智能手机。

paras.en: AI-related stocks have been on a roller coaster lately, swinging between panic-driven sell-offs and relief rallies.
paras.zh: 人工智能相关股票最近一直在经历过山车般的波动，在恐慌性抛售和救济性反弹之间摇摆。

paras.en: - The Nvidia scandal has wiped away $1T in value. What that means for your investments
paras.zh: - Nvidia 丑闻已经蒸发了 1T 美元的价值。这对您的投资意味着什么

paras.en: - AI stock sell-off sends the S&P 500 down 4.4% in worst day since April 2025
paras.zh: - AI 股票抛售导致标准普尔 500 指数下跌 4.4%，这是 2025 年 4 月以来最糟糕的一天

paras.en: Shares of companies like Oracle, Microsoft, and Amazon saw massive gains through the summer and early fall. Since then, a trio of headwinds have emerged: the leadership crisis at Nvidia; U.S. regulators putting tighter controls on China's access to AI chips; and fears of a data centre slowdown in the U.S. driven by the "blue wave" of Democrat victories in the recent midterm elections.
paras.zh: 甲骨文、微软和亚马逊等公司的股价在夏季和初秋期间出现了大幅上涨。从那时起，出现了三个不利因素：英伟达的领导危机；美国监管机构对中国获取人工智能芯片实施更严格的控制；以及由于民主党在近期中期选举中获胜的“蓝色浪潮”而引发的对美国数据中心放缓的担忧。

paras.en: As a result, the tech-heavy Nasdaq index is down nearly seven per cent over the past month.
paras.zh: 结果，以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数在过去一个月下跌了近 7%。

paras.en: Wong says investors buying Anthropic stock should brace for big price swings early on. He says his firm does not typically buy IPOs, and will take a wait-and-see approach.
paras.zh: Wong表示，购买Anthropic股票的投资者应该尽早做好价格大幅波动的准备。他表示，他的公司通常不会购买首次公开募股，并且会采取观望态度。

paras.en: "I think it's [going to be] very volatile," Wong said. "It really takes some time before the trading of the stock kind of settles into where it's supposed to be."
paras.zh: “我认为它会非常不稳定，”黄说。 “股票交易确实需要一些时间才能稳定下来。”

articles.title: Crimea bridge attacked again, Russian governor says

paras.en: Crimea bridge attacked again, Russian governor says
paras.zh: 俄罗斯州长称克里米亚大桥再次遭到袭击

paras.en: Damage assessment underway after 3rd such attack this week
paras.zh: 本周第三次此类袭击后正在进行损失评估

paras.en: Traffic on the Crimean Bridge was temporarily suspended following an attack, Sergei Aksyonov, Crimea's Russian-installed governor, said on Telegram on Thursday, adding that an assessment of the damage was underway.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯任命的克里米亚州长谢尔盖·阿克肖诺夫 (Sergei Aksyonov) 周四在 Telegram 上表示，袭击发生后，克里米亚大桥上的交通暂时中断，并补充说正在对损失进行评估。

paras.en: The attack was the third this week on the bridge connecting mainland Russia to Crimea, which Russia annexed from Ukraine in 2014. It comes as a blow to President Vladimir Putin ahead of his meetings with U.S. and Chinese counterparts on Thursday.
paras.zh: 这是本周在连接俄罗斯大陆和克里米亚的大桥上发生的第三起袭击事件，克里米亚是俄罗斯于 2014 年从乌克兰吞并的。这对总统弗拉基米尔·普京(Vladimir Putin)来说是一个打击，他将在周四与美国和中国同行会面。

paras.en: The 19-kilometre bridge, inaugurated by Putin in 2018, is a flagship project and a symbol of Russia's attachment to the peninsula.
paras.zh: 这座全长 19 公里的大桥由普京于 2018 年落成，是一个旗舰项目，也是俄罗斯对半岛依恋的象征。

paras.en: Earlier this week, Ukrainian drones and missiles destroyed the central road section of the bridge, causing its main road arch to crumble into the sea and leaving a yawning gap, according to videos and images verified by Reuters.
paras.zh: 据路透社核实的视频和图像显示，本周早些时候，乌克兰无人机和导弹摧毁了大桥的中央路段，导致其主要道路拱门崩塌入海，留下了一个巨大的缺口。

paras.en: Russia launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022. The two countries have been at war ever since.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯于2022年2月对乌克兰发动全面入侵。此后两国一直处于交战状态。

articles.title: Axes and cutlasses: Violence on Nigeria's election campaign trail

paras.en: Samuel Adebanjo had gone to the Oregun area of Lagos, the economic heartbeat of Nigeria, to cover a town hall meeting organized by the opposition party, the National Democratic Congress (NDC). But what was supposed to be a routine reporting assignment took a violent turn when a group of armed men stormed the venue and disrupted the gathering.
paras.zh: 塞缪尔·阿德班乔前往尼日利亚经济中心拉各斯的俄勒冈地区，报道反对党全国民主党大会（NDC）组织的市政厅会议。但当一群武装人员冲进会场并扰乱集会时，本应是例行报道的任务发生了剧烈变化。

paras.en: "I was at the entrance, taking photos of people entering the hall when some buses drove in and I heard a loud bang," Samuel recalled.
